Either relax and explore Las Vegas at your pace or take an optional excursion to the Grand Canyon—one of the world’s natural wonders. Opt for a ground or air tour and don't miss the thrilling SKYWALK experience. You may also enjoy the Las Vegas Night Flight, offering a bird’s-eye view of the illuminated cityscape. Another option is to attend one of the city’s spectacular shows. Overnight in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Las Vegas to Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast before departing for Los Angeles, the world’s entertainment capital. Upon arrival, take a guided city tour that includes Hollywood Boulevard, the Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Grauman’s Chinese Theatre, Rodeo Drive, the Sunset Strip, and vibrant Chinatown. Discover the glitz and glam of this star-studded city before retiring for the night at your Los Angeles hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Universal Studios Hollywood
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, prepare for a thrilling day at Universal Studios. Enjoy cutting-edge attractions and immersive rides that bring your favorite films to life. Step behind the scenes of a working studio, enjoy live-action shows, and explore themed zones designed for all ages. Wrap up the day and spend another night in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Los Angeles to Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast before boarding your flight to Honolulu, the gateway to Hawaii. Upon arrival, enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure. Honolulu is the capital of Hawaii and the largest city across all Pacific islands. Rich in both culture and modern charm, it serves as a key financial and tourism center in the region. Settle into your hotel and relax in paradise. Overnight stay in Honolulu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Pearl Harbor and USS Missouri Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and embark on a memorable visit to historic Pearl Harbor. Explore the USS Missouri and the poignant Arizona Memorial. Your guided tour also includes a drive through Punchbowl National Memorial Cemetery and stops at key downtown landmarks. With pre-arranged access, you can skip the long lines and enjoy seamless transport to and from your hotel. Spend the evening relaxing in Honolulu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Optional Big Island Volcano Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Start with breakfast and, if you choose, take an optional flight to the Big Island for an epic volcano tour. Visit Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, the Jaggar Museum, Thurston Lava Tube, Kilauea Iki Crater, and Rainbow Falls. This full-day adventure includes return airfare, guided transport, and park entry. Return to Honolulu in the evening and enjoy your final night on the island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and prepare for your flight home or onward travel. Your West Coast and Hawaii tour package concludes with unforgettable memories of iconic cities, natural wonders, and island bliss.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: Kickstart your adventure as you arrive in San Francisco—an iconic American city often compared to Paris and London for its charm and cultural blend. With its dramatic hills, scenic bay views, and vibrant neighborhoods, San Francisco offers a stunning first impression. Explore trendy boutiques, savor global cuisine, and enjoy the city’s exciting nightlife. On arrival, transfer to your hotel and relax with an overnight stay in San Francisco.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: San Francisco City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a guided city tour showcasing the best of San Francisco. Walk across the legendary Golden Gate Bridge, admire panoramic views from Twin Peaks, and visit famous spots like Lombard Street, Nob Hill, Civic Center, Union Square, Pier 39, and Fisherman’s Wharf. Don’t miss a photo stop at the elegant Palace of Fine Arts and a glimpse of the historic Cable Cars. Return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Day Trip to Yosemite National Park
package_itineraries.description: Today, set out on an unforgettable excursion to Yosemite National Park. Behold awe-inspiring landscapes shaped by ancient glaciers, including thundering waterfalls, serene lakes, towering cliffs, and giant sequoia trees. Capture memorable views of Half Dome, El Capitan, and Yosemite Falls. After an adventurous day in nature’s masterpiece, head back to San Francisco for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: San Francisco to Las Vegas
package_itineraries.description: Catch a morning flight to the dazzling city of Las Vegas. Upon arrival, check in and later gear up for an exciting evening city tour. Witness the iconic Bellagio Dancing Fountains, the vibrant Fremont Street light show, Pirate Ships at Treasure Island, and the stunning views from the Stratosphere Tower. Soak in the city’s electric atmosphere before heading back for an overnight stay in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Leisure or Optional Grand Canyon Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your day at leisure or join the optional Grand Canyon Tour by bus or air. Marvel at the vast natural wonder and experience the thrilling Skywalk. In the evening, you can opt for the Las Vegas Night Flight—an exhilarating helicopter ride over the glittering Strip—or attend one of Vegas’s many live shows. Overnight in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Las Vegas to Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Los Angeles, the entertainment capital of the world. Embark on a scenic city tour covering top attractions such as Hollywood, the Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Sunset Strip, Grauman’s Chinese Theater, Rodeo Drive, and China Town. After exploring the star-studded city, unwind with an overnight stay in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Universal Studios Tour
package_itineraries.description: Step into the world of movies with a full-day visit to Universal Studios. Enjoy thrilling rides, live-action shows, and behind-the-scenes movie experiences. This working studio lets you see where magic is made and gives you a taste of Hollywood like never before. Stay overnight in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: San Diego – SeaWorld Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today’s adventure takes you to SeaWorld in San Diego, home to thrilling marine life shows, rides, and interactive exhibits. Brave the water coaster through Atlantis, ride a virtual copter to the Wild Arctic, and get up close with dolphins, sea lions, and orcas. After a fun-filled day, return to your Los Angeles hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Disneyland Magic
package_itineraries.description: Delight in a magical day at Disneyland, where fairy tales come to life. Wander through the enchanting Main Street USA, meet beloved characters, and enjoy classic rides and shows. The park’s immersive atmosphere promises fun for all ages. Overnight at your hotel in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning followed by checkout. Proceed to the airport for your onward journey, bringing an end to your memorable Western Explorer Tour Package experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Perth
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Perth Airport, a private transfer will be arranged for you—available if your flight arrives before 10:00 PM. Note: Surcharges may apply for arrivals after 10:00 PM. You'll be taken to your city hotel, where check-in is available (subject to standard check-in times). Relax and enjoy your first overnight stay in Perth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Perth and Fremantle
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a morning half-day SIC tour of Perth and Fremantle (Tour #PF – Daily). The tour ends at Barrack Street Jetty and does not include a return transfer to the hotel. Afterwards, enjoy a self-guided walk to the Perth Mint on Hay Street and join the 3:30 PM guided tour (no transfers provided). Walk back to your hotel and settle in for another night in Perth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rottnest Island Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a full-day Rottnest Island Discovery Tour, featuring a 90-minute high-speed Adventure Eco Express Boat experience and a satisfying lunch at Thomson Rest. (Tour #EC7 – Daily). Please note this activity is not suitable for children under 4. Optional: Rent a bike and helmet for self-guided island exploration (AUD 50 for adults / AUD 15 for children), also not suitable for children under 4. Enjoy another overnight stay in Perth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Pinnacles Desert and Wildlife Experience
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, join a full-day SIC tour featuring the Pinnacles Desert, Caversham Wildlife Park with koala encounters, and an exciting sandboarding and 4WD adventure. The tour includes a Fish & Chips lunch. Return in the evening to your Perth hotel for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Choose Your Full-Day Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Pick from three enriching SIC tour options: Margaret River Tour (Tour #MR): Visit enchanting caves, enjoy wine tasting, stroll the Busselton Jetty, and see Cape Leeuwin Lighthouse. Includes lunch. Wave Rock Tour (Tour #WR): Explore York, Aboriginal sites, and wildflower country with a picnic lunch. Operates TUE/WED/FRI/SUN. Valley of the Giants (Tour #TT): Marvel at giant trees during the Treetop Walk and enjoy a gourmet picnic. Operates only on TUE. Spend your last night at the hotel in Perth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Perth
package_itineraries.description: Following your final breakfast, check out and transfer to Perth Airport by private vehicle for your flight. Note: A surcharge applies for departures before 6:00 AM.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Brisbane/Gold Coast Arrival
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at either Brisbane or Gold Coast Airport by 10:00 AM. Transfer to your hotel. Optional afternoon jet boat ride and fire truck tour (transfers not included). Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Dream World Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Spend a fun-filled day at Dream World. Enjoy rides and attractions before returning to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Wildlife Encounters & SeaWorld
package_itineraries.description: Visit Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary in the morning, followed by an afternoon trip to SeaWorld. Enjoy animal exhibits and marine-themed attractions. Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Movie World Excitement
package_itineraries.description: Experience Movie World with return transfers and a souvenir gift combo. Immerse in the entertainment and thrill. Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Travel to Hamilton Island
package_itineraries.description: Fly from Brisbane to Hamilton Island. Enjoy complimentary resort activities like snorkeling, catamarans, and the Island Shuttle. Overnight on Hamilton Island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Whitehaven Beach Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Visit Wildlife Hamilton Island in the morning, followed by a half-day cruise to Whitehaven Beach. Overnight stay on the island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Great Barrier Reef Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Full-day reef cruise with lunch. Discover the vibrant underwater world before returning to your Hamilton Island resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Hamilton to Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Sydney and transfer to your hotel. Arrive by evening and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Hop-On Hop-Off & Showboat Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Explore Sydney at your pace with a hop-on hop-off bus ticket. In the evening, enjoy an Indian vegetarian dinner aboard the Sydney ShowBoat Cruise. Overnight in Sydney.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Iconic Sights & Attractions
package_itineraries.description: Visit Sydney Opera House for a guided tour. Later, redeem your Combo 4 Pass at Sea Life Aquarium for access to top attractions like Madame Tussauds and Sydney Tower Eye. Return independently to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Departure from Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport. Departure transfers valid only for later flights (after 7:00 AM domestic or 8:00 AM international).

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, receive a warm welcome and transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy as you relax by the beach or pool. Overnight at the resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Navua River Experience
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, followed by a scenic boat trip along the Navua River. Visit traditional villages, see cascading waterfalls, and participate in the traditional ‘Kava’ ceremony. Return to the resort for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Temples, Gardens & Culture
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Sri Siva Subramaniya Temple, the Garden of the Sleeping Giant, and the luxurious Denarau Island. End your day with a serene Nadi sunset cruise. Overnight at the resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Free Day in Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Spend this day as you wish—relax, take part in water sports, or explore nearby shops and cafés.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Farewell Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before your transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Matamanoa Island
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Nadi Airport and transfer to Matamanoa Island Resort. This serene island lets you relax your way—whether lounging by the pool, enjoying watersports, or sipping cocktails at sunset. Overnight at the beautiful Matamanoa Island Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Leisure Time at Matamanoa Island
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day indulging in rest and recreation. Take a stroll along the beach, swim in crystal-clear waters, or simply unwind in your villa. Another night in paradise awaits you.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Explore at Your Own Pace
package_itineraries.description: Your third day at the resort is all about setting your own pace. Revisit your favourite island corners or try something new. Recharge with a good night’s sleep on the island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Travel to Mercure Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Check out from Matamanoa and transfer to Mercure Nadi on the mainland. The evening is yours to relax or explore local markets and eateries. Stay overnight in Nadi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Fiji
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your departure. End your tropical vacation with heartwarming memories of Matamanoa Island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Nadi Arrival and Transfer to Denarau Island
package_itineraries.description: Land at Nadi International Airport and complete immigration and customs formalities. A cheerful “Bula” greeting awaits you from our friendly local representative, along with shell leis, refreshing minted towels, and bottled water. Proceed to a short briefing and voucher collection before meeting your driver for a scenic seat-in-coach transfer to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day unwinding at your leisure. Overnight stay at Denarau Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Denarau Island – Relaxation and Sunset Views
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day enjoying various hotel amenities or opt for an additional excursion. In the evening, set sail on a tranquil Sunset Dinner Cruise and marvel at the tropical horizon. Return for an overnight stay at Denarau Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Denarau Island – Mana Island Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a full-day cruise to Mana Island, inclusive of transfers and lunch. Discover three distinct beaches, swim in warm turquoise waters, and enjoy poolside refreshments. Snorkeling and water activities are available on the lagoon side, while North Beach offers a peaceful retreat. BBQ lunch with side salads is provided. Return and stay overnight at Denarau Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Denarau Island – Adventure and Entertainment
package_itineraries.description: Today, optional experiences include jet boat rides on the Nadi River, parasailing, river safaris, and more. As night falls, explore Denarau’s local nightlife at popular venues like PURPLE HAZE or ICE BAR. Overnight at Denarau Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Denarau Island
package_itineraries.description: Check out early for your transfer to Nadi International Airport to catch your departing flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing in Auckland, you’ll be warmly welcomed by our tour representatives at the airport. They’ll assist you with your transfer and hotel check-in. Once settled, enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Auckland's Iconic Sights
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a visit to Viaduct Harbour, then head to the Harbour Bridge for incredible views. Finish the day at the Michael Joseph Savage Memorial for panoramic scenes of the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Journey from Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo
package_itineraries.description: Travel through the Waikato region to the Waitomo Caves for a magical glowworm boat tour. Later, continue to Rotorua, a city famous for geothermal activity and Maori heritage.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua’s Wonders and Maori Culture
package_itineraries.description: Explore Te Puia’s geysers, experience farm life at Agrodome, and meet native wildlife. Conclude the evening with a traditional Maori Hangi feast and cultural performance.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Rotorua to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Board a domestic flight and head to Christchurch, the largest city in the South Island. Spend the day unwinding and soaking in its serene, garden-filled setting.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Mount Cook and Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Drive through scenic valleys and lakes to reach Mount Cook. Then, head onward to Queenstown—a lively town known for its vineyards, lakes, and adventure sports.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: From New Zealand to Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Depart New Zealand and arrive in Fiji. Discover the Garden of the Sleeping Giant, home to vibrant orchids and tropical flora. Rest in this new island paradise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Explore Local Culture in Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Visit Viseisei Village, one of Fiji’s oldest settlements, or relax by the ocean. Enjoy the local lifestyle and warm island hospitality.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure from Fiji
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your accommodation and head to the airport, concluding your enriching and romantic journey across New Zealand and Fiji.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Saigon – Immersive Saigon City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Saigon, now officially Ho Chi Minh City – a vibrant, bustling heart of Vietnam. Upon landing, transfer to the city centre for hotel check-in. In the evening, begin your sightseeing with the iconic Reunification Palace, an important historical site from the Vietnam War, now preserved as a museum and event venue. Just a short walk away lies the French colonial-era Central Post Office, a masterpiece of architecture. Continue your stroll along Nguyen Hue Street, snapping photos of the Opera House and Ho Chi Minh Committee building (viewed from outside). End the day with a visit to the lively Ben Thanh Market, a true cultural hub where you can explore local crafts and flavours. Overnight stay in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Saigon – Mekong Delta Adventure – Saigon
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off for My Tho in the Mekong Delta. Board a boat to cruise the mighty Mekong River, passing riverside villages and lush landscapes. Stop at one of the four islands to explore its charm before switching to smaller rowboats, drifting along coconut-lined canals. Visit local workshops to taste honey tea, observe coconut candy-making, and walk through fragrant fruit gardens. Experience a relaxing horse-cart ride through peaceful village lanes before enjoying lunch at a riverside restaurant, sampling the local speciality – Elephant Ear fish. On your return to Saigon, visit Vinh Trang Pagoda, famed for its blend of Chinese, Cambodian, and French architecture. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels Exploration – Flight to Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning at the Cu Chi Tunnels, an extraordinary 200-km underground network used by Vietnamese fighters during the war. Gain insight into the resourcefulness and resilience of those who lived here, and, if you wish, crawl through a short tunnel section. In the afternoon, transfer to the airport for your flight to Siem Reap. Upon arrival, meet your local guide for a hotel transfer. The rest of the evening is at leisure. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Full-Day Angkor Temple Discovery
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, step into the ancient world of Angkor. Begin at the South Gate of Angkor Thom, once the royal city of the Khmer Empire, and visit Bayon Temple, a fascinating structure with its serene stone faces. Explore the Terrace of the Elephants, the Terrace of the Leper King, Baphuon, and the Royal Palace area, including Phimeanakas Temple. Wander through Ta Prohm, a photogenic site where massive tree roots intertwine with the temple’s stone walls. In the afternoon, marvel at Angkor Wat, the largest religious monument in the world, with its five lotus-shaped towers, detailed carvings, and graceful Apsara dancers etched into the stone. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi – Cultural Introduction
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Noi Bai Airport and transfer to your hotel. Begin your exploration at the Temple of Literature, built in 1070, followed by a photo stop at Ba Dinh Square to view Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum from outside. Stroll by Hoan Kiem Lake, visit Ngoc Son Temple, and enjoy a cyclo ride around the Old Quarter. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Halong Bay Day Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Travel through the Red River Delta to reach Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Board a wooden junk boat to sail past formations like Stone Dog and Fighting Cock. Enjoy a seafood lunch before visiting Thien Cung Cave or relaxing on board. Return to Hanoi in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi to Saigon – Evening Tour
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Saigon and check into your hotel. Visit the Reunification Palace, pass European-inspired landmarks, and see Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mekong Delta Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Cruise along the Mekong River, visit tropical gardens, listen to traditional folk music, and ride small boats through coconut groves. Explore local workshops and enjoy a horse-cart ride before visiting Vinh Trang Pagoda. Return to Saigon for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Saigon City Tour – Flight to Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Tour the Reunification Palace, City Hall, Opera House, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and the Central Post Office before flying to Siem Reap. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Angkor Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Visit the South Gate of Angkor Thom, Bayon Temple, Terrace of the Leper King, and Ta Prohm. In the afternoon, explore Angkor Wat. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before transferring to the airport for your flight home or onward travel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Phnom Penh – Discover the City’s Historic Heart
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Phnom Penh International Airport, our friendly representative will welcome you and assist with your hotel transfer. After checking in and freshening up, your exploration begins. Your first stop will be the iconic Royal Palace of Cambodia – a splendid complex that serves as the official residence of the King. Just south of the palace lies the dazzling Silver Pagoda, home to an impressive life-sized gold Buddha decorated with over 2,000 diamonds. Continue to the Independence Monument, built to commemorate Cambodia’s liberation from French colonial rule, before visiting the National Museum of Cambodia, the country’s largest repository of cultural treasures. Stroll past the picturesque river-front park, where four rivers meet, and finish your day at Wat Phnom, a serene hilltop Buddhist temple steeped in local legend. Overnight stay in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phnom Penh – Heritage & Local Markets
package_itineraries.description: Begin your morning with a visit to the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum, a deeply moving site that tells the tragic story of Cambodia’s recent history. Once a school, it was converted into Security Prison 21 by the Khmer Rouge between 1975 and 1979. Afterwards, shift to a lighter mood with a shopping excursion at the Russian Market – one of the city’s most vibrant hubs for local handicrafts. Browse through silk fabrics, Buddha statues, wooden carvings, jewellery, paintings, and more. End the day with a hearty dinner before returning to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Phnom Penh to Siem Reap – Journey into Ancient Wonders
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, take a short flight to Siem Reap, the gateway to the legendary temples of Angkor. Upon arrival and hotel check-in, your temple exploration begins. Marvel at Prasat Kravan, known for its exquisite brick sculptures, admire the peaceful beauty of Srah Srang, and visit the intricately carved Banteay Srei, often called the “Citadel of Women.” Continue to Banteay Samre, a restored 11th-century temple, before heading to Wat Bo Pagoda, one of Siem Reap’s oldest and most significant religious sites. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Apsara dance performance at the Apsara Theatre while savouring a delicious dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Siem Reap – Biking Through the Ancient City
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore Siem Reap from a different perspective as you set off on a guided bike tour. Cycle your way to the legendary Angkor Wat complex, visiting iconic sites such as Angkor Thom, the South Gate, Bayon Temple, and the grand Baphuon Temple. Wander along the Terrace of the Elephants and the Terrace of the Leper King, both adorned with fascinating carvings. In the evening, immerse yourself in Siem Reap’s vibrant nightlife or shop for souvenirs at the Angkor Night Market. Treat yourself to a soothing foot massage before heading back to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Siem Reap – Sunrise & Floating Villages
package_itineraries.description: Rise early to witness a breathtaking sunrise over the Angkor area, followed by a scenic boat trip on Tonle Sap Lake, the largest freshwater lake in Southeast Asia. Observe the unique floating villages and the traditional lifestyle of the locals. Before departing, visit Artisans Angkor to discover the artistry behind traditional Khmer crafts. Later, transfer to the airport for your onward journey, marking the end of your unforgettable Cambodia holiday tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Check in and enjoy an evening city tour including the Temple of Literature, Ba Dinh Square, Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum (exterior), and a cyclo ride around the Old Quarter. Visit Ngoc Son Temple by Hoan Kiem Lake. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Halong Bay Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Travel through Red River Delta villages to Halong Bay. Board a wooden boat to cruise past formations like Stone Dog, Incense Burner, and Fighting Cock. Explore Thien Cung Cave before returning to Hanoi. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi Heritage & Flight to Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Ho Chi Minh Complex, One Pillar Pagoda, Tran Quoc Pagoda, Hanoi Flag Tower, and Thang Long Citadel. Fly to Siem Reap. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Angkor Discovery
package_itineraries.description: See the South Gate of Angkor Thom, Bayon Temple, Terrace of the Elephants, Royal Palace, Phimeanakas, Terrace of the Leper King, and Ta Prohm. Visit Angkor Wat in the afternoon. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Beijing International Airport, where you’ll be warmly greeted and transferred to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to relax or explore at your own pace. Overnight stay in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Beijing
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off to witness one of the world’s most famous landmarks — the Great Wall of China at Juyong Pass. Visit a Jade factory to see exquisite craftsmanship, followed by a photo stop at the Olympic Stadium. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Discovering Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before heading out to explore Tiananmen Square, the grand Forbidden City, and the picturesque Summer Palace. Later, browse through the lively Xiushui Market. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Beijing to Xi’an
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, transfer to the airport or train station for your journey to Xi’an. Upon arrival, meet your guide for a transfer to the hotel. In the afternoon, enjoy a city tour featuring a photo stop at the City Wall. Overnight stay in Xi’an.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Xi’an to Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a visit to the famous Terracotta Warriors and a tour of a crockery factory. Afterward, transfer to the airport for your flight to Shanghai. Upon arrival, you’ll be taken to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Exploring Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: This morning, discover Shanghai’s highlights, including People’s Square, a Silk factory, the Shanghai Museum, and panoramic city views from the 88th floor of Jinmao Tower. End the tour at the iconic Bund before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit the Jade Buddha Temple and the bustling Taobao Market. Later, enjoy shopping along Nanjing Road. Overnight in Shanghai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure from Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast before transferring to the airport for your departure flight or continue with optional activities.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong – Transfer to Macao
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Hong Kong International Airport, proceed to the pier for a scenic ferry ride to the charming city of Macao. After arriving, check in at your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the surroundings on your own. Overnight stay in Macao.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Macao – Half-Day Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning with a guided half-day city tour, covering famous spots such as the Ruins of St. Paul’s, A-Ma Temple, a local Cake Shop, and the Macao Tower (Observation Deck ticket not included), followed by a visit to one of the city’s casinos. The remainder of the day is free for personal activities. Overnight stay in Macao.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Macao to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, head to the pier for a ferry transfer to Hong Kong. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight stay in Hong Kong. (B)

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hong Kong – Half-Day City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a half-day sightseeing trip featuring the Water Front, a Jewellery Workshop, and a bus journey up to Victoria Peak. The evening is yours to enjoy freely. Overnight stay in Hong Kong. Optional: Visit Madame Tussauds independently for USD 24 per person.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hong Kong – Full Day at Disneyland
package_itineraries.description: Spend an entire day at Hong Kong Disneyland, enjoying rides, themed attractions, parades, and character meet-and-greets. Cap off the experience with shopping and dining. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Hong Kong to Shenzhen
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the pier and take the ferry to Shenzhen. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and explore at your leisure. Overnight stay in Shenzhen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Shenzhen – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today’s sightseeing includes Window of the World, Lianhua Park, a Bamboo Shop visit, and shopping at Luohu Mall. Overnight stay in Shenzhen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Farewell to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Begin your morning with a delicious breakfast. Afterward, transfer to the pier for your ferry ride to Hong Kong Airport. From here, board your flight for the journey back to your hometown, carrying with you wonderful memories of the trip.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Hong Kong International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the day exploring nearby attractions — ride the cable car to Victoria Peak for panoramic city views, browse local flea markets, or visit Madame Tussauds. Sample the city’s bistros or fine-dining restaurants.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover the city’s highlights, including Aberdeen Fishing Village, Repulse Bay, Tian Tan Buddha, Ngong Ping 360, and Nan Lian Garden. If time permits, visit Hong Kong Disneyland. Overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hong Kong – Macau
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take the ferry to Macau. Known as the “Las Vegas of the East,” the city is famous for casinos, luxury hotels, and nightlife. Check in to your hotel and explore the area.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Macau – Full-Day Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Macau Tower Convention and Entertainment Centre, the Ruins of St. Paul’s, Senado Square, A-Ma Temple, and the Macao Giant Panda Pavilion. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Macau
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel back to Hong Kong for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Beijing and transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is free for leisure. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Great Wall at Juyong Pass, the Jade Factory, and the Silk Factory. Stop for photos at the Olympic Stadium. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Explore Tiananmen Square, the Forbidden City, and the Summer Palace. Shop at Yaxiu Market. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Beijing to Zhangjiajie
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Zhangjiajie and transfer to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Zhangjiajie
package_itineraries.description: Visit Tianzi Mountain by cable car, then continue to Yuanjiajie Mountain via the Bailong Elevator. Overnight in Zhangjiajie.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Zhangjiajie to Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: See the Glass Bridge and Tianmen Mountain before flying to Shanghai. Transfer to your hotel upon arrival. Overnight in Shanghai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Tour the Jade Buddha Temple and Silk Factory, stroll along the Bund, ascend the Jinmao Tower, and shop along Nanjing Road. Overnight in Shanghai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure from Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Ride the magnetic train to Pudong International Airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Beijing, meet your guide, and transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to explore. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Beijing
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the Great Wall at Juyong Pass, explore a Jade factory, and stop for photos at the Olympic Stadium. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Start with a visit to Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City, followed by the Summer Palace. Later, browse Xiushui Market. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Beijing to Xian
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, transfer to the airport or train station for your journey to Xi’an. On arrival, enjoy a city tour with stops at the City Wall and the Big Wild Goose Pagoda square, including a fountain show. Overnight in Xi’an.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Xi’an to Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore the Terracotta Warriors and a crockery factory before flying to Shanghai. Transfer to your hotel and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Exploring Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Join a full-day city tour covering People’s Square, a Silk factory, the Shanghai Museum, the 88th floor of Jinmao Tower, and the Bund. Enjoy shopping at Nanjing Road. Overnight in Shanghai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong – Transfer to Macau
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Hong Kong International Airport and transfer to the pier for a ferry ride to Macau. After check-in, the day is yours to explore. Overnight in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Macao – Half-Day Sightseeing Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning with a delicious breakfast before setting out on a fascinating half-day exploration of Macao. Discover some of the city’s most celebrated landmarks, including the historic Ruins of St. Paul’s, the serene A-Ma Temple, a charming Cake Shop, and the impressive Macao Tower (please note: Observation Deck admission not included). Round off the tour with a peek into the city’s vibrant casino culture. The rest of the day is free for you to explore on your own. Spend the night in comfort at your hotel in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Macau to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take the ferry to Hong Kong, check in to your hotel, and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hong Kong – Morning City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Waterfront, visit a Jewellery Workshop, and ride a bus to Victoria Peak. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Hong Kong. Optional: Visit Madame Tussauds on your own for USD 24 per person.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hong Kong – Full Day Disneyland Experience
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Hong Kong Disneyland, enjoying attractions, live shows, parades, and themed zones. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your return journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tokyo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Narita Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tokyo – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, assemble at designated points and head to Hamamatsucho Bus Terminal. Discover Tokyo highlights including Tokyo Tower, a traditional tea ceremony, and a Japanese-style lunch. Visit Imperial Palace Plaza, Nijubashi Bridge, Hinode Pier, and enjoy a Sumida River Cruise. Explore Asakusa’s Sensoji Temple and Nakamise Street before returning at your own pace. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tokyo – Mt. Fuji & Hakone
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, meet at the hotel and travel by bus to Mt. Fuji 5th Station, perched 2,300m above sea level. Savor lunch and enjoy a cruise on Lake Ashi with Mt. Fuji views. Ride the Komagatake Ropeway for panoramic sights before returning to Tokyo. Tour ends at Ginza where you return independently to your hotel. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Tokyo to Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast at the hotel before making your way to Tokyo Station. Board the Shinkansen Nozomi 27 to Kyoto. Check into your hotel and enjoy free time. Overnight in Kyoto.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kyoto to Nara and Back
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a guided city tour of Kyoto including Nijo Castle, Kinkaku-ji Temple, and Kyoto Imperial Palace (Mon–Fri) or Kitano Tenmangu Shrine (weekends and holidays). After lunch, travel to Nara to see Todai-ji Temple, Nara Park, Kasuga Taisha Shrine, and Nara Nagomikan. Return to Kyoto and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast and transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong – Macau
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Hong Kong International Airport, you will be transferred via ferry to Macau. Once there, check in to your hotel and take the evening to relax at leisure. Spend your first night enjoying the calm atmosphere before your adventure begins.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Macau
package_itineraries.description: Start with a hearty breakfast, then explore iconic landmarks such as the Ruins of St. Paul’s Church and Senado Square, both central to Macau’s history. Visit the Portuguese Cathedral for a spiritual pause before continuing to Na Tcha Temple and the A-Ma Temple. In the evening, savour a delicious Indian dinner before heading back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Macau to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the ferry terminal for your ride to Hong Kong. Upon arrival, you will be escorted to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to relax or take a stroll through the city at your own pace before an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Explore Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before beginning a half-day guided tour of Hong Kong Island. Visit Victoria Peak for sweeping city views and the famous Man Mo Temple. Stroll through Aberdeen Fishing Village, discover Repulse Bay’s charm, and stop at the Hong Kong Jewelry Factory. Wrap up with Madame Tussauds, where wax figures of global icons create a fascinating experience. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Exploring Hong Kong Ocean Park
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off for Ocean Park, one of the world’s top marine theme parks. Enjoy cable car rides, thrill rides, and an impressive aquarium. Meet pandas, dolphins, and sea lions as part of the park’s wildlife attractions. At the end of the day, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Magical Day at Hong Kong Disneyland
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast before travelling to Disneyland. Encounter walking cartoon characters, themed rides, and shows that bring fairytales to life. Relish a tasty dinner at a local Indian restaurant before heading back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Hong Kong Farewell
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and dedicate your final day to shopping at local markets or malls. In the evening, you will be transferred to the airport for your return journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Once you arrive at Hong Kong Airport, you will be greeted by a local representative who will escort you to your hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is free for leisure—take time to rest, stroll nearby attractions, or simply relax at the hotel. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After a delicious breakfast, set out on a half-day sightseeing journey. Visit the scenic Waterfront, discover craftsmanship at a Jewellery Workshop, and enjoy panoramic views from Victoria Peak. The rest of the day is left open for shopping or personal exploration. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Farewell to Hong Kong – Hello, Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Today you will board a flight to Jeju Island, Korea’s largest volcanic island and a UNESCO World Natural Heritage site. Famous for its pleasant climate and stunning natural scenery, Jeju is known for beaches, cliffs, waterfalls, and lava caves. Recognised as a Global Geopark and one of the New 7 Wonders of Nature, the island offers a memorable welcome. Overnight stay at a hotel in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Discovering Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast and enjoy leisure time or join the optional West Jeju tour (available Mon/Wed/Fri). Highlights include Hyupjae Beach with its clear waters, Hanlim Park showcasing vast botanical gardens, and O’Sulloc Green Tea Field where you can learn about traditional Korean tea culture. The day ends with a hotel drop-off. Overnight stay in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Explore Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: This day is also free or can be used for an optional East Jeju tour (Tue/Thu/Sat). Experience horse-riding or visit the Horse Museum, explore Seongup Folk Village, and stop at Gwangchigi Beach. Watch the Woman Diver show, a UNESCO Intangible cultural heritage, and continue to Sunrise Peak, one of Jeju’s most famous UNESCO sites. The tour also includes Manjang Cave, Asia’s longest lava cave. Overnight stay in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Farewell to Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you will be transferred to the airport for your return journey home or onward connection, concluding your delightful trip.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Land at Incheon Airport, meet your guide, and transfer to your hotel. In the evening, explore Myeongdong’s shopping lanes or Itaewon’s bustling dining scene. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Seoul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off on a guided city tour with lunch included. Highlights: Joggye Temple, Blue House, Gyeongbok Palace with Guard Ceremony, Insadong antique street, Korean Ginseng or Amethyst shopping, Namdaemun Market, and Changdeok Palace. Tour ends by 17:00. Overnight stay in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Seoul – DMZ Tour & Optional Excursions
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then head on a half-day DMZ tour (08:00–14:00, closed Mondays). Stops include Imjingak Park, Unification Bridge, 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station, and a shopping stop. Drop-off at Itaewon street. Optional tours include Nami Island & Petit France (USD 140) or Everland Theme Park (USD 140). Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Seoul to Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a morning flight to Jeju Island. Transfer to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Eastern Jeju Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, join an optional shared tour (available Tue, Thu, Sat). Activities include horse riding, Seongup Folk Village, and visits to local attractions showcasing Jeju’s traditional culture. Overnight in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Farewell to Jeju
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then fly back to Seoul for your transfer to Incheon Airport and your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Incheon Airport, meet your guide and transfer comfortably to your hotel. In the evening, explore the streets filled with Indian restaurants, vibrant Myeongdong shopping district, and the lively Itaewon street, known for its international dining and nightlife. Rest overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discovering Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day at leisure or join the optional Palace Tour (USD 95 per person). The guided tour begins at 09:00 with a visit to Joggye Buddhist Temple and a drive past the Presidential Blue House. Highlights include Gyeongbok Palace with the Royal Guard Changing Ceremony, Insadong antique street, a local lunch, Namdaemun Traditional Market, and Changdeok Palace. The day ends around 17:00 with a return to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Seoul
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you may relax or join the optional DMZ Half Day Tour (USD 70 per person, closed on Mondays and holidays). Starting at 07:50, this guided trip covers Imjingak Park, Unification Bridge ID check, DMZ theatre & exhibition hall, the 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station, and a visit to a Ginseng or Amethyst shop. The tour ends around 14:00 at Itaewon street, leaving you free to explore before returning to the hotel independently.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Seoul to Busan
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then board a train to Busan. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy leisure time. Overnight in Busan.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Busan to Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Catch a morning flight to Jeju Island and check in at your hotel. The rest of the day is free for personal exploration.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Jeju Island Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, relax or join the optional western Jeju tour (USD 105 per person). Visit Hyupjae Beach, Hanlim Park with its botanical gardens, and O’Sulloc Green Tea Field for a taste of Korea’s tea culture. The tour runs from 09:00 to 17:00. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast, then fly to Seoul and transfer to Incheon Airport for your international departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Incheon Airport where your guide will greet you. Transfer to your hotel and relax. In the evening, stroll through Myeongdong shopping street and the dynamic Itaewon area filled with restaurants and nightlife. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Seoul
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, spend the day at leisure or join the optional Palace Tour (USD 94 per person, including lunch). This guided trip includes Joggye Temple, Blue House view, Gyeongbok Palace with Royal Guard Ceremony, Insadong antique street, Namdaemun Market, Ginseng or Amethyst shopping, and Changdeok Palace. The tour runs from 09:00–17:00. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Seoul – Day of Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then explore freely or choose optional tours: DMZ Half Day Tour (USD 75): Includes Imjingak Park, 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station. Nami Island & Petit France Tour (USD 145): Includes visits to the filming sites of Winter Sonata and My Love from the Star. Everland Tour (USD 145): A full day of fun at South Korea’s largest theme park. After your chosen activity, return for an overnight stay in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Farewell to Seoul
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hilo
package_itineraries.description: Land at Hilo International Airport, where friendly representatives will welcome you and assist with your hotel transfer. Complete your check-in and spend the rest of the day relaxing at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Volcanoes National Park – Hilo – Wailuku River State Park
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day exploring Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, home to two active giants—Kīlauea and Mauna Loa. Continue to Akatsuka Orchid Gardens and enjoy the exotic blooms before visiting a Macadamia Nut Farm. Spend time at Richardson Ocean Park for swimming and snorkelling. Later, witness the beauty of Wailuku River State Park, King Kamehameha Statue, and Rainbow Falls before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leisure Day
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, choose between a peaceful day of rest or engage in thrilling water sports and beachside activities.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Akaka Falls State Park – Lava Tree State Monument – Hilo
package_itineraries.description: Discover the enchanting Akaka Falls State Park with its famous cascades—Akaka and Kahuna Falls. Wander through Nani Mau Gardens, filled with tropical blooms. Explore Lava Trees State Monument, where lava formations preserve the shapes of once-standing trees. End the day at the Kapoho Tide Pools and Kalapana Beach before heading back.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hilo – Maui – Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Travel to the island of Maui, a haven of scenic beaches, lush parks, and adventurous hiking trails. By evening, make your way to Honolulu for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Pearl Harbor – Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a visit to the historic Pearl Harbor, the most significant landmark in the Hawaiian Islands. Pay respects at the USS Arizona Memorial, the final resting place of sailors who perished during the 1941 attack. Later, return to Honolulu and relax.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Exploring Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out to explore Honolulu’s iconic landmarks, including Iolani Palace, Kawaiahaʻo Church, Honolulu Hale, and the National Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Free Day in Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Spend your day shopping, relaxing by the beach, or simply enjoying the city’s vibrant vibe.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and head to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Manila
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Manila where a warm reception awaits. You’ll be escorted to your hotel for check-in and an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Manila
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before embarking on a city tour. Visit Makati’s financial district, Fort Bonifacio, and the American Cemetery. Explore Rizal Park, dedicated to Dr. Jose Rizal, then stroll through the Walled City of Intramuros. Admire San Agustin Church, Casa Manila, and Fort Santiago. Later, explore Quiapo’s bustling markets and end the day at the Chinese Cemetery, where ornate mausoleums reflect a blend of Buddhist and Christian traditions. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Manila to Coron, Palawan
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your flight to Palawan. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy the day at leisure. Overnight in Coron.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Coron Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Set out on an island-hopping experience in Coron. Marvel at the crystal waters of Kayangan Lake, the striking Twin Lagoons, and the breathtaking seascapes. Snorkel and swim before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight back to Manila, carrying home unforgettable memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Manila
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Manila and transfer to your hotel for check-in. Overnight stay in Manila.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Manila Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Start with Makati’s highlights including Fort Bonifacio. Move on to Rizal Park, Intramuros, San Agustin Church, Casa Manila, and Fort Santiago. Visit Quiapo’s busy market and the Chinese Cemetery before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Manila to Cebu
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Cebu in the morning. Upon arrival, transfer to your resort and spend the day relaxing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cebu Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Temple of Leah, Celosia Flower Farm, local markets, and Terrazas de Flores, showcasing hundreds of blooming flower species. Overnight stay in Cebu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your onward flight, taking with you lasting memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Taipei International Airport and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, the rest of the day is yours to relax or explore. Overnight stay in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Half-Day Taipei City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided half-day tour. Visit Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, Presidential Square (drive past), Martyrs’ Shrine, and National Palace Museum. Explore a Taiwanese temple and admire handicrafts at the Taipei Handicraft Centre. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before checking out. Transfer to Taoyuan International Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Reach Kuala Lumpur - Petronas Twin Towers - KL Bird Park
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Kuala Lumpur and transfer to your hotel. Begin your sightseeing with iconic landmarks such as the Petronas Twin Towers, Batu Caves, the bustling Petaling Street market, and the Kuala Lumpur Bird Park, which spans over 20 acres and houses thousands of bird species.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cameron Highlands - Boh Tea Plantation - Cameron Lavender Garden
package_itineraries.description: Travel to the cool, lush Cameron Highlands, one of Malaysia’s most beloved hill stations. Visit the Boh Tea Plantation, the largest in Southeast Asia, and enjoy the panoramic views of the tea terraces. Later, explore the Cameron Lavender Garden, where colorful lavender and tropical flowers bloom year-round.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cameron Highlands Butterfly Farm - Time Tunnel Museum
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at the Cameron Highlands Butterfly Farm, home to butterflies, reptiles, and small animals. Continue to the Time Tunnel Museum, an interactive place filled with nostalgic memorabilia and displays that reflect Malaysia’s history.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Pangkor Laut Island – Jungle Trekking
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Pangkor Laut Island by speedboat and check into the luxurious resort. After lunch, embark on a guided jungle trek, where you’ll discover the island’s flora and fauna in their natural habitat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Water Sports – Sunset View Chalet - Fisherman’s Cove
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy thrilling water sports such as kayaking, paddleboarding, or wakeboarding. In the evening, visit the Sunset View Chalet to feed hornbills before savoring a seafood dinner at the popular Fisherman’s Cove.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Coral Beach - Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Relax at Coral Beach, one of Pangkor’s most serene coastal stretches. Later, explore Chinatown, where you can sample authentic Chinese dishes and shop for local specialties.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Langkawi - Langkawi Cable Car - Langkawi Wildlife Park
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Langkawi, transfer to your hotel. Start your journey with the Langkawi Cable Car ride, which takes you up 650 metres for spectacular aerial views. End the day at Langkawi Wildlife Park, where you can interact with over 150 animal species.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Pantai Cenang Beach - Paradise 3D Museum - Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls
package_itineraries.description: Relax at Pantai Cenang Beach, a lively stretch with cafes and water activities. Continue to the Paradise 3D Museum, one of the world’s largest, before finishing the day at the majestic Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Reach Kuala Lumpur - Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Kuala Lumpur and begin sightseeing with Malacca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the evening, marvel at the Petronas Twin Towers, the city’s most iconic landmark.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: KL Bird Park - Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Batu Caves, followed by the National Mosque of Malaysia. Later, visit KL Bird Park and enjoy the wide variety of exotic bird species.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Kuala Lumpur International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Begin exploring Kuala Lumpur with visits to the Petronas Twin Towers, Thean Hou Temple, Central Market, and Batu Caves. In the evening, enjoy the Kuala Selangor Fireflies Tour, a magical sight of glowing fireflies.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kuala Lumpur - Langkawi
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Langkawi and check into your hotel. Spend the rest of the day enjoying beach activities such as jet skiing, parasailing, or snorkeling.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Langkawi Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Langkawi’s highlights including the Langkawi Sky Bridge, Dataran Lang, Telaga Tujuh Waterfall, and Underwater World Langkawi. Visit Kuah Town and Atma Alam Batik Art Village before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Langkawi Day 2
package_itineraries.description: Set out for a mangrove and geopark tour, a UNESCO site. Cruise along the Kilim River, spot sea eagles, and explore bat caves. Learn about rare plants like the Cycad Langkawiensis while admiring the island’s diverse birdlife.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Langkawi
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Langkawi International Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Reach Kuala Lumpur - Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing in Kuala Lumpur, head to your hotel. Begin your journey with a visit to Malacca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its history and architecture. End the day at the Petronas Twin Towers, Kuala Lumpur’s iconic landmark.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: KL Bird Park - Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Batu Caves, a spiritual and cultural hub, followed by the National Mosque of Malaysia. Later, head to the KL Bird Park, a massive aviary home to over 3,000 birds from around the world.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Kota Kinabalu - Lok Kawi Wildlife Park - Tanjung Aru Beach
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Kota Kinabalu and begin exploring with a visit to the Lok Kawi Wildlife Park. In the evening, unwind at Tanjung Aru Beach, famous for its beautiful sunsets.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Sabah State Museum - Kota Kinabalu City Mosque
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at the Sabah State Museum, which houses cultural treasures, followed by the Floating Mosque, one of Kota Kinabalu’s most striking landmarks.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Mount Kinabalu
package_itineraries.description: Witness the grandeur of Mount Kinabalu, Malaysia’s highest peak at 4,101 meters, known as one of the most accessible mountains in the world.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bangkok – Phuket – Fantasea Show
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Phuket Airport, meet our representative for your transfer to the hotel. Phuket, the largest island in Thailand, is surrounded by the Andaman Sea and known for its lush scenery. Spend the afternoon relaxing at your resort before enjoying the spectacular Phuket Fantasea Show in the evening. Overnight in Phuket.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phuket – Phi-Phi Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, board an express boat to the stunning Phi-Phi Islands. Visit Maya Bay, snorkel at Coral Bay, and enjoy swimming in crystal-clear waters. After lunch, return to Phuket for an evening at leisure. Overnight in Phuket.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Phuket – Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, fly to Bangkok. Embark on a half-day city tour, visiting iconic temples like Wat Pho (Reclining Buddha), Wat Trimit (Solid Gold Buddha), and Wat Benchamabopit (Marble Temple). Stop by the Gems and Jewelry centre before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bangkok – Safari World
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before visiting Safari World, divided into Safari Park and Marine Park. Encounter wildlife in the open zoo, then enjoy entertaining shows such as the Dolphin Show, Bird Show, and Sea Lion Show. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bangkok Departure
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast, shop at Indhira Market, and transfer to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Phuket
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Phuket International Airport, meet your guide and transfer to your hotel. Known for its beaches and stunning Andaman coastline, Phuket is a great place to unwind. Enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure. Optional Activity: Attend the Fantasea Show – a grand Thai cultural performance featuring magical effects, elephants, and theatrical storytelling (extra charge).

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phi Phi Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a ferry to the world-renowned Phi Phi Islands. Soak up the beauty of white sand beaches, towering limestone cliffs, and clear turquoise waters. Lunch is included. Return to Phuket in the evening and relax at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Fly from Phuket to Pattaya via Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Bangkok. From there, continue to Pattaya and check in at your hotel. The remainder of the day is free to explore or relax. Overnight stay in Pattaya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Coral Island Excursion from Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast and embark on a speedboat ride to Coral Island. Discover the underwater world through a glass-bottom boat and enjoy water activities like parasailing. Lunch is provided, and your evening is free for leisure. Overnight stay in Pattaya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Transfer to Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Bangkok and check in to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours. Optional Tour: Chao Phraya River Cruise with Dinner – Enjoy a buffet, live entertainment, and beautiful city views from the river (extra cost).

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Bangkok Temple Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today’s city tour begins after breakfast. Visit Wat Traimit (Golden Buddha) and Wat Benchamabophit (Marble Temple), known for its exquisite architecture and serene atmosphere. Optional Visit: Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World and Madame Tussauds – One of Southeast Asia's largest aquariums and a popular wax museum featuring global celebrities (additional cost). Stay overnight in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you'll be transferred to Bangkok International Airport for your onward journey. Take home memories of adventure, culture, and relaxation.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Phuket – Phuket Fantasea Show
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Phuket Airport, our team will escort you to your resort. Phuket, Thailand’s largest island, is surrounded by the sparkling Andaman Sea. After settling in, enjoy the spectacular Fantasea Show in the evening, which combines traditional Thai culture with advanced technology and vibrant stage performances. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phi Phi Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off by express boat to the breathtaking Phi Phi Islands. Visit Maya Bay, famous for its scenic beauty. For those interested in marine life, Coral Bay offers snorkelling opportunities with a chance to spot tropical fish. Enjoy time on the Sun Deck before heading back to Phuket. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: James Bond Island Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast before heading to James Bond Island, located in Phang Nga Bay. Known for its appearance in "The Man with the Golden Gun," this location features towering limestone cliffs and emerald-green waters. Explore caves, enjoy canoeing, or simply soak in the panoramic views before returning to Phuket for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Phuket
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast and enjoy the morning at your own pace. Whether you relax at the resort or explore nearby attractions, the day is yours. Later, you will be transferred to Phuket International Airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bangkok – Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Bangkok and travel to Pattaya. In the evening, enjoy the Alcazar Show with its vibrant costumes and music.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Visit Coral Island via glass-bottom boat and enjoy water sports like parasailing and snorkelling. Return to the city for shopping before heading back to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Pattaya to Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Bangkok for a half-day city tour covering Wat Pho, Wat Trimit, and the Marble Temple. Visit the Gems and Jewelry Shop before spending the rest of the day at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bangkok – Safari World
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Safari World, featuring an open zoo and Marine Park with shows including dolphins, birds, and sea lions. Return to your hotel afterward.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bangkok Departure
package_itineraries.description: Shop at Indhira Market before your transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Saigon and take an evening tour of the Reunification Palace, Central Post Office, Notre Dame Cathedral, Nguyen Hue Street, and Ben Thanh Market. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Saigon - Mekong Delta - Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Cruise along the Mekong River , visit islands, enjoy honey tea, taste coconut candy, and ride a horse-cart through a village. Stop at Vinh Trang Pagoda before returning to Saigon. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Saigon - Cu Chi Tunnels
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Cu Chi Tunnels , with the option to crawl through narrow passages. Evening free for shopping at Ben Thanh Market, Saigon Square, or Diamond Plaza. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport after breakfast for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Hanoi and begin a city tour featuring the Temple of Literature , Ba Dinh Square , and the Old Quarter by cyclo, including a visit to Ngoc Son Temple . Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi - Tam Coc - Hoa Lu - Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Head to Ninh Binh for a boat trip through the Tam Coc caves and a visit to the ancient capital Hoa Lu . See temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le. Lunch included. Return to Hanoi for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi to Halong
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Halong Bay , a UNESCO Natural World Heritage site. Cruise among limestone cliffs, visit caves, and enjoy swimming or kayaking. Dinner and overnight on board.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Halong – Hanoi – Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Cruise back to Halong Wharf, passing by Cock-Fighting Rock, Sail Island, and other famous islets. Return to Hanoi and fly to Saigon . Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Saigon – Mekong Delta – Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Mekong Delta with boat trips, island visits, local factory stops, honey tea tasting, and a horse-cart ride. Visit Vinh Trang Pagoda before returning to Saigon. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Cu Chi Tunnels , a wartime relic. In the evening, explore Saigon’s shopping spots such as Ben Thanh Market, Saigon Square, or Diamond Plaza. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast at the hotel before your airport transfer.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi and City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Hanoi International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Begin your sightseeing with the Temple of Literature , followed by a visit to the historic Ba Dinh Square . Take a leisurely cyclo ride around the Old Quarter , with a stop at Ngoc Son Temple . Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi to Halong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Halong Bay , passing through the rural landscapes of the Red River delta. Board your cruise to explore limestone caves, floating villages, and unique karst islands. Lunch and dinner are served on the boat. Overnight stay on board.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Halong – Hanoi – Danang – Hoi An
package_itineraries.description: Rise early to watch the sunrise over the bay. Cruise past fascinating islands such as Sail Island and Butterfly Rock before returning to Hanoi. Transfer to the airport for your flight to Danang , and upon arrival, proceed to Hoi An Ancient Town . Overnight in Hoi An.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hoi An City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Hoi An’s Japanese Bridge , ancient houses, Chinese Assembly Halls, and traditional markets by the Thu Bon River. Enjoy local crafts, lantern shopping, and perhaps a bike ride to Cua Dai Beach. Overnight in Hoi An.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hoi An to Hue City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel via the scenic Hai Van Pass , stopping to admire Lang Co Beach . In Hue, visit the Royal Citadel, Forbidden City, Hue Royal Museum, Thien Mu Pagoda, and the Tombs of King Tu Duc . Overnight in Hue.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: From Hue to Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) . Visit the Reunification Palace, Notre Dame Cathedral, Central Post Office, Opera House, and Ben Thanh Market. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore the Cu Chi Tunnels , a network of underground passages used during the Vietnam War. Return to Saigon and enjoy shopping at Ben Thanh Market, Saigon Square, or Diamond Plaza . Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Saigon - Mekong Delta - Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a boat trip in My Tho , cruising along the Mekong River . Explore canals lined with coconut palms, enjoy honey tea, taste coconut candy, and take a horse-cart ride through a village. Visit Vinh Trang Pagoda before returning to Saigon. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Depart Saigon
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Tashkent International Airport, you will be greeted warmly and transferred to your hotel for check-in. After a refreshing rest, enjoy a delightful lunch at an Indian restaurant. In the afternoon, set out on a guided city tour of Tashkent, visiting Independence Square, Amir Temur Square, Broadway Street, Lal Bahadur Shastri Monument, and the Victory Monument . The evening is reserved for a Cocktail Gala dinner, complete with an enchanting belly dance performance. Overnight stay at your hotel in Tashkent.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Excursion to Charvak Mountains
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a scenic drive to the Chimgan Mountains.
