On the way, admire breathtaking landscapes and experience a thrilling cable car ride with views of snow-capped peaks. Continue your journey to Chirwak Lake and Charvak Mountains , where you can relax and soak in the natural beauty. Pause for a buffet lunch by the lakeside before returning to Tashkent. Overnight stay at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Exploring Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel’s café. Your morning includes a visit to a viewpoint offering panoramic views of Tashkent. Later, enjoy sightseeing at the Tashkent TV Tower , followed by leisure time for shopping at Zoom Mall and Chorsu Bazaar , two of the city’s most vibrant shopping destinations. After lunch, continue exploring local markets before heading back to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: Relish your final breakfast in Tashkent. Afterward, you will be transferred to the airport for your departure flight, carrying cherished memories of your Uzbekistan adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Vienna
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Vienna, you will be greeted and escorted to your hotel. After checking in, the rest of the day is yours to relax and unwind. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off on a Grand City Tour of Vienna. Explore the famous Ringstrasse boulevard and admire highlights such as the State Opera House, Parliament, National Theatre, Votive Church, City Hall, and Urania. Visit the magnificent Schönbrunn Palace for an inside tour, followed by a stop at Belvedere Palace. The tour concludes at the Opera, leaving your afternoon free for independent exploration. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Day Trip to Salzburg
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast and travel west through the Salzkammergut Lake District to reach Salzburg. Pause in Gmunden and enjoy the alpine scenery before arriving in Salzburg for lunch and shopping. A guided city tour will cover highlights like Fortress Hohensalzburg, Salzburg Cathedral, Festival Halls, Mozart’s Birthplace, Getreidegasse, and Mirabell Gardens. Return to Vienna in the evening and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Vienna to Prague
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and board your train to Prague. The scenic journey takes about four hours. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring at your own pace. Overnight stay in Prague.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Prague City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and set out for a guided city tour covering the State Opera, National Museum, Wenceslas Square, and Charles Square. Explore Prague Castle, its courtyards, and St. Vitus Cathedral before heading to the Old Town Square to see the Astronomical Clock. The afternoon is free for personal activities. Overnight stay in Prague.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Travel to Budapest
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and board a train to Budapest. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to relax. Overnight stay in Budapest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Budapest City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast, then embark on a panoramic city tour. Cross the Chain Bridge and Margaret Bridge to the Buda side. Explore Castle District, Matthias Church, and Fisherman’s Bastion, followed by Gellért Hill for stunning views. On the Pest side, visit the Central Market Hall, City Park, Heroes’ Square, and the Parliament. Drive along Andrássy Avenue, passing the Opera House and St. Stephen’s Basilica. The tour concludes in the city center. Free time in the evening. Overnight stay in Budapest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Budapest to Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and travel back to Vienna by train. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and spend the afternoon at leisure. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure from Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel. A transfer will take you to Vienna Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zagreb
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb and check into your hotel. Explore the cultural heart of Croatia and enjoy the city at your leisure. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zagreb & Zadar City Tours
package_itineraries.description: Morning Zagreb city tour covering Upper Town, St. Stephen’s Cathedral, Jelacic Square. Travel to Zadar in the afternoon. Evening Zadar city tour, including Sea Organ, Land Gate, and famous sunsets. Overnight in Zadar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Plitvice Lakes National Park
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Plitvice Lakes, exploring 16 lakes, 92 waterfalls, and lush forests. Return to Zadar for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Split Evening Tour
package_itineraries.description: Head to Split and explore Diocletian Palace, Marjan Hill, and Austro-Hungarian architecture on a guided tour. Overnight in Split.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Split to Hvar by Ferry
package_itineraries.description: Ferry to Hvar. Explore lavender-scented streets, quiet coves, local vineyards, and nearby islands. Overnight in Hvar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Hvar to Dubrovnik – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Dubrovnik. Guided tour of Old Town, exploring historic streets, architecture, and culture. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Dubrovnik to Montenegro
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Montenegro via the Bay of Kotor. Check into your hotel and explore the town independently. Overnight in Montenegro (Kotor).

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Kotor Day Trip
package_itineraries.description: Walking tour of Kotor’s Old Town, St. Tryphon Cathedral, Clock Tower, Pima Palace, and local landmarks. Overnight in Montenegro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport after breakfast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Rovaniemi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive by flight and transfer to your hotel. Optional Northern Lights hunting tour available in the evening. Overnight in Rovaniemi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Reindeer Farm & Santa Claus Village
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, ride a snowmobile through forest trails, then visit a reindeer farm for a sleigh ride and Arctic Circle ceremony. Enjoy lunch at Santa Claus Village, meet Santa, and explore souvenir shops. Overnight in Rovaniemi

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Husky Safari
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a thrilling husky safari, driving your sled across snowy landscapes. Learn about husky care at the farm and enjoy hot drinks by the fire. Overnight in Rovaniemi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast. Optionally visit the Arktikum Museum before your transfer to Rovaniemi Airport.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Helsinki
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Helsinki Airport, transfer to hotel, and explore nearby sights including Suomenlinna Fortress. Overnight in Helsinki.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Helsinki Cruise to Stockholm
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Helsinki Airport, transfer to hotel, and explore nearby sights including Suomenlinna Fortress. Overnight in Helsinki.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Stockholm
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Stockholm and visit Vasa Museum, Royal Palace, ABBA Museum, and Skansen. Overnight in Stockholm.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Stockholm to Copenhagen
package_itineraries.description: Travel by train to Copenhagen, Denmark. Visit Tivoli Gardens, Gefion Fountain, Christianborg Palace, and more. Overnight in Copenhagen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Copenhagen Cruise to Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Spend free time shopping before boarding an overnight ferry to Oslo. Overnight on board.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Oslo Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Oslo and tour Akershus Fortress, Fram Museum, Holmenkollen Ski Museum, and the Royal Palace. Overnight in Oslo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Oslo Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival – Helsinki to Porvoo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Helsinki-Vantaa Airport, rent a car, and visit Suomenlinna Fortress before driving to Porvoo. Explore its Old Town and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Porvoo to Savonlinna
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Punkaharju Ridge and visit the Lusto Forest Museum. Continue to Savonlinna, known for Olavinlinna Castle and its Opera Festival. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Savonlinna to Nurmes
package_itineraries.description: Visit New Valamo Monastery, Joensuu, and Lake Pielinen. Explore Koli National Park and end the day in Nurmes. Optional fishing available.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Nurmes to Kuopio
package_itineraries.description: Tour Pielisen Museum, Ruunaa Nature Reserve, and Eva Ryynänen’s studio. Continue to Kuopio, famous for the Puijo Tower and Lake Kallavesi cruises.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kuopio to Tampere
package_itineraries.description: Drive via Jyväskylä, admiring Aalto architecture, before reaching Tampere. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Tampere to Helsinki
package_itineraries.description: Spend the morning in Tampere, visit Hämeenlinna Castle or Jean Sibelius’s birthplace, then proceed to Helsinki Airport.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Athens
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Athens and transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening discovering the city at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full-day tour visiting the Acropolis, Parthenon, Temple of Zeus, Erechtheion, and Roman Forum. Modern sites include the Panathenaic Stadium, Parliament, and National Archaeological Museum. End at the Acropolis Museum. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Athens to Naxos
package_itineraries.description: Take a scenic ferry to Naxos, the largest Cycladic island. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Naxos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Explore Naxos
package_itineraries.description: Discover Portara, the unfinished gate dedicated to Apollo, and explore the island’s charming villages. Overnight in Naxos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Naxos to Santorini
package_itineraries.description: Catch a ferry to Santorini, one of Greece’s most beautiful islands. Evening free. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Santorini Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Explore Santorini’s caldera, Akrotiri ruins, volcano, and hot springs. Experience its unique wines and traditional cuisine. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Santorini
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Santorini International Airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Athens
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Athens International Airport and transfer to your hotel. In the evening, head out for a night city tour, including the Port of Piraeus, Mikrolimano Harbour, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, the National Garden, Parliament Building, and National Library. End the evening at Plaka, the historic district, enjoying dinner with traditional Greek folk music and dance. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens to Mykonos
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, board a scenic ferry to Mykonos. Famous for its nightlife, charming windmills, and pristine beaches, Mykonos offers a perfect mix of relaxation and adventure. Spend the evening exploring the island. Overnight in Mykonos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Mykonos Full-Day Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Set off on a full-day cruise along Mykonos’ southern coast aboard a traditional kaiki boat. Visit Dragonissi Island, snorkel at Frangias Beach, swim at Kalafati Beach, and enjoy lunch by the sea. Later, relax at Paradise Beach and Ornos Beach before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Mykonos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mykonos to Santorini
package_itineraries.description: Take a ferry to Santorini, known for its dramatic cliffs, whitewashed houses, and volcanic history. After check-in, explore at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Santorini Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Santorini’s highlights such as Skaros Rock, ancient Thera, and Akrotiri. Enjoy panoramic views during the Caldera tour and witness the beauty of volcanic landscapes. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Santorini to Athens
package_itineraries.description: Return to Athens via ferry and spend your evening at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Athens
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure or onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Dublin
package_itineraries.description: Known as the “City of a Thousand Welcomes,” Dublin greets you warmly. On arrival at Dublin International Airport, our tour manager will transfer you to the hotel and assist with check-in. After a short orientation, spend the rest of your day relaxing or exploring nearby attractions at your own pace. Overnight in Dublin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Dublin City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying a filling breakfast, set off on a Hop On Hop Off bus tour. The route includes major sites such as Dublin Castle, St. Patrick’s Cathedral, the Guinness Storehouse, Trinity College, Kilmainham Gaol, and the Old James Distillery. Live commentary in different languages enhances the experience. Pause for a traditional lunch at a local eatery before spending the afternoon shopping or relaxing at a classic Irish pub. Stay overnight in Dublin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Dublin to Killarney
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a train journey of about 3 hours to Killarney in County Kerry. This scenic ride showcases rolling hills and lush landscapes. On arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy a horse-drawn cart ride to Killarney National Park. The park features over 26,000 acres of lakes, rivers, and ancient woodlands, offering activities such as hiking, horse riding, canoeing, kayaking, and bird watching.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Killarney – Ring of Kerry
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a traditional Irish breakfast before embarking on the Ring of Kerry circuit. Your route passes through Killorglin, Lough Caragh, Glenbeigh, Cahersiveen, and Ballycarberry Castle. Further along, you’ll explore Waterville, a seaside village, and Sneem, famous for its colorful houses. The journey continues through Moll’s Gap and ends at Ladies View, one of Killarney’s most scenic lookouts. Stay overnight in Killarney.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Killarney to Dublin
package_itineraries.description: Return by train to Dublin after breakfast. Spend the rest of the evening enjoying the city one last time.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart Dublin
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and proceed to Dublin Airport for your onward Europe tour package or your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Amsterdam
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Schiphol Airport, our representative will assist you with the transfer to your hotel. Take some time to rest after check-in. In the evening, begin your first taste of Amsterdam by visiting the Van Gogh Museum, where the artist’s timeless works are displayed. Later, head to the Heineken Experience to enjoy interactive exhibits and tastings. Conclude your evening with a stroll through the Amsterdam Light Festival, which turns the city into a glowing spectacle. Stay overnight at your Amsterdam hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Amsterdam City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast before exploring some of Amsterdam’s best-loved attractions. Start with Madame Tussauds Museum, featuring lifelike wax figures, and continue to the Amsterdam Dungeon for a thrilling historic experience. Later, visit the iconic windmills that are symbols of Dutch culture—many of these windmills host museums or quirky cafés. In the afternoon, head to Zandvoort Beach, known for its golden sands and vibrant atmosphere, offering water sports and relaxation. Return to your Amsterdam hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Amsterdam Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a Dutch breakfast before heading to the breathtaking Keukenhof Gardens, famously called the “Garden of Europe.” Spread across vast acres, it showcases millions of tulips and seasonal flowers in full bloom. Afterward, visit the Amsterdam Ice Bar for a unique sub-zero experience, followed by a canal cruise that highlights the city’s scenic waterways and charming architecture. Overnight stay in Amsterdam.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Brussels City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Belgium’s capital. Known for its rich history and cosmopolitan culture, Brussels will impress with its diversity. Visit the iconic Grand Palace, admire the futuristic Atomium, and explore Mini-Europe, a fascinating miniature park displaying famous European landmarks. In the evening, enjoy Belgian delicacies such as waffles and chocolates before heading back to your hotel. Stay overnight in Brussels.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Amsterdam
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out of the hotel. Continue your onward Europe tour package journey or take your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Bucharest International Airport and transfer to your hotel for check-in. Spend the evening exploring the lively surroundings at leisure. Overnight in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Bucharest to Sibiu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a short tour of Bucharest to see highlights like the Palace of Parliament, Stavropoleos Monastery, the National Bank, the Romanian Athenaeum, Herastrau Park, the Village Museum, and the Arch of Triumph. Journey onwards to Sibiu, stopping at Poenari Castle, once the residence of Vlad the Impaler, believed to be the inspiration for Count Dracula. Arrive in Sibiu, a medieval town framed by mountain peaks. Visit the Big, Small, and Huet Squares, the Liar’s Bridge, and the Gothic-style Evangelical Church. Overnight in Sibiu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sibiu to Borgo Pass
package_itineraries.description: Follow in Bram Stoker’s footsteps as you head toward Borgo Pass. En route, enjoy lunch at the Bran Castle Restaurant, linked to the Dracula legend. In the evening, stay at the atmospheric Castle Dracula in Pasul Bargaului. Overnight at Castle Dracula.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Borgo Pass to Sighisoara
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Sighisoara, birthplace of Vlad the Impaler. Explore its UNESCO-listed citadel, the Clock Tower, The Covered Stairway, Biserica din Deal, and the Catholic Church. Overnight in Sighisoara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Sighisoara to Brasov
package_itineraries.description: Head to Brasov, a charming medieval town. Visit the Black Church, Council Square, and the infamous hill where Vlad the Impaler punished his enemies. Overnight in Brasov.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Brasov to Bucharest via Snagov
package_itineraries.description: On your way back to Bucharest, stop at Snagov Island to visit the monastery where Vlad the Impaler is said to be buried. Overnight in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast and transfer to the airport to fly home or continue with your Europe tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Stockholm – Gamla Stan – Vasa Museum – ABBA The Museum
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Stockholm, you’ll be welcomed at the airport and transferred to your hotel. After checking in and freshening up, begin your adventure in Sweden’s beautiful capital. Explore Gamla Stan (Old Town), with its cobbled streets, cozy cafes, boutiques, and art galleries. Next, visit the Vasa Museum, home to the world’s only preserved 17th-century warship. End the day at the interactive ABBA The Museum, where fans of the legendary pop group can relive their music and legacy. Other highlights you can explore include The Royal Palace, Skansen Open Air Museum, and Stockholm City Hall.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Stockholm – Copenhagen – Tivoli Gardens – Christiansborg Palace – National Museum of Denmark
package_itineraries.description: Travel by train to Copenhagen, Denmark’s charming capital. After checking in, explore this city known for colorful buildings, canals, and its historic monarchy. Visit Tivoli Gardens, the world’s second-oldest amusement park, followed by the impressive Christiansborg Palace, home to the Danish Parliament, Supreme Court, and Prime Minister’s office. End the day with a tour of the National Museum of Denmark, the country’s largest cultural history museum.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Copenhagen – Odense – Hans Christian Andersen Museum
package_itineraries.description: Board a train to Odense, Denmark’s third-largest city. Visit the Hans Christian Andersen Museum, which provides fascinating insights into the life and works of the beloved storyteller. Overnight stay in Odense.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Odense – Aarhus – Moesgaard Museum – Marselisborg Castle – Street Food Hall
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Aarhus, Denmark’s second-largest city, often called the “City of Smiles.” Begin with a visit to Moesgaard Museum and Marselisborg Castle, then stroll through the historic Den Gamle By (Old Town). In the evening, enjoy local and international flavors at the Street Food Hall.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Aarhus – Frederikshavn – Gothenburg
package_itineraries.description: Take a train to Frederikshavn and then a ferry to Gothenburg, Sweden’s second-largest city. Visit Liseberg Amusement Park, the floating maritime museum Maritiman, and enjoy a boat cruise to the New Alvsborg Fortress. Overnight in Gothenburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Gothenburg – Oslo – Vigeland Park – Royal Palace – City Hall
package_itineraries.description: Continue your journey by train to Oslo, the capital of Norway. Discover landmarks such as Vigeland Park, the Royal Palace, City Hall, Parliament Building, and the historic Akershus Fortress. Oslo, surrounded by fjords and rolling hills, offers a perfect blend of nature and history.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Stockholm
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Stockholm, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day relaxing or exploring the city at leisure. End the evening with a fine dining experience at one of Stockholm’s top restaurants.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Stockholm – Hop On Hop Off Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover Stockholm aboard a Hop On Hop Off bus tour with audio commentary available in multiple languages. Visit landmarks like Gamla Stan (Old Town), ABBA The Museum, and the Vasa Museum, housing the world’s only preserved 17th-century ship. Other attractions include the Ice Bar, City Hall, Skansen, Royal Palace, Grona Lund, and Fjallgatan for stunning views.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Stockholm – Copenhagen – Bakken
package_itineraries.description: Take a train to Copenhagen, enjoying the scenic view of the Oresund Bridge. On arrival, visit Bakken, the world’s oldest amusement park. Overnight stay in Copenhagen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Copenhagen – Hop On Hop Off Tour – Cruise to Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a sightseeing bus tour of Copenhagen, covering highlights like the National Museum of Denmark, Tivoli Gardens, Christiansborg Palace, Amalienborg Palace, Gefion Fountain, Botanical Gardens, and the Royal Library. In the evening, board a luxury cruise to Oslo, with entertainment and dinner onboard.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Oslo – Hop On Hop Off Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Oslo and check in to your hotel. Then, explore the city on a Hop On Hop Off tour, visiting the National Theatre, Vigeland Park, Parliament Building, Aker Brygge, and the Akershus Fortress.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy free time in Oslo before heading to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Zurich – Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Zurich, board a train to the beautiful town of Lucerne. After checking in at your hotel, spend the rest of the day exploring at leisure. You may wander through Lucerne’s historic Old Town, stroll along Chapel Bridge, or relax by Lake Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Lucerne – Mt. Titlis
package_itineraries.description: Begin your alpine adventure with a trip to Mt. Titlis . Travel to Engelberg and ascend the peak by the famous Titlis Rotair, the world’s first revolving cable car. Enjoy stunning views of glaciers, valleys, and the Black Forest region as you reach the summit. Spend the evening at your hotel in Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Lucerne – Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and take a scenic train ride to Interlaken. This town, nestled between Lake Thun and Lake Brienz, offers breathtaking alpine panoramas. The Golden Pass route is a highlight, presenting some of the finest Swiss landscapes. After checking in, explore Interlaken at your own pace.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Interlaken – Jungfraujoch
package_itineraries.description: Board the train from Interlaken Ost to Grindelwald, followed by the cogwheel journey to the summit of Jungfraujoch . Standing at 3,454 metres, this is the highest railway station in Europe. Admire the vast Aletsch Glacier, explore the Ice Palace, and enjoy panoramic mountain views before returning to Interlaken for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Zurich – Rhine Falls
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Interlaken back to Zurich. After checking in, embark on an excursion to the Rhine Falls , Europe’s largest waterfall. Later, explore Zurich’s cobbled alleys, browse flea markets, or visit its world-class museums.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Zurich
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your return journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Farewell Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before transferring to Taoyuan International Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Zurich – Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and travel to Lucerne. Explore the Old Town, Chapel Bridge, and Lion Monument, or enjoy a boat ride on Lake Lucerne. Overnight in Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Lucerne – Mount Titlis
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Engelberg and ride the Rotair cable car to Mount Titlis , where snow awaits year-round. Admire panoramic alpine views before returning to Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Lucerne – Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Board a train to Interlaken. Spend the day exploring or trying adventure activities like paragliding. Evening strolls along Interlaken’s streets are highly recommended.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Jungfraujoch Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Jungfraujoch , the “Top of Europe,” and explore the Ice Palace and Sphinx Observatory. Return to Interlaken in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Interlaken – Bern City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Adventure seekers may try bungee jumping or a helicopter ride. Later, take a train to Bern for a city tour featuring the Rose Garden, Clock Tower, and Bern Cathedral before returning to Interlaken.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Interlaken – Zurich
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Zurich. Visit the Rhine Falls and explore Zurich’s vibrant old streets, markets, and museums.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Zurich Airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Zurich
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Zurich Airport, transfer to your hotel. After check-in, enjoy lunch at the hotel’s restaurant and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zurich City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Zurich’s highlights, starting with the Swiss National Museum , followed by Bahnhofstrasse , one of the world’s most exclusive shopping streets. Walk along Limmatquai in Zurich’s Old Town, admire St. Peter’s Church , and catch a glimpse of the Zurich Opera House . Visit the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology , where Albert Einstein once studied, and ride the Dolderbahn Cogwheel Train to the Zurichberg district. End the day admiring the stained-glass masterpieces at Fraumünster Church .

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Zurich – Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Board a train to Lucerne. After checking in, enjoy the day at your own pace, perhaps exploring the lakeside or wandering the medieval streets.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mt. Titlis Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Engelberg and take the Titlis Rotair , the world’s first revolving cable car, up to Mt. Titlis at 10,000 feet. Attractions here include the Glacier Cave , Ice Flyer Chairlift , Glacier Park, Adventure Park, souvenir shops, and alpine restaurants offering spectacular views. Return to Lucerne for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Lucerne – Paris
package_itineraries.description: Take a train from Lucerne to Paris. After check-in, begin your Paris sightseeing with a visit to the Louvre Museum , stroll along the Champs-Elysées , shop at Galeries Lafayette , and enjoy an evening cabaret performance at the Lido.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Paris City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore the most iconic landmarks of Paris: Arc de Triomphe , Place de la Concorde , Les Invalides , and the Tuileries Gardens . Ride the elevator to the 2nd level of the Eiffel Tower for panoramic views. In the evening, discover the vibrant Latin Quarter filled with cafés and bookstores.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Disneyland Paris
package_itineraries.description: Spend a magical day at Disneyland Paris . Enjoy thrilling rides, meet Disney characters, and explore the Walt Disney Studios Park with its behind-the-scenes movie secrets.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure from Paris
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival – St. Pierre Cathedral – Conservatory and Botanical Garden – Museum of Art and History
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Geneva, check in to your hotel before beginning your city exploration. Visit St. Pierre Cathedral , an architectural gem with centuries of history. Continue to the Conservatory and Botanical Garden , spread over 28 hectares with one of the world’s largest herbaria. Later, explore the Museum of Art and History , showcasing over a million exhibits from ancient to modern eras.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Geneva Water Fountain – Flower Clock – Mini Train Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with the iconic Geneva Water Fountain , one of the tallest in the world and a symbol of the city. Next, admire the Flower Clock , a masterpiece of design created from over 6,000 vibrant plants. End your day with a mini-train ride through Geneva’s Old Town, discovering its charming squares and historic landmarks.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and head to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zurich – Engelberg
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and travel to Engelberg. After checking in, visit the Benedictine Monastery and enjoy the alpine surroundings. Overnight stay in Engelberg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Engelberg – Lucerne – Engelberg
package_itineraries.description: Head to Lucerne for a day excursion. Ride the cable car to Mt. Titlis, walk across the iconic Chapel Bridge , see the Water Tower , and explore the charming Old Town. Return to Engelberg for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Engelberg – Basel
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Basel, known for its cultural heritage and thriving art scene. Visit Basel Minster , explore Old Town, and tour museums such as Kunstmuseum Basel or Fondation Beyeler . End the day strolling along the Rhine River. Overnight in Basel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Basel – Zurich – Schaffhausen
package_itineraries.description: Head to Zurich for a city tour including Grossmünster , Fraumünster , and the Swiss National Museum. Continue to Schaffhausen to witness the spectacular Rhine Falls , Europe’s largest waterfall. Return to Zurich for shopping along Bahnhofstrasse and an evening by Lake Zurich.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Zurich
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Zurich Airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Lucerne – Explore the Old Town
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Lucerne and settle into your hotel. Begin your journey with a visit to the iconic Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke) , where flower-decked wooden panels and breathtaking views of the Reuss River set the tone for your trip. Wander through Lucerne’s Old Town (Altstadt) , exploring cobbled alleys, boutique stores, and pastel-colored medieval façades. Admire the Jesuit Church , with its ornate Baroque interiors. Later, enjoy a scenic boat ride on Lake Lucerne , capturing magnificent views of the Swiss Alps. Continue with a visit to the Swiss Museum of Transport , an interactive showcase of Switzerland’s transport and space history. End the evening with a cozy Swiss dinner or a walk along the serene lakeside promenade.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Mount Pilatus Excursion – Lion Monument & Cultural Discovery
package_itineraries.description: Take an unforgettable day trip to Mount Pilatus via cogwheel train, gondola, or cable car. At the summit, soak in panoramic alpine views, explore walking trails, or enjoy traditional Swiss cuisine at mountaintop restaurants. Return to Lucerne and visit the moving Lion Monument (Löwendenkmal) , a powerful sculpture symbolizing Swiss bravery. Explore the Richard Wagner Museum by the lakeside to discover the composer’s legacy. As night falls, immerse yourself in Lucerne’s lively nightlife with music, performances, or relaxed café experiences.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Engelberg & Mount Titlis – Departure from Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Head to Engelberg for an excursion to Mount Titlis , where revolving cable cars, snowy landscapes, and glaciers await. Walk across the Titlis Cliff Walk , Europe’s highest suspension bridge, or enjoy snow sports at Glacier Park. Return to Lucerne and visit the Swiss Museum of Art (Kunstmuseum) , featuring remarkable collections from Swiss masters. Conclude your journey with a traditional Swiss fondue dinner before taking a final stroll through Lucerne’s charming streets, cherishing the city’s magical atmosphere before departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Istanbul and check in at your hotel. Spend the afternoon exploring at your own pace. Wander through the lively Grand Bazaar, brimming with colorful stalls and local treasures. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Turkish dinner at a charming restaurant. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel in Turkey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day at the remarkable Basilica Cistern, an underground architectural masterpiece. Discover the Sultanahmet district, home to Istanbul’s most historic sites. Visit the majestic Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, and the grand Topkapi Palace. Continue to the Spice Bazaar, renowned for its fragrant teas, spices, and Turkish sweets. Enjoy a Bosphorus cruise and admire Istanbul’s skyline. End the day with a visit to Dolmabahce Palace, followed by an optional Whirling Dervishes performance.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Explore the vibrant quarter of Beyoglu and the bustling Istiklal Street. Climb Galata Tower for stunning city views. Visit the Istanbul Modern Art Museum to experience contemporary Turkish creativity. Cross Galata Bridge to Karakoy and sample mouthwatering street food. In the evening, immerse yourself in the energetic nightlife of Istanbul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Istanbul – Kusadasi
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and take a domestic flight to Izmir. Upon arrival, continue to the coastal town of Kusadasi. Relax at your hotel or enjoy a walk along the beaches. End the evening with fresh seafood at a local restaurant.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kusadasi
package_itineraries.description: Take a full-day trip to Ephesus, one of the world’s most impressive Roman archaeological sites. Visit the Library of Celsus, the Great Theater, and the Temple of Artemis. Stop at the House of the Virgin Mary, a spiritual pilgrimage site. Relish an authentic Turkish lunch before returning to Kusadasi for an evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Kusadasi
package_itineraries.description: Spend the morning exploring Kusadasi at your own pace or opt for a guided excursion to Pamukkale. Discover the ruins of Hierapolis including its Necropolis and Basilica. Take a dip in Pamukkale’s famous white travertine pools. Return to Kusadasi for free time in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and travel back to Istanbul for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Istanbul Ataturk Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Istanbul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a full-day exploration of Istanbul’s landmarks, including Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar. Optionally, enjoy a Bosphorus cruise before returning to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Istanbul Leisure Day
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring on your own. You might visit Dolmabahce Palace, Camlica Hill, Spice Market, or Rumeli Fortress. Sample Turkish cuisine or shop for souvenirs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Flight to Antalya
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Antalya, a jewel on the Mediterranean coast. Transfer to your hotel and relax along the picturesque shoreline.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Antalya Old Town & Perge
package_itineraries.description: Discover Kaleici, Antalya’s charming Old Town with cobblestone streets and historic homes. Visit Perge’s Roman ruins, the Aspendos Theater, and Kursunlu Waterfalls.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Antalya Leisure
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day relaxing on beaches or enjoying water activities. Alternatively, explore sites like Myra Lycian tombs, the Church of St. Nicholas, Kekova Island, and the Sunken City of Simena. Return for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to Istanbul for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive In Colombo
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to Ceylon! Upon arriving at the Bandaranaike International Airport, our tour manager will guide you to the hotel and help you with transfer formalities. After a few hours of rest, you can either head to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage or go directly to Kandy. The Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage was established in 1975 to help abandoned elephants. Visitors can spend time with the elephants in the sanctuary, feeding them, helping them bathe, and watching them as they go about their daily lives. Kandy is Sri Lanka’s last capital, which fell into the British Empire. It is home to the Temple of the Tooth, which is believed to house the tooth of Lord Buddha. Sri Lankans celebrate Esala Perahara, an annual festival where the tooth is paraded through the streets on the back of an elephant. It is also home to beautiful tea estates and the Knuckles Mountain Range, which is listed in the UNESCO Natural World Heritage list. Check into a luxury hotel to spend the night in Kandy.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Kandy – Nuwara Eliya
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, proceed to Nuwara Eliya, a lush and green city surrounded by tea estates, waterfalls, and lakes. It is believed that Nuwara Eliya was Ravana's capital and that Sita was kept captive in Sita Eliya. You will visit the Ramboda Falls, Sri Baktha Hanuman Temple, Hakgala Botanical Garden, Devon Falls, and the Horton Plains National Park. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Nuwara Eliya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Nuwara Eliya - Colombo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and proceed to Colombo. It is Sri Lanka’s cultural and judicial capital. You will visit Lotus Tower, the National Museum of Colombo, the Sri Lanka Planetarium, Viharamahadevi Park, Gangaramaya Temple, and the Pettah Floating Market. Enjoy shopping at the Arcade Independence Square and the Pettah Market in the evening to buy spices, tea, traditional masks, antiques, gems, and batik items. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Colombo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart Colombo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the Colombo International Airport to catch your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Colombo - Kandy
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at the Colombo International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Kandy, Sri Lanka’s second-largest city. Kandy was the last capital city of the Sinhalese royal family and is famous for its colonial architecture and ancient temples. Check into the hotel and spend some time exploring places around the neighbourhood.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Kandy City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the Temple of the Tooth Relic, a UNESCO World Heritage site famous for hosting the Buddha's canine tooth. The tooth is taken on a procession yearly as part of the Perahara, a 10-day annual festival. Some of the other places you will visit include the Royal Botanical Garden, the Kandy Lake, and the Ceylon Tea Museum. Spend the night in Kandy.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Kandy - Colombo
package_itineraries.description: After a leisurely breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Colombo. You will explore major tourist attractions in Sri Lanka’s capital city, including the Colombo Museum, the Gangaramaya Temple, and the Viharamahadevi Temple. Spend the evening shopping at the local markets before returning to the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart Colombo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and complete your shopping expedition. Later, drive to the airport to continue with your return journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive In Bentota
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at the Bandaranaike International Airport in Colombo, our tour manager will welcome you and guide you to Bentota. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day enjoying the places in and around it. Spend the night in Bentota.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Bentota City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Bentota is a resort town famous for its picturesque landscape and cultural attractions. Some of the attractions you will visit in Bentota include the Kande Viharaya Temple, Ventura Beach, and the Polgampola Waterfalls. Later, you will check out of the hotel and head to Colombo. Spend the night in Colombo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Colombo City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Sri Lanka’s capital city, Colombo, has a rich cultural heritage and is a melting pot of different cultures. Some of the attractions you will cover include the Gangaramaya Temple, Viharamahadevi Park, and the Kelaniya Raja Maha Viharaya. Don’t miss shopping at one of the many flea markets where you can buy spices, tea, handicrafts, Ayurveda products, and Batik wear. Spend the night in Colombo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart Colombo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the airport to catch your flight to India.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Jordan - Arrival in Amman
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Amman Airport, where you’ll be met and assisted with visa procedures. Transfer to your hotel for check-in. The evening is free to relax. Overnight stay in Amman.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Amman Panoramic Tour, Jerash, Ajloun, and the Dead Sea
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a panoramic city tour of Amman, then visit Jerash to see its temples, theatres, and colonnaded streets. Next, travel to Ajloun to explore its medieval castle, built by Saladin’s general in 1184 AD. End the day at the Dead Sea, where you’ll experience floating in its salty waters. Overnight stay near the Dead Sea.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Exploring the Enchanting Dead Sea
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a leisure day at the Dead Sea. Float in the mineral-rich waters and experience its therapeutic qualities. Overnight stay at your Dead Sea hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Journey through History - Madaba, Mt. Nebo, Little Petra, and Petra
package_itineraries.description: Travel after breakfast to Madaba to see its famous 6th-century Mosaic Map and St. George’s Church. Continue to Mount Nebo, then to Little Petra, a Nabataean site carved into pale rock. Finally, arrive at Petra and check into your hotel for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Exploring the Marvels of Petra
package_itineraries.description: Explore Petra today. Walk through the Siq and admire its rock-cut wonders: the Treasury, tombs, temples, and theatres. After sightseeing, return to your hotel in Petra for dinner and overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Discovering the Wonders of Wadi Rum
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Wadi Rum for a jeep ride across its vast desert. Known as the “Valley of the Moon,” this reserve is filled with spectacular rock formations. Overnight stay at a hotel in Wadi Rum.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Journey to Amman
package_itineraries.description: Travel back to Amman after breakfast. The day is free to explore at your own pace. Overnight stay in Amman.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Farewell to Amman
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Amman Airport for your flight home, concluding your journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Delhi to Mauritius – Begin the Journey
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam Airport, meet your representatives, and transfer to your hotel. Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Ile Aux Cerfs Island Tour Package
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Ile Aux Cerfs, famous for sandy beaches, restaurants, and water activities. Optional parasailing available. Return for dinner and overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Trou Aux Cerfs & Grand Basin
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and visit Trou Aux Cerfs crater, followed by Grand Basin’s sacred lakes. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Pamplemousses Gardens & Grand Baie
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Royal Botanical Gardens and later head to Grand Baie for dining, beaches, and nightlife. Dinner and overnight at hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Relax until your transfer to the airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Muscat
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Muscat International Airport, clear immigration, collect your luggage, and complete customs. Your driver will be waiting in the arrival hall to escort you to your hotel. Relax and spend the night in the beautiful city of Muscat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Half-Day Muscat City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a visit to the Grand Mosque, the most iconic landmark of Muscat. Closed to visitors on Fridays and public holidays, the mosque, completed in 2001, is a striking masterpiece of modern design fused with traditional artistry. Admire its vast prayer hall with handmade carpets, brilliant chandeliers, and the elegant dome. Women are asked to dress fully covered with a scarf, and men should wear trousers. Proceed with a scenic drive along the Corniche, then explore the bustling Muttrah Souq. Later, make a stop at Al Alam Palace, the ceremonial residence of His Majesty Sultan Qaboos, framed by the Portuguese forts of Mirani and Jalali. Continue with the Bait Al Zubair Museum, which houses artefacts depicting Oman’s cultural and historical legacy. Conclude the tour with a return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Dolphin-Watching Experience
package_itineraries.description: Head to the Marina for a boat excursion into Oman’s waters. This morning, embark on a dolphin-watching cruise, where playful pods can often be seen gliding through the waves. On rare occasions, whales may also appear in these waters close to Muscat’s rugged coastline. Even without sightings, the sea trip itself is refreshing and informative. After the excursion, return to your hotel, where the rest of the day is free for leisure. Spend the evening at your hotel in Muscat for another restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Muscat – Nizwa – Jabal Akhdar
package_itineraries.description: Today, set off to Nizwa, once Oman’s historic capital and the birthplace of Islam in the region. Take a photo stop at the 17th-century Round Tower Fort and explore Nizwa Souq, famous for khanjars, silver jewellery, and the bustling Friday livestock auction. From there, continue to Wadi Al Madeen and drive up the 36-kilometre mountain road leading to Jebel Akhdar. Perched 2000 metres above sea level, the “Green Mountain” offers rare cool air, fertile valleys, and spectacular scenery. Spend the evening at Sama Jabal Akhdar Hotel and enjoy an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Jabal Akhdar Villages – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Al Jebel Al Akhdar’s terraced orchards, natural springs, and aflaj irrigation. Visit the villages of Saiq, Wadi Bani Habib, Roose, and Al Ain, each offering panoramic views of mountains and wadis. If travelling in spring, the blooming roses add fragrance to the air, and villagers prepare rose water through traditional distillation. Light clothing and sturdy shoes are recommended. Later, transfer back to Muscat International Airport, concluding your unforgettable Muscat travel package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Dubai – Miracle Garden - Dhow Cruise
package_itineraries.description: On reaching Dubai, you will be escorted to your hotel. Begin sightseeing with Miracle Garden, the world’s largest floral display, showcasing 150 million blooms across vast landscapes. In the evening, embark on a dhow cruise for dining, entertainment, and dazzling city views before retiring to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Burj Khalifa – Dubai Creek – Dubai Mall - Jumeirah Beach
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with Burj Khalifa, capturing spectacular city views from its observation decks. Continue to Dubai Creek for a traditional boat ride, then enjoy shopping at Dubai Mall. End your day with a relaxing evening at Jumeirah Beach.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Desert Safari
package_itineraries.description: Dedicate this day to the majestic desert. Enjoy dune bashing, camel riding, sand skiing, and starlit cultural shows with Arabic coffee and a sumptuous buffet. Stay overnight under the desert sky.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Dubai
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport, carrying wonderful memories home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cairo
package_itineraries.description: On reaching the celebrated city of Cairo, you will be smoothly transferred to your chosen accommodation for check-in. This provides the perfect chance to relax and restore energy after your travels. As dusk descends, you will be treated to the captivating Sound and Light Show at the Giza Pyramids, a spectacular retelling of Egypt’s majestic past. The night will conclude with a restful stay at your Cairo hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cairo
package_itineraries.description: A hearty breakfast welcomes the start of the day. The adventure begins with an awe-filled visit to the monumental Great Pyramids of Giza, one of the wonders of antiquity. The Egyptian Museum will introduce you to countless treasures of pharaonic times, while the lively Khan El Khalil Bazaar—once called the Turkish market—offers a delightful blend of traditional goods and vibrant atmosphere. The remaining hours may be enjoyed at leisure before retiring for the evening at your Cairo hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cairo to Aswan – Nile Cruise Embarkation
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you will be escorted to the airport for a short flight to Aswan. Upon arrival, transfer to the Nile cruise terminal to begin your voyage along the storied river. Today’s visits include the mighty High Dam, the striking Unfinished Obelisk, and the sacred Philae Temple. Meals and accommodation onboard the cruise ensure an indulgent evening in comfort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Sailing the Nile
package_itineraries.description: Following your morning meal, the day’s discovery begins at the Kom Ombo Temple, an extraordinary sanctuary shared by two deities, reflecting the artistry of the Ptolemaic period. Sailing onward, you’ll reach Edfu to marvel at the grand Temple of Horus, guarded by an imposing falcon statue. Dinner and overnight rest will once again be enjoyed aboard your cruise ship.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Luxor’s Ancient Marvels
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast sets the pace for a day immersed in ancient wonders. In Luxor, the agenda features the monumental Karnak and Luxor Temples, the Valley of the Kings, the mortuary Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, and the colossal twin statues known as the Colossi of Memnon. Evening comes with a peaceful night of dining and comfort aboard your cruise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Nile Cruise – Luxor – Sharm el-Sheikh
package_itineraries.description: After your final breakfast on the cruise, disembark and continue your journey to Sharm el-Sheikh. Renowned worldwide as a premier resort town, Sharm is celebrated for its spectacular marine life and vibrant coral reefs. On arrival, you’ll check in at your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day in relaxed leisure. Overnight stay will be in Sharm el-Sheikh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Sharm el-Sheikh
package_itineraries.description: A delicious breakfast opens the day for free exploration or an optional full-day yacht excursion to Tiran Island. From the jetty, board a snorkelling cruise guided by an expert, offering you a glimpse of colourful fish species and dazzling coral gardens in the Red Sea. After a day of aquatic wonders, return to your hotel in Sharm for overnight rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Sharm el-Sheikh to Cairo – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After checking out of the hotel, travel by road back to Cairo. From here, you will be transferred to Cairo International Airport to connect with your flight home, bringing your memorable journey through Egypt to an end.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Delhi - Agra via Mathura
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Delhi Airport and proceed to Agra, with a stop at Mathura, the birthplace of Lord Krishna. Check into your hotel on arrival and relax.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Agra - Jaipur
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort in the morning before departing for Jaipur. Arrive in Jaipur and check in at the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Jaipur Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Jaipur’s architectural gems, including Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar, City Palace, and Nahargarh Fort. Later, drive to Delhi and check into the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Visit Delhi’s landmarks, including Jama Masjid, Qutub Minar, Red Fort, Rashtrapati Bhavan, and Old Delhi. Later, proceed to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive Agra – Taj Mahal
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Agra, check into your hotel and rest. Later, visit the Taj Mahal, one of the world’s greatest wonders, and admire its architectural brilliance. Stay overnight in Agra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Agra – Jaipur Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Jaipur. On arrival, begin sightseeing with Albert Hall Museum, Hawa Mahal, and Jantar Mantar. Later, explore the City Palace and Jal Mahal before checking into your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Jaipur – Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Delhi. En route, stop to visit Amer Fort, a magnificent fort built of red sandstone and marble. Overnight stay in Delhi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Delhi Temples and Memorials
package_itineraries.description: Explore Delhi’s spiritual and historical landmarks. Visit Birla Mandir, Lotus Temple, Rajghat, and Indira Gandhi Memorial. Later, return to your hotel for rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Delhi City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a visit to Akshardham Temple, followed by India Gate, a symbol of national pride. Spend the rest of the day exploring Delhi’s vibrant streets. Overnight in Delhi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, shop at Karol Bagh before heading to the airport or railway station for your journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 01: Arrive in Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching the Srinagar Airport, you’ll be welcomed by your tour representative and transferred to your hotel. Once you’ve checked in, spend some time unwinding before starting your exploration. Visit the enchanting Mughal Gardens — Nishant Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Pari Mahal, and Chashme Shahi — known for their artistic design and natural beauty. Spend the night at your hotel in Srinagar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 02: Srinagar – Sonmarg – Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off to Sonmarg, also called the “Meadow of Gold,” surrounded by snow-dusted peaks and the sparkling Sindh River. Visit the Thajiwas Glacier, Zoji La Pass, Vishansar Lake, Gangabal Lake, Gadsar Lake, and the sacred Amarnath Cave Temple. Return to Srinagar in the evening and enjoy a peaceful night in a houseboat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 03: Srinagar – Pahalgam
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, check out and proceed towards Pahalgam. En route, stop by Mattan Lake and the Awantipora Ruins — ancient remains of a temple built by King Awanti Warman in the 8th century. After reaching Pahalgam, check into your hotel and spend the evening exploring the scenic town, often called “Mini Switzerland,” known for its association with the Amarnath Yatra. Stay overnight in Pahalgam.

package_itineraries.title: Day 04: Pahalgam – Gulmarg
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Gulmarg, stopping at Chandanwari, Betaab Valley, and Aru Valley along the way. These valleys are known for their snow-covered hills, pine forests, and peaceful atmosphere. Upon arrival in Gulmarg, check into your hotel and spend the day at leisure. Gulmarg, meaning “Meadow of Flowers,” offers delightful springtime views with blooming bluebells and buttercups. Stay overnight in Gulmarg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 05: Gulmarg – Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head back to Srinagar. En route, stop at Kungdoor to enjoy the famous gondola ride that offers panoramic mountain views from Kongdori Station. Return to Srinagar and check into your houseboat for a traditional overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 06: Depart Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, proceed to the airport to catch your flight back home, cherishing the unforgettable memories of Kashmir.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive in Gangtok
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Bagdogra Airport, a tour representative will assist with your transfer to Gangtok. En route, admire stunning landscapes and magnificent views of the Kanchenjunga Mountains. Check in and spend the night in Gangtok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Gangtok Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day city tour. Visit Baba Mandir, Hanuman Tok, Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park, and Tshangu Lake before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Gangtok - Kalimpong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Banjhakri Waterfalls, Do Drul Chorten, Ganesh Tok, Enchey Monastery, and the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology. Don’t miss the Gangtok Ropeway for panoramic views. Later, drive to Kalimpong, check in, and relax overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Kalimpong - Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Delo Park, Kalimpong Science Centre, Mangal Dham Temple, Pine View Nursery, Geden Tharpa Choling Monastery, Lepcha Museum, and Zang Dhok Palri Monastery. Later, continue your journey to Darjeeling. Check in at a luxury hotel and rest for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Darjeeling’s highlights, including Kanchendzonga Peak, Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop, Peace Pagoda, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Japanese Temple, Tenzing, Gombu Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre, and the scenic tea plantations. Enjoy the ropeway ride and stay overnight in Darjeeling.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : Depart Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head to Bagdogra Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive in Pune
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Pune Railway Station or Pune International Airport, you will be greeted and assisted with a smooth transfer to Lonavala. After checking into your hotel, take some time to relax and unwind. Later, you can head out to discover the nearby attractions and soak in the serene beauty of this hill retreat. Overnight stay in Lonavala.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Mahabaleshwar Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Mahabaleshwar. The drive, around four hours long, offers mesmerizing views of the Sahyadri Mountains along the way. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Later, visit Venna Lake—an artificial lake created by Shahaji Bhonsale, the ruler of Satara. Activities around the lake include boating, horse riding, and souvenir shopping. You can also explore attractions such as Mapro Garden, Mahabaleshwar Temple, Krishnabai Temple, and the Panchganga Temple. Overnight stay in Mahabaleshwar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Mahabaleshwar Day 2
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out for an excursion to Pratapgadh Fort, a 17th-century marvel built by Moropant Trimbak Pingle, the Prime Minister of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. This is where the historic battle between Shivaji and Afzal Khan took place. You may revisit or continue exploring Mahabaleshwar’s key attractions like Mapro Garden, Mahabaleshwar Temple, Krishnabai Temple, and the Panchganga Temple.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart to Pune
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Pune. En route, stop at Panchgani, another beautiful hill station known for its scenic landscapes, lush plateaus, and captivating viewpoints.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Guruvayur
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Kochi Airport or Guruvayur Railway Station, your tour representative will welcome you and assist in transferring to the hotel. Take some time to relax and refresh. Later, you can visit the iconic Sree Krishna Temple for a serene darshan of Guruvayurappan. Spend the night at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Guruvayur – Munnar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Munnar, a journey of approximately six hours. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and unwind. Post lunch, set out for sightseeing, exploring Munnar’s famous tea plantations. Enjoy the scenic views and a cozy evening by the fire at the hotel. Overnight stay in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Munnar
package_itineraries.description: Dedicate this day to exploring Munnar’s scenic attractions, including Eravikulam National Park, Kolukkumalai Tea Estate, Pothamedu View Point, Mattupetty Dam, Kundala Dam, Echo Point, and Top Station. Take in the breathtaking natural beauty and relax in the serene surroundings. Spend the night in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Munnar – Thekkady
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Thekkady to explore Periyar National Park, home to elephants, monkeys, wild boars, and other wildlife. Also, visit the Cardamom Hills, known for its cardamom, pepper, and coffee plantations. Your tour includes a boat cruise on Periyar Lake to experience wildlife up close. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel in Thekkady.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Thekkady – Alleppey
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, transfer to Alleppey for a traditional houseboat stay. Enjoy spacious accommodations equipped with modern amenities while cruising the serene backwaters. Savor freshly prepared Kerala cuisine on board. Spend the night on the houseboat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Alleppey – Kochi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, proceed to Kochi, a historic port city. Visit Mattancherry Palace, Jew Town, Marine Drive, and Cherai Beach. In the evening, enjoy a relaxing cruise on the Sagararani. Overnight stay in Kochi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Kochi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Kochi Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey, concluding your Kerala honeymoon experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive in Mumbai
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Mumbai Airport, you will be welcomed and assisted on your journey to Shirdi, a spiritual destination renowned for the Sai Baba Temple. En route, visit the Trimbakeshwar Temple in Nashik—one of the twelve Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva. You can also explore the Panchavati Wildlife Sanctuary, home to tigers, leopards, hyenas, and over 300 bird species. Overnight stay in Nashik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Aurangabad Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a visit to Shani Shingnapur, a unique village where the Shani Temple is open to the sky, without a roof. Interestingly, the houses here do not have doors, as locals believe Lord Shani himself protects them and punishes wrongdoers. Overnight stay in Nashik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Ajanta and Ellora Caves
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel towards the famous Ajanta and Ellora Caves, located about three hours apart. These UNESCO World Heritage Sites feature 30 rock-cut Buddhist monuments dating back to the 5th and 6th centuries BCE, with intricate carvings that depict the life and teachings of Buddha. Return to Nashik for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Aurangabad City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today, continue your exploration of the Ellora Caves—magnificent rock-cut temples that span from the 5th to the 12th century. Don’t miss the Kailasa Temple, an architectural wonder carved out of a single rock during the reign of Rashtrakuta King Krishna I. You will also visit the Grishneshwar Temple, Bibi-ka-Maqbara, and the Daulatabad Fort as part of your sightseeing tour. Return to Nashik for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to Mumbai. Depending on your flight or train schedule, explore local attractions in Mumbai City before heading to the airport or railway station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Lucknow - Ayodhya
package_itineraries.description: On your arrival at Lucknow Airport, you will be greeted by the tour representative who will assist you with your transfer to the hotel. After check-in and a brief rest, begin your journey towards Ayodhya. The scenic drive of approximately 2.5 hours passes through picturesque villages and lush fields. Your sightseeing begins with the Ram Janmabhoomi Temple, followed by visits to the Nageshwarnath Temple—believed to be founded by Lord Rama’s son Kush—Kanak Bhawan, Treta ke Thakur, and Sita ki Rasoi, an ancient kitchen shrine associated with Goddess Sita. Each site resonates with deep mythological connections and divine charm. Overnight stay will be arranged in Ayodhya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Ayodhya - Allahabad - Varanasi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Prayagraj (Allahabad) to visit the sacred Triveni Sangam, where the holy rivers Ganga, Yamuna, and Saraswati converge. Continue to explore the Alopi Devi Shakti Peeth Temple, Hanuman Temple, Khusro Baugh, and the historic Anand Bhavan Museum, the ancestral home of the Nehru family. Later, proceed to Varanasi and check into your hotel for an overnight stay in the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Varanasi Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Rise early for the serene morning Ganga Aarti at Assi Ghat, followed by a refreshing boat ride and ritual ablutions in the sacred river. Visit the famous Kashi Vishwanath Temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva, and continue to the Maa Annapurna Mandir, Sankat Mochan Hanuman Mandir, Tulsi Manas Mandir, Kaal Bhairav Mandir, and Durga Kund Mandir. In the evening, enjoy another spiritual moment with the grand Maha Aarti on the Assi Ghat. Take a boat tour to witness the beauty of the renowned ghats such as Manikarnika, Munshi, Dashashwamedh, Scindia, and Man Mandir Ghats, each holding its own story and tradition.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart Varanasi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and make a short visit to Kanak Bhavan, also known as the Golden Palace. Then proceed to Varanasi Airport for your flight home, concluding a deeply spiritual and memorable pilgrimage through India’s most sacred cities.
