package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive in Pune
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Pune Railway Station or Pune International Airport, you will be greeted and assisted with a smooth transfer to Lonavala. After checking into your hotel, take some time to relax and unwind. Later, you can head out to discover the nearby attractions and soak in the serene beauty of this hill retreat.Overnight stay in Lonavala.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Mahabaleshwar Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Mahabaleshwar. The drive, around four hours long, offers mesmerizing views of the Sahyadri Mountains along the way. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Later, visit Venna Lake—an artificial lake created by Shahaji Bhonsale, the ruler of Satara. Activities around the lake include boating, horse riding, and souvenir shopping. You can also explore attractions such as Mapro Garden, Mahabaleshwar Temple, Krishnabai Temple, and the Panchganga Temple.Overnight stay in Mahabaleshwar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Mahabaleshwar Day 2
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out for an excursion to Pratapgadh Fort, a 17th-century marvel built by Moropant Trimbak Pingle, the Prime Minister of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. This is where the historic battle between Shivaji and Afzal Khan took place. You may revisit or continue exploring Mahabaleshwar’s key attractions like Mapro Garden, Mahabaleshwar Temple, Krishnabai Temple, and the Panchganga Temple.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart to Pune
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Pune. En route, stop at Panchgani, another beautiful hill station known for its scenic landscapes, lush plateaus, and captivating viewpoints.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Goa
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival, our representatives will welcome you and escort you to your hotel. After check-in, freshen up and take some time to relax. Spend the remainder of the day exploring romantic local attractions before returning for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: South Goa
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, head out to experience the peaceful charm of South Goa. Visit the revered Shree Mangueshi Temple and the iconic churches of Old Goa. End your day at Dona Paula, where you can indulge in sunbathing or adventurous water activities like jet skiing, kayaking, and scuba diving.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: North Goa
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, embark on a North Goa tour filled with scenic beaches and lively vibes. Enjoy dolphin watching and explore the historic Aguada Fort, a magnificent 17th-century Portuguese structure. Return to your hotel and unwind.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Goa
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at leisure, soak in your last moments in Goa, and then check out from the hotel. Proceed to the airport or railway station for your return journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Goa
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Goa, you’ll be greeted by the tour manager who will assist you with hotel check-in. Once settled, enjoy the rest of the day exploring nearby attractions or simply relaxing at the property.Overnight stay in Goa.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore North Goa
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your North Goa sightseeing adventure. Visit charming towns such as Candolim, Mapusa, Panjim, Mardol, Vagator, and Anjuna. Key highlights include Fort Aguada in Candolim, Vagator Beach, the Basilica of Bom Jesus in Old Goa, and the Mangueshi Temple in Mardol.Don’t forget to stop by Dona Paula, Miramar, and Margoa for scenic views.Overnight stay in North Goa.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Explore South Goa
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, set out to explore Mormagoa, Sonauli, and Vasco da Gama. Visit the Bondla Wildlife Sanctuary in Ponda, marvel at the Dudhsagar Falls, explore the Cotigao Wildlife Sanctuary, and relax at Colva and Palolem Beaches. End the day at Se Cathedral, a stunning example of Goan heritage.Return to your hotel for a peaceful evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Goa
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and bid farewell to Goa before heading to the airport for your journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Coimbatore - Chennai - Arrive in New Jalpaiguri
package_itineraries.description: Begin your journey by boarding the train from Coimbatore Junction Railway Station, travelling towards New Jalpaiguri.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : New Jalpaiguri
package_itineraries.description: The second day is dedicated to your travel towards New Jalpaiguri, ensuring a comfortable and scenic ride.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : New Jalpaiguri - Gangtok
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching New Jalpaiguri Railway Station, you’ll be greeted by our tour representatives who will escort you to your hotel. After check-in, spend the rest of the day at leisure, soaking in the peaceful surroundings. Enjoy an overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Gangtok - Tsongmo Lake - Baba Mandir
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out to explore the stunning Tsongmo Lake, also known as Changgu Lake. Located at an altitude of 3,753 metres, this glacial lake remains frozen in winter and reflects different hues throughout the year, making it sacred to locals. Later, visit Baba Mandir, dedicated to the memory of Indian Army soldier Baba Harbhajan Singh, who lost his life in the line of duty. Situated at 13,123 ft between Nathu La and Jelep La Pass, this temple is revered for its spiritual significance. Return to your hotel for a peaceful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Gangtok - Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a half-day sightseeing tour of Gangtok. Start at Banjhakri Falls and Energy Park, a beautiful recreation area conceptualized by former Chief Minister Pawan Kumar Chamling. Next, visit Do Drul Chorten, a large stupa built in 1945, and the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, home to rare artifacts and a Tibetan library. Continue to the Directorate of Handicrafts & Handloom and the Flower Exhibition Centre. By afternoon, transfer from Gangtok to Darjeeling and unwind at your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: Set out early to Tiger Hill to witness an unforgettable sunrise over the snow-clad peaks of Kanchenjunga and Mount Everest. On your return, stop by Batasia Loop, a spiral railway track with panoramic mountain views, and visit Ghoom Monastery, famous for its 15-ft Maitreya Buddha statue. After breakfast, head to other highlights like the Japanese Buddhist Temple, a tranquil site built under the guidance of Japanese monk Nichidatsu Fujii. Discover the lush tea estates that make Darjeeling world-famous, and visit attractions such as the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Tenzing and Gombu Rock, and the Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre. Conclude your day with a cable car ride from the Darjeeling Ropeway, enjoying breathtaking views of valleys, forests, waterfalls, and tea gardens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7 : Darjeeling - Kolkata
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, travel to New Jalpaiguri Railway Station to board your train to Kolkata.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8 : Kolkata - Botanical Garden - Kalighat Kali Temple
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Kolkata, check in at your hotel and savour a delicious lunch. Begin your city exploration with a visit to the sacred Kalighat Kali Temple, one of the 51 Shakti Peethas, dedicated to Goddess Kali and believed to be around 200 years old. Pass by the iconic Vidyasagar Setu, or Second Hooghly Bridge. Continue to the Botanical Garden, a vast open-air museum of flora featuring over 12,000 plant species across 109 hectares. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9 : Kolkata City Tour - Belur Math - Dakshineswar Kali Temple - Victoria Memorial - Indian Museum
package_itineraries.description: Start your Kolkata sightseeing with Belur Math, located on the west bank of the Hooghly River and founded by Swami Vivekananda as the headquarters of Ramakrishna Math and Mission. Visit Rabindra Bharati University to learn more about Rabindranath Tagore’s life. Explore Dalhousie Square, a colonial-era district featuring Raj Bhavan, Kolkata High Court, Town Hall, General Post Office, and Writers' Building. Head to Victoria Memorial, an architectural masterpiece dedicated to Queen Victoria, and conclude your day at the Indian Museum — Asia’s largest and oldest museum and the ninth oldest in the world.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10 : Depart Kolkata
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your final breakfast in Kolkata and indulge in some shopping before heading to the railway station for your return journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive In Gangtok
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport and meet your representative for a scenic transfer to Gangtok, with stunning views of Kanchenjunga en route. Check in and spend the night in Gangtok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Gangtok Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Baba Mandir, Tsomgo Lake, Hanuman Tok, Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park, and Ganesh Tok. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Gangtok - Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a visit to Ban Jhakri Falls, Droul Chorthen, the Directorate of Handicraft and Handloom, the Flower Exhibition Centre, and the Research Institute of Tibetology. Later, drive to Darjeeling and check in at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Darjeeling Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Ghoom Monastery, Japanese Temple, Batasia Loop, and Himalayan Mountaineering Institute. Enjoy the Darjeeling Ropeway for panoramic views before returning to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Darjeeling Day 2
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Mirik, a serene town known for Mirik Lake’s peaceful ambiance and lush surroundings. Return to Darjeeling in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : Depart Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed to Bagdogra Airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Bagdogra Airport, meet your representative for a transfer to Gangtok. The 4–5-hour drive offers scenic mountain views. Check in to your hotel and rest for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Gangtok Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Tshangu Lake, Hanuman Tok, Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park, Ganesh Tok, and Enchey Monastery. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Gangtok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Gangtok - Pelling
package_itineraries.description: Before departing for Pelling, visit Banjhakri Falls and Do Drul Chorten. Pelling, at an elevation of 6,800 ft, is surrounded by lush forests and vibrant wildlife. Check in and spend the evening admiring the natural beauty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Pelling
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Yuksom, stopping by Rimbi Waterfalls and Darap Waterfalls. Attractions in Yuksom include Dubdi Monastery, Kanchenjunga Waterfall, Khecheopalri Lake, Tashiding Monastery, Pemayangtse Monastery, and Ralang Monastery. Return to Pelling for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Depart Pelling
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Siliguri or Bagdogra Airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Bagdogra – Gangtok
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Bagdogra Airport, meet your representative and proceed to Gangtok. Check in at your hotel and spend the evening relaxing together.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Gangtok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Gangtok, the capital of Sikkim. Visit the famous Tsomgo Lake, whose glacial waters reflect mesmerizing colors depending on the season. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Gangtok – Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day at Ban Jhakri Falls Park, followed by a visit to Do Drul Chorten, the Directorate of Handicrafts and Handloom, Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, and the Flower Exhibition Centre. In the evening, drive to Darjeeling and check in at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: Early morning, visit Tiger Hill to witness the sunrise over Kanchenjunga’s snow peaks. En route back, stop by Ghoom Monastery, Japanese Temple, and Batasia Loop. After breakfast, explore Peace Pagoda, enjoy the Darjeeling Ropeway, and visit Tenzing & Gombu Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre, and Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park. End your day amidst the picturesque tea plantations.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Darjeeling – Depart Bagdogra
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed to Bagdogra Airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Bagdogra Airport, a tour representative will assist with your transfer to Gangtok. En route, admire stunning landscapes and magnificent views of the Kanchenjunga Mountains.Check in and spend the night in Gangtok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Gangtok Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day city tour. Visit Baba Mandir, Hanuman Tok, Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park, and Tshangu Lake before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Gangtok - Kalimpong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Banjhakri Waterfalls, Do Drul Chorten, Ganesh Tok, Enchey Monastery, and the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology. Don’t miss the Gangtok Ropeway for panoramic views. Later, drive to Kalimpong, check in, and relax overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Kalimpong - Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Delo Park, Kalimpong Science Centre, Mangal Dham Temple, Pine View Nursery, Geden Tharpa Choling Monastery, Lepcha Museum, and Zang Dhok Palri Monastery.Later, continue your journey to Darjeeling. Check in at a luxury hotel and rest for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Darjeeling’s highlights, including Kanchendzonga Peak, Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop, Peace Pagoda, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Japanese Temple, Tenzing, Gombu Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre, and the scenic tea plantations.Enjoy the ropeway ride and stay overnight in Darjeeling.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : Depart Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head to Bagdogra Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive In Gangtok
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Bagdogra Airport in Siliguri, you’ll be greeted by a representative who will assist you with your transfer to Gangtok via a scenic road journey. This 4–5-hour drive offers stunning vistas of the Kanchenjunga mountain range. Once at your hotel, check in and spend the evening at leisure, exploring nearby attractions.Overnight stay in Gangtok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Gangtok Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out to discover Gangtok, the capital of Sikkim and a historic Buddhist pilgrimage site established in the 1840s. Renowned for its breathtaking mountain views, Gangtok offers a mix of spirituality and natural beauty.Visit Tsomgo Lake, Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park, Ganesh Tok, Do Drul Chorten, and Enchey Monastery. Enjoy an exciting ride on the Gangtok Ropeway before heading back to your hotel.Overnight stay in Gangtok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Gangtok - Kalimpong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your day with a visit to Banjhakri Falls, a stunning 100-foot waterfall fed by mountain springs. Explore the Research Institute of Tibetology, the Directorate of Handicrafts and Handloom, and the Flower Exhibition Centre.Later, check out and proceed to Kalimpong. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and unwind for the evening.Overnight stay in Kalimpong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Kalimpong Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover Kalimpong, a charming town known for its monasteries, handicrafts, and panoramic views of the Teesta River. Your tour includes Delo Park, Mangal Dham Temple, Pine View Nursery, Geden Tharpa Choling Monastery, Lepcha Museum, Durpin Monastery, and Neora Valley.Later, check out and travel to Darjeeling.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Kalimpong - Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore the local markets of Kalimpong before departing for Darjeeling in the afternoon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : Darjeeling Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Nestled in West Bengal, Darjeeling—fondly called the Queen of the Hills—is famed for its tea and breathtaking scenery. Begin your tour with visits to Kanchendzonga Peak, Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop, and Peace Pagoda. After lunch, explore the Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Japanese Temple, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Darjeeling Ropeway, Tenzing and Gombu Rock, and the Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Center. End your day with a walk through the tea gardens.Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7 : Depart Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Bagdogra Airport for your journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kalimpong - Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Kalimpong’s gems such as Delo Park, Kalimpong Science Centre, Mangal Dham Temple, Pine View Nursery, Geden Tharpa Choling Monastery, Lepcha Museum, Zang Dhok Palri Monastery, and Durpin Monastery. package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Darjeeling

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Darjeeling Day 2

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Gangtok Tour Day 2

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Gangtok – Kalimpong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, journey to Kalimpong. Discover attractions such as Delo Park, Mangal Dham Temple, Kalimpong Science Centre, Pine View Nursery, Geden Tharpa Choling Monastery, Lepcha Museum, and Zang Dhok Palri Monastery.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Gangtok
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast and drive to Bagdogra Airport for your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Gangtok
package_itineraries.description: On arriving at Bagdogra Airport in Siliguri, a representative will meet you and help you transfer to Gangtok. The 4–5-hour journey offers captivating views of the Kanchenjunga Mountains. Check into your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day relaxing or strolling nearby.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Gangtok Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with a delightful breakfast and head out for a full-day city tour. Explore Gangtok’s top attractions including Hanuman Tok, Ganesh Tok, Rumtek Dharma Chakra Centre, and the Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park. Return to your hotel in the evening and stay overnight in Gangtok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Gangtok - Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel to visit Ban Jhakri Falls, Tsongmo Lake, Do Drul Chorten, and Enchey Monastery. Later, drive to Darjeeling for the next part of your adventure. Check in to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day exploring or relaxing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Darjeeling’s famous attractions including Tiger Hills, Batasia Loop, Japanese Peace Pagoda, Sandakphu, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Rock Garden, and the Tea Garden Viewpoint. Don’t miss the Tenzing Rock and the ropeway ride across the tea estates. Spend the night in Darjeeling.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Bagdogra Airport to catch your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Gangtok
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Bagdogra Airport, a representative will greet you and assist with your transfer to Gangtok. Enjoy the picturesque 4–5-hour drive through winding mountain roads. Once you check into your hotel, spend the evening unwinding and exploring the nearby surroundings.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Gangtok Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a day of sightseeing around Gangtok. Visit iconic attractions such as Hanuman Tok, Ban Jhakri Falls, Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park, Ganesh Tok, Enchey Monastery, Do Drul Chorten, and Bakthang Waterfall. Be sure to experience the ropeway ride for a stunning panoramic view of Gangtok City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Gangtok - Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, check out of the hotel and proceed toward Darjeeling. En route, stop at any attractions you may have missed previously. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and set out to explore Darjeeling’s famous landmarks including Tiger Hills, Tenzing Rock, Peace Pagoda, Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre, and Batasia Loop.Stay overnight in Gangtok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Darjeeling
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and travel to Bagdogra Airport to board your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Trivandrum Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Thiruvananthapuram and transfer to your hotel. Explore attractions such as Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple, Trivandrum Zoo, Napier Museum, Sri Chitra Art Gallery, and Padmanabhaswamy Palace. Overnight stay in Trivandrum.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kovalam Beaches
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit the scenic beaches of Kovalam, Varkala, and Shangumugham. Relax, enjoy beach activities, and return to a resort for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Alleppey Houseboat Experience
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, travel to Alleppey and board a houseboat to cruise the tranquil backwaters. Explore village life along the banks and relish freshly cooked cuisine onboard. Spend the night on the houseboat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Thekkady Wildlife Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Check out from the houseboat after breakfast and head to Thekkady. Explore Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary, Elephant Junction, and Green Park Spices Plantation. Overnight stay in Thekkady.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Munnar Hill Station
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Munnar to explore tea plantations, waterfalls, Eravikulam National Park, Pothamedu View Point, Mattupetty Dam, Kolukkumalai Tea Estate, Top Station, and Echo Point. Overnight stay in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Munnar Sightseeing Continuation
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day visiting remaining attractions in Munnar, enjoying scenic views, trekking, and nature walks. Overnight stay in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Kochi City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Kochi. Check in to your hotel and tour the city, visiting the Dutch Palace, Jewish Synagogue, Chinese Fishing Nets, St. Francis Church, and Cherai Beach. Return to the hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure from Kochi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head to Kochi Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey, concluding your complete Kerala vacation.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Kochi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Kochi and check in to your hotel. Begin sightseeing with a visit to Mattancherry Palace, Hill Palace Museum, Paradesi Synagogue, St. Francis Church, and the famous Chinese fishing nets. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kochi to Alleppey
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Alleppey, known for its backwaters, lagoons, and beaches. Check in to your hotel and enjoy lunch. Stroll along Alleppey Beach in the evening before returning for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Alleppey to Kumarakom
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, drive to Kumarakom and board a houseboat at 12:30 PM. Cruise along Vembanad Lake while enjoying local cuisine prepared onboard. Relax amidst the serene surroundings and spend the night on the houseboat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Kochi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the houseboat and drive to Kochi Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cochin
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Cochin Airport or Railway Station, where representatives will assist with hotel transfer. After check-in, embark on a sightseeing tour of Cochin, visiting historical landmarks such as Mattancherry Palace, Paradesi Synagogue, Santa Cruz Cathedral Basilica, and the iconic Chinese fishing nets. In the evening, enjoy a scenic Sagararani cruise, soaking in the waterfront views.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cochin to Munnar
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, travel to Munnar, passing through undulating hills, tea plantations, and waterfalls. On arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the evening at leisure, enjoying the serene hill station ambiance.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Munnar Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Munnar’s must-see attractions, including tea plantations, Echo Point for hiking, Kundala Lake for boating, and Mattupetty Dam. Immerse yourself in the natural beauty of this picturesque region. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Munnar to Thekkady
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Thekkady after breakfast, stopping at the Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary to spot leopards, tigers, elephants, and lion-tailed macaques. Enjoy boating at Periyar Lake before reaching Thekkady, where you check in to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Thekkady to Alleppey
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Alleppey and check in to your hotel. Spend the day enjoying the backwater views, relaxing, and exploring the surrounding area.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Cochin
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive back to Cochin for your onward journey by flight or train, concluding the romantic getaway.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Kochi to Munnar
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Kochi Airport, where you will be greeted and assisted in transferring to Munnar. The drive of around three hours is scenic, passing swaying coconut palms, tea gardens, and lush landscapes. On the way, stop at Cheeyappara Waterfalls in Adimali to enjoy cascading waters over rocky terraces. Check in to your hotel in Munnar and spend the evening soaking in the views or resting after the journey. Overnight stay in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Full-Day Munnar Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day tour of Munnar’s top attractions. Visit Eravikulam National Park, home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr, and take in sweeping views from Pothamedu View Point. Explore Mattupetty Dam, Kundala Dam, and the scenic tea gardens. Capture the essence of Munnar’s natural beauty through trekking, photography, and relaxation. Return to your hotel in the evening for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Munnar to Thekkady
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, drive to Thekkady, famous for the Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary. The sanctuary offers encounters with elephants, tigers, leopards, and other wildlife. Explore the Cinnamon Gardens Spice Plantation and engage in activities such as trekking, bamboo rafting, and elephant rides. Overnight stay in Thekkady, surrounded by the region’s natural splendor.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Thekkady to Kochi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, bid farewell to Thekkady and travel back to Kochi to catch your onward flight or train, concluding your nature-filled Kerala adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Kochi – Transfer to Munnar
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Kochi, you will be welcomed by tour representatives who will assist with your transfer to Munnar. Nestled amidst rolling hills, tea gardens, and misty mountains, Munnar is a paradise for nature lovers. After checking into your hotel, spend the evening relaxing or taking a gentle stroll through the nearby tea plantations, enjoying the fresh mountain air.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Munnar
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before setting out to explore the highlights of Munnar. Visit the lush tea estates, enjoy panoramic views from Pothamedu View Point, and admire the engineering marvel of Mattupetty Dam. You can also take part in boating at Kundala Lake, go trekking at Echo Point, or enjoy birdwatching as you soak in the serenity of this hill station. Return to your hotel in the evening for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Munnar to Kumarakom
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and travel to Kumarakom, a picturesque village on the Vembanad Lake. On arrival, complete hotel check-in and unwind. In the evening, enjoy the stunning backwater views from your resort, perhaps taking a leisurely walk along the lakeside, breathing in the tranquil ambiance.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kumarakom to Alleppey Houseboat Stay
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, drive to Alleppey to experience one of Kerala’s most iconic attractions—a stay on a traditional houseboat. Board your houseboat and cruise through the serene backwaters, enjoying views of coconut palms, small villages, and paddy fields along the canals. Relish freshly prepared local cuisine on board while you relax, ending the day immersed in the unique charm of Alleppey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart from Kochi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the houseboat and drive back to Kochi. You will be assisted in boarding your flight or train, marking the conclusion of a blissful honeymoon journey in Kerala.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Alleppey
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, check into your hotel and board a houseboat for a relaxing cruise through canals and lagoons. Enjoy a sumptuous lunch while taking in serene views. Later, explore Alleppey Beach.Overnight stay at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kochi – Wonderla
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Kochi and check into your hotel. Spend the day at Wonderla amusement park, enjoying rides and family fun. Return to the hotel for the night.Overnight stay in Kochi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Kochi – Cherai Beach – Marine Drive – Munnar
package_itineraries.description: Explore Cherai Beach and Marine Drive in Kochi, enjoy a boat ride, and indulge in shopping at Lulu Mall. Later, transfer to Munnar for a peaceful night at the hotel.Overnight stay in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rose Garden – Echo Point – Kundala Dam – Mattupetty Dam – Depart
package_itineraries.description: On the final day, visit Munnar’s top attractions, including Rose Garden, Echo Point, Kundala Dam, and Mattupetty Dam, before departing for the airport to catch your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Cochin – Munnar
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Cochin, transfer to Munnar with a stop at Athirappilly Falls. Check into the hotel and later visit Mattupetty Dam and Kundala Lake, surrounded by scenic views. Return to the hotel for the night.Overnight stay in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Munnar
package_itineraries.description: Explore Munnar’s tea plantations, hills, and natural beauty. Visit Echo Point, where three mountain ranges converge. Enjoy birdwatching, boating, and nature walks, followed by a visit to Eravikulam National Park to spot wildlife including leopards and giant squirrels.Overnight stay in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Munnar – Thekkady
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Thekkady. After check-in, visit Periyar National Park, home to tigers, elephants, leopards, lion-tailed macaques, and bison.Overnight stay in Thekkady.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Thekkady
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, the day is free for leisure or additional exploration.Overnight stay in Thekkady.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Thekkady – Cochin – Depart
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Cochin for your flight or train home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Calicut
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Calicut Airport or Railway Station, your tour representative will escort you to your hotel. Complete check-in formalities and spend the day at leisure.Overnight stay in Calicut.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Wayanad
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Wayanad’s highlights, including Pookode Lake, Lakkidi Rainforest, Kuruva Island, and Edakkal Caves, with rock engravings dating back to the Neolithic Age. Also, visit Panamaram, Mananthavady, and the Kabini tributary for scenic views.Overnight stay in Wayanad.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Wayanad – Calicut
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, return to Calicut and check into your hotel. Explore Kozhikode Beach, Thali Temple, Pazhassi Raja Archaeological Museum, Kappad Beach, and Beypore Beach.Overnight stay in Calicut.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Calicut
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport or railway station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Munnar
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Kochi, transfer to Munnar, a journey of about five hours through lush greenery. Check into your hotel and relax. Later, visit Devikulam, Mattupetty Dam, and Anaimudi Peak before returning for a leisurely evening at the hotel.Overnight stay in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Munnar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Rajamalai Hills to explore Eravikulam National Park, Kerala’s first national park and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Later, explore Nyayamakad, known for its waterfalls, Echo Point, Kundala Dam, and Malankara Reservoir.Overnight stay in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Thekkady
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Thekkady to explore Periyar National Park, home to elephants, tigers, and other endemic species. Check into your hotel and enjoy a boat ride on Periyar Lake to observe birds and wildlife.Overnight stay in Thekkady.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Thekkady
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, visit Mangala Devi Temple for blessings and explore Kumily and Vandiperiyar. Return to your hotel to relax in the evening.Overnight stay in Thekkady.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kochi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Kochi for your train or flight, marking the end of a memorable honeymoon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Kochi
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Kochi International Airport or Railway Station, you will be greeted and guided to your hotel. Complete check-in formalities and relax. Later, embark on a city tour, visiting Dutch Palace, Jewish Synagogue, Santa Cruz Basilica, and Vasco da Gama Square, with its famous Chinese fishing nets. Jew Town offers unique shopping opportunities for antiques, crockery, and brass sculptures.Overnight stay in Kochi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kochi – Munnar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Munnar, often called the “Kashmir of South India,” known for its tea estates, spice plantations, waterfalls, and valleys. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the nearby scenic spots.Overnight stay in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Munnar
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, explore Munnar’s highlights: Pothamedu View Point, Mattupetty Dam, Tea Museum, Kolukkumalai Tea Estate, Kundala Dam, Echo Point, Anamudi Peak, and Eravikulam National Park. Take in the serene landscapes and lush plantations.Overnight stay at a luxury hotel in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Munnar – Kumarakom
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Kumarakom, set on the banks of Vembanad Lake. Complete check-in at a lakeside resort and enjoy a relaxing backwater cruise with picturesque views.Overnight stay in Kumarakom.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kumarakom – Alleppey
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Alleppey for a houseboat experience. Spend the night on board, enjoying the tranquil backwaters. The houseboat features air-conditioned bedrooms, a living area, and a viewing deck. Enjoy freshly cooked vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals by onboard chefs.Overnight stay on the houseboat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Alleppey – Kochi
package_itineraries.description: On the final day, travel to Kochi, a journey of approximately 1.5 hours. Depart from Kochi Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Guruvayur
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Kochi Airport or Guruvayur Railway Station, your tour representative will welcome you and assist in transferring to the hotel. Take some time to relax and refresh. Later, you can visit the iconic Sree Krishna Temple for a serene darshan of Guruvayurappan.Spend the night at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Guruvayur – Munnar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Munnar, a journey of approximately six hours. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and unwind. Post lunch, set out for sightseeing, exploring Munnar’s famous tea plantations. Enjoy the scenic views and a cozy evening by the fire at the hotel.Overnight stay in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Munnar
package_itineraries.description: Dedicate this day to exploring Munnar’s scenic attractions, including Eravikulam National Park, Kolukkumalai Tea Estate, Pothamedu View Point, Mattupetty Dam, Kundala Dam, Echo Point, and Top Station. Take in the breathtaking natural beauty and relax in the serene surroundings.Spend the night in Munnar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Munnar – Thekkady
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Thekkady to explore Periyar National Park, home to elephants, monkeys, wild boars, and other wildlife. Also, visit the Cardamom Hills, known for its cardamom, pepper, and coffee plantations. Your tour includes a boat cruise on Periyar Lake to experience wildlife up close.Overnight stay at a luxury hotel in Thekkady.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Thekkady – Alleppey
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, transfer to Alleppey for a traditional houseboat stay. Enjoy spacious accommodations equipped with modern amenities while cruising the serene backwaters. Savor freshly prepared Kerala cuisine on board.Spend the night on the houseboat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Alleppey – Kochi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, proceed to Kochi, a historic port city. Visit Mattancherry Palace, Jew Town, Marine Drive, and Cherai Beach. In the evening, enjoy a relaxing cruise on the Sagararani.Overnight stay in Kochi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Kochi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Kochi Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey, concluding your Kerala honeymoon experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hyderabad
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Hyderabad airport or railway station, you will be warmly welcomed and assisted with a comfortable transfer to your hotel. After completing the check-in process, take some time to relax before beginning your exploration of the city.Start your sightseeing by visiting some of Hyderabad’s iconic attractions, including Hussain Sagar Lake, Birla Mandir, Sanjeevaiah Park, Lumbini Park, Necklace Road, NTR Gardens, and the popular Snow World amusement park.Return to your hotel in the evening and enjoy your leisure time at rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Ramoji Film City Excursion
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, embark on a full-day excursion to the world-renowned Ramoji Film City. Sprawled across more than 1,600 acres, this is among the largest integrated film studios in the world. Inside, you’ll find movie sets, thrilling rides, gardens, themed attractions, and entertainment shows for visitors of all ages.Take a guided studio tour to witness the grandeur of film production, enjoy the adventure zones, and unwind at the leisure spaces before returning to your hotel for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hyderabad Sightseeing Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, continue with the final segment of your Hyderabad tour. Begin by visiting the Charminar, the city’s most iconic monument, and explore the lively bazaars around it known for pearls, bangles, and traditional artefacts.Later, proceed to Nehru Zoological Park, Makkah Masjid, and the renowned Salar Jung Museum, home to one of the world’s largest private art collections. End your day sampling the city’s famous street food or shopping for souvenirs before heading back to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Hyderabad
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, it’s time to bid farewell to the vibrant city. Proceed to Hyderabad airport or railway station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Bangalore
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Bangalore airport or railway station and meet your representative. After check-in, visit Cubbon Park, Lalbagh Botanical Garden, Tipu Sultan’s Palace, Vidhana Soudha, Bangalore Palace, St. Patrick’s Church, and Bull Temple.Stay overnight in Bangalore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Bangalore – Mysore
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Mysore. Check in and spend the rest of the day exploring or relaxing.Overnight stay in Mysore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Mysore City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Chamundi Hills, Brindavan Gardens, Karanji Lake, Mysore Zoo, and St. Philomena’s Cathedral.Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mysore – Coorg
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Coorg, the most scenic hill station in Karnataka. Check in at the hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure.Stay overnight in Coorg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Coorg
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Omkareshwara Temple, Abbey Falls, Raja’s Seat, Iruppu Falls, Madikeri Fort, and Nagarahole Tiger Reserve.Overnight stay in Coorg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Coorg – Bangalore – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, return to Bangalore for your onward journey, marking the end of your Coorg Honeymoon Package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Bangalore – Mysore
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Bangalore, you will be welcomed and driven to Mysore, a journey of around three hours through scenic countryside. En route, stop at Chamundi Hills, Mysore Zoo, Brindavan Gardens, Mysore Lake, and St. Philomena Church.Check in to your hotel and spend the night in Mysore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Mysore – Ooty
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Ooty, the renowned Queen of Hill Stations. The four-hour drive offers delightful views of valleys and plantations. Check in at the hotel and spend the evening visiting Ooty Lake and the famous Botanical Gardens.Overnight stay in Ooty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Ooty
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Ooty’s most popular sites such as Doddabetta Peak, Rose Garden, Lamb’s Rock, Tea Factory, Mudumalai Tiger Reserve, and Pykara Falls.Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Ooty – Kodaikanal
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and travel to Kodaikanal through winding hill roads, taking about six hours. On arrival, relax at your hotel and enjoy the serene surroundings.Stay overnight in Kodaikanal.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kodaikanal
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head out to explore Coaker’s Walk, Green Valley View, Byrant Park, Pillar Rocks, Kodai Lake, and Kurinji Andavar Temple.Return to your hotel and enjoy an evening stroll through nearby farmlands.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Kodaikanal – Bangalore
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and return to Bangalore, marking the end of your Mysore vacation package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Bangalore
package_itineraries.description: Upon arriving in Bangalore, you’ll be greeted by the tour representative and transferred to your hotel. After check-in, take a short rest before setting out for a sightseeing tour of Bengaluru. You will visit Lalbagh Botanical Garden, Cubbon Park, Vidhana Soudha, and Tipu Sultan’s Palace.Spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Bangalore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Bangalore to Coorg
package_itineraries.description: After a delicious breakfast, check out and drive to Coorg. The six-hour journey through the lush countryside is truly picturesque. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel and relax for the evening while soaking in the pleasant atmosphere.Overnight stay at a luxury resort in Coorg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Coorg
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and begin your full-day sightseeing of Coorg. Known for its coffee estates and misty landscapes, you’ll explore Nagarhole National Park, Madikeri Fort, Iruppu Falls, Raja’s Seat, Nunnery Falls, and the Omkareshwara Sanctuary.Return to the hotel and spend the night in Coorg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Coorg – Bangalore
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and drive back to Bangalore as your Coorg trip package concludes.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Tirupathi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Tirupathi by train or flight. After check-in, enjoy an optional local sightseeing tour or relax at your hotel. Spend the night in Tirupathi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tirupathi – Bangalore
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a sacred darshan at Sri Venkateshwara Swami Temple and Padmavati Ammavari Temple. After lunch, travel to Bangalore. On arrival, check into your hotel and spend the evening exploring nearby attractions. Overnight stay in Bangalore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bangalore – Mysore
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Bangalore’s famous landmarks, including Cubbon Park, Tippu Sultan’s Summer Palace, Bangalore Palace, and Bull Temple. Later, proceed to Mysore and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mysore – Ooty
package_itineraries.description: Visit Mysore Palace, Chamundeshwari Temple, Somnathapura Temple, and Brindavan Gardens. After sightseeing, head to Ooty and check into your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Ooty
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Ooty’s highlights—Botanical Gardens, Rose Garden, Doddabetta, Mudumalai Tiger Reserve, Pykara Falls, and Tea Factory. Overnight stay in Ooty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Ooty - Madurai
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Madurai via Coonoor, stopping at Dolphin’s Nose viewpoint. Visit Meenakshi Amman Temple in the evening and shop nearby before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Madurai
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore the Gandhi Museum, Thirumalai Nayakar Palace, Vandiyur Mariamman Teppakulam, and Alagarkoil. Spend the evening sampling Madurai’s street food.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Rameshwaram
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Rameshwaram. Visit Ramanathaswamy Temple, Pamban Bridge, Dhanushkodi, and the Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial. Overnight stay in Rameshwaram.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Rameshwaram – Kanyakumari
package_itineraries.description: Head to Kanyakumari, visiting Gandhi Memorial, Thiruvalluvar Statue, and watching the sunset. Overnight stay in Kanyakumari.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Witness the sunrise, visit Bhagavathiamman Temple, Suchindrum Temple, and Padmanabhapuram Palace before travelling to Coimbatore for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Madurai
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Madurai Airport or Railway Station, our representatives will assist with your transfer. After check-in, explore Madurai’s landmarks, including Meenakshi Amman Temple, Thiruparankundram Murugan Temple, Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace, Gandhi Memorial Museum, and Alagar Kovil. Overnight stay at Madurai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Madurai - Rameshwaram
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Rameshwaram. On arrival, check in and visit Sri Ramanathaswamy Temple, famous for its long corridors and carved pillars. Then explore Agnitheertham, Dhanushkodi, Ramar Padam, and Adam’s Bridge. Stay overnight in Rameshwaram.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rameshwaram - Kanyakumari
package_itineraries.description: Leave for Kanyakumari, the meeting point of three oceans. Visit Vivekananda Rock Memorial, Kumari Amman Temple, Suchindram Temple, Gandhi Mandapam, and Triveni Sangamam. Witness a peaceful sunset over the sea and return to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kanyakumari – Trivandrum
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Trivandrum. Visit Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple, Padmanabhapuram Palace, the Government Secretariat, and the Museum of History and Heritage.

package_itineraries.title: Depart Trivandrum
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, proceed to check out and transfer to the airport or railway station for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Madurai
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Madurai, our representatives will welcome you and transfer you to your hotel. After check-in, start your city tour with visits to Meenakshi Amman Temple, Thiruparankundram Murugan Temple, Pazhamudhir Solai, and Teppakulam. In the evening, witness the light and sound show at Thirumalai Nayak Palace. Stay overnight in Madurai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Madurai - Kodaikanal
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and travel to Kodaikanal, the “Princess of Hill Stations.” After check-in, relax before heading to Bryant Park, a picturesque garden ideal for boating, cycling, and horse riding. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Kodaikanal
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore the highlights of Kodaikanal. Visit Coaker’s Walk for panoramic views, Pillar Rocks, Chettiar Park, Green Valley View Point, and the beautiful waterfalls that surround the hill station. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Madurai
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel in Kodaikanal and return to Madurai. Proceed to the airport or railway station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Madurai
package_itineraries.description: After reaching Madurai, our representatives will welcome you and assist with your hotel transfer. Once check-in is done, begin exploring the vibrant city. Visit the magnificent Arulmigu Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple, also known as Arulmigu Meenakshi Amman Thirukkovil, devoted to Goddess Meenakshi. Later, explore Teppakulam and enjoy the mesmerizing light and sound show at Thirumalai Nayak Palace. Spend the night at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Madurai - Kodaikanal
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast and drive to the scenic hill station of Kodaikanal. After check-in, relax for a bit before visiting Bryant Park, a lush botanical paradise filled with colourful plants and exotic shrubs. Return to your hotel in the evening for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Kodaikanal
package_itineraries.description: Dedicate the entire day to sightseeing around Kodaikanal. Visit Green Valley View Point, Coaker’s Walk, Pillar Rocks, Shenbaganur Museum, and Chettiar Park. Discover the region’s beautiful waterfalls and serene landscapes before heading back to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kodaikanal - Madurai
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, journey back to Madurai. On arrival, visit the sacred Alagar Kovil Temple and the Gandhi Memorial Museum to learn about India’s freedom history. Relax at your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Madurai – Rameshwaram
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, set off for Rameshwaram, one of India’s holiest pilgrimage destinations. After check-in, explore the town’s famous landmarks such as Ramjharoka Temple, Sri Arulmigu Ramanathaswamy Temple, Agnitheertham, Dhanushkodi, and Adam’s Bridge. Spend the night in Rameshwaram.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Rameshwaram - Kanyakumari
package_itineraries.description: Depart from Rameshwaram for Kanyakumari, located at India’s southernmost tip. Visit important landmarks including Kumari Amman Temple, Suchindram Theroor Bird Sanctuary, Vivekananda Rock Memorial, Triveni Sangamam, and Gandhi Memorial. Enjoy the breathtaking sunset at Kanyakumari Beach before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Kanyakumari – Trivandrum – Depart Trivandrum
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Trivandrum with a stop at the historic Padmanabhapuram Palace. In the capital of Kerala, visit Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple and the Government Secretariat before heading to the airport or railway station for your journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Delhi Airport, you’ll be met and driven to Agra. En route, stop at Mathura, the birthplace of Lord Krishna. On reaching Agra, check in at the hotel and spend the evening exploring the local surroundings. Overnight stay in Agra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Agra – Jaipur via Fatehpur Sikri
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort before departing for Jaipur. Stop at Fatehpur Sikri to explore Buland Darwaza, Diwan-i-Khas, Panch Mahal, Birbal Mahal, and Jodhabai’s Palace. Arrive in Jaipur and spend the evening browsing the local markets. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Jaipur Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin exploring Jaipur. Visit Hawa Mahal, City Palace, Amber Fort, Jaigarh Fort, Nahargarh Fort, Jal Mahal, Jantar Mantar, Rambagh Palace, and Ramniwas Bagh. In the evening, shop for handicrafts at Bapu Bazaar. Stay overnight in Jaipur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Jaipur – Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Delhi and check into your hotel. Later, explore Delhi’s landmarks such as Qutub Minar, India Gate, Red Fort, Parliament House, and Jama Masjid. Spend the evening at leisure before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Raj Ghat, Shanti Van, and Agrasen Ki Baoli. Later, shop for souvenirs at Sarojini Market before heading to the airport or railway station for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Delhi Airport or Railway Station, where representatives will assist you on your drive to Nainital. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax for the rest of the day at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Nainital Zoo – Hanuman Garhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your day with a visit to the Nainital Zoo, located 2100 meters above sea level and spread over nearly five hectares. Here you’ll spot leopards, Tibetan wolves, red junglefowls, macaques, and barking deer. Later, visit Hanuman Garhi Temple, a revered shrine dedicated to Lord Hanuman. Return to your hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bhimtal – Sattal – Naukuchiatal
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Bhimtal, Sattal, and Naukuchiatal Lakes to enjoy boating and scenic beauty. Later, visit the Naina Devi Himalayan Bird Conservation Reserve for a peaceful walk among birds. Return to your hotel in the evening and stay overnight in Nainital.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed to Delhi to catch your train or flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Once you arrive in Delhi, you’ll be met and escorted to Nainital. The scenic 7-hour drive passes through charming countryside views. Upon reaching Nainital, check into your hotel and take some time to unwind. Later, enjoy a peaceful boat ride on Naini Lake or stroll along the lively Mall Road. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay in Nainital.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Nainital Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty mountain-style breakfast, begin exploring Nainital. Named after the Naina Devi Temple that overlooks Naini Lake, the town offers mesmerizing landscapes. Visit the Mukteshwar Temple, Bhim Tal, Sat Tal, and the sacred Naina Devi Temple. Post lunch, enjoy a thrilling ropeway ride on Gun Hill followed by some evening shopping before heading back to your hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Nainital – Kausani
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Kausani via Almora. Known as the ‘Switzerland of India’, Kausani offers uninterrupted views of the Himalayan peaks. Visit Anasakti Ashram, Rudradhari Falls, Baijnath Temple, and the Kausani Tea Estate. Return to your hotel for dinner and overnight stay in Nainital.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kausani
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Kausani’s attractions, including the Kausani Shawl Factory and the sacred town of Bageshwar. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay in Kausani.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kausani - Corbett National Park
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Corbett, stopping by Ranikhet along the way. Explore local attractions such as Chaubatia Gardens, Haidakhan Babaji Temple, and Bhalu Dam. On reaching Corbett, check into your hotel and enjoy the evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Corbett – Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a morning safari at Jim Corbett National Park, India’s oldest national park established in 1936. Spot animals such as Bengal tigers, elephants, sambars, and bears in their natural habitat. After the safari, check out and drive back to Delhi to board your train or flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival in Delhi, you’ll be greeted warmly and transferred to your hotel. After check-in and some rest, spend the day exploring nearby attractions or shopping in the vibrant local markets. Delhi’s diverse blend of culture and history offers a fascinating introduction to your journey. Return to your hotel in the evening for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Delhi - Manali
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast before setting off for a sightseeing tour around Delhi. Discover architectural landmarks like the Lotus Temple, Birla Mandir, Rajghat, Indira Gandhi Memorial Museum, and the iconic India Gate. Later, spend some time shopping at Karol Bagh before boarding your evening journey to Manali, nestled in the lap of the Himalayas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Manali - Shri Vashisht Temple - Hadimba Devi Temple
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Manali, check into your hotel and refresh yourself. Begin your exploration with a visit to the ancient Vashisht Temple, famed for its natural hot water springs believed to have healing properties. Continue to the Hadimba Devi Temple, dedicated to Hidimbi Devi and surrounded by cedar forests. Enjoy the evening in leisure before retiring for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rohtang Pass
package_itineraries.description: Today’s excursion takes you to the legendary Rohtang Pass, located at a height of 3,980 meters above sea level. This mountain pass links the Kullu Valley with Lahaul and Spiti and provides awe-inspiring views of snow-laden peaks and glaciers. Spend time playing in the snow or capturing photographs before returning to Manali by evening for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Manali - Kullu - Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, bid farewell to Manali as you begin your return journey to Delhi. On the way, pass by the scenic Beas River, Sutlej River, and the stunning landscapes of Kullu Valley. Stop at a local shawl factory in Kullu to see traditional craftsmanship before continuing your drive toward Delhi. Enjoy the peaceful mountain vistas along the way.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Delhi, relax for a while before visiting the spiritual Akshardham Temple, a marvel of modern Indian architecture. Spend some time shopping for souvenirs in the local markets before heading to the Delhi Railway Station or airport for your onward journey home, bringing back memories of your educational adventure in Manali.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Leh
package_itineraries.description: After landing at Leh Airport, you will be received and escorted to your hotel for check-in. Enjoy a welcome drink upon arrival and take some time to rest and acclimatize to the altitude. Spend the remainder of the day relaxing or exploring the local surroundings at your leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Leh City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a hearty breakfast before setting out on a full-day exploration of Leh. Begin your sightseeing at Shey Palace, once the summer capital of Ladakh and home to the region’s second-largest Buddha statue. Continue to Stakna Monastery, perched at an altitude of 3,600 m, before heading to the famous Hemis Monastery, founded in 1672 AD and renowned for its vibrant annual festival. End the day at Thiksey Monastery, a magnificent hilltop Gompa offering breathtaking views of the Indus Valley.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leh – Ladakh – Leh
package_itineraries.description: Today, prepare for a mesmerizing drive to Pangong Lake, the world’s highest saltwater lake. The route passes through the scenic Chang La Pass, where you can stop for lunch at Tagste village. The shimmering blue hues of Pangong Lake will captivate your senses. After spending time soaking in its beauty and capturing memories, return to Leh by evening for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Leh – Ladakh – Leh
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head out to explore the famous Khardung La Pass, one of the highest motorable roads in the world, located 40 km from Leh at an altitude of 5,359 meters. Visit the Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, a sacred site built in memory of Guru Nanak Dev Ji. Later, witness the stunning confluence of the Indus and Zanskar Rivers — a remarkable natural wonder of Ladakh. Return to your hotel in Leh for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Leh
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast in the morning before checking out of your hotel. You will then be transferred to Leh Airport to catch your flight home, carrying unforgettable memories of your Ladakh adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Srinagar Airport, you’ll be warmly greeted and assisted to your hotel or houseboat. After check-in, enjoy a romantic shikhara ride on Dal Lake, one of the largest and most picturesque lakes in India. Explore Char Chinar Island and Nehru Park before returning to your stay.Overnight in Srinagar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Srinagar – Gulmarg – Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to the scenic town of Gulmarg, famously known as the “Meadow of Flowers.” En route, stop at the Apple Garden and soak in the countryside charm. Visit Gulmarg Golf Course and enjoy the famous Gulmarg Gondola ride, the highest cable car project in Asia. Return to Srinagar for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Srinagar – Pahalgam – Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out for Pahalgam, a romantic town surrounded by pine forests and snow peaks. Stop at Awantipora Ruins and saffron fields along the way. Spend quality time in Pahalgam before heading back to Srinagar for the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Srinagar’s beauty. Visit the Shankaracharya Temple, Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Garden, and Cheshma Shahi Garden. In the evening, enjoy a leisurely stroll or relax in your houseboat.Stay overnight in Srinagar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport to catch your flight back home, taking unforgettable honeymoon memories with you.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Jammu
package_itineraries.description: Upon arriving at Jammu Airport, you will be greeted by your tour representative, who will assist you on your drive to Katra. The journey takes about one and a half hours and is filled with stunning mountain views. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the surroundings.Overnight stay in Katra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Katra – Vaishno Devi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out for a spiritual journey to the Vaishno Devi Temple, a revered 700-year-old shrine devoted to Maa Shakti. After completing your darshan, return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Katra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Katra – Pahalgam
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Pahalgam, a tranquil hill station adorned with verdant meadows and glistening rivers. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy exploring the charming surroundings.Spend the night in Pahalgam.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Pahalgam – Gulmarg
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, explore local attractions in Pahalgam, such as Mamaleshwar Temple, Chandanwari, Wadiy e Hajan, and the sacred Amarnath Cave Temple. Later, proceed to Gulmarg, known for its scenic gondola rides and alpine beauty. Visit Strawberry Valley, Afarwat, and Drung Waterfall before retiring for the night in Gulmarg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Gulmarg – Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir. Visit Shalimar Bagh, Nishat Garden, Pari Mahal, the Tulip Garden, Hari Parbat, and Dal Lake. Enjoy a serene houseboat stay overnight in Srinagar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore the places you missed yesterday. Take a boat ride across Dal Lake, visit the Floating Gardens, Lal Chowk, and Sinthan Top, or simply unwind amid the natural beauty.Overnight stay in Srinagar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a relaxed day. You can visit Sri Shankaracharya Temple, go shopping for souvenirs, or simply relax in your houseboat with a warm cup of Kashmiri kahwa.Stay overnight in Srinagar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Depart Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed to the airport to board your flight home, carrying wonderful memories of your Kashmir journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 01: Arrive in Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching the Srinagar Airport, you’ll be welcomed by your tour representative and transferred to your hotel. Once you’ve checked in, spend some time unwinding before starting your exploration. Visit the enchanting Mughal Gardens — Nishant Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Pari Mahal, and Chashme Shahi — known for their artistic design and natural beauty.Spend the night at your hotel in Srinagar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 02: Srinagar – Sonmarg – Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off to Sonmarg, also called the “Meadow of Gold,” surrounded by snow-dusted peaks and the sparkling Sindh River. Visit the Thajiwas Glacier, Zoji La Pass, Vishansar Lake, Gangabal Lake, Gadsar Lake, and the sacred Amarnath Cave Temple.Return to Srinagar in the evening and enjoy a peaceful night in a houseboat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 03: Srinagar – Pahalgam
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, check out and proceed towards Pahalgam. En route, stop by Mattan Lake and the Awantipora Ruins — ancient remains of a temple built by King Awanti Warman in the 8th century.After reaching Pahalgam, check into your hotel and spend the evening exploring the scenic town, often called “Mini Switzerland,” known for its association with the Amarnath Yatra.Stay overnight in Pahalgam.

package_itineraries.title: Day 04: Pahalgam – Gulmarg
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Gulmarg, stopping at Chandanwari, Betaab Valley, and Aru Valley along the way. These valleys are known for their snow-covered hills, pine forests, and peaceful atmosphere.Upon arrival in Gulmarg, check into your hotel and spend the day at leisure. Gulmarg, meaning “Meadow of Flowers,” offers delightful springtime views with blooming bluebells and buttercups.Stay overnight in Gulmarg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 05: Gulmarg – Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head back to Srinagar. En route, stop at Kungdoor to enjoy the famous gondola ride that offers panoramic mountain views from Kongdori Station.Return to Srinagar and check into your houseboat for a traditional overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 06: Depart Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, proceed to the airport to catch your flight back home, cherishing the unforgettable memories of Kashmir.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Jaipur
package_itineraries.description: Upon arriving in Jaipur, you will be greeted and assisted to your hotel. After checking in, spend the rest of the day exploring nearby attractions or relaxing.Overnight stay in Jaipur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Jaipur Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a full-day exploration of the Pink City. Visit Amber Fort, Sheesh Mahal, Hawa Mahal, City Palace, Nahargarh Fort, Jantar Mantar, Jal Mahal, Jaigarh Fort, and Birla Mandir.Return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Jaipur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Jaipur - Jodhpur
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive toward Jodhpur, stopping at Pushkar on the way. In Pushkar, explore the sacred Brahma Temple, the famous Camel Fair grounds, and the Ajmer Khwaja Dargah.Arrive in Jodhpur, check into your hotel, and spend the night in the Blue City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Jodhpur
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a city tour of Jodhpur. Visit the majestic Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada, Ghanta Ghar, and Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum. Later, explore Osian Village, known for its ancient Jain and Hindu temples dating back to the 8th–12th centuries. You can also experience a desert camel safari.Return to your hotel and spend the night in Jodhpur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Jodhpur - Udaipur
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, proceed to Udaipur and visit the stunning Ranakpur Temples en route. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and explore the City Palace, Jagdish Temple, Sajjangarh Monsoon Palace, Bagore ki Haveli, Lake Pichola, and Ambrai Ghat.Overnight stay in Udaipur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Udaipur City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Saheliyon ki Bari, Lok Kala Mandal, and the Crystal Gallery to complete your sightseeing.Spend the night in Udaipur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Udaipur
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy shopping at the local markets before being dropped off at the railway station or airport for your return journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Jaipur
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Jaipur Airport, you will be warmly greeted and assisted to your hotel. Check in and spend the evening relaxing or exploring nearby attractions. Overnight stay in the Pink City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Jaipur Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out for a full-day tour of Jaipur. Your sightseeing includes Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, Nahargarh Fort, Jantar Mantar, City Palace, Jal Mahal, Jaigarh Fort, Rambagh Palace, and Patrika Gate.Return to your hotel for an overnight stay at a luxury property in Jaipur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Jaipur - Pushkar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Pushkar, one of the oldest cities in India, known for its sacred lake, the Brahma Temple, and the world-famous Camel Fair. You will also stop by Ajmer to visit the revered Khwaja Nawaz Dargah Sharif.Head back to the hotel for an overnight stay in Jaipur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Jaipur - Jodhpur
package_itineraries.description: After a delightful breakfast, journey toward Jodhpur, the Blue City of Rajasthan. The drive takes about 4.5 hours. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and relax for the remainder of the day.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Jodhpur Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After a relaxed breakfast, begin your sightseeing adventure in Jodhpur. Explore the majestic Mehrangarh Fort, Moti Mahal, Phool Mahal, Umaid Bhawan Palace, and Jaswant Thada.Return to your hotel in the evening for an overnight stay in Jodhpur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart Jodhpur
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your breakfast, then check out from the hotel and proceed to the airport for your return journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Delhi – Jaipur
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Delhi Airport or Railway Station, meet your tour guide and drive to Jaipur. Stop en route at Amber Fort for an elephant ride. Once in Jaipur, check in to your hotel and explore the nearby attractions.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Jaipur City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit City Palace, a grand structure representing Rajasthan’s royal history. Explore Hawa Mahal, built with pink and red sandstone, and Jantar Mantar, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Later, visit the Tomb of Salim Chishti and the Albert Hall Museum before driving to Pushkar to see the sacred Pushkar Lake and Brahma Temple.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Jaipur – Udaipur
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive from Jaipur to Udaipur. Upon arrival, relax at your hotel before visiting Jagdish Temple, built during Maharana Jagat Singh’s reign, and Saheliyon Ki Bari. End the day with a scenic view of Lake Pichola.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Udaipur – Mount Abu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Mount Abu, Rajasthan’s only hill station. Check in and visit famous spots like Dilwara Temples, Nakki Lake, and Sunset Point for a serene evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Mount Abu – Delhi – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive back to Delhi to catch your flight or train home, carrying wonderful memories of your honeymoon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Delhi – Manali
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Delhi Airport, meet your representative and transfer to Manali. Complete your check-in at the hotel and spend the rest of the evening relaxing or exploring the local markets.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Manali – Rohtang Pass – Manali
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Rohtang Pass, one of the most scenic mountain passes in India. Marvel at the snow-draped peaks and take memorable photos before returning to Manali in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Manali
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Manali’s temples and attractions, including Hadimba Devi Temple and Vashisht Temple. Return to the hotel for a peaceful evening with your partner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Manali – Kullu – Manali
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, make your way to Kullu Valley. Stop by the Beas River, Sutlej River, and a traditional shawl factory. Shop for souvenirs before heading back to Manali for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Manali
package_itineraries.description: Today is your leisure day. Enjoy the cool mountain breeze, local cafés, or simply relax at the hotel with your partner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Manali – Delhi – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive back to Delhi and proceed to the airport for your return flight, wrapping up your honeymoon with lifelong memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Delhi – Nainital
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Delhi, drive toward Nainital, a scenic journey that takes about seven hours. Once you check in to your hotel, relax and unwind. In the evening, enjoy a peaceful boat ride on Naini Lake surrounded by misty hills.Spend the night in Nainital.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Nainital Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast before exploring the popular attractions of Nainital, including Sattal Lake, Bhimtal Lake, and the sacred Naina Devi Temple. Enjoy a ride on the cable car at Gun Hill and shop for souvenirs at Mall Road.Stay overnight in Nainital.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Ranikhet Full Day Tour
