package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Ranikhet, a peaceful hill town blessed with fruit orchards and pine forests. Visit Jhula Devi Temple and enjoy a traditional Pahari lunch. Capture the Himalayan ranges before returning to Nainital for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Nainital – Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and head back to Delhi to catch your return flight or train home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Delhi
package_itineraries.description: When you reach Indira Gandhi International Airport in Delhi, you will be welcomed by the tour representative, who will assist with your hotel check-in. After relaxing for a while, begin a short sightseeing tour covering Parliament House and India Gate.Spend the evening at Karol Bagh exploring local shops filled with accessories, footwear, and home décor, followed by a delightful street food dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Delhi – Amritsar
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your breakfast before continuing the city exploration. Visit top landmarks such as the Birla Mandir, Indira Gandhi Memorial, Lotus Temple, and Rajghat. By evening, board the vehicle for an overnight journey to Amritsar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Amritsar
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Amritsar, check in to the hotel and rest. Later, embark on a sightseeing tour that includes the world-famous Golden Temple and the historic Jallianwala Bagh. In the evening, head to the Wagah Border to watch the patriotic flag-lowering ceremony.Stay overnight in Amritsar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Amritsar – Kullu Manali
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and start your journey to Manali. Enjoy views of the rivers Beas and Sutlej along the route and stop by the Kullu Valley and shawl factory. Arrive in Manali by evening and check in to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Manali – Rohtang Pass – Manali
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Rohtang Pass, famous for its breathtaking scenery and snow-covered peaks. Take in the picturesque views of the lush green slopes and glacial landscapes before returning to Manali in the evening for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Manali – Chandigarh
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit the Hidimba Temple, Vashisht Temple, and Bhrigu Lake. Later, drive to Chandigarh, where you’ll enjoy a serene boat ride on Sukhna Lake. Explore Palika Bazaar and Patel Market for souvenirs and handmade crafts.Spend the night in Chandigarh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Chandigarh – Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Chandigarh’s most famous gardens — Rock Garden, Pinjore Garden, and Rose Garden. Post lunch, return to Delhi and check into your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After morning breakfast, proceed to board your train to Chennai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Delhi – Chennai
package_itineraries.description: Continue your journey by train, enjoying the travel experience with your group.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Chennai
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Chennai, concluding your journey with cherished travel memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive Agra – Taj Mahal
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Agra, check into your hotel and rest. Later, visit the Taj Mahal, one of the world’s greatest wonders, and admire its architectural brilliance. Stay overnight in Agra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Agra – Jaipur Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Jaipur. On arrival, begin sightseeing with Albert Hall Museum, Hawa Mahal, and Jantar Mantar. Later, explore the City Palace and Jal Mahal before checking into your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Jaipur – Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Delhi. En route, stop to visit Amer Fort, a magnificent fort built of red sandstone and marble. Overnight stay in Delhi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Delhi Temples and Memorials
package_itineraries.description: Explore Delhi’s spiritual and historical landmarks. Visit Birla Mandir, Lotus Temple, Rajghat, and Indira Gandhi Memorial. Later, return to your hotel for rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Delhi City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a visit to Akshardham Temple, followed by India Gate, a symbol of national pride. Spend the rest of the day exploring Delhi’s vibrant streets. Overnight in Delhi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, shop at Karol Bagh before heading to the airport or railway station for your journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Delhi – Shimla
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Delhi airport, meet your representative and transfer to Shimla. After checking into your hotel, spend the rest of the day at leisure with your partner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Shimla City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a visit to Christ Church, followed by the Tudor Library (now the State Library). Spend some quiet time exploring these heritage spots before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Shimla – Kufri
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Kufri, a charming hill station. Visit Kufri Zoo, Himalayan Nature Park, and Mahasu Peak. Enjoy the romantic weather and scenic views before returning to Shimla.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Shopping in Shimla
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day shopping for souvenirs and gifts. Explore Mall Road and The Ridge for woollens, handicrafts, wooden goods, metal artefacts, and jewellery. Carry home keepsakes of your honeymoon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Shimla
package_itineraries.description: Relish a hearty breakfast and check out of your hotel. Drive back to Delhi airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Delhi – Shimla
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Delhi airport, where you’ll be assisted with your transfer to Shimla. The scenic 8-hour drive showcases the majestic Shivalik mountain ranges. After checking into the hotel, explore the nearby surroundings or rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Shimla City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out for local sightseeing. Visit Christ Church, Viceregal Lodge, Shri Hanuman Temple, Kali Bari Temple, Annadale Ground, and Green Valley. Spend the evening at Mall Road, enjoying shopping and dining before returning to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Shimla – Manali
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Manali. The 8-hour journey offers spectacular landscapes, mountain valleys, and lush forests. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel and spend the night in Manali.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Manali
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore Manali’s major attractions including the Hadimba Devi Temple, Tibetan monasteries, and the hot springs of Vashisht Kund. Later, browse through the local markets for handicrafts before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Snow Point Excursion
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head for an excursion to the nearby snow points—Kothi, Gulaba, Marhi, and the iconic Rohtang Pass. Later, enjoy Solang Valley, famous for adventure sports and breathtaking landscapes. Return to Manali for an overnight stay

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Manali – Chandigarh
package_itineraries.description: Leave Manali after breakfast and travel to Chandigarh, known for its urban planning and modern architecture. Visit Rock Garden, Rose Garden, and Sukhna Lake. Stay overnight in Chandigarh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Chandigarh – Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and return to Delhi. Proceed to the airport or railway station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Delhi – Haridwar
package_itineraries.description: On your arrival in Delhi, you will be received and driven to Haridwar, a journey of about 4.5 hours, filled with picturesque sights. After check-in at the hotel, relax for a while.Haridwar means “Gateway to Vishnu.” Vaishnavites call it Haridwar, while Shaivites know it as Hardwar, meaning “Gateway to Shiva.” The most sacred site here is Har ki Pauri, believed to be the point where the River Ganga flows down from the mountains into the plains. The Brahma Kund at Har ki Pauri is said to be the spot where a drop of amrit fell during the Sagar Manthan.Overnight stay in Haridwar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Haridwar – Rishikesh
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out to visit Haridwar’s popular temples and ashrams: Daksha Mahadev Temple, Ma Anandmayi Ashram, Parad Shivling, Mansa Devi Temple, Chandi Devi Temple, Maya Devi Temple, Pawan Dham, Shanti Kunj, Bharat Mata Mandir, Bhuma Niketan, Parmarth Niketan Ashram, and Saptarishi Ashram.Later, continue to Rishikesh, a spiritual hub located at the confluence of the Ganga and Chandrabhaga rivers. Taking a dip here is believed to cleanse one of all sins. In the evening, witness the mesmerizing Triveni Ghat Aarti, where the Ganga, Yamuna, and mythical Saraswati meet.Overnight in Rishikesh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rishikesh – Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore famous landmarks of Rishikesh like Ram Jhula, Lakshman Jhula, Gita Bhawan, and the iconic Beatles Ashram. Later, drive back to Delhi and check in at your hotel.Stay overnight in Delhi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head out to explore Old Delhi—covering Red Fort, Jama Masjid, Raj Ghat, and Chandni Chowk. In New Delhi, visit Akshardham, Rashtrapati Bhavan, and India Gate. Later, transfer to the airport or railway station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Delhi - Agra via Mathura
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Delhi Airport and proceed to Agra, with a stop at Mathura, the birthplace of Lord Krishna. Check into your hotel on arrival and relax.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Agra - Jaipur
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort in the morning before departing for Jaipur. Arrive in Jaipur and check in at the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Jaipur Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Jaipur’s architectural gems, including Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar, City Palace, and Nahargarh Fort. Later, drive to Delhi and check into the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Visit Delhi’s landmarks, including Jama Masjid, Qutub Minar, Red Fort, Rashtrapati Bhavan, and Old Delhi. Later, proceed to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Delhi
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Delhi Airport, you will be greeted and assisted to your hotel. After check-in, explore local markets at leisure. Overnight stay in Delhi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Delhi - Haridwar
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Haridwar, situated at the foothills of the Shivaliks. Visit Har ki Pauri, Mansa Devi Temple, Chandi Devi Temple, and the Shaktikunj Gayatri Parivar. End the day with the sacred Ganga Aarti before retiring at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Haridwar
package_itineraries.description: Today’s sightseeing includes Bharat Mata Temple, Saptarishi Ashram, Bhuma Niketan, and Pawan Dham. Overnight stay in Haridwar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Haridwar - Mussoorie
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Mussoorie, a popular hill station with views of the Doon Valley. Visit Lal Tibba, Bhatta Falls, Company Garden, Gun Hill, Camel’s Back Road, and Mussoorie Lake. Overnight stay in Mussoorie.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Mussoorie Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Proceed for another day of sightseeing, covering Kempty Falls, Benog Wildlife Sanctuary, Happy Valley, and Mall Road for shopping. Overnight stay in Mussoorie.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Mussoorie - Shimla
package_itineraries.description: Head to Shimla, Himachal Pradesh’s charming capital. Check into your hotel on arrival and relax. Overnight stay in Shimla.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Shimla Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Tour Shimla’s attractions, including Christ Church, Summer Hill, Annandale, Viceregal Lodge, Green Valley, and Jakhu Temple. Spend the evening shopping at Mall Road. Overnight stay in Shimla.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Shimla - Manali
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, journey to Manali. The scenic route offers stunning landscapes. Check in at your hotel and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Manali Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Visit Hadimba Temple, Manu Temple, Jogini Falls, Solang Valley, Nehru Kund, Tibetan Monasteries, and the Great Himalayan National Park. End the day shopping in Old Manali. Overnight stay in Manali.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Manali - Snow Point
package_itineraries.description: Explore the surrounding snow points at Gulaba, Marhi, Kothi, and the famed Rohtang Pass. Overnight stay in Manali.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Manali - Chandigarh
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Chandigarh, check in at your hotel, and explore the nearby areas. Overnight stay in Chandigarh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Chandigarh - Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Visit Rock Garden, Sukhna Lake, and the Garden of Fragrance before driving back to Delhi. Overnight stay in Delhi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Depart Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Explore Delhi’s attractions, including India Gate, Rashtrapati Bhavan, Parliament House, Qutub Minar, Old Delhi, and Red Fort. Later, shop at Sarojini Nagar before departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Delhi Airport, you will be received and guided on a city tour covering Qutub Minar, Old Delhi, Jama Masjid, Red Fort, Parliament House, Rashtrapati Bhavan, and Connaught Place. Overnight stay in Delhi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Delhi - Agra
package_itineraries.description: Drive from Delhi to Agra, where the iconic Taj Mahal awaits. After checking into the hotel, spend your evening exploring nearby attractions and markets. Overnight in Agra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Agra - Jaipur
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with visits to the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Pearl Mosque, and the Tomb of Itmad-ud-Daulah. Then journey to Jaipur, halting at Fatehpur Sikri to see Jama Masjid, Panch Mahal, and the Tomb of Salim Chisti. Arrive in Jaipur and check into your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Jaipur Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin sightseeing in the Pink City. Highlights include Hawa Mahal, City Palace, Jantar Mantar, Jal Mahal, Amer Fort, Jaigarh Fort, and Nahargarh Fort. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Jaipur - Jodhpur
package_itineraries.description: Proceed to Jodhpur with a stop at Pushkar to visit the Brahma Temple and witness the famous Camel Fair site. Continue to Ajmer to see the revered Ajmer Sharif Dargah before arriving in Jodhpur. Overnight stay in the Blue City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Jodhpur - Udaipur
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a morning tour of Jodhpur’s Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada, and Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum. In the afternoon, drive to Udaipur via Ranakpur Temple. Overnight in Udaipur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Udaipur
package_itineraries.description: Spend a full day exploring the City of Lakes. Visit the City Palace, Jagdish Temple, Sajjangarh Palace, Bagore Ki Haveli, Shilpgram, and the scenic Lake Pichola. Stay overnight in Udaipur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Depart from Udaipur
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy some shopping in local bazaars before being transferred to the airport or railway station for your return journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Delhi – Shimla
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Delhi by flight or train, you will be welcomed by representatives and assisted on your drive to Shimla. After checking in at the hotel, spend the evening unwinding at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Shimla
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, step out for a full-day exploration of Shimla, the state capital and the largest city of Himachal Pradesh. Begin at the famous Naldehra Golf Course, continue to the picturesque hill station of Kufri, and later shop for souvenirs along Mall Road before returning to the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Shimla – Manali
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, depart for Manali while relishing the scenic beauty en route. Once you reach your Manali hotel, check in and relax for the rest of the day.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Manali
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a sightseeing tour of Manali, beginning with the Hidimba Devi Temple, built in 1553 and surrounded by deodar trees. Then visit the hot springs at Vashisht Kund and shop at nearby local markets. Spend the remainder of the day at your own pace before retiring for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Manali
package_itineraries.description: Today, enjoy breathtaking mountain views as you visit Gulaba, Marhi, and Kothi on the way to Rohtang Pass. This famous mountain pass connects Kullu Valley with Lahaul and Spiti and is one of Himachal’s most-visited attractions. Return to your hotel by evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Manali – Chandigarh
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Chandigarh, a city renowned for its modernist design and architectural brilliance of the 20th century. Upon arrival, visit Rock Garden and Sukhna Lake before heading to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Chandigarh - Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Drive back to Delhi, check in to the hotel, and spend the rest of the day at leisure in the capital.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Delhi – Agra – Delhi
package_itineraries.description: Set out on a day trip to Agra, a city rich with Mughal heritage. Visit the Taj Mahal, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the Seven Wonders of the World, followed by the Agra Fort and the Tomb of Itimad-ud-Daulah. Later, return to Delhi for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Depart Delhi
package_itineraries.description: On your last day, explore key landmarks of Delhi, including Rajghat, Jama Masjid, Shanti Van, Jawaharlal Nehru University, Red Fort, and Chandni Chowk. Later, visit Qutub Minar before being transferred to the airport or railway station for your journey back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cairo
package_itineraries.description: Your African journey begins as you land at Cairo International Airport, where helpful representatives will guide you through customs and visa procedures. You will then be transported in a private vehicle to your hotel, marking the start of your memorable adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cairo’s Highlights
package_itineraries.description: After a refreshing breakfast, begin your sightseeing at the renowned Egyptian Museum of Antiquities, showcasing the largest collection of artefacts from Egypt’s pharaohs. Later, visit the Great Pyramids of Giza—Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos—along with the mysterious Sphinx, a symbol of ancient ingenuity.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Luxor – Nile Cruise
package_itineraries.description: This morning, fly to Luxor and transfer directly to your cruise vessel for a four-night journey along the Nile. The afternoon invites you to marvel at Karnak and Luxor Temples before returning to your ship for an overnight stay in Luxor.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Journey to the West Bank
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, your exploration continues on the West Bank of the Nile. Here, you will visit the famed Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, and the towering Colossi of Memnon. Later, the cruise will sail through Esna Lock toward Edfu, where you will spend the night aboard.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Cruise to Aswan
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a visit to the Edfu Temple, dedicated to Horus, reached by a horse-drawn carriage ride. Later, sail to Kom Ombo to explore the impressive Sobek Temple. The day concludes with your arrival in Aswan, where you will remain overnight on the cruise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Wonders of Aswan
package_itineraries.description: In Aswan, your visits include the monumental High Dam and the intriguing Unfinished Obelisk. A peaceful felucca sail follows, allowing you to view the Agha Khan Mausoleum and the ancient Nilometer from the water.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Aswan to Cairo
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before choosing how to spend your day: either relax in Aswan or take an optional excursion to the famed Abu Simbel Temples at an additional cost. In the afternoon, board a flight back to Cairo for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Cairo – Departure
package_itineraries.description: Conclude your holiday with breakfast, followed by check-out and transfer to Cairo International Airport for your final departure, bringing this unforgettable journey through Egypt to an end.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cairo
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Cairo International Airport, you will be greeted and guided through customs and entry procedures before being transferred to your hotel in a private vehicle. Your first evening will be spent in the comfortable setting of your Cairo hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cairo Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, prepare for an inspiring day at the Great Pyramids of Giza, a magnificent relic among the Seven Wonders. The journey continues with a tour of the Egyptian Museum, home to countless treasures, followed by a vibrant experience at Khan el Khalil Bazaar. Later, you will return to your hotel for another overnight in Cairo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cairo to Aswan
package_itineraries.description: Following a morning meal, you will be taken to the domestic airport for a flight to Aswan. On arrival, transfer directly to the Nile Cruise to begin your sailing adventure. Visits include the impressive High Dam, the historic Unfinished Obelisk, and the enchanting Philae Temple, accessible by felucca boat. You’ll spend the evening on the cruise with meals included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kom Ombo – Edfu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, your day unfolds with a visit to the striking Kom Ombo Temple. Continuing along the Nile, arrive at Edfu to explore the Temple of Horus, one of the most beautifully preserved temples of Egypt. Your night will be spent back on the cruise vessel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Luxor
package_itineraries.description: A hearty breakfast prepares you for Luxor’s treasures. Here, you will discover the East Bank’s legendary sites, including Karnak Temple and Luxor Temple. After a day rich with history, return to your cruise for a restful evening stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Luxor – Cairo
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your morning meal before venturing to the West Bank of Luxor. Highlights include the Valley of the Kings, the grand Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, and the towering Colossi of Memnon. Later, you will transfer to the airport for your flight back to Cairo, where you will check into your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Cairo
package_itineraries.description: Savour your final breakfast in Egypt before being escorted to Cairo International Airport for your return flight, concluding this enriching adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cairo
package_itineraries.description: On reaching the celebrated city of Cairo, you will be smoothly transferred to your chosen accommodation for check-in. This provides the perfect chance to relax and restore energy after your travels. As dusk descends, you will be treated to the captivating Sound and Light Show at the Giza Pyramids, a spectacular retelling of Egypt’s majestic past. The night will conclude with a restful stay at your Cairo hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cairo
package_itineraries.description: A hearty breakfast welcomes the start of the day. The adventure begins with an awe-filled visit to the monumental Great Pyramids of Giza, one of the wonders of antiquity. The Egyptian Museum will introduce you to countless treasures of pharaonic times, while the lively Khan El Khalil Bazaar—once called the Turkish market—offers a delightful blend of traditional goods and vibrant atmosphere. The remaining hours may be enjoyed at leisure before retiring for the evening at your Cairo hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cairo to Aswan – Nile Cruise Embarkation
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you will be escorted to the airport for a short flight to Aswan. Upon arrival, transfer to the Nile cruise terminal to begin your voyage along the storied river. Today’s visits include the mighty High Dam, the striking Unfinished Obelisk, and the sacred Philae Temple. Meals and accommodation onboard the cruise ensure an indulgent evening in comfort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Sailing the Nile
package_itineraries.description: Following your morning meal, the day’s discovery begins at the Kom Ombo Temple, an extraordinary sanctuary shared by two deities, reflecting the artistry of the Ptolemaic period. Sailing onward, you’ll reach Edfu to marvel at the grand Temple of Horus, guarded by an imposing falcon statue. Dinner and overnight rest will once again be enjoyed aboard your cruise ship.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Luxor’s Ancient Marvels
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast sets the pace for a day immersed in ancient wonders. In Luxor, the agenda features the monumental Karnak and Luxor Temples, the Valley of the Kings, the mortuary Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, and the colossal twin statues known as the Colossi of Memnon. Evening comes with a peaceful night of dining and comfort aboard your cruise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Nile Cruise – Luxor – Sharm el-Sheikh
package_itineraries.description: After your final breakfast on the cruise, disembark and continue your journey to Sharm el-Sheikh. Renowned worldwide as a premier resort town, Sharm is celebrated for its spectacular marine life and vibrant coral reefs. On arrival, you’ll check in at your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day in relaxed leisure. Overnight stay will be in Sharm el-Sheikh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Sharm el-Sheikh
package_itineraries.description: A delicious breakfast opens the day for free exploration or an optional full-day yacht excursion to Tiran Island. From the jetty, board a snorkelling cruise guided by an expert, offering you a glimpse of colourful fish species and dazzling coral gardens in the Red Sea. After a day of aquatic wonders, return to your hotel in Sharm for overnight rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Sharm el-Sheikh to Cairo – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After checking out of the hotel, travel by road back to Cairo. From here, you will be transferred to Cairo International Airport to connect with your flight home, bringing your memorable journey through Egypt to an end.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cairo
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Cairo International Airport, a representative will greet and assist you with customs and immigration. You will then be escorted in a private coach to your hotel. In the evening, enjoy the famous Sound and Light Show at the Pyramids, offering an exciting introduction to Egypt’s history. Overnight stay in Cairo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cairo – Pyramids and Historical Sites
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a full-day tour of Cairo. Begin with the Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mycerinus — marvels of engineering still admired today. Later, enjoy lunch before heading to Sakkara, the site of Egypt’s first pyramid, and then to Memphis, the ancient capital. Don’t miss the opportunity for a camel or horse ride during the day. Visits to the Papyrus Institute and Old Bazaars round off your exploration. Overnight in Cairo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cairo – Museum and Religious Sites
package_itineraries.description: Today begins with breakfast before a tour of the Egyptian Museum, home to the world’s most significant collection of Pharaonic artefacts and the treasures of Tutankhamun. Later, head to the Citadel atop the Muqattam Hills, followed by a stop at Cairo’s historic bazaar. After lunch, continue your visit to the Church of the Virgin and St. Mark’s Cathedral. Overnight stay at your Cairo hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cairo – Day Excursion to Alexandria
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and depart for a full-day tour of Alexandria, often called the "Pearl of the Mediterranean." Highlights include Pompey’s Pillar, the Quaitbay Citadel, and the famous Alexandria Library — the largest in Africa. Spend quality time exploring this coastal city before returning to Cairo in the evening for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Cairo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel. You will then be transferred to Cairo International Airport for your flight home, marking the end of your Cairo experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cairo
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Cairo, a transfer will escort you to your hotel. After checking in and settling down, spend the afternoon relaxing. In the evening, witness history come alive at the magical Sound and Light Show at the iconic Pyramids of Giza — a fascinating experience that shares the story of the Pharaohs. Return afterward for your overnight stay in Cairo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Cairo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your sightseeing with a visit to the legendary Great Pyramids of Giza, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Continue to the Egyptian Museum, renowned for its vast collection of antiquities, including the treasures of Tutankhamun. Your next stop is the Khan El Khalil Bazaar, a historic market that dates back to the Ottoman period, where you can shop for unique souvenirs. The evening is free for leisure before retiring for another night in Cairo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cairo to Aswan – Start of Nile Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Aswan. Upon arrival, you’ll be escorted to the cruise terminal. Your Nile Cruise adventure begins with sightseeing in Aswan, where you’ll visit the High Dam, the unfinished Obelisk, and the stunning Philae Temple. In the evening, settle into your cabin aboard the cruise for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cruise Visit – Kom Ombo and Edfu
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast on board before visiting Kom Ombo Temple, dedicated to the gods Sobek and Haroeris. Continue sailing to Edfu, where you’ll explore the Temple of Horus, famous for its impressive falcon statue at the entrance. Later, return to the ship for another overnight stay as you cruise along the Nile.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Luxor – East Bank Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today’s sightseeing focuses on Luxor’s East Bank, where you’ll tour the magnificent Karnak and Luxor Temples, two of the most celebrated temples in Upper Egypt. Spend the evening back on the cruise ship, where you’ll dine and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Luxor – Hurghada
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, disembark the cruise and travel by coach to Hurghada. On arrival, check into your hotel and relax. Once a small fishing village, Hurghada has grown into a famous resort town, known for its vibrant nightlife and excellent diving and snorkelling opportunities. Overnight stay at your Hurghada hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Leisure in Hurghada
package_itineraries.description: Today is yours to enjoy as you wish. Many travellers choose to take a boat trip to Giftun Island for snorkelling and the chance to swim alongside dolphins. On the island, you can enjoy water sports or simply relax by the sea. Return in the evening to explore Hurghada’s lively entertainment scene before another overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Hurghada to Cairo – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart Hurghada and travel by road back to Cairo. You will then be transferred to Cairo International Airport for your flight back home, bringing your trip to a close.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cairo
package_itineraries.description: Once you arrive at Cairo International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and guided by a representative who will assist you with all necessary customs and immigration procedures. Following that, a private transfer will take you directly to your hotel, where you can relax after your long journey. The remainder of the evening is at your leisure, and your first night will be spent comfortably at your Cairo hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Cairo
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying a delicious breakfast, set out to explore one of the world’s greatest wonders — the magnificent Pyramids of Giza. Continue with a visit to the remarkable Egyptian Museum, home to priceless treasures and artefacts. Later, discover the vibrant Khan El Khalil Bazaar, where the bustling lanes are filled with traditional shops and souvenirs. At the end of the day, return to your Cairo hotel for another relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leisure in Cairo
package_itineraries.description: Your morning begins with a refreshing breakfast. Today, you are free to enjoy your time at leisure, whether by resting at the hotel or exploring the city independently. This day is dedicated to personal relaxation, giving you the chance to rejuvenate or do some sightseeing at your own pace. You will once again spend the night in the comfort of your Cairo hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Cairo
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your final breakfast at the hotel before preparing to leave. You will be transferred to Cairo International Airport for your departure, concluding your memorable experience as you head home or continue to another destination.

package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Sharjah and transfer to your hotel. Visit the Sharjah Museum of Islamic Civilization, which holds over 5,000 artifacts showcasing Islamic heritage. Later, head to Al Majaz Waterfront for leisure, attractions, and entertainment.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Al Corniche Beach - Sharjah Natural History Museum and Desert Park
package_itineraries.description: Start the day at Al Corniche Beach, enjoying its turquoise waters. Continue to the Sharjah Natural History Museum and Desert Park to learn about the desert’s flora and fauna, and interact with friendly animals.

package_itineraries.description: Begin with Mleiha Archaeological Centre to experience history and nature. Next, visit the Sharjah Aquarium to see marine ecosystems with more than 250 aquatic species. End the day at Al Noor Island with its Butterfly House, café, playground, and art installations.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Dubai Frame - Desert Safari
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day at the Dubai Frame, where past and present are beautifully connected. package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bollywood Park - Motiongate Dubai

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Dubai – Abu Dhabi – Corniche - Ferrari World

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Warner Bros. World - Saadiyat Public Beach
package_itineraries.description: Your second day begins with Warner Bros. World, the largest indoor theme park globally, where rides, shows, and dining options await.By late afternoon, visit Saadiyat Public Beach and spend a calm evening enjoying its pristine setting.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Louvre - Ferrari World

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Doha with Optional Dhow Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Hamad International Airport, frequently recognised among the best airports globally, you will be warmly greeted by a representative who will assist with your private transfer to the city. The drive to your hotel in Doha typically takes about 30 minutes. Your accommodation has been chosen for its central location to provide maximum convenience.Check-in begins at 1400 hours, after which you may relax or explore at leisure. Spend the rest of the day unwinding or getting acquainted with your surroundings. Overnight stay at your selected Doha hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Doha – City Tour and Desert Safari
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a guided city tour with an English-speaking chauffeur. Begin with The Pearl Qatar, a stunning artificial island inspired by iconic cities like Venice, featuring luxury apartments, high-end boutiques, a marina, and charming boulevards.Proceed to Katara Cultural Village, a hub for art, heritage, and beachside experiences. Your tour continues through the commercial district of West Bay, before reaching the scenic Doha Corniche. Admire the world-famous Museum of Islamic Art and stroll through the adjacent MIA Park for unforgettable sea views.In the afternoon, experience an adventurous desert safari. Let your skilled driver navigate the golden dunes for a thrilling ride before returning to the city for an overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Doha – Leisure Day with Optional Excursions
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy the day at leisure or join one of the optional excursions. A visit to the Museum of Islamic Art (MIA) offers a two-hour exploration of priceless artefacts within a striking cubistic pyramid rising above the Gulf.Alternatively, embark on a sunset Dhow Cruise along the Corniche. These traditional wooden boats, once used for fishing and trade, now provide modern comforts for a memorable evening on the Arabian Gulf.For cultural encounters, the Souq Waqif Tour is a must. This vibrant “standing market” is home to the Falcon Souq, Spice Souq, Gold Souq, Pet Souq, and craft stalls, capturing the essence of traditional commerce and social life.Another excellent option is the National Museum of Qatar. Its galleries span three chapters — Beginnings, Life in Qatar, and Modern History — combining modern design with the restored Palace of Sheikh Abdullah bin Jassim Al-Thani. After your chosen activity, return to the hotel for overnight stay. Tour Schedule: Afternoon – Sun, Mon, Wed, Thu & Sat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Doha
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Standard check-out is at 12:00; late check-out may be available with a fee and subject to availability. Your driver will then accompany you to the airport for your departure, marking the end of your memorable trip.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Doha with Optional Dhow Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Hamad International Airport, acclaimed worldwide as one of the most prestigious aviation hubs, you will be warmly welcomed by a representative who will assist with your private transfer. The drive to your centrally located hotel in Doha takes approximately 30 minutes, ensuring you can quickly settle into the vibrant city.Check-in is available from 1400 hours, after which you can relax at your own pace. The rest of the day is entirely free for leisure, whether you wish to wander through the city or enjoy the amenities of your hotel. Your first night will be spent at your selected Doha accommodation, marking the beginning of your memorable journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Doha – City Tour & Desert Safari
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a guided city tour of Doha with an experienced English-speaking chauffeur. Your excursion begins with The Pearl Qatar, a man-made island inspired by architectural wonders from cities like Venice. Admire the luxury residences, scenic marina, premium shops, and elegant boulevards.Next, visit Katara Cultural Village, a vibrant hub of art, culture, and performance spaces with a picturesque beachfront. Continue with a drive through West Bay, the bustling commercial district, and admire the iconic skyline. Stop at the Doha Corniche for panoramic views, and take the chance to photograph the world-renowned Museum of Islamic Art before strolling through the adjoining MIA Park.Later in the day, prepare for a thrilling desert safari. With the expertise of a professional driver, experience an adrenaline-fuelled ride over the rolling sand dunes before returning to your hotel for a relaxing evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Doha – Leisure Day with Optional Tours
package_itineraries.description: This day allows for independent exploration of Doha or optional guided activities. Those interested in history and art may embark on a two-hour Museum of Islamic Art (MIA) Tour. Its modern cubistic design rising from the Persian Gulf makes it a true landmark, reflecting Qatar’s blend of tradition and progress.Alternatively, choose a serene Dhow Cruise, including a stroll along the Corniche. The dhow, once a vital wooden vessel for merchants, has been modernised to provide tourists with a comfortable sailing experience, especially magical during sunset.For cultural immersion, opt for the Souq Waqif Tour. This lively “standing market” features specialised sections such as the Falcon Souq, Spice Souq, Gold Souq, and Handicraft areas, offering a glimpse into Qatar’s trading traditions.You may also explore the National Museum of Qatar on a two-hour guided visit. The museum narrates the nation’s story through three chapters: Beginnings, Life in Qatar, and Modern History, spread across eleven galleries. Built around Sheikh Abdullah bin Jassim Al-Thani’s restored palace, it offers a truly immersive cultural journey. Afterward, return to your hotel for another overnight stay. Tour Schedule: Afternoon – Sun, Mon, Wed, Thu & Sat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Doha
package_itineraries.description: Savour a delicious breakfast at your hotel. Standard check-out is at 12:00, though late check-out may be available on request with an extra fee. At the appointed time, your driver will ensure a smooth transfer to Hamad International Airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Muscat
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Muscat International Airport, clear immigration, collect your luggage, and complete customs. Your driver will be waiting in the arrival hall to escort you to your hotel. Relax and spend the night in the beautiful city of Muscat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Half-Day Muscat City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a visit to the Grand Mosque, the most iconic landmark of Muscat. Closed to visitors on Fridays and public holidays, the mosque, completed in 2001, is a striking masterpiece of modern design fused with traditional artistry. Admire its vast prayer hall with handmade carpets, brilliant chandeliers, and the elegant dome. Women are asked to dress fully covered with a scarf, and men should wear trousers.Proceed with a scenic drive along the Corniche, then explore the bustling Muttrah Souq. Later, make a stop at Al Alam Palace, the ceremonial residence of His Majesty Sultan Qaboos, framed by the Portuguese forts of Mirani and Jalali. Continue with the Bait Al Zubair Museum, which houses artefacts depicting Oman’s cultural and historical legacy. Conclude the tour with a return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Dolphin-Watching Experience
package_itineraries.description: Head to the Marina for a boat excursion into Oman’s waters. This morning, embark on a dolphin-watching cruise, where playful pods can often be seen gliding through the waves. On rare occasions, whales may also appear in these waters close to Muscat’s rugged coastline. Even without sightings, the sea trip itself is refreshing and informative.After the excursion, return to your hotel, where the rest of the day is free for leisure. Spend the evening at your hotel in Muscat for another restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Muscat – Nizwa – Jabal Akhdar
package_itineraries.description: Today, set off to Nizwa, once Oman’s historic capital and the birthplace of Islam in the region. Take a photo stop at the 17th-century Round Tower Fort and explore Nizwa Souq, famous for khanjars, silver jewellery, and the bustling Friday livestock auction.From there, continue to Wadi Al Madeen and drive up the 36-kilometre mountain road leading to Jebel Akhdar. Perched 2000 metres above sea level, the “Green Mountain” offers rare cool air, fertile valleys, and spectacular scenery. Spend the evening at Sama Jabal Akhdar Hotel and enjoy an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Jabal Akhdar Villages – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Al Jebel Al Akhdar’s terraced orchards, natural springs, and aflaj irrigation. Visit the villages of Saiq, Wadi Bani Habib, Roose, and Al Ain, each offering panoramic views of mountains and wadis. If travelling in spring, the blooming roses add fragrance to the air, and villagers prepare rose water through traditional distillation. Light clothing and sturdy shoes are recommended.Later, transfer back to Muscat International Airport, concluding your unforgettable Muscat travel package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Muscat
package_itineraries.description: Begin your journey as you land at Muscat International Airport. After completing immigration, baggage claim, and customs, proceed to the arrival hall where your personal driver will welcome you. You will be transferred to your Muscat hotel for a comfortable overnight stay, setting the tone for the days ahead.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Muscat’s Wonders
package_itineraries.description: Your exploration begins with the majestic Grand Mosque, the jewel of Muscat. Remember, it remains closed on Fridays and certain public holidays. Completed in 2001, this mosque perfectly combines traditional Islamic artistry with modern architectural brilliance. Inside, you’ll find exquisite carpets, sparkling chandeliers, and an awe-inspiring dome. Respectful attire is essential: women must be fully covered with a headscarf, and men should wear trousers.The tour continues with a scenic drive along Muscat’s Corniche and a visit to Muttrah Souq, alive with colour and local spirit. Next, capture photos at Al Alam Palace, the ceremonial residence of His Majesty Sultan Qaboos, framed by the 16th-century Portuguese forts, Mirani and Jalali. A stop at Bait Al Zubair Museum offers deeper insights into Omani history and traditions. At the end of the day, return to your hotel for another night in Muscat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Dolphin Watching Adventure
package_itineraries.description: This morning, depart for the Marina for a refreshing boat trip across Oman’s waters. Set out in search of dolphins and possibly whales along the rugged coastline. Spotting wild dolphins is an unforgettable experience, and lucky travellers may glimpse whales that frequent these waters. While sightings are not guaranteed, the voyage itself offers both relaxation and excitement. Return to the Marina, then transfer back to your hotel. The remainder of the day is free at leisure, followed by an overnight stay in Muscat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Muscat to Wahiba Sands – Desert Experience
package_itineraries.description: Your adventure continues with a 4WD journey toward Wahiba Sands, travelling via the coastal road with breathtaking views of the Gulf of Oman. En route, pass Quriyat fishing village, and keep an eye out for flamingos and eagles near inland streams. A stop at Wadi Arabayeen reveals pools shaded by palm trees, while the Bimah sinkhole offers an extraordinary natural sight with turquoise water at its base.Upon reaching Sur, explore a traditional dhow factory to witness Oman's shipbuilding heritage. Continue across rocky mountains before arriving at Wahiba Sands, where towering red and white dunes rise up to 200 metres high. The shifting sands provide a photographer’s paradise and the thrill of dune driving. End the day with dinner and an overnight stay at Arabian Oryx Camp under the starlit desert sky.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: From Wahiba Sands to Jabal Akhdar Heights
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast at camp, visit a Bedouin family to learn about their desert lifestyle. Continue toward Wadi Bani Khalid, famous for crystal-clear pools perfect for a refreshing dip. Later, journey upward to Al Jebel Al Akhdar, celebrated for terraced orchards and flowing aflaj irrigation systems. Explore the charming mountain villages of Saiq, Wadi Bani Habib, Roose, and Al Ain, perched dramatically on the cliffs.If travelling in spring, the valleys bloom with roses, and villagers prepare rose water through age-old distillation methods. Comfortable walking shoes and lightweight clothing are recommended. Overnight stay at Sama Jabal Akhdar Hotel surrounded by the mountains.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Farewell Journey via Nizwa
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart Jabal Akhdar and travel to Nizwa, once the capital of Oman and an Islamic learning hub. Stop to photograph the iconic 17th-century Round Tower Fort and visit Nizwa Souq, renowned for traditional silver jewellery, carved khanjars, and the lively Friday livestock market. Later, transfer to Muscat International Airport, marking the conclusion of your Oman journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Muscat – A Warm Welcome
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Muscat International Airport, complete the immigration process, collect your luggage, and pass through customs with ease. In the arrivals area, your private chauffeur will meet and assist you. From here, you’ll be driven comfortably to your Muscat hotel, where you’ll check in and settle for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discovering Muscat’s Historical Wonders
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your guided exploration of Muscat’s timeless charm. The first stop is the impressive Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, completed in 2001 and celebrated for its mix of modern and traditional artistry. Its sprawling prayer hall, elaborate chandeliers, and the world’s second-largest handwoven carpet are unmissable highlights. Note that visits are not permitted on Fridays or public holidays. Dress codes apply—women should cover fully and bring a headscarf, while men should wear trousers.From here, enjoy a scenic drive along the waterfront Corniche to the vibrant Muttrah Souq, an atmospheric bazaar alive with colours, scents, and crafts. Continue to Al Alam Palace, the ceremonial residence of His Majesty Sultan Qaboos, with the grand Portuguese-built forts Mirani and Jalali rising on either side. The Bait Al Zubair Museum awaits next, offering exhibits that bring Oman’s heritage to life. With the afternoon free, you may explore at leisure before retiring to your Muscat hotel for the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Encountering Dolphins and Whales
package_itineraries.description: Today promises a marine adventure. Transfer from your hotel to the Marina, where you’ll embark on a boat ride into the sparkling Gulf waters. Here, pods of dolphins leap gracefully, and, if fortune favours you, you may even glimpse the whales that migrate along this coastline. Observing these creatures in their natural environment is a memory to cherish.Though sightings cannot be guaranteed, the trip itself is rewarding, offering sea breezes and scenic coastal views. After returning to the Marina, head back to your hotel. The rest of the day is free for relaxation or personal exploration. Overnight stay at your Muscat hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Muscat to Wahiba Sands – Adventure Awaits
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, board a 4WD vehicle for a scenic drive towards Wahiba Sands. The journey reveals Omani treasures, from the blue waters of the Gulf of Oman to the tranquil fishing village of Quriyat. Stop at Wadi Dayqah Dam, Oman’s largest, where flamingoes and migratory birds often gather. Next, explore the stunning Wadi Al Arbaeen, with pools ideal for swimming, waterfalls for picnics, and relaxing natural beauty.Continue to the dramatic Bimmah Sinkhole, a turquoise water-filled crater believed by locals to be formed by a meteorite. Afterward, drive through Sur, known for traditional dhow-building, watchtowers, and coastal ruins. Finally, head into Wahiba Sands, where shifting red and white dunes tower over 200 metres. Capture the magical desert sunset before checking in at Arabian Oryx Camp. Tonight, sleep under the starlit desert sky.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bedouin Encounters and Return to Muscat
package_itineraries.description: This morning, experience the life of Oman’s desert dwellers by visiting nearby Bedouin villages. A stop at a traditional Bedouin home offers insight into their customs and survival skills in the harsh yet beautiful desert landscape.Proceed to Wadi Bani Khalid, a stunning oasis fed year-round by natural springs. Its crystal-clear pools invite you to swim, relax, or simply admire the view surrounded by dramatic rock formations. Later, return to Muscat International Airport, where your journey concludes with your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Muscat – A Comfortable Beginning
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Muscat International Airport, clear immigration, collect your baggage, and pass through customs smoothly. In the arrivals hall, your chauffeur will welcome you and escort you to your hotel. Take the evening to unwind and rest, ready for the adventures ahead. Overnight stay in Muscat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: A Cultural Exploration of Muscat
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a half-day sightseeing tour of Muscat’s treasures. Begin with the Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, an architectural masterpiece that opened in 2001. Its interiors feature dazzling chandeliers, exquisite handmade carpets, and a grand prayer hall beneath a majestic dome. The mosque is closed on Fridays and public holidays. Ensure modest attire—ladies should wear full-length clothing with a headscarf, and men should wear trousers.Next, enjoy a scenic drive along Muscat’s Corniche, leading to Muttrah Souq, a lively marketplace overflowing with spices, silver, and handicrafts. Wander its narrow alleys and shop for souvenirs. Continue to Al Alam Palace, a ceremonial palace framed by the centuries-old forts Mirani and Jalali, both legacies of the Portuguese era.The tour concludes at Bait Al Zubair Museum, which houses an excellent collection of artefacts reflecting Oman’s traditions, from weaponry to costumes. Return to your hotel to relax. Overnight stay in Muscat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Marine Adventure – Dolphin Watching
package_itineraries.description: Today, transfer to the Marina for an exciting sea excursion. Board a boat and set sail into the Gulf of Oman, where playful dolphins are often seen frolicking in the waves. With a bit of luck, you may also spot whales in the deeper waters nearby.Though wildlife sightings are not guaranteed, the voyage itself is refreshing, with views of the rugged coastline and endless ocean. Upon returning to the Marina, you’ll have the afternoon free for personal activities, relaxation, or further exploration of Muscat. Spend the night at your hotel in Muscat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Muscat
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel. Your chauffeur will then transfer you to Muscat International Airport in time for your onward flight, carrying with you fond memories of Oman’s hospitality and the highlights of your package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Amman
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Amman Airport, where your representative will welcome you and assist with visa procedures. Transfer to your hotel, check in, and relax for the evening. Overnight stay in Amman.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Desert Castles and Dead Sea Excursion
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out to explore the Eastern Desert Castles: Al Kharraneh, Amra (a UNESCO site), and Al Azraq, known for its link to Lawrence of Arabia. Later, continue to the Dead Sea to float in its mineral waters before returning to Amman for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Madaba, Mount Nebo, and Little Petra en route to Petra
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Madaba for its mosaic treasures and St. George’s Church, then continue to Mount Nebo for panoramic views. Later, explore Little Petra before heading to Petra for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Petra Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided tour of Petra, one of the Seven Wonders of the World. Explore the Siq, Treasury, tombs, temples, and Roman-style theatre. Overnight stay in Petra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Petra to Wadi Rum Adventure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Wadi Rum for a jeep ride across dramatic desert landscapes. Overnight stay in Wadi Rum.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Wadi Rum to Aqaba
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Aqaba. Spend the day at leisure exploring beaches, water activities, and historical sites. Overnight stay in Aqaba.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Leisure Day in Aqaba
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a full day in Aqaba with optional diving and snorkelling in the Red Sea. Overnight stay in Aqaba.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: More of Aqaba
package_itineraries.description: Spend another day at leisure in Aqaba, with optional tours to local landmarks or relaxing by the beach. Overnight stay in Aqaba.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Return to Amman
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer from Aqaba to Amman. Overnight stay in Amman.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Amman City Tour, Jerash, and Ajloun
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a city tour of Amman before heading to Jerash to explore its Roman ruins. Continue to Ajloun Castle before returning to Amman. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Departure from Amman
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, check out, and transfer to the airport for your flight home, concluding your journey with our Amman tour packages.
