Continue to the Metronome monument, where sweeping panoramic views of Prague await.For a luxury shopping experience, stroll along Paris Street, lined with high-end boutiques. Later, admire the scenic beauty of the Vltava River, the longest in the Czech Republic, and its historic bridges.Your tour also takes you to Lesser Town (Malá Strana), where the magnificent St. Nicholas Church dominates the skyline. Spend some time exploring local pubs, shops, and quaint alleys before heading back to your hotel. Overnight stay in Prague.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Prague – Farewell to a Magical City
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel. If you wish, you may extend your stay to discover more hidden gems. Otherwise, transfer to the airport or train station for your onward journey, taking with you unforgettable memories of your Prague tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zagreb – Discover the Capital
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb, the largest and most vibrant city in Croatia, where culture, politics, sports, and art merge together. Check into your hotel and freshen up before joining the Zagreb City Tour in the evening. Starting from Ban Josip Jelačić Square, your English-speaking guide will take you on a 2.5 to 3-hour walking journey through the capital’s most treasured landmarks.Explore the Stone Gate, admire the iconic St. Mark’s Church, and learn how two medieval settlements merged to create today’s capital. Step inside the intriguing Museum of Broken Relationships, a unique cultural highlight. Conclude the day with a relaxing drink at one of Zagreb’s stylish cafés before resting overnight at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zagreb to Zadar – Walking Tour of Ancient Heritage
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Zadar, a coastal gem known for its marble streets, pine-scented beaches, and island-dotted surroundings. Once checked in, enjoy free time to relax before joining the Zadar walking tour in the evening.Meeting at Narodni Trg (People’s Square), your guide will introduce you to the town’s long history, from the Roman forum to medieval cathedrals. Highlights include the Church of St. Donat, Cathedral of St. Anastasia, Sea Gate, and Square of Five Wells.As the day ends, listen to the mystical sounds of the Sea Organ while watching one of the world’s most beautiful sunsets. Don’t miss tasting Zadar’s world-famous ice cream at its oldest shop before retiring for an overnight stay in Zadar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Excursion to Plitvice Lakes National Park
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before setting off for Plitvice Lakes, Croatia’s most iconic natural wonder and a UNESCO World Heritage site. Stroll along wooden walkways as you explore the park’s 16 interconnected lakes divided into Upper and Lower Lakes.Admire the turquoise waters of Kozjak Lake, the largest of them all, and marvel at the impressive Great Waterfall, Croatia’s tallest at 78 meters. With lush greenery, limestone cliffs, and cascading streams, the scenery feels like a living painting. After an adventurous day in nature, return to Zadar for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Journey to Dubrovnik – Cable Car & Old Town Tour
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast and head south to Dubrovnik, the jewel of the Adriatic. After settling into your hotel, join a guided tour starting with a thrilling cable car ride up Mt. Srđ. From the panoramic terraces at the summit, capture sweeping views of the Dalmatian Coast, Old Town, and the sparkling Adriatic Sea.Back in Dubrovnik’s Old Town, your guide will walk you through its UNESCO-protected streets. Visit Onofrio’s Fountain, admire Sponza Palace, explore the grand Rector’s Palace, and see the Baroque Cathedral of the Assumption. End the evening with time to wander at your own pace before spending the night in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Leisure Day in Dubrovnik
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel, followed by a full day of leisure in Dubrovnik. You may choose to explore the City Walls, take a ferry to Lokrum Island, or simply relax at one of Dubrovnik’s beaches overlooking the Adriatic. This free day lets you soak in the city’s charm at your own pace. Overnight stay in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Dubrovnik
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, check out and transfer to Dubrovnik Airport for your flight home or onward journey, carrying unforgettable memories of your Croatia travel packages experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zagreb
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb and check into your hotel. Explore the cultural heart of Croatia and enjoy the city at your leisure. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zagreb & Zadar City Tours
package_itineraries.description: Morning Zagreb city tour covering Upper Town, St. Stephen’s Cathedral, Jelacic Square. Travel to Zadar in the afternoon. Evening Zadar city tour, including Sea Organ, Land Gate, and famous sunsets. Overnight in Zadar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Plitvice Lakes National Park
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Plitvice Lakes, exploring 16 lakes, 92 waterfalls, and lush forests. Return to Zadar for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Split Evening Tour
package_itineraries.description: Head to Split and explore Diocletian Palace, Marjan Hill, and Austro-Hungarian architecture on a guided tour. Overnight in Split.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Split to Hvar by Ferry
package_itineraries.description: Ferry to Hvar. Explore lavender-scented streets, quiet coves, local vineyards, and nearby islands. Overnight in Hvar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Hvar to Dubrovnik – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Dubrovnik. Guided tour of Old Town, exploring historic streets, architecture, and culture. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Dubrovnik to Montenegro
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Montenegro via the Bay of Kotor. Check into your hotel and explore the town independently. Overnight in Montenegro (Kotor).

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Kotor Day Trip
package_itineraries.description: Walking tour of Kotor’s Old Town, St. Tryphon Cathedral, Clock Tower, Pima Palace, and local landmarks. Overnight in Montenegro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport after breakfast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Zagreb – Evening Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb, check into your hotel, and join the evening Zagreb tour, visiting Ban Josip Jelačić Square, Tkalčićeva Street, Stone Gate, St. Mark’s Church, Lotrščak Tower, and the Museum of Broken Relationships. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Split City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Split. Check into the hotel and join a 75-minute walking tour of Diocletian Palace, Cathedral of St. Duje, and other landmarks. Overnight in Split.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Plitvice Lakes Tour
package_itineraries.description: Visit Plitvice Lakes, exploring Upper and Lower Lakes, Big Waterfall, and local trails. Enjoy the natural beauty before returning to Split. Overnight in Split.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Dubrovnik – City Tour & Cable Car
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Dubrovnik. Take a cable car ride up Mt Srđ for panoramic views. Explore Old Town, Onofrio’s Fountain, Sponza Palace, Rector’s Palace, and the Cathedral of the Assumption. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Free Day in Dubrovnik
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day at leisure exploring Dubrovnik independently. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport after breakfast for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zagreb
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb, Croatia’s cultural and political capital. Check into your hotel and rest after your journey. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zagreb City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a guided city tour of Lotrščak Tower, Stone Gate, St. Catherine’s Church, Croatian Parliament, and other landmarks. Afternoon at leisure to explore the city independently. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Free Time in Zagreb
package_itineraries.description: Spend a relaxed day exploring Zagreb at your own pace or take optional excursions. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Zagreb – Evening Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb, check into your hotel, and join the evening city tour. Explore Ban Josip Jelačić Square, Upper and Lower Towns, Stone Gate, and learn the stories behind the city’s formation. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Plitvice Lakes National Park
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Plitvice Lakes National Park, exploring Upper and Lower Lakes, Kozjak Lake, Stephanie’s Island, and the Great Waterfall. Enjoy nature trails, waterfalls, and local wildlife. Overnight in Plitvice.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Zadar Evening City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Head to Zadar, check into your hotel, and take a guided evening tour. Visit Narodni trg, Sea Organ, Roman Forum, St. Donat, Land Gate, Square of Five Wells, and enjoy sunset views over the Adriatic. Overnight in Zadar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Travel to Dubrovnik – City Introduction
package_itineraries.description: Journey to Dubrovnik. Check into your hotel and explore Old Town, St. Blaise Church, Sponza Palace, Stradun Street, and other historical gems. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Dubrovnik City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on the Dubrovnik city tour, discovering architectural and cultural highlights. Enjoy historical stories and beautiful streets. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Split Evening Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Split. Join a 75-minute walking tour visiting Golden Gate, Diocletian Palace, Gregory of Nin statue, and other landmarks. Return to hotel for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Blue & Green Caves Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Sail from Split to visit Blue and Green Caves, islands of Vis and Pakleni, Stiniva, and relax at Palmižana Bay. Enjoy swimming, sunbathing, or seaside dining. Return to Split for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Split to Zagreb
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel back to Zagreb. Evening at leisure to explore the city independently. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your flight home or next destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zagreb – Evening City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb, Croatia’s lively capital, where history meets modernity. Check into your hotel and explore the city on an evening city tour, visiting the romantic Upper Town and bustling Lower Town. Walk through the iconic Stone Gate (Kamenita vrata) and soak in the city’s rich stories. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zagreb to Zadar – Evening City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Zadar (approx. 3.5 hours). Relax at your hotel before joining a guided evening tour, visiting Sea Organ, Greetings to the Sun, Roman Forum, St. Donat, St. Anastasia Cathedral, and more. End the day with a taste of traditional Maraskino liqueur before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Plitvice Lakes Tour
package_itineraries.description: Drive 1.5 hours to Plitvice Lakes, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Explore 16 terraced lakes, 92 waterfalls, and the Rastoke ethno village along the Korana River. Enjoy nature walks and wildlife spotting before returning to Zadar for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Zadar to Hvar via Split – Hvar Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Take a ferry to Hvar via Split. Discover landmarks such as Fortica Fortress, Hvar Cathedral, Arsenal, and Franciscan Monastery. Relax at the sunny beaches and explore the Pakleni Islands. Evening at leisure with dinner at a local restaurant. Overnight in Hvar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hvar to Dubrovnik – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Hvar to Dubrovnik (approx. 3 hours). Enjoy the Discover Dubrovnik tour, visiting Old Town, Onofrio's Fountain, Prijeko Street, St. Saviour’s Church, Franciscan and Dominican churches, and historic vineyards. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Free Day in Dubrovnik
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a full day at leisure to explore Dubrovnik independently or relax at your hotel. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sofia – Leisure and Relaxation
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Sofia Airport, a private transfer will take you to your hotel. After a smooth check-in, take the rest of the day to relax or stroll around nearby streets at your own pace. Enjoy the lively atmosphere of Bulgaria’s capital and soak in the first impressions of this sunny city. Overnight stay in Sofia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Guided Sofia City Tour – Discover the Landmarks
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a hearty breakfast before setting off on a city tour of Sofia. Visit the awe-inspiring St. Alexander Nevsky Cathedral, one of the city’s most iconic landmarks, admired for its golden domes and intricate architecture. Continue your exploration with stops at cultural and historical highlights around the city, from elegant squares to hidden gems tucked within Sofia’s charming streets. End the day back at your hotel for an overnight stay in Sofia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Farewell to Sofia – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy some free time to shop, relax, or explore Sofia at leisure. Depending on your travel plans, you may extend your stay in the city or proceed with a transfer to the airport for your onward journey. Carry with you the wonderful memories of your Sofia tour package experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Brussels – Welcome to the Capital
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Brussels Airport or Brussels Train Station, where a private transfer will take you to your hotel. After check-in, enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. You can relax at the hotel, take a gentle evening walk through the neighborhood, or sample Belgian chocolates at a local café. Soak in the city’s charm as you prepare for the adventures ahead. Overnight stay in Brussels.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Brussels City Sightseeing – Landmarks and Heritage
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast before embarking on a City Sightseeing tour of Brussels. With 13 hop-on hop-off stops, you’ll have the freedom to explore at your own pace.Marvel at iconic landmarks such as the European Union headquarters, European Parliament, and the world-famous Atomium, a futuristic structure representing Belgium’s innovation. Stroll through the Grand-Place, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its ornate guildhalls and lively atmosphere.Don’t miss the quirky Manneken Pis statue, the elegant Cinquantenaire Arch, and the stunning Art Nouveau designs of Victor Horta. From Renaissance beauty to contemporary wonders, Brussels is a city where every corner reveals a new story. After an enriching day, return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Brussels.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Brussels
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel, followed by free time for last-minute shopping or a relaxing stroll through the city center. Depending on your departure schedule, you might visit a café for a final taste of Belgian waffles or chocolates. Later, transfer to Brussels Airport or Train Station for your onward journey, carrying memories of a remarkable European getaway.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Vienna
package_itineraries.description: On reaching Vienna Airport or Train Station, transfer to your hotel. After checking in, the day is yours to relax and explore at leisure. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, discover the city with a Hop-on Hop-off bus tour. With 35 stops around Vienna, you can explore iconic landmarks at your own pace. Stroll along Graben street, indulge in retail therapy, and pause at one of the city’s famous cafés. Don’t miss a slice of the original Sacher Torte at Café Sacher. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel. Depending on your schedule, either extend your stay or transfer to Vienna Airport or Train Station for your next destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Innsbruck
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Innsbruck Airport or Train Station, transfer to your hotel. After check-in, the rest of the day is free to relax or begin exploring on your own. Overnight stay in Innsbruck.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Innsbruck
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out to explore the Tyrolean capital. You can join the local sightseeing Hop-on Hop-off service, “The Sightseer,” which covers major attractions. Alternatively, wander through the Old Town, browse souvenir shops, and stop at traditional cafés. A short trip to Wattens to visit Swarovski Crystal Worlds is also recommended. Overnight stay in Innsbruck.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Innsbruck
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before checking out. A transfer will be arranged to Innsbruck Airport or Train Station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Vienna
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Vienna, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is free for you to relax and enjoy at leisure. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Vienna City Tour & Transfer to Salzburg
package_itineraries.description: Start with breakfast, then enjoy a guided city tour. Admire landmarks such as the State Opera House, the Museum of Fine Arts, Hofburg, Parliament, City Hall, and Burg Theatre. Visit the grand Schönbrunn Palace, once the summer residence of the Habsburgs, before passing by Belvedere Palace. In the afternoon, board a train to Salzburg. On arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight stay in Salzburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Salzburg Tour & Travel to Innsbruck
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Mirabellplatz to join a half-day Salzburg tour. Discover the iconic filming sites of The Sound of Music while enjoying alpine scenery and a glimpse of the Lake District. Visit historic landmarks, including Mozart’s connections to the city. After the tour, return to your hotel. Later in the afternoon, travel by train to Innsbruck. Overnight stay in Innsbruck.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Leisure Day in Innsbruck
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, enjoy free time to explore Innsbruck at your own pace. Visit the Swarovski Crystal Factory showroom, stroll through the Old Town, or simply soak in the alpine atmosphere. Overnight stay in Innsbruck.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Innsbruck to Vienna
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast, then travel by train to Vienna. After arrival, check in at your hotel. The rest of the day is free for personal sightseeing or shopping. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel. A transfer will take you to Vienna Airport or train station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Vienna
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Vienna, you will be greeted and escorted to your hotel. After checking in, the rest of the day is yours to relax and unwind. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off on a Grand City Tour of Vienna. Explore the famous Ringstrasse boulevard and admire highlights such as the State Opera House, Parliament, National Theatre, Votive Church, City Hall, and Urania. Visit the magnificent Schönbrunn Palace for an inside tour, followed by a stop at Belvedere Palace. The tour concludes at the Opera, leaving your afternoon free for independent exploration. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Day Trip to Salzburg
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast and travel west through the Salzkammergut Lake District to reach Salzburg. Pause in Gmunden and enjoy the alpine scenery before arriving in Salzburg for lunch and shopping. A guided city tour will cover highlights like Fortress Hohensalzburg, Salzburg Cathedral, Festival Halls, Mozart’s Birthplace, Getreidegasse, and Mirabell Gardens. Return to Vienna in the evening and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Vienna to Prague
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and board your train to Prague. The scenic journey takes about four hours. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring at your own pace. Overnight stay in Prague.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Prague City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and set out for a guided city tour covering the State Opera, National Museum, Wenceslas Square, and Charles Square. Explore Prague Castle, its courtyards, and St. Vitus Cathedral before heading to the Old Town Square to see the Astronomical Clock. The afternoon is free for personal activities. Overnight stay in Prague.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Travel to Budapest
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and board a train to Budapest. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to relax. Overnight stay in Budapest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Budapest City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast, then embark on a panoramic city tour. Cross the Chain Bridge and Margaret Bridge to the Buda side. Explore Castle District, Matthias Church, and Fisherman’s Bastion, followed by Gellért Hill for stunning views. On the Pest side, visit the Central Market Hall, City Park, Heroes’ Square, and the Parliament. Drive along Andrássy Avenue, passing the Opera House and St. Stephen’s Basilica. The tour concludes in the city center. Free time in the evening. Overnight stay in Budapest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Budapest to Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and travel back to Vienna by train. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and spend the afternoon at leisure. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure from Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel. A transfer will take you to Vienna Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zurich – Transfer to Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and board a scenic train to Interlaken. After checking into your hotel, take a walk along the Hoheweg promenade, enjoying spectacular mountain views. Shop for authentic Swiss souvenirs, including watches and handcrafted items, before unwinding in your luxury accommodation.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Excursion to Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Interlaken to Jungfraujoch, known as the “Top of Europe.” Ride the Jungfrau Railway to the summit, where panoramic Alpine vistas await. Explore the Ice Palace and enjoy the Alpine Sensation exhibition, immersing yourself in Swiss mountain culture. Return to Interlaken for a relaxed evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Scenic Journey to Zermatt
package_itineraries.description: Board a train through picturesque Swiss countryside to Zermatt, a charming village nestled at the foot of the Matterhorn. Stroll through its car-free streets, visit the Matterhorn Museum, and take in views of the iconic peak. Overnight at a luxury Zermatt hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Panoramic Views from Gornergrat
package_itineraries.description: Take the Gornergrat Bahn cogwheel train to reach one of Switzerland’s most breathtaking viewpoints. From the summit, admire 360° vistas of snow-covered peaks, including the Matterhorn. Spend the afternoon hiking or simply soaking in the alpine atmosphere before returning to Zermatt.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Zermatt to Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Zermatt to Lucerne via Brig and Bern. Explore Lucerne’s iconic landmarks such as the Chapel Bridge, Lion Monument, and charming Old Town. End the day with a peaceful Lake Lucerne cruise before retiring to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Adventure at Mount Titlis
package_itineraries.description: From Lucerne, take a day trip to Mount Titlis. Ride the world’s first revolving cable car, the Titlis Rotair, and step into the Ice Palace. Walk across the thrilling Titlis Cliff Walk suspension bridge, or enjoy snow activities like skiing and tubing. Return to Lucerne for a relaxed evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Zurich
package_itineraries.description: Travel back to Zurich and, time permitting, explore highlights like the Bahnhofstrasse shopping district, Lake Zurich, and the charming Old Town before departing from Zurich Airport.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Lucerne – Explore the Old Town
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Lucerne and settle into your hotel. Begin your journey with a visit to the iconic Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke), where flower-decked wooden panels and breathtaking views of the Reuss River set the tone for your trip.Wander through Lucerne’s Old Town (Altstadt), exploring cobbled alleys, boutique stores, and pastel-colored medieval façades. Admire the Jesuit Church, with its ornate Baroque interiors.Later, enjoy a scenic boat ride on Lake Lucerne, capturing magnificent views of the Swiss Alps. Continue with a visit to the Swiss Museum of Transport, an interactive showcase of Switzerland’s transport and space history. End the evening with a cozy Swiss dinner or a walk along the serene lakeside promenade.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Mount Pilatus Excursion – Lion Monument & Cultural Discovery
package_itineraries.description: Take an unforgettable day trip to Mount Pilatus via cogwheel train, gondola, or cable car. At the summit, soak in panoramic alpine views, explore walking trails, or enjoy traditional Swiss cuisine at mountaintop restaurants.Return to Lucerne and visit the moving Lion Monument (Löwendenkmal), a powerful sculpture symbolizing Swiss bravery. Explore the Richard Wagner Museum by the lakeside to discover the composer’s legacy. As night falls, immerse yourself in Lucerne’s lively nightlife with music, performances, or relaxed café experiences.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Engelberg & Mount Titlis – Departure from Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Head to Engelberg for an excursion to Mount Titlis, where revolving cable cars, snowy landscapes, and glaciers await. Walk across the Titlis Cliff Walk, Europe’s highest suspension bridge, or enjoy snow sports at Glacier Park.Return to Lucerne and visit the Swiss Museum of Art (Kunstmuseum), featuring remarkable collections from Swiss masters. Conclude your journey with a traditional Swiss fondue dinner before taking a final stroll through Lucerne’s charming streets, cherishing the city’s magical atmosphere before departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Interlaken and check in to your hotel. Explore Hoheweg, the bustling main street with shops, cafes, and restaurants. End the evening with a lakeside walk and a traditional Swiss dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Full-Day Tour – Jungfraujoch
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a day trip to Jungfraujoch, Europe’s highest railway station. Visit the Ice Palace, Sphinx Observatory, and enjoy panoramic alpine views before returning to Interlaken.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Schynige Platte Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Take the cogwheel train to Schynige Platte for incredible views and the Alpine Garden featuring 600 plant species. Spend the afternoon shopping, visiting the casino, or trying activities like paragliding. Enjoy a farewell Swiss dinner in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Zurich – Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and travel to Lucerne. Explore the Old Town, Chapel Bridge, and Lion Monument, or enjoy a boat ride on Lake Lucerne. Overnight in Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Lucerne – Mount Titlis
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Engelberg and ride the Rotair cable car to Mount Titlis, where snow awaits year-round. Admire panoramic alpine views before returning to Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Lucerne – Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Board a train to Interlaken. Spend the day exploring or trying adventure activities like paragliding. Evening strolls along Interlaken’s streets are highly recommended.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Jungfraujoch Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Jungfraujoch, the “Top of Europe,” and explore the Ice Palace and Sphinx Observatory. Return to Interlaken in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Interlaken – Bern City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Adventure seekers may try bungee jumping or a helicopter ride. Later, take a train to Bern for a city tour featuring the Rose Garden, Clock Tower, and Bern Cathedral before returning to Interlaken.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Interlaken – Zurich
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Zurich. Visit the Rhine Falls and explore Zurich’s vibrant old streets, markets, and museums.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Zurich Airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Zurich – Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and board a train to Interlaken. After check-in, enjoy leisure time to explore the lakeside promenades and alpine scenery.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Interlaken – Jungfraujoch
package_itineraries.description: Take the cogwheel train to the summit of Jungfraujoch, standing 3,454 meters high. Marvel at the Aletsch Glacier and wander through the Ice Palace before returning to Interlaken.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Interlaken – Mt. Rigi – Zermatt
package_itineraries.description: Begin with an excursion to Mt. Rigi, “Queen of the Mountains.” Ride Europe’s first mountain railway and enjoy views from the summit before descending via cable car. Continue your journey to Zermatt for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Zermatt – Gornergrat – Matterhorn
package_itineraries.description: Board the Gornergrat Railway and ascend to one of Switzerland’s best viewing points. Admire the spectacular Matterhorn and surrounding alpine scenery before heading back to Zermatt.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Zermatt – Rhine Falls – Zurich
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Zermatt to Zurich. After checking in, use your Swiss Pass to visit the majestic Rhine Falls.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Zurich – Zermatt
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and board the world-famous Glacier Express to Zermatt. The 4-hour ride takes you past gorges, valleys, and snowy peaks. Overnight stay in Zermatt.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zermatt – Gornergrat – Matterhorn
package_itineraries.description: Take the Gornergrat Railway up to 3,089m, where the panoramic view of the Matterhorn, Switzerland’s iconic mountain, will leave you spellbound. Return to your Zermatt hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Zermatt – St. Moritz
package_itineraries.description: Board the Glacier Express again for a scenic seven-and-a-half-hour journey to St. Moritz, the glamorous alpine resort. Known for its mineral springs and luxurious lifestyle, it is a favorite destination for royals and celebrities. Overnight stay in St. Moritz.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: St. Moritz – Zurich – Rhine Falls
package_itineraries.description: Travel back to Zurich. Spend the day exploring the city’s cultural landmarks before visiting the Rhine Falls, Europe’s largest waterfall. Return to Zurich for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bahnhofstrasse – Swiss National Museum
package_itineraries.description: Use your Swiss Pass to explore Zurich. Walk along Bahnhofstrasse, one of the world’s premier shopping streets, and later visit the Swiss National Museum, which highlights the nation’s cultural history.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Zurich Airport, or continue your Swiss journey with the Swiss Pass.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival – St. Pierre Cathedral – Conservatory and Botanical Garden – Museum of Art and History
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Geneva, check in to your hotel before beginning your city exploration. Visit St. Pierre Cathedral, an architectural gem with centuries of history. Continue to the Conservatory and Botanical Garden, spread over 28 hectares with one of the world’s largest herbaria. Later, explore the Museum of Art and History, showcasing over a million exhibits from ancient to modern eras.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Geneva Water Fountain – Flower Clock – Mini Train Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with the iconic Geneva Water Fountain, one of the tallest in the world and a symbol of the city. Next, admire the Flower Clock, a masterpiece of design created from over 6,000 vibrant plants. End your day with a mini-train ride through Geneva’s Old Town, discovering its charming squares and historic landmarks.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and head to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Zurich – Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Zurich, board a train to the beautiful town of Lucerne. After checking in at your hotel, spend the rest of the day exploring at leisure. You may wander through Lucerne’s historic Old Town, stroll along Chapel Bridge, or relax by Lake Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Lucerne – Mt. Titlis
package_itineraries.description: Begin your alpine adventure with a trip to Mt. Titlis. Travel to Engelberg and ascend the peak by the famous Titlis Rotair, the world’s first revolving cable car. Enjoy stunning views of glaciers, valleys, and the Black Forest region as you reach the summit. Spend the evening at your hotel in Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Lucerne – Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and take a scenic train ride to Interlaken. This town, nestled between Lake Thun and Lake Brienz, offers breathtaking alpine panoramas. The Golden Pass route is a highlight, presenting some of the finest Swiss landscapes. After checking in, explore Interlaken at your own pace.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Interlaken – Jungfraujoch
package_itineraries.description: Board the train from Interlaken Ost to Grindelwald, followed by the cogwheel journey to the summit of Jungfraujoch. Standing at 3,454 metres, this is the highest railway station in Europe. Admire the vast Aletsch Glacier, explore the Ice Palace, and enjoy panoramic mountain views before returning to Interlaken for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Zurich – Rhine Falls
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Interlaken back to Zurich. After checking in, embark on an excursion to the Rhine Falls, Europe’s largest waterfall. Later, explore Zurich’s cobbled alleys, browse flea markets, or visit its world-class museums.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Zurich
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your return journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Farewell Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before transferring to Taoyuan International Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Geneva
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Geneva and check into your luxury hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Geneva City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Tour Geneva’s highlights including the UN headquarters, WHO, and CERN. See the Jet d’Eau Fountain, the Flower Clock, and explore the Old Town on a mini-train and walking tour.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Geneva – Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Travel by scenic Swiss Rail to Interlaken. Admire views of Lake Geneva and the Alps. After check-in, relax and explore the town at your pace.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Interlaken – Jungfraujoch
package_itineraries.description: Take the cogwheel train to Jungfraujoch, the highest railway station in Europe. Visit the Ice Palace, view the Aletsch Glacier, and admire the Bernese Alps. Overnight in Interlaken.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Interlaken – Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Take the train to Lucerne. After check-in, explore Old Town or shop at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Lucerne – Mt. Titlis
package_itineraries.description: Visit Mt. Titlis via Engelberg and ride the Titlis Rotair. Explore surrounding attractions before returning to Lucerne for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Lucerne – Zurich
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Zurich and explore its highlights including the Swiss National Museum, Lake Zurich, and the Old Town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zurich – Engelberg
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and travel to Engelberg. After checking in, visit the Benedictine Monastery and enjoy the alpine surroundings. Overnight stay in Engelberg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Engelberg – Lucerne – Engelberg
package_itineraries.description: Head to Lucerne for a day excursion. Ride the cable car to Mt. Titlis, walk across the iconic Chapel Bridge, see the Water Tower, and explore the charming Old Town. Return to Engelberg for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Engelberg – Basel
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Basel, known for its cultural heritage and thriving art scene. Visit Basel Minster, explore Old Town, and tour museums such as Kunstmuseum Basel or Fondation Beyeler. End the day strolling along the Rhine River. Overnight in Basel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Basel – Zurich – Schaffhausen
package_itineraries.description: Head to Zurich for a city tour including Grossmünster, Fraumünster, and the Swiss National Museum. Continue to Schaffhausen to witness the spectacular Rhine Falls, Europe’s largest waterfall. Return to Zurich for shopping along Bahnhofstrasse and an evening by Lake Zurich.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Zurich
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Zurich Airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Zurich
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Zurich Airport, transfer to your hotel. After check-in, enjoy lunch at the hotel’s restaurant and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zurich City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Zurich’s highlights, starting with the Swiss National Museum, followed by Bahnhofstrasse, one of the world’s most exclusive shopping streets. Walk along Limmatquai in Zurich’s Old Town, admire St. Peter’s Church, and catch a glimpse of the Zurich Opera House. Visit the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, where Albert Einstein once studied, and ride the Dolderbahn Cogwheel Train to the Zurichberg district. End the day admiring the stained-glass masterpieces at Fraumünster Church.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Zurich – Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Board a train to Lucerne. After checking in, enjoy the day at your own pace, perhaps exploring the lakeside or wandering the medieval streets.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mt. Titlis Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Engelberg and take the Titlis Rotair, the world’s first revolving cable car, up to Mt. Titlis at 10,000 feet. Attractions here include the Glacier Cave, Ice Flyer Chairlift, Glacier Park, Adventure Park, souvenir shops, and alpine restaurants offering spectacular views. Return to Lucerne for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Lucerne – Paris
package_itineraries.description: Take a train from Lucerne to Paris. After check-in, begin your Paris sightseeing with a visit to the Louvre Museum, stroll along the Champs-Elysées, shop at Galeries Lafayette, and enjoy an evening cabaret performance at the Lido.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Paris City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore the most iconic landmarks of Paris: Arc de Triomphe, Place de la Concorde, Les Invalides, and the Tuileries Gardens. Ride the elevator to the 2nd level of the Eiffel Tower for panoramic views. In the evening, discover the vibrant Latin Quarter filled with cafés and bookstores.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Disneyland Paris
package_itineraries.description: Spend a magical day at Disneyland Paris. Enjoy thrilling rides, meet Disney characters, and explore the Walt Disney Studios Park with its behind-the-scenes movie secrets.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure from Paris
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Bern – Rose Garden – Bern Minster
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Bern, you will be welcomed at the airport and transferred to your hotel. After check-in and some relaxation, begin your journey with a visit to the Rose Garden. This peaceful park offers panoramic views of the city and features more than 400 varieties of roses, making it a favorite among locals and tourists alike. Continue to Bern Minster, the tallest cathedral in Switzerland, known for its Gothic architecture and impressive tower that began construction in 1421. Spend the evening exploring the cobbled streets of Bern before retiring to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Clock Tower – Einstein Museum – Historical Museum – Botanical Garden
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning at the Zytglogge Clock Tower, a landmark dating back to the 13th century with an astronomical clock that fascinates visitors daily. Next, head to the Einstein Museum, where over 500 exhibits showcase the life and work of Albert Einstein during his time in Bern. Explore the Historical Museum, the second largest in Switzerland, housing diverse artifacts that highlight the cultural and political past of the region. Conclude the day with a visit to the Botanical Garden of the University of Bern, home to over 5,500 plant species from across the world. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Bern
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight, carrying fond memories of Switzerland’s charming capital.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: On landing at Tashkent Airport, you will be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. After check-in, enjoy a traditional Indian lunch before starting your city sightseeing tour. Visit landmarks such as Independence Square, Amir Temur Square, Broadway Street, Lal Bahadur Shastri Monument, and the Victory Monument. Conclude the evening with a Cocktail Gala dinner and an engaging belly dance performance. Overnight stay in Tashkent.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Excursion to Charvak Mountains
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Journey to the Chimgan Mountains, where you can enjoy breathtaking views from a cable car ride. Continue to Charvak Lake, a popular spot for relaxation and leisure activities. Enjoy a buffet lunch by the lake before heading back to Tashkent. Complimentary bottled mineral water will be provided in both the coach and hotel. Overnight stay in Tashkent.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Day Trip to Samarkand
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, board a high-speed train to Samarkand, one of the most iconic Silk Road cities. Explore the architectural masterpieces of the Registan Square, including Medreseh Shir-Dor (17th century), Medreseh Ulughbek (15th century), and Medreseh Tilla-Kori (17th century). Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant before visiting the Bibi-Khanym Mosque, Shakhi Zinda complex, and browsing through Sieb National Market for souvenirs. In the evening, return by train to Tashkent for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Tashkent Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast at the hotel café. Head out to see the city from elevated viewpoints and make a stop at the Tashkent TV Tower, one of the tallest structures in Central Asia. After lunch, enjoy shopping at Zoom Mall and Chorsu Market, perfect for souvenirs and local goods. Dinner and overnight stay in Tashkent.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you will be transferred to the airport for your onward flight, concluding your unforgettable journey across Uzbekistan.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Tashkent International Airport, you will be greeted warmly and transferred to your hotel for check-in. After a refreshing rest, enjoy a delightful lunch at an Indian restaurant. In the afternoon, set out on a guided city tour of Tashkent, visiting Independence Square, Amir Temur Square, Broadway Street, Lal Bahadur Shastri Monument, and the Victory Monument. The evening is reserved for a Cocktail Gala dinner, complete with an enchanting belly dance performance. Overnight stay at your hotel in Tashkent.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Excursion to Charvak Mountains
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a scenic drive to the Chimgan Mountains. On the way, admire breathtaking landscapes and experience a thrilling cable car ride with views of snow-capped peaks. Continue your journey to Chirwak Lake and Charvak Mountains, where you can relax and soak in the natural beauty. Pause for a buffet lunch by the lakeside before returning to Tashkent. Overnight stay at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Exploring Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel’s café. Your morning includes a visit to a viewpoint offering panoramic views of Tashkent. Later, enjoy sightseeing at the Tashkent TV Tower, followed by leisure time for shopping at Zoom Mall and Chorsu Bazaar, two of the city’s most vibrant shopping destinations. After lunch, continue exploring local markets before heading back to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: Relish your final breakfast in Tashkent. Afterward, you will be transferred to the airport for your departure flight, carrying cherished memories of your Uzbekistan adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi and City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Hanoi, check in, and explore the Temple of Literature, Ba Dinh Square, and Ngoc Son Temple via a cyclo ride through the Old Quarter. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi to Halong Bay
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Halong Bay, a UNESCO Natural World Heritage site. Cruise among limestone islands, enjoy seafood lunch, and visit the Surprising Grotto. Optional swimming or kayaking. Dinner and overnight on board.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Halong Bay to Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Visit Luon Cave, a tranquil lagoon, before cruising past islets like Cock-Fighting Rock and Incense Burner Rock. Return to Hanoi for check-in. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Leaving Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Saigon and take an evening tour of the Reunification Palace, Central Post Office, Notre Dame Cathedral, Nguyen Hue Street, and Ben Thanh Market. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Saigon - Mekong Delta - Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Cruise along the Mekong River, visit islands, enjoy honey tea, taste coconut candy, and ride a horse-cart through a village. Stop at Vinh Trang Pagoda before returning to Saigon. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Saigon - Cu Chi Tunnels
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Cu Chi Tunnels, with the option to crawl through narrow passages. Evening free for shopping at Ben Thanh Market, Saigon Square, or Diamond Plaza. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport after breakfast for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Hanoi and begin a city tour featuring the Temple of Literature, Ba Dinh Square, and the Old Quarter by cyclo, including a visit to Ngoc Son Temple. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi - Tam Coc - Hoa Lu - Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Head to Ninh Binh for a boat trip through the Tam Coc caves and a visit to the ancient capital Hoa Lu. See temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le. Lunch included. Return to Hanoi for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi to Halong
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Halong Bay, a UNESCO Natural World Heritage site. Cruise among limestone cliffs, visit caves, and enjoy swimming or kayaking. Dinner and overnight on board.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Halong – Hanoi – Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Cruise back to Halong Wharf, passing by Cock-Fighting Rock, Sail Island, and other famous islets. Return to Hanoi and fly to Saigon. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Saigon – Mekong Delta – Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Mekong Delta with boat trips, island visits, local factory stops, honey tea tasting, and a horse-cart ride. Visit Vinh Trang Pagoda before returning to Saigon. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Cu Chi Tunnels, a wartime relic. In the evening, explore Saigon’s shopping spots such as Ben Thanh Market, Saigon Square, or Diamond Plaza. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast at the hotel before your airport transfer.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi and City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Hanoi International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Begin your sightseeing with the Temple of Literature, followed by a visit to the historic Ba Dinh Square. Take a leisurely cyclo ride around the Old Quarter, with a stop at Ngoc Son Temple. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi to Halong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Halong Bay, passing through the rural landscapes of the Red River delta. Board your cruise to explore limestone caves, floating villages, and unique karst islands. Lunch and dinner are served on the boat. Overnight stay on board.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Halong – Hanoi – Danang – Hoi An
package_itineraries.description: Rise early to watch the sunrise over the bay. Cruise past fascinating islands such as Sail Island and Butterfly Rock before returning to Hanoi. Transfer to the airport for your flight to Danang, and upon arrival, proceed to Hoi An Ancient Town. Overnight in Hoi An.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hoi An City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Hoi An’s Japanese Bridge, ancient houses, Chinese Assembly Halls, and traditional markets by the Thu Bon River. Enjoy local crafts, lantern shopping, and perhaps a bike ride to Cua Dai Beach. Overnight in Hoi An.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hoi An to Hue City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel via the scenic Hai Van Pass, stopping to admire Lang Co Beach. In Hue, visit the Royal Citadel, Forbidden City, Hue Royal Museum, Thien Mu Pagoda, and the Tombs of King Tu Duc. Overnight in Hue.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: From Hue to Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City). Visit the Reunification Palace, Notre Dame Cathedral, Central Post Office, Opera House, and Ben Thanh Market. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore the Cu Chi Tunnels, a network of underground passages used during the Vietnam War. Return to Saigon and enjoy shopping at Ben Thanh Market, Saigon Square, or Diamond Plaza. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Saigon - Mekong Delta - Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a boat trip in My Tho, cruising along the Mekong River. Explore canals lined with coconut palms, enjoy honey tea, taste coconut candy, and take a horse-cart ride through a village. Visit Vinh Trang Pagoda before returning to Saigon. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Depart Saigon
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Hanoi and City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Upon arriving at Hanoi International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel for check-in. Once refreshed, begin your exploration of Hanoi. Visit the Temple of Literature, Vietnam’s very first university, admired for its architecture and historic value. Continue to Ba Dinh Square, an iconic landmark where many national events are held. Later, enjoy a traditional “cyclo” ride around the atmospheric Old Quarter of Hanoi before stopping at Ngoc Son Temple on Hoan Kiem Lake. Overnight stay at your hotel in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi - Tam Coc - Hoa Lu - Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, journey south to Ninh Binh, home to picturesque countryside and historic sites. Begin with a tranquil boat trip through the Tam Coc caves, where limestone karsts rise dramatically from rice fields, creating scenery often called “Halong Bay on land.” Next, explore the ancient capital of Hoa Lu, once the seat of Vietnam’s royalty, and admire temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le. Lunch is included. By late afternoon, return to Hanoi for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi to Halong
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before departing for Halong Bay, recognized by UNESCO as a World Heritage site in 1994. Embark on a scenic boat cruise across emerald waters, surrounded by thousands of limestone cliffs and caves. Relish a seafood lunch on board before visiting the Surprising Grotto, with time for swimming or kayaking. Sail past floating villages and striking islands, then enjoy dinner on the boat. Stay overnight on board, immersed in Halong’s beauty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Halong to Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, continue your cruise to the serene Luon Cave, a circular lagoon surrounded by towering cliffs and lush greenery. On your return journey, pass remarkable islets with curious names such as Cock-Fighting Rock, Sail Island, Incense Burner Rock, and Sea Dog Rock. Lunch will be served before disembarking. By evening, return to Hanoi and enjoy free time. Overnight at your hotel in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Leaving Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight home or to your onward destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Taipei International Airport and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, the rest of the day is yours to relax or explore. Overnight stay in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Half-Day Taipei City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided half-day tour. Visit Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, Presidential Square (drive past), Martyrs’ Shrine, and National Palace Museum. Explore a Taiwanese temple and admire handicrafts at the Taipei Handicraft Centre. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before checking out. Transfer to Taoyuan International Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Taoyuan International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the day relaxing or exploring at your own pace. Overnight stay in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Taipei’s Charm
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off for a half-day Taipei city tour. Visit Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, National Palace Museum, and Martyrs’ Shrine, where you can watch the Changing of the Guards. Explore a Taiwanese temple and discover traditional crafts at the Handicraft Centre. The rest of the day is free. Overnight stay in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: From Taipei to Sun Moon Lake
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Sun Moon Lake after breakfast. Visit Wenwu Temple, Holy Monk Shrine, and Ci En Pagoda. In the evening, relax at your hotel, where you can enjoy hot springs or outdoor activities such as cycling or boat rides on the lake. Overnight stay at Sun Moon Lake.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Sun Moon Lake – Foguangshan Monastery – Kaohsiung
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Jiji Railway Station and then the Fo Guang Shan Monastery. Explore the Buddha Memorial Centre and interact with monks before heading to Kaohsiung. Spend the evening exploring Love River and Liuhe Night Market. Overnight stay in Kaohsiung.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kaohsiung to Kenting and Zhiben Hot Springs
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Kenting National Park, where highlights include Eluanbi Lighthouse, Maobitou, and Longpan Park. Continue your journey to Taitung via the Southern Link Highway. Relax in the hot springs at Hotel Royal Chihpen before an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Taitung – East Coast – Taroko
package_itineraries.description: Embark on an East Coast Scenic Tour, stopping at Xiaoyeliu, Sanxiantai, Shitiping, and a marble factory. Continue to Hualien for an overnight stay inside Taroko National Park.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Explore Taroko National Park and Return to Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day visiting Taroko Gorge highlights, including Tunnel of Nine Turns, Ci Mu Bridge, Swallow Grotto, and Eternal Spring Shrine. On your way back to Taipei, admire Cingshui Cliff before passing through the Syue-Shan Long Tunnel. Overnight stay in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure from Taipei
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Taoyuan International Airport for your flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Taoyuan International Airport, where you will be greeted and escorted to your hotel. After check-in, enjoy the remainder of the day at leisure. Overnight stay at your hotel in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Taipei to Sun Moon Lake
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a scenic journey to Sun Moon Lake, located 762 metres above sea level and surrounded by mountains. Explore Wenwu Temple (Literature-Warrior Temple), dedicated to Confucius and Kuan Ti, followed by visits to the Holy Monk Shrine and Ci En Pagoda. Relax at your lakeside accommodation, where you can enjoy hot springs, walking trails, biking, or boating. Overnight stay at Sun Moon Lake.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sun Moon Lake – Foguangshan Monastery – Kaohsiung
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before visiting Jiji Railway Station, a quaint historical stop. Continue to the famous Foguangshan Monastery, southern Taiwan’s most important Buddhist site. Tour the Buddha Memorial Centre and interact with monks and nuns. Later, arrive in Kaohsiung and enjoy sightseeing at Love River and the lively Liuhe Night Market. Overnight stay in Kaohsiung.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kaohsiung to Kenting and Zhiben Hot Springs
package_itineraries.description: Travel south to Kenting National Park, famous for its 37 miles of coral-fringed coastline. Visit Eluanbi Lighthouse, Maobitou scenic area, and Longpan Park. Continue along the Southern Link Highway to Taitung. End your day by relaxing in the hot springs at Hotel Royal Chihpen. Overnight stay in Taitung.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Taitung to Taroko via East Coast National Scenic Area
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, discover Taiwan’s untouched eastern coast. Explore Xiaoyeliu, Sanxiantai, Shitiping (Stone Steps), and visit a marble factory and showroom. This coastal region, often called “Taiwan’s last unspoiled paradise,” offers dramatic views and unique rock formations. Continue to Hualien and stay overnight inside Taroko National Park.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Taroko National Park to Taipei
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Taroko Gorge, a spectacular ravine carved through marble cliffs. Visit Tunnel of Nine Turns, Ci Mu Bridge, Swallow Grotto, and Changchun Temple (Eternal Spring Shrine). On the return to Taipei, admire Cingshui Cliff and pass through the 12.9 km Syue-Shan Long Tunnel. Overnight stay in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Farewell Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before transferring to Taoyuan International Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Taipei
package_itineraries.description: When you arrive at Taipei International Airport, you will be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. After checking in, spend the rest of your day at leisure to recover from your journey. Relax overnight at your hotel in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Half-Day Tour of Taipei City, Jiufen Village & Northeast Coast
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast before exploring Taipei City. Visit the National Palace Museum, filled with historic treasures, and stop by iconic sites such as Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, Presidential Square, and Martyrs’ Shrine. Experience the local heritage with a visit to a Taiwanese temple and explore handicrafts at the Taipei Handicraft Centre.In the afternoon, travel to the charming Jiufen Village, where narrow streets, tea houses, and mountain views await. On the way, admire the unique Nanya Rock Formations and the beautiful Bay of Two Colours. Visit the mysterious Jinguashi 13 Ruins before returning to Taipei for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Discover Taroko Gorge in Taiwan
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before heading to Taipei Main Station for a train journey to Hualien. Upon arrival, begin your exploration of Taroko Gorge. Walk the scenic Shakadang Trail, visit the Eternal Spring Shrine (Changchun Temple), and take in the beauty of the Swallow Grotto (Tianxiang). A stop at a Marble Factory showcases the artistry of stonework in this region. Later, visit Qixing Lake and Hualien Stone Sculptural Park before traveling back to Taipei for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Taipei
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to Taoyuan International Airport for your flight home or onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Manila
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Manila, where you’ll be warmly received and transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Manila Heritage Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Makati’s landmarks before heading to Rizal Park. Continue to Intramuros, San Agustin Church, Casa Manila, and Fort Santiago. Experience Quiapo’s local markets and conclude with a visit to the Chinese Cemetery before heading back to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Manila to Boracay
package_itineraries.description: Board a domestic flight to Boracay via Caticlan Airport. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy the day at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Boracay Island Hopping
package_itineraries.description: Embark on an island-hopping tour around Boracay’s hidden beaches, coral reefs, and turquoise waters. Snorkel, swim, and discover marine life in one of the world’s most picturesque destinations.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Manila airport for your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Manila
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Manila and transfer to your hotel for check-in. Overnight stay in Manila.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Manila Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Start with Makati’s highlights including Fort Bonifacio. Move on to Rizal Park, Intramuros, San Agustin Church, Casa Manila, and Fort Santiago. Visit Quiapo’s busy market and the Chinese Cemetery before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Manila to Cebu
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Cebu in the morning. Upon arrival, transfer to your resort and spend the day relaxing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cebu Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Temple of Leah, Celosia Flower Farm, local markets, and Terrazas de Flores, showcasing hundreds of blooming flower species. Overnight stay in Cebu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your onward flight, taking with you lasting memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Manila
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, you’ll be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Overnight stay in Manila.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Manila City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Makati’s Fort Bonifacio and the American Cemetery before visiting Rizal Park. Tour Intramuros, San Agustin Church, Casa Manila, and Fort Santiago. Continue to Quiapo’s vibrant centre and end with a visit to the unique Chinese Cemetery. Overnight in Manila.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Flight to Bohol
package_itineraries.description: Take a morning flight to Bohol. Upon arrival, transfer to your resort and relax for the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bohol Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Explore Bohol’s wonders with visits to the Philippine Tarsier Sanctuary, Baclayon Church, and the historic Blood Compact site. Drive through the man-made Bilar Forest and marvel at the Chocolate Hills, which change colours with the seasons. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Manila
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Manila where a warm reception awaits. You’ll be escorted to your hotel for check-in and an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Manila
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before embarking on a city tour. Visit Makati’s financial district, Fort Bonifacio, and the American Cemetery. Explore Rizal Park, dedicated to Dr. Jose Rizal, then stroll through the Walled City of Intramuros. Admire San Agustin Church, Casa Manila, and Fort Santiago. Later, explore Quiapo’s bustling markets and end the day at the Chinese Cemetery, where ornate mausoleums reflect a blend of Buddhist and Christian traditions. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Manila to Coron, Palawan
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your flight to Palawan. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy the day at leisure. Overnight in Coron.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Coron Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Set out on an island-hopping experience in Coron. Marvel at the crystal waters of Kayangan Lake, the striking Twin Lagoons, and the breathtaking seascapes. Snorkel and swim before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight back to Manila, carrying home unforgettable memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hilo
package_itineraries.description: Land at Hilo International Airport, where friendly representatives will welcome you and assist with your hotel transfer. Complete your check-in and spend the rest of the day relaxing at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Volcanoes National Park – Hilo – Wailuku River State Park
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day exploring Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, home to two active giants—Kīlauea and Mauna Loa. Continue to Akatsuka Orchid Gardens and enjoy the exotic blooms before visiting a Macadamia Nut Farm. Spend time at Richardson Ocean Park for swimming and snorkelling. Later, witness the beauty of Wailuku River State Park, King Kamehameha Statue, and Rainbow Falls before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leisure Day
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, choose between a peaceful day of rest or engage in thrilling water sports and beachside activities.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Akaka Falls State Park – Lava Tree State Monument – Hilo
package_itineraries.description: Discover the enchanting Akaka Falls State Park with its famous cascades—Akaka and Kahuna Falls. Wander through Nani Mau Gardens, filled with tropical blooms. Explore Lava Trees State Monument, where lava formations preserve the shapes of once-standing trees. End the day at the Kapoho Tide Pools and Kalapana Beach before heading back.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hilo – Maui – Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Travel to the island of Maui, a haven of scenic beaches, lush parks, and adventurous hiking trails. By evening, make your way to Honolulu for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Pearl Harbor – Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a visit to the historic Pearl Harbor, the most significant landmark in the Hawaiian Islands. Pay respects at the USS Arizona Memorial, the final resting place of sailors who perished during the 1941 attack. Later, return to Honolulu and relax.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Exploring Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out to explore Honolulu’s iconic landmarks, including Iolani Palace, Kawaiahaʻo Church, Honolulu Hale, and the National Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Free Day in Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Spend your day shopping, relaxing by the beach, or simply enjoying the city’s vibrant vibe.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and head to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Singapore - Night Safari
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and enjoy a meal before heading to the Mandai Wildlife Reserve. Experience the world’s first nocturnal zoo, encountering exotic animals like Asian elephants, civets, Malayan tigers, and fishing cats.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sentosa Island Tour And Singapore Half-Day City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a half-day city tour covering Merlion Park, Mount Faber, Jewellery Factory, Chocolate Shop, and Little India. Then, spend the day at Sentosa Island exploring attractions such as cable car rides, Dolphin Island experiences, and pristine beaches.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios
package_itineraries.description: Relive your childhood at Universal Studios Singapore, Southeast Asia’s first theme park of its kind. Ride Battlestar Galactica and enjoy other thrilling attractions. Later, visit Chinatown for authentic cuisine and souvenir shopping.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Explore Gardens by the Bay’s 101-hectare park, marvel at art at the National Gallery Singapore, and meet over 4,200 animals at the Singapore Zoo for an enriching experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Explore Little India And Other Attractions
package_itineraries.description: Discover the vibrant streets of Little India, sampling street food, shopping for handicrafts, and experiencing local art. Enjoy the river view at night along Boat Quay for a perfect end to your day.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight, concluding your Singapore family adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Singapore - Gardens by The Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, check in at your hotel before starting the tour with the Night Safari at Mandai Wildlife Reserve, the world’s first open-air nocturnal zoo. Discover over 2,500 animals from more than 900 species, including civets, leopards, and porcupines.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Singapore Half-Day City Tour – Merlion Park, Chinatown & More
package_itineraries.description: Take a city coach tour covering Merlion Park, Mount Faber, the Jewellery Factory, Chocolate Shop, and Little India. Chinatown offers bargain shopping and souvenirs, while Little India showcases Indian culture, cuisine, and handicrafts.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy Sentosa Island’s numerous attractions, including S.E.A. Aquarium, Universal Studios Singapore, Madame Tussauds, and Mega Adventure Park’s Mega Zip. Take a cable car ride, swim with dolphins at Dolphin Island, or unwind on its picturesque beaches.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Check out from the hotel and proceed to the airport for your onward journey, concluding your Singapore Delight tour.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Night Safari
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Singapore and check in at your hotel. Start your evening with the Night Safari, the world’s first nocturnal zoo. Encounter wildlife such as Asian Elephants, Malayan Tigers, and fishing cats in an immersive nocturnal setting.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Singapore City Tour - Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a half-day city tour of Singapore, covering attractions like Chinatown’s Thian Hock Keng temple and other historical spots. Continue to Sentosa Island, where adventure awaits with cable car rides, dolphin encounters, and beach relaxation. Experience Underwater World and the Song of the Sea light show before returning to the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios
package_itineraries.description: Revisit your childhood at Universal Studios Singapore, the first in Southeast Asia. Enjoy thrilling rides, movie-themed attractions, and memorable experiences for both adults and children.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Genting Highlands
package_itineraries.description: Board the Star Virgo Cruise to Genting Highlands in Malaysia. Visit Chin Swee Caves Temple, explore Genting Strawberry Leisure Farm, and enjoy the evening Captain’s Cocktail dinner on board. Experience the entertainment and luxury offered on the cruise for a delightful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Genting Highlands – Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a buffet breakfast, followed by a visit to Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park for fun and adventure. Travel to Kuala Lumpur to explore the city’s top attractions and spend a restful night in Malaysia’s vibrant capital.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Kuala Lumpur City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Kuala Lumpur’s iconic landmarks, including the Petronas Towers, Batu Caves, and the National Museum, gaining a full perspective on Malaysia’s cultural and architectural wonders.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out and head to the airport for your flight back home, concluding a dynamic city and nature exploration tour.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Night Safari
package_itineraries.description: After arriving in Singapore, check in at your hotel and refresh. Begin your adventure in the evening with the Night Safari, the world’s first nocturnal zoo. Witness exotic creatures such as Asian Elephants, Malayan Tigers, and fishing cats in their naturalistic habitats while enjoying an immersive evening safari experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Gardens By The Bay - National Gallery Singapore – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Start the day at Gardens By The Bay, a sprawling 101-hectare park with three spectacular waterfront gardens. Continue to the National Gallery Singapore, showcasing an exceptional collection of Southeast Asian art and culture.
