End your day in Chinatown, exploring vibrant streets filled with shops and indulging in authentic oriental cuisine. In the evening, board the Star Virgo Cruise to begin a luxury voyage.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Penang
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Penang early in the morning. Explore this Malaysian gem by visiting the Tropical Spice Garden, Kek Lok Si Temple, and the Pinang Peranakan Mansion. Experience the unique culture and scenery before returning to the Star Virgo Cruise for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Phuket
package_itineraries.description: The cruise reaches Phuket, where you can relax at Patong Beach, enjoy snorkeling adventures, and visit the revered Wat Chalong temple. Return to the cruise for an evening journey back to Singapore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Back to Singapore - Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day soaking in Sentosa Island’s attractions. Enjoy interactive dolphin experiences, ride the Skyline Luge and Skyride, or relax at Palawan Beach, making this an unforgettable day for the entire family.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Universal Studios
package_itineraries.description: Visit Universal Studios Singapore, Southeast Asia’s first theme park of its kind. Enjoy adrenaline-pumping rides, relive cinematic memories with classics like Transformers, The Mummy, and Jurassic Park, and create magical moments with your family.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport for your flight home after a memorable family vacation.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Singapore - Indian National Army Monument - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, check into your hotel and freshen up before beginning your historic journey. Start at the Indian National Army Monument in Downtown Singapore, established on 8th July 1945, commemorating the brave soldiers. Then, visit the Singapore Zoo to interact with over 4,200 animals.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Sentosa Island, combining adventure and leisure. Ride the Skyline Luge and Skyride, meet dolphins at Dolphin Island, and explore other attractions that make the island a must-visit destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day filled with excitement at Universal Studios Singapore. Experience thrilling rides like Battlestar Galactica and revisit beloved movie worlds. Later, explore Chinatown’s markets and eateries, picking up unique souvenirs and tasting authentic dishes.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: National Gallery - Merlion Park - St. Andrew's Cathedral
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, check into your hotel and prepare for your first day of exploration. Start with the National Gallery, where Southeast Asian art and culture come alive. Continue to Merlion Park to see the iconic half-lion, half-fish statue, a reminder of Singapore’s fishing village origins. End the day in the tranquil St. Andrew’s Cathedral, enjoying its serene and sacred ambiance.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend a full day on Sentosa Island, home to countless activities and attractions. Marvel at marine life at S.E.A. Aquarium, meet playful dolphins at Dolphin Island, and enjoy panoramic views with a cable car ride on the Skyline Luge and Skyride. Relax and unwind at Siloso Beach to end your action-packed day.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios - Singapore Botanic Gardens
package_itineraries.description: Venture into Universal Studios Singapore to ride the thrilling Battlestar Galactica and explore attractions like The Lost World. Later, visit the Singapore Botanic Gardens, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and wander through the National Orchid Garden with its impressive collection of over 1,000 orchid species.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Gardens by the Bay - Singapore Zoo – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day at Gardens By The Bay, a scenic nature park with three waterfront gardens. Continue to the Singapore Zoo to observe more than 4,200 animals. Conclude your day in Chinatown, savoring oriental cuisine and shopping for souvenirs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport for your onward journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Singapore Changi Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and escorted to your hotel. After checking in and freshening up, get ready to begin your adventure with a visit to the beautiful Sentosa Island. Explore the thrilling attractions it offers—interact with dolphins at Dolphin Island, stroll along Palawan Beach to admire the famous suspension bridge, and experience an adrenaline rush on the Skyline Luge and Skyride. The island promises a perfect blend of relaxation and excitement for all ages.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Merlion Park - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Begin your second day with a journey to Gardens By The Bay, an iconic nature park spanning 101 hectares with three waterfront gardens. Next, immerse yourself in Southeast Asian artistry at the National Gallery Singapore, showcasing captivating works of art. Visit the legendary Merlion Park, where the half-lion, half-fish statue symbolizes Singapore's beginnings as a fishing village. Conclude your day with a visit to the Singapore Zoo, home to over 4,200 animals, offering an unforgettable wildlife experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios - Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Spend a day at Universal Studios Singapore, Southeast Asia’s first theme park of its kind. Thrill-seekers can enjoy Battlestar Galactica, the tallest duelling rollercoaster in the world, and relive classic movies such as Transformers, The Mummy, and Jurassic Park. Later, explore Chinatown, a vibrant district perfect for picking up souvenirs and enjoying authentic oriental cuisine.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: After an enriching vacation, check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport to board your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Kuala Lumpur International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Begin exploring Kuala Lumpur with visits to the Petronas Twin Towers, Thean Hou Temple, Central Market, and Batu Caves. In the evening, enjoy the Kuala Selangor Fireflies Tour, a magical sight of glowing fireflies.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kuala Lumpur - Langkawi
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Langkawi and check into your hotel. Spend the rest of the day enjoying beach activities such as jet skiing, parasailing, or snorkeling.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Langkawi Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Langkawi’s highlights including the Langkawi Sky Bridge, Dataran Lang, Telaga Tujuh Waterfall, and Underwater World Langkawi. Visit Kuah Town and Atma Alam Batik Art Village before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Langkawi Day 2
package_itineraries.description: Set out for a mangrove and geopark tour, a UNESCO site. Cruise along the Kilim River, spot sea eagles, and explore bat caves. Learn about rare plants like the Cycad Langkawiensis while admiring the island’s diverse birdlife.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Langkawi
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Langkawi International Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Gardens By The Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Singapore and check in at your hotel. Visit Gardens by the Bay, the National Gallery, and Singapore Zoo for a day filled with art, nature, and wildlife.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover the charm of Sentosa Island with its beaches, dolphin encounters, and scenic rides.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Universal Studios, packed with thrilling rides, before heading to Chinatown for food and shopping.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Reach Langkawi - Langkawi Cable Car - Langkawi Wildlife Park
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Langkawi and check in at your hotel. Ride the Langkawi Cable Car for stunning views and explore Langkawi Wildlife Park.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Pantai Cenang Beach - Paradise 3D Museum - Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls
package_itineraries.description: Relax at Pantai Cenang Beach, then explore the Paradise 3D Museum. End the day at the enchanting Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Langkawi
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Singapore and check in at your hotel. Begin your adventure at Sentosa Island with activities such as Dolphin Island, cable car rides, and beach visits.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Explore Gardens by the Bay with its spectacular plant conservatories, followed by the National Gallery showcasing Southeast Asian art. Later, visit Singapore Zoo, known for its rainforest setting.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy an exciting day at Universal Studios theme park, followed by an evening stroll and dining experience in Chinatown.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kuala Lumpur – Genting Highlands
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Kuala Lumpur and visit Genting Highlands. Highlights include Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park, Strawberry Leisure Farm, and the Chin Swee Caves Temple.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
package_itineraries.description: Tour the historic city of Malacca before heading to the iconic Petronas Twin Towers.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Batu Caves and the National Mosque of Malaysia, both offering cultural and spiritual insights.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out and head to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Singapore and transfer to your hotel. Start your day at Gardens by the Bay, a futuristic nature park, then explore Southeast Asian art at the National Gallery. End the day at Singapore Zoo, home to over 4,000 animals.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Sentosa Island, where you can enjoy beaches, dolphin encounters, and cable car rides.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Step into a world of adventure at Universal Studios, Southeast Asia’s first. Experience themed rides and attractions, then head to Chinatown in the evening for delicious cuisine and souvenir shopping.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kuala Lumpur – Genting Highlands
package_itineraries.description: Travel by coach to Kuala Lumpur. Your first excursion is Genting Highlands, where you’ll visit Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park, Genting Strawberry Leisure Farm, and the Chin Swee Caves Temple.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
package_itineraries.description: Explore Malacca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, before visiting the famous Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Discover Batu Caves, a spiritual site with colorful shrines, followed by the serene National Mosque of Malaysia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Reach Kuala Lumpur – Petronas Twin Towers - KL Bird Park
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Kuala Lumpur, transfer to your hotel. Begin exploring the city with the Petronas Twin Towers, Batu Caves, and the KL Bird Park, home to over 3,000 bird species.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Johor Bahru - Johor Zoo - Johor Bahru Old Chinese Temple
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Johor Bahru and visit Johor Zoo, one of the oldest in Malaysia. Later, stop at the historic Johor Bahru Old Chinese Temple, which holds great cultural importance.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Legoland Malaysia - Desaru Beach
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy an entire day at Legoland Malaysia, where rides, attractions, and family-friendly entertainment await. In the evening, relax at Desaru Beach with options for boating, swimming, and fishing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Melaka - A’Famosa - Baba Nyonya Heritage Museum
package_itineraries.description: Discover Melaka, starting with the historic A’Famosa fortress ruins. Continue to the Baba Nyonya Heritage Museum, showcasing Peranakan culture and history.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Safari Wonderland - Jonker Street
package_itineraries.description: Head to A’Famosa Resort and enjoy Safari Wonderland, featuring live animal shows and rides. In the evening, stroll through Jonker Street, perfect for shopping antiques, souvenirs, and street food.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Langkawi - Langkawi Cable Car - Langkawi Wildlife Park
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Langkawi, transfer to your hotel. Start your journey with the Langkawi Cable Car ride, which takes you up 650 metres for spectacular aerial views. End the day at Langkawi Wildlife Park, where you can interact with over 150 animal species.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Pantai Cenang Beach - Paradise 3D Museum - Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls
package_itineraries.description: Relax at Pantai Cenang Beach, a lively stretch with cafes and water activities. Continue to the Paradise 3D Museum, one of the world’s largest, before finishing the day at the majestic Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Reach Kuala Lumpur - Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Kuala Lumpur and begin sightseeing with Malacca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the evening, marvel at the Petronas Twin Towers, the city’s most iconic landmark.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: KL Bird Park - Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Batu Caves, followed by the National Mosque of Malaysia. Later, visit KL Bird Park and enjoy the wide variety of exotic bird species.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Reach Kuala Lumpur – Petronas Twin Towers - KL Bird Park
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Kuala Lumpur and transfer to your hotel. After settling in, begin your journey with a visit to the iconic Petronas Twin Towers, followed by the vibrant KL Bird Park, home to over 3,000 bird species within its 20.9-acre expanse.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Taman Negara - Night Jungle Walk
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Kuala Tahan and board a boat to reach Taman Negara National Park. After registering and receiving permits at the Department of Wildlife, watch an introduction video about the park. At night, experience an adventurous jungle walk guided by experts.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Canopy Walkway - Teresek Hill - Lata Berkoh
package_itineraries.description: Visit Kuala Terengganu for recreational shooting activities. Later, discover the Orang Asli Aboriginal Village, where you will learn about the culture and traditions of Malaysia’s indigenous people.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Sabah State Museum - Kota Kinabalu City Mosque
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at the Sabah State Museum, which houses cultural treasures, followed by the Floating Mosque, one of Kota Kinabalu’s most striking landmarks.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Back to Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Return to Kuala Lumpur via Kuala Tahan and spend your free time exploring the city or relaxing at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Reach Kuala Lumpur - Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing in Kuala Lumpur, head to your hotel. Begin your journey with a visit to Malacca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its history and architecture. End the day at the Petronas Twin Towers, Kuala Lumpur’s iconic landmark.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: KL Bird Park - Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Batu Caves, a spiritual and cultural hub, followed by the National Mosque of Malaysia. Later, head to the KL Bird Park, a massive aviary home to over 3,000 birds from around the world.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Kota Kinabalu - Lok Kawi Wildlife Park - Tanjung Aru Beach
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Kota Kinabalu and begin exploring with a visit to the Lok Kawi Wildlife Park. In the evening, unwind at Tanjung Aru Beach, famous for its beautiful sunsets.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Sabah State Museum - Kota Kinabalu City Mosque
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at the Sabah State Museum, which houses cultural treasures, followed by the Floating Mosque, one of Kota Kinabalu’s most striking landmarks.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Mount Kinabalu
package_itineraries.description: Witness the grandeur of Mount Kinabalu, Malaysia’s highest peak at 4,101 meters, known as one of the most accessible mountains in the world.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Sabah State Museum - Kota Kinabalu City Mosque
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Kota Kinabalu, you’ll be taken to your hotel. Begin sightseeing at the Sabah State Museum, which showcases the state’s cultural heritage and artifacts. Next, visit the Kota Kinabalu City Mosque, often called the Floating Mosque due to its serene lagoon setting.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: White Water Rafting
package_itineraries.description: Get ready for an adrenaline-filled day as you board a train to the starting point of your white water rafting adventure on the Padas River. Surrounded by lush scenery, this thrilling activity is followed by a hearty lunch before heading back to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Klias Wildlife Safari River Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Venture into the Klias wetlands, located about 112 km from Kota Kinabalu. Cruise along the river and spot exotic wildlife such as proboscis monkeys, silver leaf langurs, and long-tailed macaques.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Kota Kinabalu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Reach Kuala Lumpur - Petronas Twin Towers - KL Bird Park
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Kuala Lumpur and transfer to your hotel. Begin your sightseeing with iconic landmarks such as the Petronas Twin Towers, Batu Caves, the bustling Petaling Street market, and the Kuala Lumpur Bird Park, which spans over 20 acres and houses thousands of bird species.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cameron Highlands - Boh Tea Plantation - Cameron Lavender Garden
package_itineraries.description: Travel to the cool, lush Cameron Highlands, one of Malaysia’s most beloved hill stations. Visit the Boh Tea Plantation, the largest in Southeast Asia, and enjoy the panoramic views of the tea terraces. Later, explore the Cameron Lavender Garden, where colorful lavender and tropical flowers bloom year-round.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cameron Highlands Butterfly Farm - Time Tunnel Museum
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at the Cameron Highlands Butterfly Farm, home to butterflies, reptiles, and small animals. Continue to the Time Tunnel Museum, an interactive place filled with nostalgic memorabilia and displays that reflect Malaysia’s history.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Pangkor Laut Island – Jungle Trekking
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Pangkor Laut Island by speedboat and check into the luxurious resort. After lunch, embark on a guided jungle trek, where you’ll discover the island’s flora and fauna in their natural habitat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Water Sports – Sunset View Chalet - Fisherman’s Cove
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy thrilling water sports such as kayaking, paddleboarding, or wakeboarding. In the evening, visit the Sunset View Chalet to feed hornbills before savoring a seafood dinner at the popular Fisherman’s Cove.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Coral Beach - Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Relax at Coral Beach, one of Pangkor’s most serene coastal stretches. Later, explore Chinatown, where you can sample authentic Chinese dishes and shop for local specialties.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Reach Kuching - Kuching Waterfront - Sarawak Cultural Village
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Kuching, you will be welcomed at the airport and transferred to your hotel. After check-in and freshening up, your journey begins at the scenic Kuching Waterfront, a lively riverside promenade lined with eateries, historic colonial buildings, and cultural attractions. Later, explore the Sarawak Cultural Village, where you can experience the traditions and heritage of the many indigenous communities of Malaysia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Gunung Gading National Park - Cat Museum
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a visit to Gunung Gading National Park, one of the rare places in the world where you can witness the rafflesia flower blooming in its natural setting. In the afternoon, explore the famous Cat Museum in Kuching, home to over 2,000 fascinating exhibits that highlight the cultural and historical significance of cats.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bidayuh Annah Rais Longhouse - Tua Pek Kong Temple - Main Bazaar
package_itineraries.description: Journey to the Bidayuh Annah Rais Longhouse, a traditional communal home of the Bidayuh tribe nestled at the base of the Borneo Highlands. Continue to Tua Pek Kong Temple, a centuries-old Chinese temple perched on a small hill overlooking Kuching. In the evening, stroll through the Main Bazaar, where you can shop for handmade crafts, antiques, and souvenirs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Kuching
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Land at Incheon Airport, meet your guide, and transfer to your hotel. In the evening, explore Myeongdong’s shopping lanes or Itaewon’s bustling dining scene. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Seoul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off on a guided city tour with lunch included. Highlights: Joggye Temple, Blue House, Gyeongbok Palace with Guard Ceremony, Insadong antique street, Korean Ginseng or Amethyst shopping, Namdaemun Market, and Changdeok Palace. Tour ends by 17:00. Overnight stay in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Seoul – DMZ Tour & Optional Excursions
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then head on a half-day DMZ tour (08:00–14:00, closed Mondays). Stops include Imjingak Park, Unification Bridge, 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station, and a shopping stop. Drop-off at Itaewon street. Optional tours include Nami Island & Petit France (USD 140) or Everland Theme Park (USD 140). Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Seoul to Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a morning flight to Jeju Island. Transfer to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Eastern Jeju Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, join an optional shared tour (available Tue, Thu, Sat). Activities include horse riding, Seongup Folk Village, and visits to local attractions showcasing Jeju’s traditional culture. Overnight in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Farewell to Jeju
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then fly back to Seoul for your transfer to Incheon Airport and your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Incheon Airport and transfer to your hotel. In the evening, enjoy free time in Seoul’s lively streets—explore Myeongdong shopping area and Itaewon’s dining and nightlife. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast at the hotel. The day is free, or you may opt for the Palace Tour (USD 95 per person). This includes Joggye Temple, Blue House, Gyeongbok Palace with Guard Ceremony, Insadong, Namdaemun Market, Ginseng or Amethyst shops, lunch, and Changdeok Palace. Tour ends around 17:00. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Seoul
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy at leisure or take an optional excursion:DMZ Tour (USD 70): Imjingak Park, 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station (closed Mondays).Nami Island & Petit France Tour (USD 140): Visit drama filming sites with French-inspired architecture and Nami’s scenic landscapes.Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Seoul to Busan
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast, then transfer by high-speed train to Busan. Check in at your hotel and enjoy leisure time in the evening. Overnight in Busan.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Busan
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer back to Seoul via train for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Incheon Airport where your guide will greet you. Transfer to your hotel and relax. In the evening, stroll through Myeongdong shopping street and the dynamic Itaewon area filled with restaurants and nightlife. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Seoul
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, spend the day at leisure or join the optional Palace Tour (USD 94 per person, including lunch). This guided trip includes Joggye Temple, Blue House view, Gyeongbok Palace with Royal Guard Ceremony, Insadong antique street, Namdaemun Market, Ginseng or Amethyst shopping, and Changdeok Palace. The tour runs from 09:00–17:00. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Seoul – Day of Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then explore freely or choose optional tours:DMZ Half Day Tour (USD 75): Includes Imjingak Park, 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station.Nami Island & Petit France Tour (USD 145): Includes visits to the filming sites of Winter Sonata and My Love from the Star.Everland Tour (USD 145): A full day of fun at South Korea’s largest theme park.After your chosen activity, return for an overnight stay in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Farewell to Seoul
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Incheon Airport, meet your guide and transfer comfortably to your hotel. In the evening, explore the streets filled with Indian restaurants, vibrant Myeongdong shopping district, and the lively Itaewon street, known for its international dining and nightlife. Rest overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discovering Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day at leisure or join the optional Palace Tour (USD 95 per person). The guided tour begins at 09:00 with a visit to Joggye Buddhist Temple and a drive past the Presidential Blue House. Highlights include Gyeongbok Palace with the Royal Guard Changing Ceremony, Insadong antique street, a local lunch, Namdaemun Traditional Market, and Changdeok Palace. The day ends around 17:00 with a return to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Seoul
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you may relax or join the optional DMZ Half Day Tour (USD 70 per person, closed on Mondays and holidays). Starting at 07:50, this guided trip covers Imjingak Park, Unification Bridge ID check, DMZ theatre & exhibition hall, the 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station, and a visit to a Ginseng or Amethyst shop. The tour ends around 14:00 at Itaewon street, leaving you free to explore before returning to the hotel independently.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Seoul to Busan
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then board a train to Busan. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy leisure time. Overnight in Busan.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Busan to Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Catch a morning flight to Jeju Island and check in at your hotel. The rest of the day is free for personal exploration.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Jeju Island Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, relax or join the optional western Jeju tour (USD 105 per person). Visit Hyupjae Beach, Hanlim Park with its botanical gardens, and O’Sulloc Green Tea Field for a taste of Korea’s tea culture. The tour runs from 09:00 to 17:00. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast, then fly to Seoul and transfer to Incheon Airport for your international departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Seoul International Airport, you’ll be welcomed by our representatives who will assist with your hotel transfer. Once checked in, take some time to relax after your journey and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Seoul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, begin a full-day guided tour of Seoul. Discover historical gems such as the National Folk Museum, Gyeongbokgung Palace, Jogye Temple, and a drive past the famous Blue House. Later, travel to Yeoju Green Village and visit the scenic Nami Island, renowned as a filming spot for Winter Sonata. Enjoy unique experiences like Korean Kimchi making and trying on a Hanbok costume before stopping at a local Ginseng plantation to sample Ginseng Juice. Return to Seoul for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Seoul – Everland Theme Park
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your breakfast before departing for Everland Theme Park, South Korea’s most popular amusement park. Spend the day enjoying thrilling rides, attractions, and entertainment before returning to Seoul for an overnight stay. Breakfast included, other meals not provided.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast, then transfer to Incheon Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive In Moscow
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, you will be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. The day is free for you to explore nearby areas or simply relax.Overnight in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Moscow City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start your Moscow city tour with sites such as Poklonnaya Hill, Novodevichy Convent, and Vorobyovy Hills. Drive along Tverskaya Street, Manezhnaya Square, and Lubyanka Square. Visit landmarks like the Cathedral of Christ the Saviour, Kremlin, Ohotny Ryad, Bolshoi Theatre, and Kropotkinskaya Embankment before concluding at Red Square.Overnight stay in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Moscow City Tour Day 2
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore Old Arbat Street, one of Moscow’s oldest cultural hubs. Walk along its cobblestones, enjoy live performances, and shop for unique souvenirs. Return to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Moscow - Izmailovo
package_itineraries.description: Visit Izmailovo, a suburb known for its lively market and the Izmailovo Kremlin. Shop for antiques, handicrafts, and paintings before returning to Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Moscow - St Petersburg
package_itineraries.description: Board the Sapsan train to St Petersburg. After check-in at your hotel, enjoy a leisurely evening. Overnight in St Petersburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : St Petersburg City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore landmarks such as St Isaac’s Cathedral, Palace Square, Church of the Saviour on Spilled Blood, Nevsky Prospekt, and the Aurora. Visit Peter and Paul Fortress, the burial place of Russian royalty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7 : St Petersburg City Tour Day 2
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at the Winter Palace, now housing the Hermitage Museum with its extraordinary collection of art, artefacts, and history.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8 : St Petersburg - Pushkin
package_itineraries.description: Visit Pushkin to see Catherine Palace and Alexander Palace. The famed Amber Room in Catherine Palace is an unmissable highlight. Spend the evening shopping before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9 : Depart Russia
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive in Moscow
package_itineraries.description: After arrival, you’ll be greeted and taken to your hotel. Later, explore Moscow’s green parks and boulevards, home to hundreds of gardens and tree-lined spaces.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Moscow City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin a guided tour of Moscow’s most famous sites: Red Square, State Historical Museum, St Basil’s Cathedral, Lenin Mausoleum, and Cathedral of Christ the Saviour. Continue to Novodevichy Convent, Moscow State University, Sparrow Hills, and the Kremlin from the Moskvoretskaya Embankment.In the evening, see other highlights such as Victory Park, Triumphal Arch, Tverskaya Street, Pushkin Square, and Kutuzovsky Avenue before ending with Tsar Cannon, Tsar Bell, and Senate Square.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Moscow Metro Tour – St Petersburg
package_itineraries.description: This morning, visit Moscow’s stunning metro stations such as Komsomolskaya, Mayakovskaya, Novoslobodskaya, and Arbatskaya. Later, board a train to St Petersburg and transfer to your hotel upon arrival. Enjoy a relaxed evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : St Petersburg City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring landmarks such as St Isaac’s Cathedral, Alexander Nevsky Lavra, Peter and Paul Fortress, Pavlovsk Palace, Yusupov Palace, and Catherine Palace. Overnight in St Petersburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Hermitage State Museum
package_itineraries.description: Today’s highlight is the Hermitage Museum, one of the world’s greatest collections of art, with millions of works ranging from classical sculptures to Renaissance masterpieces. After lunch, visit a flea market before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : Depart St Petersburg
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Pulkovo Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive in Moscow
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing in Moscow, you will be assisted to your hotel for check-in. Take some time to relax or explore the local neighbourhoods.In the evening, enjoy a traditional Russian dinner before overnighting at a hotel in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Moscow City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Moscow, dating back to the 12th century, remains the heart of Russia and the seat of its Orthodox Church. Today’s city tour will include the Kremlin, Red Square, St Basil’s Cathedral, Bolshoi Theatre, Lubyanka Square, and the Cathedral of Christ the Saviour. You will also witness the splendour of the Moscow Metro stations, decorated like underground palaces.After lunch, experience one of Moscow’s famous circus performances at either Nikulin or Bolshoi.Overnight stay in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Moscow City Tour Day 2
package_itineraries.description: Start your day at Old Arbat Street, Moscow’s oldest cultural street filled with shops, historic buildings, and local performers. After lunch, visit Bunker 42, a Cold War museum hidden underground, showcasing how thousands lived self-sufficiently during the Soviet era.Later, enjoy a river cruise for stunning city views, followed by dinner. Overnight in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Moscow - St Petersburg
package_itineraries.description: Board the Sapsan train to St Petersburg with lunch included. On arrival, transfer to your hotel and later attend a vibrant folk performance at Nikolaevsky Palace featuring traditional dances and Cossack music. End the evening with dinner at a local restaurant.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : St Petersburg City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore St Petersburg’s highlights today: Spit of Vasilievsky Island, St Isaac’s Cathedral, Palace Square, Church of the Saviour on Spilled Blood, Nevsky Prospekt, Isaac’s Square, Cruiser Aurora, and Peter and Paul Fortress.Overnight in St Petersburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : Catherine Palace Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Pushkin to visit Catherine Palace, an ornate masterpiece with the famous Amber Room. Afterwards, head to Peterhof to see the opulent Grand Palace, built by Peter the Great, with its fountains, gardens, and gilded interiors.Spend the evening shopping before enjoying a farewell dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7 : Depart Russia
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive In Moscow
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Moscow, you will be greeted and escorted to your hotel for check-in. Spend the rest of the day unwinding or strolling around nearby attractions at your leisure.Overnight stay in a premium hotel in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Moscow City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin a sightseeing tour of Moscow’s renowned landmarks. Highlights include Poklonnaya Hill, Novodevichy Convent, Vorobyovy Hills, Manezhnaya Square, and Lubyanka Square. Continue to see Bolshoi Theatre, Ohotny Ryad, Tverskaya Street, Cathedral of Christ the Saviour, and Kropotkinskaya Embankment.Later, explore the iconic Red Square and tour the Kremlin to admire its historic cathedrals.Overnight in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Moscow - St Petersburg
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the train station for your Sapsan journey to St Petersburg with a complimentary lunch onboard. Upon arrival, you’ll be assisted to your hotel.Spend your evening leisurely exploring the surroundings before resting overnight in St Petersburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : St Petersburg City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Founded in 1703 by Peter the Great, St Petersburg is Russia’s second-largest city, famed for its White Nights in summer. Visit its iconic attractions, including the Spit of Vasilievsky Island, St Isaac’s Cathedral, Church of the Saviour on Spilled Blood, Cruiser Aurora Museum, Nevsky Prospekt, Neva Embankments, and Peter and Paul Fortress, where Russian Tsars are laid to rest.Overnight stay in St Petersburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : St Petersburg – Hermitage Museum
package_itineraries.description: This day is dedicated to visiting the Catherine Palace, a grand baroque estate famed for its striking blue-and-white façade. It now forms part of the Hermitage Museum, home to millions of artefacts—paintings, sculptures, ceramics, costumes, and medieval weaponry.Overnight in St Petersburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : Depart Russia
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Almaty
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Almaty airport, you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel. Complete the check-in process, take some time to relax, and in the evening, enjoy a delicious Indian dinner at a local restaurant. Spend the night at your hotel in Almaty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Almaty City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast before heading out for a guided city tour of Almaty. Visit key attractions such as the Palace of the President, Republic Square, Monument of Independence, Panfilov Park, Abai Square, Astana Square, Presidential Park, and the Palace of the Republic. Stop for a flavorful Indian lunch before returning to the hotel. In the afternoon, explore the Rakhat Chocolate Factory and the lively Zilyoni Bazaar, famous for chocolates, nuts, and souvenirs. Head back to your hotel and spend the evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Almaty – Meadows & Chimbulak Ski Resort
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a full-day excursion into the scenic mountains near Almaty. Begin with a stop at the stunning Medeo Gorge to admire the Trans-Ili Ala-Tau peaks. Continue to the Chimbulak Ski Resort, perched 2230 meters above sea level (note: cable car fee is not included). Take in the panoramic views, enjoy the fresh mountain air, and later return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Almaty Zoo & Family Park
package_itineraries.description: Relish breakfast at the hotel before visiting the famous Almaty Zoo, home to a wide variety of animals. Capture the exciting sights on camera before continuing to one of Kazakhstan’s largest family amusement parks for a fun-filled afternoon. Conclude the day with dinner and spend another restful night at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Almaty
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Almaty International Airport for your onward journey or return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tokyo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Narita where our representatives will welcome you and escort you to your hotel by bus. Spend the night relaxing in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tokyo City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a guided exploration of Tokyo. Visit famous spots including Tokyo Tower, Akasaka Guest House, Meiji Shrine, and the National Diet Building. Continue to the Imperial Palace Plaza, East Garden, Ginza shopping hub, Tasaki Pearl Gallery, Asakusa Kannon Temple, and take a Sumida River Cruise. Stroll through Nakamise Street, Kappabashi, Ueno, and Akihabara. Return from Harajuku Station for an overnight stay in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hakone
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before travelling towards Mt. Fuji and Hakone. Explore Tomei Expressway-Fuji Skyline 5th Station with stunning views. Have lunch at Hakone Lake Hotel before riding the Hakone Sky Gondola and visiting Owakudani Valley. Take a Lake Ashi cruise before returning by motor coach to Tokyo for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Tokyo Station and board the express train to Kyoto. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and rest. In the afternoon, join a coach tour to see Helan Shrine, Kiyomizu Temple, and Sanjusangendo Hall. Travel to Osaka by JR Rapid Train and stay overnight in Osaka.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Osaka
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, prepare for your transfer to Kansai International Airport to board your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast and transfer once more to Kansai Airport for your flight back home.
