package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Bali
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Bali, you’ll be greeted at the airport and transferred to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to unwind, enjoy the surroundings, or explore nearby attractions at your leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Celuk Village – Mas Village – Elephant Cave – Kintamani – Ubud Village Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start the day at Celuk Village, renowned for its intricate gold and silver jewellery crafted by local artisans. Continue to Mas Village, where skilled craftsmen create elaborate wooden carvings. Visit the historic Elephant Cave (Goa Gajah), an important Hindu archaeological site. The journey then leads to Tirta Empul Temple, where holy spring water is believed to hold purifying powers. Later, admire the volcanic beauty of Mount Batur and Lake Batur in Kintamani. Before heading back, explore Ubud Market for traditional Balinese crafts and souvenirs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tanjung Benoa Beach
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a fun-filled day at Tanjung Benoa Beach, a hub for exciting water sports like parasailing, jet skiing, and banana boat rides. In the afternoon, relax with a rejuvenating spa session that will leave you refreshed and re-energized. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Bali
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight, carrying with you the memories of a splendid Bali experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Singapore – Night Safari
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Changi Airport, you will be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. After settling in, the evening begins with a visit to the renowned Night Safari at Mandai Wildlife Reserve. As the world’s first nocturnal zoo, it offers a rare opportunity to see creatures like leopards, lions, and civets in their natural nighttime habitats.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Singapore City Tour – Gardens by the Bay – National Gallery – Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Singapore’s highlights. Wander through Gardens by the Bay, famous for its Supertree Grove and Cloud Forest Dome. Continue to the National Gallery Singapore, which showcases Southeast Asian art across beautifully restored historic buildings. Later, enjoy an immersive experience at the Singapore Zoo, known for its open enclosures and wide variety of wildlife.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sentosa – Universal Studios – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day at Sentosa Island, where you can enjoy a cable car ride, relax on its beaches, or meet marine animals at Dolphin Island. In the afternoon, step into the world of movies at Universal Studios Singapore, where thrilling rides and shows bring stories like Jurassic Park and Transformers to life. In the evening, head to Chinatown, a lively spot for street food, cultural sights, and souvenir shopping.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Singapore – Bintan – Banyan Tree Temple
package_itineraries.description: Take a ferry ride from Singapore to Bintan, a tropical Indonesian island known for its resorts and beaches. After arrival at Tanah Merah Ferry Terminal, you’ll be transferred to your hotel for check-in and relaxation. Later, visit the Banyan Tree Temple, a revered Chinese shrine that has stood for more than two centuries.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bintan Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover Bintan’s charm on a full-day exploration. The island offers everything from stunning beaches and ancient temples to delicious seafood and lively local markets. Adventure seekers can indulge in water sports like snorkelling, jet skiing, and windsurfing, while others may simply enjoy the island’s serenity.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Bintan – Singapore – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and travel back to Singapore. From there, you will be assisted to the airport for your flight home, bringing your journey to a close.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Singapore – Gardens by the Bay – Marina Bay Sands
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Singapore and check into your hotel. Begin with Gardens by the Bay, a futuristic park filled with rare plants and iconic Supertree structures. Later, visit Marina Bay Sands, an architectural masterpiece offering attractions like a rooftop infinity pool, fine dining, and luxury shopping. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Botanic Gardens – Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Spend your morning at Singapore Botanic Gardens, a lush UNESCO World Heritage Site. Afterwards, explore the Singapore Zoo, home to thousands of species from around the world, making it a great family-friendly experience. Overnight stay in Singapore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full day at Universal Studios Singapore, a theme park packed with thrilling rides, shows, and attractions inspired by blockbuster films. Return to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Arrive at Bali – Celuk – Mas Village
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Bali and start with visits to Celuk Village, famous for its silver jewellery, and Mas Village, renowned for intricate wooden carvings. Later, check into your hotel for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Batubulan – Kintamani Volcano – Ubud Market
package_itineraries.description: Discover Batubulan Village, where traditional dance performances take place. Then, head to Kintamani for sweeping views of Mount Batur. Conclude your day at Ubud Market, picking up souvenirs and handicrafts. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Tanjung Benoa Beach
package_itineraries.description: Spend your day at Tanjung Benoa Beach, enjoying its calm waters and thrilling activities like parasailing, banana boat rides, and jet skiing. Later, relax with a rejuvenating spa treatment. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Bali
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your final breakfast before departing for the airport to catch your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Bali – Ayung River Rafting
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Bali, you will be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Begin your journey with an adrenaline-pumping rafting experience on the Ayung River, the longest river in Bali. Surrounded by lush jungle and waterfalls, this thrilling activity is the perfect way to kickstart your holiday. After the adventure, relax at your hotel for the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tanjung Benoa Beach
package_itineraries.description: The second day is all about Bali’s beaches. Spend your time at Tanjung Benoa, enjoying sunbathing, walks along the shore, or watersports like jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides. In the afternoon, unwind with a soothing spa therapy session. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Celuk – Mas Village – Elephant Cave – Kintamani – Ubud Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Bali’s cultural side by visiting Celuk, famous for silver and gold jewellery, and Mas Village, known for exquisite wooden carvings. Next, stop at Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave), a sacred archaeological site. Visit Tirta Empul, Bali’s holy water temple, before travelling to Kintamani to witness Mount Batur. Wrap up the day with shopping at Ubud’s bustling local market before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bounty Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Head to Benoa Harbour in the evening to board the Bounty Sunset Cruise. Enjoy live entertainment, cultural shows, and a delicious dinner as you sail along Bali’s coastline, watching the sun dip below the horizon. Return to your hotel afterwards.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Ubud Monkey Forest – Waterbom Bali
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Ubud Monkey Forest, home to playful macaques and ancient temples nestled in greenery. Later, visit Waterbom Bali, the island’s premier water park filled with exciting rides and attractions. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Bali
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before checking out of your hotel. You will be transferred to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Bali – Tanjung Benoa Beach
package_itineraries.description: On landing in Bali, meet your representative who will escort you to your hotel. Start your journey with a visit to Tanjung Benoa Beach, a perfect place for a leisure walk or to indulge in exciting water sports such as parasailing, jet skiing, and banana boat rides. Later, rejuvenate with a two-hour spa session designed to refresh your senses. Overnight stay at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Batubulan Village – Kintamani Volcano Safari
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, proceed to Batubulan Village, well known for its artistic performances and cultural heritage. Watch the dramatic Barong dance, followed by the rhythmic Kecak dance performance. Continue your day with a trip to Kintamani, where you can admire the scenic views of Mount Batur and its lava fields, surrounded by rice terraces and coffee plantations. Return to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bedugul – Botanical Garden – Ulun Danu Beratan Temple
package_itineraries.description: Begin your third day with a trip to Bedugul, a cool mountain retreat in central Bali. Explore the Bali Botanical Garden, Indonesia’s largest garden that houses rare orchids and unique flora. Afterwards, visit Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, a picturesque lakeside temple dedicated to Hindu deities, where the reflection of the temple on Lake Beratan creates a stunning sight. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Bali
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before checking out. You will be transferred to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Bali – Uluwatu Temple
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Bali, meet your tour assistant who will transfer you to the hotel for check-in and some time to refresh. After lunch, begin your journey with a visit to the famous Uluwatu Temple, dramatically perched on cliffs overlooking the Indian Ocean. This sacred temple is known for its strong spiritual significance and breathtaking sunsets. As evening approaches, continue to Jimbaran Beach for a delightful seafood dinner before heading back to your hotel for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Batubulan – Ubud Handicraft – Kintamani – Tampaksiring
package_itineraries.description: Start your day at Batubulan village, a hub for traditional Balinese dance performances, including the famous Barong and Keris show. Continue to Ubud to witness local handicrafts, wood carvings, and paintings made by skilled artisans. After exploring Ubud, travel to Kintamani village, where Mount Batur and its stunning caldera dominate the scenery. Later, visit Tampaksiring to explore Tirta Empul Temple, a holy site with natural springs believed to hold purifying powers. Return to your hotel for dinner and rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Transfer to Jakarta – Sunda Kelapa – Fatahillah Square – National Monument
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before flying to Jakarta. Upon arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel. Your city tour begins with Sunda Kelapa Harbour, once a bustling port for Dutch traders. Move on to Fatahillah Square in Old Town Jakarta, surrounded by historical buildings and the iconic Puppet Museum displaying figures from Asia and Europe. End your sightseeing at the National Monument (Monas), a striking landmark that represents the country’s fight for independence.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Taman Mini Indonesia Indah
package_itineraries.description: The fourth day is dedicated to exploring Taman Mini Indonesia Indah, a cultural theme park that showcases Indonesia’s diversity. Spread across 250 acres, this park features replicas of traditional houses, lush gardens, theatres, museums, and even an IMAX theatre. Each pavilion represents the rich heritage of the Indonesian provinces, giving you a complete insight into the country’s traditions and natural wealth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Shopping – Depart from Jakarta
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Jakarta’s vibrant shopping hubs. Choose from Pasar Santa, known for quirky finds, or Tanah Abang Market, the largest textile marketplace in Southeast Asia. After shopping, you will be dropped at the airport to board your flight for onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Bali - Bounty Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing in Bali, you’ll be greeted at the airport and transferred to your hotel. Enjoy a hearty lunch and relax at your resort before beginning your evening adventure. Board the Bounty Sunset Cruise at Benoa Port and sail across Bali’s stunning coastline while savoring a delicious buffet dinner, cultural performances, and live music. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Celuk Village - Mas Village - Elephant Cave - Kintamani - Ubud Village Tour
package_itineraries.description: Your cultural exploration starts at Celuk Village, famous for its exquisite gold and silver craftsmanship. Continue to Mas Village, renowned for masterfully carved wooden sculptures. Visit Goa Gajah, or Elephant Cave, an archaeological and spiritual landmark, followed by a scenic drive to Kintamani, where you can admire views of Mount Batur. Conclude your day at Ubud Market, a hub for local handicrafts and souvenirs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Transfer to Yogyakarta - Sultan Palace - Taman Sari Water Castle
package_itineraries.description: On the third day, take a flight from Bali to Yogyakarta, one of Indonesia’s cultural capitals. Start with a tour of the Sultan Palace, still serving as the royal residence of the Yogyakarta monarchy. Next, explore Taman Sari Water Castle, a historic retreat for the royal family known for its elegant blend of Javanese and European design.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Borobudur Temple
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day discovering Borobudur Temple, the world’s largest Buddhist monument. This UNESCO World Heritage Site, set amid lush greenery, features intricate carvings and towering stupas that reflect Indonesia’s spiritual and cultural depth. Return to your hotel and relax after a fulfilling day.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart from Yogyakarta
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home, marking the end of your enriching journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Bounty Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival in Bali, you will be welcomed by our local representative at the airport and transferred to your hotel. After checking in and refreshing yourself, head to Benoa Port in the evening to board the Bounty Sunset Cruise. Glide along the waters of Benoa while enjoying a variety of culinary delights, traditional dance performances, and live music onboard. Conclude the evening with a delicious dinner on the cruise before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Nusa Penida Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a full-day excursion to Nusa Penida, one of Bali’s largest and most spectacular islands. Often referred to as the “Golden Egg of Bali,” Nusa Penida is home to dramatic cliffs, sacred temples, and turquoise lagoons that showcase the raw beauty of nature. Spanning nearly 200 square kilometers, this enchanting island promises breathtaking views and unforgettable experiences. Return to your hotel after a day of exploration.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tanjung Benoa Beach
package_itineraries.description: No trip to Bali is complete without soaking up the charm of its world-famous beaches. Spend your morning at Tanjung Benoa Beach, where you can bask under the sun, enjoy a peaceful walk along the shore, or indulge in water adventures such as jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides. Later in the afternoon, unwind with a soothing two-hour spa session designed to rejuvenate your senses. Rest for the night at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Bali
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to the airport for your onward journey, carrying along cherished memories of your Bali holiday.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tokyo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Narita where you’ll be transferred to your hotel. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tokyo City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a guided tour including Tokyo Tower, Akasaka Guest House, Meiji Shrine, and the National Diet Building. Continue to Imperial Palace Gardens, Ginza, Asakusa Temple, Nakamise Street, Sumida River Cruise, and Akihabara. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tokyo Free Day
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast followed by a free day for independent exploration or optional tours. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Tokyo – Hakone – Mt. Fuji – Hiroshima
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, ride the bullet train to Odawara. Visit Mt. Fuji, Hakone, Owakudani Ropeway, Lake Ashi Cruise, and Togendai before continuing by train to Hiroshima. Overnight in Hiroshima.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hiroshima – Miyajima
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast and sightseeing including Peace Memorial Museum, Itsukushima Shrine, and Atomic Bomb Dome. Continue to Miyajima for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Miyajima – Osaka – Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast and travel back to Hiroshima Station. Take the bullet train to Osaka. Sightseeing includes Osaka Castle, Dotonbori, and Umeda. Travel on to Kyoto for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Kyoto City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast then tour Kiyomizu Temple, Kinkaku-ji, Handicraft Center, and Gion district. Overnight in Kyoto.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Kyoto – Nara – Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, excursion to Nara including Todaiji, Kasuga Shrine, Kofukuji, and Deer Park. Return to Kyoto. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure from Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Kansai Airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tokyo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Narita and transfer to your hotel. Relax for the evening. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tokyo City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, start a city tour including Tokyo Tower, tea ceremony, Imperial Palace Plaza, Nijubashi Bridge, and Hinode Pier. Cruise the Sumida River, visit Sensoji Temple and Nakamise Street. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tokyo – Mt. Fuji – Hakone
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel towards Mt. Fuji 5th Station with scenic views. Lunch included. Enjoy Lake Ashi cruise and Komagatake Ropeway before reaching Odawara. Make your way to the hotel and stay overnight in Hakone.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hakone to Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Odawara Station and take the Shinkansen to Kyoto. Check into your hotel and relax. Overnight in Kyoto.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kyoto – Nara Tour
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast followed by a seat-in-coach tour. Visit Nijo Castle, Kinkaku-ji, Imperial Palace or Kitano Tenmangu Shrine (depending on day). After lunch, continue to Nara to visit Todai-ji Temple, Nara Park, Kasuga Shrine, and Nagomikan. Return to Kyoto for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Kyoto Free Day
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a free day at leisure. Overnight in Kyoto.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast and transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tokyo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Narita and transfer by bus to your hotel. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tokyo City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a guided city tour including Tokyo Tower, Akasaka Guest House, Meiji Shrine, National Diet Building, and the Imperial Palace Gardens. Continue to Ginza, Asakusa Kannon Temple, Nakamise Street, and enjoy a Sumida River Cruise. Explore Kappabashi, Ueno, and Akihabara before returning from Harajuku Station. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tokyo – Hakone – Mount Fuji
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head for an excursion covering Mt. Fuji National Park, Owakudani Valley, and Hakone Peace Park. Visit a Crystal Factory and end the day with a traditional steamboat dinner at Mt. Fuji. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mount Fuji – Tokyo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Shiraito Waterfall and admire Mt. Fuji’s breathtaking scenery. Return to Tokyo by coach or optional bullet train ride. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Tokyo Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tokyo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Narita and transfer to your hotel. Evening free. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tokyo – City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, start a sightseeing tour including Tokyo Tower, a tea ceremony, Imperial Palace Plaza, Nijubashi Bridge, Hinode Pier, and a Sumida River Cruise. Visit Sensoji Temple and Nakamise Street. Tour concludes at Hamamatsucho. Return to hotel at leisure. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tokyo – Mt. Fuji & Hakone Adventure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Mt. Fuji’s 5th Station. Enjoy views before a Japanese lunch. Cruise on Lake Ashi, then ride the Komagatake Ropeway. Return to Tokyo by bus, ending at Ginza. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Tokyo to Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, make your way to Tokyo Station and board the Shinkansen to Kyoto. Check into your hotel and relax. Overnight in Kyoto.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kyoto – Nara – Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast, then tour Kyoto’s landmarks including Nijo Castle, Kinkaku-ji, and Imperial Palace. Visit Nara to explore Todai-ji, Nara Park, and Kasuga Shrine. Drop-off provided to hotels in Kyoto. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Kyoto to Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast and transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight to Seoul. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Seoul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast followed by an optional guided tour. Highlights include Jogyesa Temple, Blue House, Gyeongbok Palace, Guard Changing Ceremony, Insadong, Namdaemun Market, and Changdeok Palace. Return to hotel. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast and free time to explore on your own. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure from Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast followed by transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tokyo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Tokyo Airport and head to your hotel. The day is free at leisure. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tokyo – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, join a half-day city tour. Visit Meiji Shrine, pass the National Diet Building, and explore the Imperial Palace East Gardens. Continue to Sensoji Temple and Nakamise Street before concluding at Tokyo Station. Return independently and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tokyo – Mt. Fuji & Hakone
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel towards Mt. Fuji and Hakone. See the 5th Station, enjoy Lake Ashi Cruise, and ascend Mt. Komagatake Ropeway for amazing views. Return to Tokyo, ending at Ginza. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Tokyo – Osaka
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast and transfer on your own to Tokyo Station. Board the Shinkansen to Osaka. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Osaka – Kyoto & Nara Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, join a guided day trip. In Kyoto, see Nijo Castle, Kinkaku-ji, and the Imperial Palace. Proceed to Nara to explore Todai-ji Temple, Kasuga Shrine, and Nara Nagomikan. Return to Osaka independently and overnight there.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Osaka
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tokyo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Narita Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tokyo – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, assemble at designated points and head to Hamamatsucho Bus Terminal. Discover Tokyo highlights including Tokyo Tower, a traditional tea ceremony, and a Japanese-style lunch. Visit Imperial Palace Plaza, Nijubashi Bridge, Hinode Pier, and enjoy a Sumida River Cruise. Explore Asakusa’s Sensoji Temple and Nakamise Street before returning at your own pace. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tokyo – Mt. Fuji & Hakone
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, meet at the hotel and travel by bus to Mt. Fuji 5th Station, perched 2,300m above sea level. Savor lunch and enjoy a cruise on Lake Ashi with Mt. Fuji views. Ride the Komagatake Ropeway for panoramic sights before returning to Tokyo. Tour ends at Ginza where you return independently to your hotel. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Tokyo to Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast at the hotel before making your way to Tokyo Station. Board the Shinkansen Nozomi 27 to Kyoto. Check into your hotel and enjoy free time. Overnight in Kyoto.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kyoto to Nara and Back
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a guided city tour of Kyoto including Nijo Castle, Kinkaku-ji Temple, and Kyoto Imperial Palace (Mon–Fri) or Kitano Tenmangu Shrine (weekends and holidays). After lunch, travel to Nara to see Todai-ji Temple, Nara Park, Kasuga Taisha Shrine, and Nara Nagomikan. Return to Kyoto and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast and transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tokyo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Narita where our representatives will welcome you and escort you to your hotel by bus. Spend the night relaxing in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tokyo City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a guided exploration of Tokyo. Visit famous spots including Tokyo Tower, Akasaka Guest House, Meiji Shrine, and the National Diet Building. Continue to the Imperial Palace Plaza, East Garden, Ginza shopping hub, Tasaki Pearl Gallery, Asakusa Kannon Temple, and take a Sumida River Cruise. Stroll through Nakamise Street, Kappabashi, Ueno, and Akihabara. Return from Harajuku Station for an overnight stay in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hakone
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before travelling towards Mt. Fuji and Hakone. Explore Tomei Expressway-Fuji Skyline 5th Station with stunning views. Have lunch at Hakone Lake Hotel before riding the Hakone Sky Gondola and visiting Owakudani Valley. Take a Lake Ashi cruise before returning by motor coach to Tokyo for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Tokyo Station and board the express train to Kyoto. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and rest. In the afternoon, join a coach tour to see Helan Shrine, Kiyomizu Temple, and Sanjusangendo Hall. Travel to Osaka by JR Rapid Train and stay overnight in Osaka.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Osaka
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, prepare for your transfer to Kansai International Airport to board your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast and transfer once more to Kansai Airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Hong Kong International Airport, a tour manager will meet you and assist with hotel transfer. Spend the afternoon exploring nearby attractions or enjoy a tram ride to Victoria Peak for spectacular harbour views. In the evening, shop at Hong Kong’s bustling flea markets and taste local delights before an overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided tour of Hong Kong. Attractions include Aberdeen Fishing Village, Repulse Bay Beach, Nan Lian Garden, and Sik Sik Yuen Wong Tai Sin Temple. Other highlights are the iconic Tian Tan Buddha, Man Mo Temple, Ocean Park, and Victoria Harbour. Overnight stay at your hotel in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hong Kong – Macau
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then check out and transfer to Macau. Upon arrival, a tour manager will welcome you and guide you to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure exploring the surroundings or simply enjoying your hotel’s facilities. Overnight stay in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Macau Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out to discover Macau’s landmarks. Visit the Venetian Macau, St. Paul’s Church, Senado Square, and A-Ma Temple. Continue to Monte Fort, Guia Fortress, and the City of Dreams. Macau’s combination of cultural heritage and modern entertainment makes the day truly memorable. Overnight stay in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Macau
package_itineraries.description: After a satisfying breakfast, check out and proceed to the airport for your return flight. This concludes your memorable journey through Hong Kong and Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After landing at Hong Kong International Airport, you will be assisted with a ferry transfer to Macau. On arrival, check into the Venetian hotel where you can relax and enjoy the luxurious setting. Use the evening to explore Macau’s nearby attractions before returning to the Venetian for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Macau
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before beginning a guided tour of Macau. Visit the famous Ruins of St. Paul’s Church, walk through Senado Square, and stop at the Portuguese Cathedral. Continue to Na Ch Temple and the culturally rich A-Ma Temple. Later, enjoy dinner at an Indian restaurant before retiring for the night at the Venetian hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Macau to Hong Kong (Disneyland)
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take the ferry to Hong Kong where a magical day awaits at Disneyland. Experience fun-filled rides, meet cartoon characters, and indulge in a variety of cuisines. End the day with dinner at an Indian restaurant before checking in to your Hong Kong hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hong Kong City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast and head on a half-day city tour. Highlights include Victoria Peak, the historic Man Mo Temple, Aberdeen Fishing Village, and the beautiful Repulse Bay. Visit the Hong Kong Jewelry Factory and wrap up your tour at Madame Tussauds, home to wax figures of global celebrities. Overnight stay at your hotel in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, dedicate your day to shopping at Hong Kong’s bustling malls and markets. Later, you will be transferred to the airport for your departure, marking the end of your memorable journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Once you arrive at Hong Kong Airport, you will be greeted by a local representative who will escort you to your hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is free for leisure—take time to rest, stroll nearby attractions, or simply relax at the hotel. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After a delicious breakfast, set out on a half-day sightseeing journey. Visit the scenic Waterfront, discover craftsmanship at a Jewellery Workshop, and enjoy panoramic views from Victoria Peak. The rest of the day is left open for shopping or personal exploration. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Farewell to Hong Kong – Hello, Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Today you will board a flight to Jeju Island, Korea’s largest volcanic island and a UNESCO World Natural Heritage site. Famous for its pleasant climate and stunning natural scenery, Jeju is known for beaches, cliffs, waterfalls, and lava caves. Recognised as a Global Geopark and one of the New 7 Wonders of Nature, the island offers a memorable welcome. Overnight stay at a hotel in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Discovering Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast and enjoy leisure time or join the optional West Jeju tour (available Mon/Wed/Fri). Highlights include Hyupjae Beach with its clear waters, Hanlim Park showcasing vast botanical gardens, and O’Sulloc Green Tea Field where you can learn about traditional Korean tea culture. The day ends with a hotel drop-off. Overnight stay in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Explore Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: This day is also free or can be used for an optional East Jeju tour (Tue/Thu/Sat). Experience horse-riding or visit the Horse Museum, explore Seongup Folk Village, and stop at Gwangchigi Beach. Watch the Woman Diver show, a UNESCO Intangible cultural heritage, and continue to Sunrise Peak, one of Jeju’s most famous UNESCO sites. The tour also includes Manjang Cave, Asia’s longest lava cave. Overnight stay in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Farewell to Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you will be transferred to the airport for your return journey home or onward connection, concluding your delightful trip.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Hong Kong and Macau
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Hong Kong International Airport, where you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure, giving you time to settle in before a restful overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong Disneyland Delight
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off for Disneyland. Spend the day enjoying thrilling rides, themed zones, and encounters with beloved cartoon characters. As evening arrives, dine at an Indian restaurant before returning to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hong Kong City Exploration and Shenzhen Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before starting a half-day tour of Hong Kong Island. Visit Victoria Peak, the historic Man Mo Temple, and the scenic Aberdeen Fishing Village. Continue to Repulse Bay and explore the Hong Kong Jewelry Factory. End with Madame Tussauds before heading to Shenzhen by train or coach. Overnight stay in Shenzhen follows.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Discover Shenzhen’s Treasures
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin with a visit to the Mineral Museum, home to fascinating exhibits. Explore the Terra-Cotta Warriors and continue to the bustling Bamboo Market. Visit the Window of the World park, featuring replicas of global wonders, before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay in Shenzhen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Journey from Shenzhen to Macau
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel by ferry to Macau. The day is free for you to explore at leisure, enjoying the city’s historical attractions and lively streets. In the evening, enjoy dinner before heading to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Discover Macau’s Charms with Macau Tower
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast before embarking on a city tour of Macau. Explore Porto De Cerco, Kun Lam Temple, Penha Hill Church, and the Ruins of Sao Paulo. End with a visit to the impressive Macau Tower. After the tour, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Farewell to Macau, Hello to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer by ferry to Hong Kong. Enjoy some final shopping before departing from the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong – Macau
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Hong Kong International Airport, you will be transferred via ferry to Macau. Once there, check in to your hotel and take the evening to relax at leisure. Spend your first night enjoying the calm atmosphere before your adventure begins.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Macau
package_itineraries.description: Start with a hearty breakfast, then explore iconic landmarks such as the Ruins of St. Paul’s Church and Senado Square, both central to Macau’s history. Visit the Portuguese Cathedral for a spiritual pause before continuing to Na Tcha Temple and the A-Ma Temple. In the evening, savour a delicious Indian dinner before heading back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Macau to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the ferry terminal for your ride to Hong Kong. Upon arrival, you will be escorted to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to relax or take a stroll through the city at your own pace before an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Explore Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before beginning a half-day guided tour of Hong Kong Island. Visit Victoria Peak for sweeping city views and the famous Man Mo Temple. Stroll through Aberdeen Fishing Village, discover Repulse Bay’s charm, and stop at the Hong Kong Jewelry Factory. Wrap up with Madame Tussauds, where wax figures of global icons create a fascinating experience. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Exploring Hong Kong Ocean Park
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off for Ocean Park, one of the world’s top marine theme parks. Enjoy cable car rides, thrill rides, and an impressive aquarium. Meet pandas, dolphins, and sea lions as part of the park’s wildlife attractions. At the end of the day, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Magical Day at Hong Kong Disneyland
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast before travelling to Disneyland. Encounter walking cartoon characters, themed rides, and shows that bring fairytales to life. Relish a tasty dinner at a local Indian restaurant before heading back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Hong Kong Farewell
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and dedicate your final day to shopping at local markets or malls. In the evening, you will be transferred to the airport for your return journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Hong Kong International Airport, you will be greeted by our representative and assisted with a ferry transfer to Macau. The scenic ride across the waters offers a refreshing start to your trip. Once in Macau, proceed to your hotel for check-in and take some time to relax. This evening is at leisure, giving you your first taste of Macau’s charm before an overnight stay at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Macau
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your sightseeing tour with the historic Ruins of St. Paul’s Church, followed by a walk through Senado Square, the cultural heart of the city. Continue to the grand Portuguese Cathedral before visiting the unique Na Tcha Temple, which stands alongside remnants of the old city walls. Later, explore the tranquil A-Ma Temple, dedicated to the goddess of seafarers. In the evening, enjoy a flavourful Indian dinner before returning to the hotel for your overnight stay in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Macau to Hong Kong (Disneyland)
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with a delicious breakfast and then head to the ferry terminal for your journey to Hong Kong. On arrival, make your way to Disneyland for a magical adventure. Filled with themed lands, fun rides, and beloved cartoon characters, Disneyland promises an exciting day for all ages. After enjoying the attractions and sampling delicious food, end your evening with dinner at an Indian restaurant before resting overnight at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hong Kong City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before setting out on a half-day city tour of Hong Kong Island. Highlights include Victoria Peak, offering panoramic views, and the historic Man Mo Temple. Next, visit the traditional Aberdeen Fishing Village, where fishing boats and luxury yachts line the waters. Continue to Repulse Bay for a glimpse of coastal beauty before exploring the Hong Kong Jewelry Factory. End the day at Madame Tussauds, where lifelike wax figures of celebrities await. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, spend your day shopping at the city’s bustling markets and malls, the perfect way to collect souvenirs. In the evening, transfer to the airport for your departure, carrying with you memories of a delightful journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your breakfast, spend the day shopping or exploring at leisure, and later transfer to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong – Macau
package_itineraries.description: After arriving at Hong Kong International Airport, board a ferry to Macau and check into your hotel. Relax and unwind as you prepare for the adventures ahead. Spend your first night in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Macau Full Day Tour – Day 1
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast and head out to visit the Ruins of St. Paul’s Church, Senado Square, Portuguese Cathedral, Na Tcha Temple, and A-Ma Temple. Conclude your day with an Indian dinner and a night at the Venetian Hotel.In the evening, enjoy a mesmerising show at “House of Dancing Water,” one of the most spectacular productions in the world, before retiring to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Macau Full Day Tour – Day 2
package_itineraries.description: After a continental breakfast, continue your city exploration and return later for a leisurely evening. Spend the night in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Macau to Hong Kong (Disneyland)
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then board a ferry to Hong Kong. Head straight to Disneyland for a day of fun with attractions, shows, and dining. In the evening, dine at an Indian restaurant before staying overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hong Kong City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, embark on a half-day city tour covering Victoria Peak, Man Mo Temple, Aberdeen Fishing Village, Repulse Bay, the Jewelry Factory, and Madame Tussauds Hong Kong. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Relish your last breakfast and dedicate time to shopping before heading to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After landing, meet your guide and transfer to your hotel. In the afternoon, set out for a half-day tour of Hong Kong Island covering Victoria Peak, Man Mo Temple, Aberdeen Fishing Village, Repulse Bay, and the Jewelry Factory.End the sightseeing with a visit to Madame Tussauds Hong Kong before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Hong Kong’s Ocean Park
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, spend the day at Ocean Park. Ride the scenic cable car, admire marine animals, and experience one of the world’s largest aquariums. Spot giant pandas, red pandas, dolphins, and more while enjoying thrilling attractions. Conclude your day with an overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hong Kong Disneyland
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast before heading to Hong Kong Disneyland. From fun-filled rides to beloved cartoon characters and vibrant shows, enjoy the magical ambience all day. In the evening, have dinner at an Indian restaurant before returning to the hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Relish breakfast at your hotel, followed by a shopping spree in Hong Kong’s bustling markets. Later in the evening, transfer to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong – Macau
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Hong Kong International Airport, board a ferry transfer to Macau. Check in at your hotel, enjoy the relaxed ambience, and spend the evening at leisure before your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Macau

Visit the Ruins of St. Paul’s Church, Senado Square, and the historic Portuguese Cathedral. Continue to the Na Tcha Temple and later explore the revered A-Ma Temple.As night approaches, indulge in Indian cuisine at a local restaurant before checking in at the Venetian Hotel for a luxurious overnight experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Macau to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to the ferry terminal for your journey to Hong Kong. Upon arrival, meet your guide and head to your hotel. In the afternoon, begin a city tour including Victoria Peak, Man Mo Temple, Aberdeen Fishing Village, Repulse Bay, and the Jewelry Factory.Cap off your sightseeing with Madame Tussauds Hong Kong, home to lifelike wax statues of global icons, before returning to your hotel for overnight rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hong Kong Ocean Park Tour
package_itineraries.description: Savour a hearty breakfast before setting off for Ocean Park. This remarkable theme park houses diverse marine life, giant aquariums, and exciting cable car rides. Spot red pandas, dolphins, and sea lions while enjoying thrilling rides throughout the day. Return to your hotel for a night’s stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hong Kong Disneyland
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, step into the world of Disney magic. Enjoy parades, character meet-and-greets, and adrenaline-pumping rides. The evening is reserved for a delicious Indian dinner before you retreat to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your breakfast, spend the day shopping or exploring at leisure, and later transfer to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Hong Kong International Airport, you will be transferred by ferry to Macau. Once you reach the city, proceed to your hotel for check-in and relaxation. Spend the evening at leisure before settling in for your overnight stay in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Macau
package_itineraries.description: Begin the morning with a tasty breakfast and start your city exploration. Visit the world-famous Ruins of St. Paul’s Church and enjoy the lively atmosphere of Senado Square. Continue with a visit to the Portuguese Cathedral, Na Tcha Temple, and the beautiful A-Ma Temple, where history and spirituality blend seamlessly.Later, enjoy an authentic Indian dinner at a popular restaurant before moving to the Venetian Hotel for an elegant overnight stay in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Macau to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the ferry terminal for your ride to Hong Kong. On arrival, your guide will welcome you and assist with hotel check-in. In the afternoon, embark on a half-day city tour visiting Victoria Peak, Man Mo Temple, and other highlights that attract millions of visitors every year.Explore Aberdeen Fishing Village, see Repulse Bay, and discover craftsmanship at the Hong Kong Jewelry Factory. Complete the day with a visit to Madame Tussauds Hong Kong before returning to the hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hong Kong Ocean Park Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before setting out for a fun-filled day at Ocean Park. Explore fascinating marine exhibits, ride the scenic cable car, and admire one of the world’s largest aquariums. See pandas, dolphins, sea lions, and a variety of other animals before enjoying thrilling rides. Conclude the day with an overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hong Kong Disneyland
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, experience the magic of Hong Kong Disneyland. Meet favourite cartoon characters, watch enchanting shows, and try exciting rides. In the evening, treat yourself to dinner at an Indian restaurant before heading back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Relish your last breakfast in Hong Kong, followed by free time for shopping across the bustling markets. In the evening, you will be dropped at the airport for your return journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Check in and enjoy an evening city tour including the Temple of Literature, Ba Dinh Square, Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum (exterior), and a cyclo ride around the Old Quarter. Visit Ngoc Son Temple by Hoan Kiem Lake. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Halong Bay Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Travel through Red River Delta villages to Halong Bay. Board a wooden boat to cruise past formations like Stone Dog, Incense Burner, and Fighting Cock. Explore Thien Cung Cave before returning to Hanoi. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi Heritage & Flight to Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Ho Chi Minh Complex, One Pillar Pagoda, Tran Quoc Pagoda, Hanoi Flag Tower, and Thang Long Citadel. Fly to Siem Reap. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Angkor Discovery
package_itineraries.description: See the South Gate of Angkor Thom, Bayon Temple, Terrace of the Elephants, Royal Palace, Phimeanakas, Terrace of the Leper King, and Ta Prohm. Visit Angkor Wat in the afternoon. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Check in and start with a visit to the Angkor complex, including Ta Prohm, Srah Srang, Banteay Kdei, Thommanon, and Chau Say Tevoda. Enjoy an Apsara Dance show with dinner. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Biking Adventure through Angkor
package_itineraries.description: Cycle to Angkor Wat and explore Bayon Temple, Angkor Thom South Gate, Baphuon Temple, the Royal Palace, and the Terraces of the Elephants and Leper King. Visit Phnom Bakheng for sunset views, then enjoy dinner and a foot massage in downtown Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Banteay Srei & Wat Bo
package_itineraries.description: Visit Banteay Srei Temple, take a Tonle Sap cruise to floating villages and crocodile farms, then explore Artisans Angkor and Wat Bo Pagoda. Dinner and overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, transfer to your Siem Reap hotel and refresh before beginning your journey with a visit to East Mebon, Neak Poan, and Prasat Preah Khan. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Apsara Dance performance during dinner. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Temples of Angkor
package_itineraries.description: Witness a magical sunrise before heading to the Angkor archaeological area. Explore Banteay Srei, Banteay Samre, Ta Prohm, Banteay Kdei, Prasat Kravan, Chau Say Tevoda, and Thommanon. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: More Angkor Wonders
package_itineraries.description: Visit Bayon Temple, Baphuon Temple, and Angkor Thom. Continue to the Terrace of the Elephants, Terrace of the Leper King, and Phnom Bakheng before enjoying dinner back in Siem Reap. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: To Sihanoukville via Phnom Penh
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Phnom Penh, then drive to Sihanoukville. Check in and relax before enjoying water activities such as snorkelling, diving, or kayaking at nearby islands. Overnight in Sihanoukville.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bamboo Island Day Trip
package_itineraries.description: Sail to Bamboo Island for swimming, sunbathing, and water sports before returning to Sihanoukville. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Phnom Penh City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Phnom Penh to visit the Royal Palace, Silver Pagoda, Independence Monument, and the National Museum. Overnight in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Before heading to the airport, visit the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum. Depart for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Siem Reap International Airport, where you’ll be met and transferred to your hotel. Spend the afternoon unwinding or strolling around your neighbourhood.Later, explore highlights such as the Baray Big Pond and Les Artisans – Chantiers Ecoles, where you’ll witness the art of traditional Khmer crafts. Visit historical treasures including Bayon Temple, Ta Prohm Temple, and Prasat Preah Khan. End your day at the Pre Rup Temple, a striking Hindu monument dedicated to Lord Shiva. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Full-Day Angkor Wat Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Set out for the awe-inspiring Angkor Wat, spanning 402 acres. Built in the early 12th century under King Suryavarman II, the temple showcases intricate carvings and grand towers inspired by Mount Meru, the mythical home of the gods. Take time to appreciate the architecture and the serene spiritual atmosphere before returning to your hotel. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Floating Villages and City Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Today, visit the fascinating Floating Villages on Tonle Sap Lake, such as Chong Khneas, Kampong Phluk, and Prek Toal. These communities, with markets and houses on stilts, offer a glimpse into daily life on the water.Explore Wat Bo, a historic 18th-century pagoda adorned with rare Ramayana paintings, and Wat Thmei, home to a memorial stupa dedicated to Khmer Rouge victims. Spend the evening shopping at Psar Chars (Old Market) and sampling local street food. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Say farewell to Siem Reap as you head to the airport for your flight home or to carry on with your Cambodia journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Phnom Penh
package_itineraries.description: Cambodia, home to the legendary Angkor Wat—the eighth wonder of the ancient world—offers much more than temples. This captivating Southeast Asian destination delights visitors with its lush landscapes, beautiful beaches, and delectable cuisine. Embark on this journey with the “Cambodia travel package” and immerse yourself in its rich heritage.Day 1: Arrival in Phnom PenhUpon landing at Phnom Penh International Airport, you’ll be greeted by a local tour representative who will assist with your transfer to the hotel. As you travel through the city, admire the charming blend of French colonial elegance and traditional Khmer architecture along scenic, tree-lined boulevards.After check-in and some relaxation, begin your exploration with iconic city landmarks such as the Royal Palace and Wat Phnom Daun Penh. Visit the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum for a sobering look into Cambodia’s past, and marvel at the Silver Pagoda, renowned for its Temple of the Emerald Buddha adorned with gold, diamonds, and precious stones.Conclude your day at the National Museum, home to over 5,000 ancient Khmer artefacts crafted from bronze, wood, gold, silver, copper, and sandstone. Overnight in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phnom Penh City Sights and Silk Island Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Begin the morning with a visit to the former Tuol Sleng prison, now a moving Genocide Museum. Continue to the bustling Russian Market to browse for traditional handicrafts, souvenirs, and fashionable local wear.In the afternoon, set out for Silk Island, travelling along the Mekong River by boat. Pass traditional stilt houses, many of which have workshops underneath where artisans weave intricate silk fabrics. Later, enjoy a scenic Mekong River cruise, watching the sunset glow over the Royal Palace skyline. Overnight in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Phnom Penh
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, it’s time to bid farewell to Cambodia as you transfer to the airport for your onward journey or continue your Asia adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Saigon – Evening City Sights
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Saigon and check into your hotel. Visit the Reunification Palace, Central Post Office, Nguyen Hue Street, the Opera House, and Ben Thanh Market. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Mekong Delta Experience
package_itineraries.description: Cruise along the Mekong River, visit local islands, enjoy tropical fruits and folk music, and ride small boats through shaded canals. Visit Vinh Trang Pagoda before returning to Saigon. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cu Chi Tunnels – Flight to Phnom Penh
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Cu Chi Tunnels, then fly to Phnom Penh. Transfer to your hotel and relax. Overnight in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Phnom Penh Heritage & History
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Royal Palace, Silver Pagoda, Independence Monument, National Museum, Phnom Daun Penh, Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum, and the Russian Market. Overnight in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi – Evening City Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Noi Bai Airport, where you’ll be greeted and transferred to your hotel. In the evening, begin your exploration with a visit to the Temple of Literature, Vietnam’s first university built in 1070. Stroll through its serene gardens and admire well-preserved architecture that offers a glimpse into the country’s scholarly past. Continue to Hoan Kiem Lake and the Ngoc Son Temple, followed by a leisurely cyclo ride through Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi – Tam Coc & Hoa Lu – Return to Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel south to Ninh Binh, home to the scenic Tam Coc Caves and the ancient capital Hoa Lu. Glide along the waterways on a traditional sampan boat, passing limestone karsts that rise dramatically from emerald rice fields—earning the nickname “Halong Bay on land.” Visit the 10th-century temples of King Dinh and King Le, famed for their intricate wooden carvings. Enjoy lunch en route before returning to Hanoi for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi to Halong Bay Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before heading to the UNESCO-listed Halong Bay. Board a traditional vessel to cruise through a seascape dotted with limestone islands and hidden grottoes. Savor a seafood lunch on board, visit the Surprising Grotto, and choose between swimming or kayaking. Glide past floating villages and secluded islets before dining and spending the night aboard the boat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Halong Bay – Hanoi – Flight to Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Begin the morning with a visit to Luon Cave, a tranquil lagoon surrounded by cliffs. As you cruise back, pass iconic rock formations like Cock-Fighting Rock and Sail Island. Disembark at Halong Wharf and return to Hanoi for your flight to Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City). Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Saigon – Mekong Delta Excursion
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, journey to the Mekong Delta and embark on a boat cruise along the mighty river. Visit one of the area’s lush islands, ride through coconut-lined canals in small rowboats, and explore local workshops. Enjoy a horse-cart ride along peaceful village paths before visiting the ornate Vinh Trang Pagoda, blending Chinese, Cambodian, and French design elements. Return to Saigon for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels & City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore the legendary Cu Chi Tunnels, a 200km underground network used during the war for shelter, storage, and defense. Return to Saigon to visit the Reunification Palace and the War Remnants Museum, then view European-inspired landmarks like the City Hall and the Opera House from the outside. Stop at Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office before spending the night in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Saigon to Siem Reap – First Glimpse of Cambodia
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, fly to Siem Reap. Visit Wat Thmei, the “Killing Field” memorial with its striking glass stupa. Continue to Les Artisans d’Angkor – Chantiers École to discover the preservation of Khmer arts and crafts. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Siem Reap – Angkor Thom & Angkor Wat
package_itineraries.description: Explore the South Gate of Angkor Thom and marvel at the Terrace of the Elephants, Baphuon temple, Phimeanakas, and the Terrace of the Leper King. In the afternoon, visit the world-famous Angkor Wat, a stunning architectural masterpiece inspired by Hindu cosmology. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Siem Reap – Temples & Sunset
package_itineraries.description: Discover Ta Prohm, where giant tree roots entwine ancient stone walls. Visit Srah Srang royal bath, Thommanon temple, Preah Khan, Ta Som, and end the day at Pre Rup temple for a spectacular sunset view. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast before transferring to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Phnom Penh Arrival & City Discovery
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Phnom Penh, a captivating blend of traditional Khmer heritage and French colonial elegance, evident in its charming villas and leafy boulevards. Upon arrival, a representative will welcome you at the airport and assist with your hotel transfer. After a refreshing breakfast, begin your exploration at the magnificent Royal Palace complex, built in 1866, a symbol of Cambodia’s regal heritage. Continue to the glittering Silver Pagoda, also known as the Emerald Buddha Temple, adorned with statues in gold, silver, diamonds, and precious gemstones.Next, visit the Independence Monument before heading to the National Museum, a masterpiece of Khmer architecture housing over 5,000 rare artefacts crafted from bronze, silver, wood, copper, sandstone, and more. Enjoy a leisurely walk along the riverside park where four rivers, including the legendary Mekong, meet. Climb the sacred Phnom Daun Penh Hill for panoramic city views before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phnom Penh Highlights & Transfer to Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, delve into Cambodia’s somber past with a visit to Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum, once the infamous S-21 security camp during the Khmer Rouge era. Continue to the lively Russian Market for a shopping experience filled with local crafts and souvenirs. Later, proceed to the airport or bus station for your journey to Siem Reap. Upon arrival, meet your local representative for hotel transfer and rest overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Angkor Thom & Angkor Wat Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a visit to the South Gate of Angkor Thom, the grand entrance to the final capital of the Angkor Empire. Explore the impressive Bayon Temple, famed for its smiling stone faces, before walking along the Terrace of the Elephants and visiting the Baphuon Temple Mountain. Discover the Royal Palace area and the intricately carved Terrace of the Leper King. End the morning at the photogenic Ta Prohm, where massive tree roots entwine ancient stonework.In the afternoon, visit Angkor Wat, one of the world’s greatest architectural wonders, symbolizing the Hindu universe. Admire its five towering spires, intricate bas-reliefs, and depictions of celestial Apsara dancers. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Temples & Sunset Views
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, revisit the enchanting Ta Prohm before continuing to Angkor Wat for deeper exploration. Visit Preah Khan, known as “The Sacred Sword,” with its endless corridors and intricate carvings. Explore Neak Pean, a small but elegant island temple, and East Mebon, set atop a former island in the now-dry East Baray reservoir. Conclude at Pre Rup, a 10th-century temple-mountain offering breathtaking sunset views. Overnight stay in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Siem Reap City & Floating Villages
package_itineraries.description: Start with a visit to Wat Thmei, a memorial site with a glass stupa containing remains from the Khmer Rouge era. Continue to Les Artisans d’Angkor – Chantiers Ecole, preserving authentic Khmer handicrafts. After lunch, enjoy a traditional wooden boat ride to the Floating Villages of Tonle Sap, Asia’s largest freshwater lake. Visit Wat Bo Pagoda to admire wall paintings depicting the Reamker and shop for souvenirs at Psar Chars, the Old Market. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Phnom Penh – Discover the City’s Historic Heart
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Phnom Penh International Airport, our friendly representative will welcome you and assist with your hotel transfer. After checking in and freshening up, your exploration begins.Your first stop will be the iconic Royal Palace of Cambodia – a splendid complex that serves as the official residence of the King. Just south of the palace lies the dazzling Silver Pagoda, home to an impressive life-sized gold Buddha decorated with over 2,000 diamonds.Continue to the Independence Monument, built to commemorate Cambodia’s liberation from French colonial rule, before visiting the National Museum of Cambodia, the country’s largest repository of cultural treasures. Stroll past the picturesque river-front park, where four rivers meet, and finish your day at Wat Phnom, a serene hilltop Buddhist temple steeped in local legend.Overnight stay in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phnom Penh – Heritage & Local Markets
package_itineraries.description: Begin your morning with a visit to the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum, a deeply moving site that tells the tragic story of Cambodia’s recent history. Once a school, it was converted into Security Prison 21 by the Khmer Rouge between 1975 and 1979.Afterwards, shift to a lighter mood with a shopping excursion at the Russian Market – one of the city’s most vibrant hubs for local handicrafts. Browse through silk fabrics, Buddha statues, wooden carvings, jewellery, paintings, and more. End the day with a hearty dinner before returning to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Phnom Penh to Siem Reap – Journey into Ancient Wonders
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, take a short flight to Siem Reap, the gateway to the legendary temples of Angkor. Upon arrival and hotel check-in, your temple exploration begins.Marvel at Prasat Kravan, known for its exquisite brick sculptures, admire the peaceful beauty of Srah Srang, and visit the intricately carved Banteay Srei, often called the “Citadel of Women.” Continue to Banteay Samre, a restored 11th-century temple, before heading to Wat Bo Pagoda, one of Siem Reap’s oldest and most significant religious sites.In the evening, enjoy a traditional Apsara dance performance at the Apsara Theatre while savouring a delicious dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Siem Reap – Biking Through the Ancient City
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore Siem Reap from a different perspective as you set off on a guided bike tour. Cycle your way to the legendary Angkor Wat complex, visiting iconic sites such as Angkor Thom, the South Gate, Bayon Temple, and the grand Baphuon Temple. Wander along the Terrace of the Elephants and the Terrace of the Leper King, both adorned with fascinating carvings.In the evening, immerse yourself in Siem Reap’s vibrant nightlife or shop for souvenirs at the Angkor Night Market. Treat yourself to a soothing foot massage before heading back to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Siem Reap – Sunrise & Floating Villages
package_itineraries.description: Rise early to witness a breathtaking sunrise over the Angkor area, followed by a scenic boat trip on Tonle Sap Lake, the largest freshwater lake in Southeast Asia. Observe the unique floating villages and the traditional lifestyle of the locals.Before departing, visit Artisans Angkor to discover the artistry behind traditional Khmer crafts. Later, transfer to the airport for your onward journey, marking the end of your unforgettable Cambodia holiday tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi – Cultural Introduction
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Noi Bai Airport and transfer to your hotel. Begin your exploration at the Temple of Literature, built in 1070, followed by a photo stop at Ba Dinh Square to view Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum from outside. Stroll by Hoan Kiem Lake, visit Ngoc Son Temple, and enjoy a cyclo ride around the Old Quarter. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Halong Bay Day Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Travel through the Red River Delta to reach Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Board a wooden junk boat to sail past formations like Stone Dog and Fighting Cock. Enjoy a seafood lunch before visiting Thien Cung Cave or relaxing on board. Return to Hanoi in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi to Saigon – Evening Tour
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Saigon and check into your hotel. Visit the Reunification Palace, pass European-inspired landmarks, and see Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mekong Delta Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Cruise along the Mekong River, visit tropical gardens, listen to traditional folk music, and ride small boats through coconut groves. Explore local workshops and enjoy a horse-cart ride before visiting Vinh Trang Pagoda. Return to Saigon for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Saigon City Tour – Flight to Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Tour the Reunification Palace, City Hall, Opera House, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and the Central Post Office before flying to Siem Reap. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Angkor Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Visit the South Gate of Angkor Thom, Bayon Temple, Terrace of the Leper King, and Ta Prohm. In the afternoon, explore Angkor Wat. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before transferring to the airport for your flight home or onward travel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Saigon – Immersive Saigon City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Saigon, now officially Ho Chi Minh City – a vibrant, bustling heart of Vietnam. Upon landing, transfer to the city centre for hotel check-in. In the evening, begin your sightseeing with the iconic Reunification Palace, an important historical site from the Vietnam War, now preserved as a museum and event venue. Just a short walk away lies the French colonial-era Central Post Office, a masterpiece of architecture.Continue your stroll along Nguyen Hue Street, snapping photos of the Opera House and Ho Chi Minh Committee building (viewed from outside). End the day with a visit to the lively Ben Thanh Market, a true cultural hub where you can explore local crafts and flavours. Overnight stay in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Saigon – Mekong Delta Adventure – Saigon
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off for My Tho in the Mekong Delta. Board a boat to cruise the mighty Mekong River, passing riverside villages and lush landscapes. Stop at one of the four islands to explore its charm before switching to smaller rowboats, drifting along coconut-lined canals. Visit local workshops to taste honey tea, observe coconut candy-making, and walk through fragrant fruit gardens.Experience a relaxing horse-cart ride through peaceful village lanes before enjoying lunch at a riverside restaurant, sampling the local speciality – Elephant Ear fish. On your return to Saigon, visit Vinh Trang Pagoda, famed for its blend of Chinese, Cambodian, and French architecture. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels Exploration – Flight to Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning at the Cu Chi Tunnels, an extraordinary 200-km underground network used by Vietnamese fighters during the war. Gain insight into the resourcefulness and resilience of those who lived here, and, if you wish, crawl through a short tunnel section.In the afternoon, transfer to the airport for your flight to Siem Reap. Upon arrival, meet your local guide for a hotel transfer. The rest of the evening is at leisure. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Full-Day Angkor Temple Discovery
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, step into the ancient world of Angkor. Begin at the South Gate of Angkor Thom, once the royal city of the Khmer Empire, and visit Bayon Temple, a fascinating structure with its serene stone faces. Explore the Terrace of the Elephants, the Terrace of the Leper King, Baphuon, and the Royal Palace area, including Phimeanakas Temple. Wander through Ta Prohm, a photogenic site where massive tree roots intertwine with the temple’s stone walls.In the afternoon, marvel at Angkor Wat, the largest religious monument in the world, with its five lotus-shaped towers, detailed carvings, and graceful Apsara dancers etched into the stone. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong – Transfer to Macau
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Hong Kong International Airport and transfer to the pier for a ferry ride to Macau. After check-in, the day is yours to explore. Overnight in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Macao – Half-Day Sightseeing Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning with a delicious breakfast before setting out on a fascinating half-day exploration of Macao. Discover some of the city’s most celebrated landmarks, including the historic Ruins of St. Paul’s, the serene A-Ma Temple, a charming Cake Shop, and the impressive Macao Tower (please note: Observation Deck admission not included). Round off the tour with a peek into the city’s vibrant casino culture. The rest of the day is free for you to explore on your own. Spend the night in comfort at your hotel in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Macau to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take the ferry to Hong Kong, check in to your hotel, and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hong Kong – Morning City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Waterfront, visit a Jewellery Workshop, and ride a bus to Victoria Peak. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Hong Kong.Optional: Visit Madame Tussauds on your own for USD 24 per person.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hong Kong – Full Day Disneyland Experience
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Hong Kong Disneyland, enjoying attractions, live shows, parades, and themed zones. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your return journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Meet your local representative at Hong Kong Airport and transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to explore. Overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong – Half-Day Tour
