package_itineraries.description: Pick from the Great Ocean Road or Phillip Island Penguin Parade. Return to Melbourne for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Fly to Gold Coast via Brisbane
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your flight to Brisbane or Gold Coast. On arrival, explore local attractions like a thrilling Jet Boat ride or a Fire Truck Tour. Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Full Day at Dreamworld
package_itineraries.description: Spend an action-packed day at Dreamworld, enjoying roller coasters and wildlife shows. Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Wildlife & Seaworld Combo
package_itineraries.description: Visit Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary in the morning, then explore Seaworld in the afternoon with its marine exhibits and thrilling rides. Return to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Movie World Adventures
package_itineraries.description: Experience the cinematic thrills of Movie World with themed rides and attractions. Return to your hotel by evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Journey to Hamilton Island
package_itineraries.description: Fly from Brisbane to Hamilton Island. Check in at your resort and enjoy access to water sports and the island shuttle. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Great Barrier Reef Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day cruise to the Great Barrier Reef. Enjoy a buffet lunch onboard. Return to the resort for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Whitehaven Beach Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Choose from a morning or afternoon half-day tour to Whitehaven Beach. Spend the rest of your day relaxing at the resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Fly to Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Sydney. On arrival, check in to your hotel. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Sydney City & Aquarium Visit
package_itineraries.description: Take a half-day tour of Sydney including key landmarks. Later, visit Sea Life Aquarium and Sydney Tower Eye. In the evening, enjoy an Indian dinner cruise aboard the Sydney ShowBoat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Full Day Blue Mountains Tour
package_itineraries.description: Choose between two full-day tour options to the Blue Mountains, both including Scenic World and a Wildlife Park, with or without lunch. Return to Sydney for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Departure from Sydney
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight home, concluding your 14-day exploration of Australia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Melbourne
package_itineraries.description: Land at Melbourne Tullamarine Airport and transfer to your hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is yours to relax or explore the city. Overnight stay in Melbourne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Melbourne City Discovery
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a half-day guided tour of Melbourne’s highlights, including Federation Square and other key landmarks. Later, choose between a tour of the iconic MCG or a scenic Yarra River Cruise. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Choose Your Melbourne Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Pick one full-day group tour from the following options:Great Ocean Road: Travel along this spectacular coastal drive, returning late evening.Phillip Island: See penguins, koalas, and kangaroos, with evening return.Sovereign Hill: Step back in time to the gold rush era.Puffing Billy & Wineries: Ride the historic train and visit top Yarra Valley vineyards.Puffing Billy & Wildlife: Combine the steam train journey with Dandenong Ranges and wildlife encounters.Return to your hotel after the adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Fly to Sydney
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head to the airport for your flight to Sydney. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and settle in for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Explore Sydney & Darling Harbour
package_itineraries.description: Join a morning tour of Sydney’s landmarks including the Opera House, Harbour Bridge, and Manly Beach. In the afternoon, visit Sea Life Aquarium and Sydney Tower Eye with your Combo Pass. In the evening, head to Darling Harbour for the Sydney ShowBoat cruise, featuring dinner and entertainment. Overnight stay in Sydney.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Full Day Tour from Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Choose one of the following full-day tours:Blue Mountains with Scenic Rides & Wildlife ParkBlue Mountains with Lunch, Scenic Rides & Wildlife ParkBoth tours include transportation and sightseeing and return by evening. Enjoy your last night in Sydney.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your onward journey, bringing your Downunder adventure to a close.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to Auckland! Upon arrival, you’ll be greeted by your local tour representative and escorted to your hotel. Take the rest of the day to explore the surroundings and begin your Kiwi adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Auckland City Highlights
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a guided city tour covering iconic sights like the Harbour Bridge, Auckland Viaduct, and Michael Joseph Savage Memorial Park, offering sweeping views over the city and harbour. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Waitomo Caves and Rotorua Journey
package_itineraries.description: Travel south from Auckland to the magical Waitomo Glowworm Caves. Marvel at the natural light show created by thousands of glowworms inside this subterranean wonderland. Then continue via the Mamaku Ranges to Rotorua. Overnight in Rotorua.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua Experiences and Māori Culture
package_itineraries.description: Visit Te Puia Thermal Reserve, where you’ll witness bubbling mud pools and powerful geysers. Then head to Rainbow Springs Nature Park and the Agrodome for a live farm show. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Māori Hangi dinner and cultural performance. Overnight in Rotorua.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Rotorua to Wellington via Taupo
package_itineraries.description: Begin your scenic road trip to Wellington, stopping at Lake Taupo to take in the peaceful waters and mountain vistas. Then travel through the dramatic landscapes of the Desert Road before arriving in New Zealand's capital city. Overnight in Wellington.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Wellington City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Wellington's cultural highlights including a guided visit to Te Papa, the National Museum. Learn about New Zealand’s history, art, and Māori heritage. Spend the evening relaxing in the vibrant city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Cross to the South Island – Picton & Kaikoura
package_itineraries.description: Board a ferry across the Cook Strait to reach the picturesque town of Picton in Marlborough Sounds. Continue through Blenheim to reach Kaikoura, famed for its marine wildlife. You may opt for a thrilling whale-watching cruise in the afternoon. Overnight in Kaikoura.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Kaikoura to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Travel along the scenic coastline through North Canterbury to Christchurch. Enjoy the mix of history and modern vibrancy as you settle in for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Mount Cook and Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a journey through the Canterbury Plains to Lake Tekapo. Visit the iconic Church of the Good Shepherd before continuing to Mount Cook, New Zealand’s highest peak. Drive along Lake Pukaki and reach Queenstown for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Milford Sound Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Depart early via Lake Te Anau and the dramatic Eglinton Valley, traveling through the Homer Tunnel to reach Milford Sound. Cruise through the fjord, admire waterfalls like Bowen Falls, and enjoy a buffet lunch onboard. Return to Queenstown for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Queenstown Adventure Day
package_itineraries.description: Today is free for adventure! Choose from thrilling activities like jet boating, bungy jumping, white-water rafting, or a scenic gondola ride for panoramic views. Overnight in Queenstown.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Journey to the Glacier Region
package_itineraries.description: Travel through Lake Wanaka and the lush Haast Pass to reach the West Coast. Marvel at the towering mountains and native forests en route to the glacier region, home to Franz Josef and Fox Glaciers. Overnight stay nearby.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Glacier Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring the glaciers at your own pace or join optional activities like scenic helicopter rides or guided glacier walks (not included). Return to your accommodation for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: TranzAlpine Scenic Rail to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Travel north to Greymouth and board the TranzAlpine train to Christchurch. Enjoy one of the world’s most scenic rail journeys as you cross Arthur’s Pass and the Southern Alps. Overnight in Christchurch.

package_itineraries.title: Day 15: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then transfer to the airport for your return or onward flight, ending your unforgettable journey through New Zealand.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Hamilton Island
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Hamilton Island Airport and enjoy a seamless transfer to your island resort. The rest of the day is yours to explore or unwind. Your stay includes complimentary access to water activities like catamaran sailing, paddle skiing, windsurfing, and snorkeling. Plus, take advantage of the convenient Island Shuttle, operating from morning till late evening. Enjoy a peaceful overnight stay at your Hamilton Island resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Great Barrier Reef Excursion
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a full-day marine adventure with Cruise Whitsundays to the outer reef pontoon—Reefworld. Witness the wonders of the Great Barrier Reef and enjoy a delicious lunch served onboard. After an action-packed day, return to your resort for another relaxing evening. Meals include breakfast and lunch.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leisure on the Island
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast and spend the day at leisure. Whether you prefer lounging on the beach or joining optional island activities, Hamilton Island offers ample opportunities for relaxation or exploration. Stay overnight at your resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Hamilton Island Airport for your onward journey. Leave with unforgettable memories of this serene island retreat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Once you arrive in Auckland, seat-in-coach passengers will be greeted by a local representative for transfer to the hotel. If you’re self-driving, collect your rental car at the airport and head to your accommodation. Overnight in Auckland.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast, then head south to explore the famous Waitomo Glowworm Caves. After your guided tour, continue through the Mamaku Ranges to Rotorua. Stay overnight in Rotorua.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Discover Rotorua
package_itineraries.description: Visit Te Puia Thermal Reserve, Rainbow Springs, and the Agrodome. Enjoy a free afternoon followed by a Maori Hangi feast and cultural show in the evening. Dinner included. Overnight in Rotorua.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua to Napier (Approx. 219km)
package_itineraries.description: Journey past Lake Taupo and into the East Coast to the art-deco city of Napier. Overnight at a local hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Napier Leisure Day
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at leisure. Optional tours include walking or vintage car tours of Napier. In the afternoon, enjoy a wine tour and tastings at three wineries. Overnight in Napier.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Napier to Wellington (Approx. 322km)
package_itineraries.description: Drive through Manawatu Gorge and Palmerston North, arriving in the capital city of Wellington. Overnight in Wellington.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Wellington
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head to Wellington Airport or return your rental car. Your unforgettable North Island experience comes to a close.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Auckland – The City of Sails
package_itineraries.description: Land in Auckland and meet your local representative if you're on a coach tour. You’ll be transferred privately to your hotel. If self-driving, collect your rental car at the airport and head to the hotel. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Auckland.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo
package_itineraries.description: Depart Auckland for the Waitomo Glowworm Caves. On a guided tour, experience a magical boat ride under glowing cave ceilings. Continue through the Mamaku Ranges to Rotorua, the heart of geothermal activity. Overnight in Rotorua.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rotorua Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a visit to Te Puia’s geysers and mud pools, followed by Rainbow Springs and the Agrodome farm show. The afternoon is free for personal exploration. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Maori Hangi dinner and performance. Overnight in Rotorua. (Dinner included)

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua to Wellington
package_itineraries.description: Travel past Lake Taupo and through Turangi and the Desert Road, where the volcanic peaks of Ruapehu and Tongariro dominate the horizon. Arrive in Wellington, the capital city, for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Discover Wellington
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided city tour and a visit to Te Papa Museum. The afternoon is yours to explore independently. Spend the night at your Wellington hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Wellington to Kaikoura
package_itineraries.description: Cross the Cook Strait and marvel at the Marlborough Sounds before arriving in Picton. Journey through Blenheim to reach the coastal town of Kaikoura for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Kaikoura to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and drive through the North Canterbury region to Christchurch. Spend the evening in this beautiful city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Christchurch to Mount Cook
package_itineraries.description: Travel through the Canterbury Plains and visit Lake Tekapo and the Church of the Good Shepherd en route to Mount Cook. Overnight in the national park.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Mount Cook to Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Drive along Lake Pukaki and through Central Otago to arrive in Queenstown by evening. Settle in for a relaxing night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Adventure in Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy the freedom to choose from a wide range of optional activities such as bungy jumping, jet boating, or scenic gondola rides (own cost). Spend the night in Queenstown.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Queenstown – Milford Sound – Te Anau
package_itineraries.description: Travel via Eglinton Valley and the Homer Tunnel to Milford Sound. Enjoy a scenic cruise before heading to Te Anau for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Te Anau to Dunedin
package_itineraries.description: Pass through Gore and Balclutha to reach the Scottish-inspired city of Dunedin. The afternoon is open for exploration. Overnight in Dunedin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Dunedin to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Travel north through charming farmland towns to Christchurch. Stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Departure Day
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, proceed to Christchurch Airport to board your return flight. Cherish the unforgettable memories of your New Zealand journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to Christchurch, also known as 'The Garden City'. A private transfer is provided for coach travelers to your hotel, while self-drivers can collect their rental car from the airport and drive to their accommodation. Enjoy a restful night in Christchurch.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Christchurch to the Glacier Region
package_itineraries.description: Travel through the scenic Waimakariri River Valley and across the Southern Alps to Arthur's Pass. After a stop at Greymouth, continue down the rugged West Coast to reach Franz Josef and Fox Glaciers. Stay overnight in the glacier region.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leisure Day at the Glaciers
package_itineraries.description: Spend today surrounded by glacial beauty. Take part in optional adventures such as a scenic flight or glacier hike (extra charges apply), or simply unwind with included access to the Glacier Hot Pools in Franz Josef. Another overnight stay awaits you in this magical region.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Glacier Region to Wanaka
package_itineraries.description: Depart for Wanaka via the Haast Pass, enjoying vistas of native forests, alpine ranges, and sparkling lakes along the way. Stop at Lake Hawea before reaching Wanaka in the afternoon. The rest of the day is yours to relax. Stay overnight in Wanaka.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Wanaka to Queenstown (Approx. 67km, 1 hour 10 mins)
package_itineraries.description: Visit the quirky Puzzling World before traveling to Queenstown, New Zealand’s adventure capital. The day ends with an overnight stay at a Queenstown hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Queenstown – Explore at Your Own Pace
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day freely exploring Queenstown’s many optional activities—from adrenaline adventures like bungy jumping and jet boating to more laid-back options like gondola rides. Activities are at your own cost. Another night in Queenstown awaits.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Queenstown to Mount Cook (Approx. 240km, 3 hours)
package_itineraries.description: Travel through Central Otago, stopping in Twizel and following Lake Pukaki to Mt. Cook National Park. Optional activities include scenic flights, glacier boating, or visiting the Sir Edmund Hillary Centre (not included). Stay overnight at Mt. Cook.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Mount Cook to Christchurch (Approx. 333km, 4.5 hours)
package_itineraries.description: Journey back to Christchurch via Lake Tekapo, where you'll visit the iconic Church of the Good Shepherd. Continue across the Canterbury Plains to reach your hotel for the final overnight stay in Christchurch.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure from Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the airport for your return journey or next destination, wrapping up this spectacular New Zealand experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Auckland Arrival
package_itineraries.description: Upon arriving in Auckland, fondly called 'The City of Sails', seat-in-coach passengers will be warmly welcomed by a local representative and transferred privately to their hotel. If you’re opting for a self-drive experience, collect your rental car at the airport and proceed to your accommodation at your own pace.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo and Matamata
package_itineraries.description: Begin your journey through rolling green landscapes and rich farmlands as you head to the magical Waitomo Glowworm Caves. Here, enjoy a guided experience through intricate limestone formations and a boat ride beneath a ceiling lit by thousands of glowing worms. Continue to Matamata for a guided exploration of the iconic Hobbiton Movie Set, then proceed to Rotorua to settle in for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rotorua
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a visit to Te Puia Thermal Reserve to witness steaming geysers and bubbling mud pools. Head next to the Agrodome for a lighthearted farm show. Then, stop by Rainbow Springs to see native trout and other wildlife. Spend your afternoon exploring more of Rotorua at your leisure. In the evening, enjoy an authentic Maori Hangi dinner and cultural performance. Breakfast and dinner are included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua to Auckland (Approx. 228km, 3 hours)
package_itineraries.description: You can either enjoy a relaxing morning in Rotorua or take part in optional activities upon returning to Auckland (optional experiences not included in the package). Later, transfer from Rotorua to Auckland for your final night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure Day
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel, return your rental car (if self-driving), and head to the airport to catch your return flight. Your romantic New Zealand getaway concludes here.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Brisbane/Gold Coast Arrival
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at either Brisbane or Gold Coast Airport by 10:00 AM. Transfer to your hotel. Optional afternoon jet boat ride and fire truck tour (transfers not included). Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Dream World Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Spend a fun-filled day at Dream World. Enjoy rides and attractions before returning to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Wildlife Encounters & SeaWorld
package_itineraries.description: Visit Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary in the morning, followed by an afternoon trip to SeaWorld. Enjoy animal exhibits and marine-themed attractions. Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Movie World Excitement
package_itineraries.description: Experience Movie World with return transfers and a souvenir gift combo. Immerse in the entertainment and thrill. Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Travel to Hamilton Island
package_itineraries.description: Fly from Brisbane to Hamilton Island. Enjoy complimentary resort activities like snorkeling, catamarans, and the Island Shuttle. Overnight on Hamilton Island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Whitehaven Beach Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Visit Wildlife Hamilton Island in the morning, followed by a half-day cruise to Whitehaven Beach. Overnight stay on the island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Great Barrier Reef Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Full-day reef cruise with lunch. Discover the vibrant underwater world before returning to your Hamilton Island resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Hamilton to Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Sydney and transfer to your hotel. Arrive by evening and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Hop-On Hop-Off & Showboat Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Explore Sydney at your pace with a hop-on hop-off bus ticket. In the evening, enjoy an Indian vegetarian dinner aboard the Sydney ShowBoat Cruise. Overnight in Sydney.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Iconic Sights & Attractions
package_itineraries.description: Visit Sydney Opera House for a guided tour. Later, redeem your Combo 4 Pass at Sea Life Aquarium for access to top attractions like Madame Tussauds and Sydney Tower Eye. Return independently to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Departure from Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport. Departure transfers valid only for later flights (after 7:00 AM domestic or 8:00 AM international).

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Perth
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Perth Airport, you’ll be transferred to your hotel (for arrivals before 10:00 PM). Settle in and enjoy your first evening in the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Perth & Fremantle Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a half-day tour exploring Perth and Fremantle. The tour concludes at Barrack Street Jetty, from where you can take a short walk to the Perth Mint for a 3:30 PM tour. Return independently to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rottnest Island Day Trip
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a full-day adventure to Rottnest Island. Enjoy a 90-minute boat ride and a delicious lunch at Thomson Restaurant. Note: this tour is not suitable for children under 4. Return to Perth for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Pinnacles & Wildlife Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today’s tour includes a trip to the Pinnacles Desert, a visit to Caversham Wildlife Park, and thrilling 4WD sandboarding experiences. A fish and chips meal caps off the day. Return to Perth for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Travel to Margaret River Region
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and leave large bags behind. Journey to the Margaret River Region, stopping at a cave, Busselton Jetty, and Cape Leeuwin Lighthouse. Wine tasting and both lunch and dinner are included. Spend the night at Abbey Beach Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Wine Tasting & Return to Perth
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your Margaret River accommodation and join a wine tasting tour with lunch. Return to Perth by late evening for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Perth
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Perth Airport. For flights before 6:00 AM, additional charges may apply.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Land in Auckland, collect your rental car, and head to your hotel. Take the day to rest and prepare for the journey ahead in this bustling waterfront city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Auckland to Bay of Islands
package_itineraries.description: Drive north via Auckland’s Harbour Bridge and the Hibiscus Coast. Pass through Whangarei and continue to the beautiful Bay of Islands, where you’ll check in for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Explore the Bay of Islands
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a free day to explore. Opt for a Cape Reinga and 90 Mile Beach tour or explore local sites like Kerikeri. Relax and absorb the natural beauty of the area.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bay of Islands to Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Spend the morning at leisure, then return to Auckland for an evening of rest and urban exploration.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Auckland to Rotorua
package_itineraries.description: Travel south, passing through Pukekohe and the agricultural heartland of Hamilton, before arriving in Rotorua—famous for its geothermal activity. Check into your hotel and relax.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Rotorua to Tongariro National Park
package_itineraries.description: Stop in Taupo to see Lake Taupo and Huka Falls. Then travel through the scenic central plateau to Tongariro National Park for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Discover Tongariro
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring the national park, with options like the world-renowned Tongariro Crossing trek or shorter scenic walks.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Tongariro to Wellington
package_itineraries.description: Make your way to New Zealand’s capital, Wellington. Enjoy the city's culture and waterfront on your own schedule.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Wellington to Nelson
package_itineraries.description: Drop off your car in Wellington and board the Interislander Ferry to Picton, sailing through the picturesque Marlborough Sounds. Pick up a new car in Picton and drive along Queen Charlotte Drive to Nelson.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Abel Tasman Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day discovering Nelson and nearby Abel Tasman National Park, known for its golden beaches and walking tracks.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Nelson to Greymouth
package_itineraries.description: Drive through the scenic Nelson Lakes district and West Coast to Greymouth. En route, stop at Punakaiki to see the famous Pancake Rocks.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Greymouth to Glacier Region
package_itineraries.description: Head south into the glacier region. Unwind with a visit to the relaxing Glacier Hot Pools. Overnight stay in this tranquil landscape.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Glacier Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day enjoying the natural glacier environment. Optional activities include a scenic flight or a glacier hike.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Glacier Region to Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Queenstown via the Haast Pass, passing Lakes Hawea and Wanaka. Enjoy stunning alpine views before arriving in the adventure capital.

package_itineraries.title: Day 15: Queenstown Adventures
package_itineraries.description: A full day to enjoy Queenstown’s many activities—bungy jumping, jet boating, gondola rides, and more. Relax in the evening with lakeside dining.

package_itineraries.title: Day 16: Queenstown to Te Anau
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Te Anau and explore at leisure. Optional excursions include Milford Sound or a glowworm cave tour. Overnight stay in Te Anau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 17: Te Anau to Dunedin
package_itineraries.description: Journey through Central Otago to the historic city of Dunedin. Explore the Scottish charm and architecture. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 18: Dunedin Leisure
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day as you please. Optional visits to Larnach Castle or local wildlife experiences are available.

package_itineraries.title: Day 19: Dunedin to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Head north to Christchurch, known as the Garden City. Spend your afternoon relaxing or exploring the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 20: Farewell from Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, make your way to the airport for your departure, taking home wonderful memories of your New Zealand journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Nadi International Airport, where your Fijian holiday begins. After clearing immigration and customs, make your way out of the Customs Hall. Friendly staff will be waiting at designated booths to welcome you with a cheerful "Bula," fresh minted towels, shell leis, and bottled water. You'll then proceed to an office where you’ll receive travel details and exchange vouchers. Your luggage will be handled by porters as you meet your driver, who will take you in an air-conditioned vehicle to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day relaxing and soaking up the Fijian vibes. Overnight stay in Nadi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Leisure in Paradise
package_itineraries.description: This day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. Unwind at your resort, enjoy beachside leisure, or take part in optional activities. For an unforgettable evening, consider joining a scheduled Sunset Dinner Cruise, where you'll witness a magical tropical sunset. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Optional Mana Island Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Enhance your tropical escape with an optional full-day cruise to Mana Island, which includes hotel transfers and a BBQ lunch. This idyllic island offers multiple beach fronts, clear waters for snorkeling, and tranquil lounges for relaxing. Whether you’re up for water activities or just want to sunbathe on North Beach, this island has it all. After a fulfilling day, return to Nadi for another peaceful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Adventure or Relaxation
package_itineraries.description: Choose from a variety of experiences today—whether it's skydiving, river safaris, cave exploration, or a soothing spa treatment. As night falls, consider visiting popular nightspots like PURPLE HAZE or ICE BAR to wrap up your trip with some island nightlife. Overnight in Nadi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Check out early and proceed to the airport for your onward journey. Depart with memories of sun, sea, and Fijian warmth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing in Auckland, you’ll be warmly welcomed by our tour representatives at the airport. They’ll assist you with your transfer and hotel check-in. Once settled, enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Auckland's Iconic Sights
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a visit to Viaduct Harbour, then head to the Harbour Bridge for incredible views. Finish the day at the Michael Joseph Savage Memorial for panoramic scenes of the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Journey from Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo
package_itineraries.description: Travel through the Waikato region to the Waitomo Caves for a magical glowworm boat tour. Later, continue to Rotorua, a city famous for geothermal activity and Maori heritage.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua’s Wonders and Maori Culture
package_itineraries.description: Explore Te Puia’s geysers, experience farm life at Agrodome, and meet native wildlife. Conclude the evening with a traditional Maori Hangi feast and cultural performance.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Rotorua to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Board a domestic flight and head to Christchurch, the largest city in the South Island. Spend the day unwinding and soaking in its serene, garden-filled setting.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Mount Cook and Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Drive through scenic valleys and lakes to reach Mount Cook. Then, head onward to Queenstown—a lively town known for its vineyards, lakes, and adventure sports.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: From New Zealand to Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Depart New Zealand and arrive in Fiji. Discover the Garden of the Sleeping Giant, home to vibrant orchids and tropical flora. Rest in this new island paradise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Explore Local Culture in Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Visit Viseisei Village, one of Fiji’s oldest settlements, or relax by the ocean. Enjoy the local lifestyle and warm island hospitality.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure from Fiji
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your accommodation and head to the airport, concluding your enriching and romantic journey across New Zealand and Fiji.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Matamanoa Island
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Nadi Airport and transfer to Matamanoa Island Resort. This serene island lets you relax your way—whether lounging by the pool, enjoying watersports, or sipping cocktails at sunset. Overnight at the beautiful Matamanoa Island Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Leisure Time at Matamanoa Island
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day indulging in rest and recreation. Take a stroll along the beach, swim in crystal-clear waters, or simply unwind in your villa. Another night in paradise awaits you.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Explore at Your Own Pace
package_itineraries.description: Your third day at the resort is all about setting your own pace. Revisit your favourite island corners or try something new. Recharge with a good night’s sleep on the island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Travel to Mercure Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Check out from Matamanoa and transfer to Mercure Nadi on the mainland. The evening is yours to relax or explore local markets and eateries. Stay overnight in Nadi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Fiji
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your departure. End your tropical vacation with heartwarming memories of Matamanoa Island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Auckland – The City of Sails
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Auckland and be greeted by your local representative. Depending on your tour type, transfer privately or via self-drive to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day relaxing in New Zealand’s vibrant harbour city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Auckland Sightseeing and Aquarium Visit
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a hearty breakfast and enjoy a guided city tour. Visit Kelly Tarlton’s Sea Life Aquarium and Antarctic Encounter. The remainder of the day is free for shopping or dining. Overnight stay in Auckland.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo and Matamata
package_itineraries.description: Set off for Rotorua via the lush Waikato countryside. Stop at Waitomo for a tour of its famous glowworm caves. Then visit the iconic Hobbiton Movie Set before reaching Rotorua for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Thermal Attractions and Maori Culture in Rotorua
package_itineraries.description: Explore Te Puia’s steaming geysers and bubbling mud pools. Visit the Agrodome for a unique farm experience and Rainbow Springs for native wildlife. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Maori Hangi dinner and cultural performance. Stay overnight in Rotorua.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Fly from Rotorua to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, catch a flight to Christchurch. Once there, the day is free for you to explore local parks, gardens, or relax in the South Island’s gateway city. Overnight stay in Christchurch.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Christchurch to Queenstown via Mt Cook
package_itineraries.description: Travel through Canterbury Plains and Lake Tekapo to reach Mt Cook. Continue past the Central Otago landscape to the adventure hub of Queenstown. Enjoy a relaxing night in Queenstown.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Milford Sound Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Journey to Milford Sound via Lake Te Anau and the Eglinton Valley. Cruise past Mitre Peak and Bowen Falls, then return to Queenstown for a well-earned rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Free Day in Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day as you please—bungy jump, ride the gondola, or simply enjoy Queenstown’s lively atmosphere. Optional activities are available. Overnight stay in Queenstown.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Queenstown to the Glaciers
package_itineraries.description: Travel through scenic Lake Wanaka and Haast Pass to reach Franz Josef and Fox Glacier region. Enjoy the stunning natural surroundings and rest overnight at your glacier-side hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Tranz Alpine Train to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Travel north to Greymouth and board the scenic Tranz Alpine train. Admire breathtaking alpine views as you return to Christchurch. Overnight stay in the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Departure from Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport and prepare for your onward journey, taking with you unforgettable memories of your New Zealand adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nadi – Journey to Lomani Island Resort
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Nadi International Airport and receive a warm welcome before being transferred to Lomani Island Resort. "Lomani" means love in Fijian—aptly named for this adults-only retreat tucked in the Mamanuca Islands. Enjoy a relaxed check-in and take in the serene ambiance. Your stay begins at the peaceful and scenic Lomani Island Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Free Day at Lomani Island Resort
package_itineraries.description: Wake up to a day of total leisure. Spend time at your own pace—stroll through tropical gardens, relax on the beach, or swim in the lagoon. Soak in the relaxing island vibes for another restful night at Lomani.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Another Day of Island Bliss
package_itineraries.description: Let your worries drift away as you spend another free day surrounded by nature. Whether you’re lounging with a book or taking a paddleboard ride, enjoy the calm of Lomani Island Resort before resting overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Last Day at Lomani – Travel to Mercure Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your final moments in the island paradise before being transferred back to the mainland. Check in at Mercure Nadi for a restful evening before your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Mercure Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Complete your check-out in the morning and proceed to Nadi Airport for your journey back home, taking with you the tranquillity and charm of Fiji.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nadi – Journey to Likuliku
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Nadi International Airport, complete immigration and customs, and receive a traditional Fijian welcome with shell leis, minted towels, and bottled water.You’ll be taken to Port Denarau, where you’ll board a catamaran bound for Likuliku Lagoon Resort. Check in and enjoy a relaxing night with all meals included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: At Likuliku Lagoon Resort
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a range of inclusions:All meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner)Refreshing welcome drinks and leisTwice-daily bottled water in your bureAccess to non-motorised water sports: paddle skis, catamarans, snorkeling, windsurfingGym access and weekly cocktail partyWi-Fi hotspot availability

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Likuliku Lagoon Resort
package_itineraries.description: Continue your stay with the same inclusions and experiences. Lounge on the beach, join in water activities, or enjoy resort amenities. Another overnight stay in paradise awaits.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Transfer to Denarau Island
package_itineraries.description: Today, optional experiences include jet boat rides on the Nadi River, parasailing, river safaris, and more. As night falls, explore Denarau’s local nightlife at popular venues like PURPLE HAZE or ICE BAR. Overnight at Denarau Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Denarau Island
package_itineraries.description: Check out early for your transfer to Nadi International Airport to catch your departing flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hobart
package_itineraries.description: Once you land at Hobart Airport, your guide will meet you and take you to your hotel by private transfer. While early check-in isn’t assured, you may leave your luggage and explore the surroundings.Stroll through the city centre, try local eateries, and enjoy dinner featuring dishes like fondue or raclette. Overnight in Hobart.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Grand Port Arthur Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast before embarking on a full-day historical and scenic tour. Explore the fascinating Isle of the Dead and enjoy a harbour cruise showcasing the region’s coastal beauty. Continue through Tasman National Park before heading back for another night in Hobart.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bruny Island Wilderness Coast Tour with Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day full of wildlife and dramatic coastal scenery. This tour includes a cruise around Bruny Island where you’ll encounter seals, sea birds, and more. A delicious local lunch is also included.Note: Guests must check in by 07:45 AM at Franklin Wharf as there is no hotel transfer service. Return to your Hobart hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Wineglass Bay & Freycinet National Park
package_itineraries.description: Join an early morning full-day tour to Wineglass Bay and Freycinet National Park. Take in panoramic views and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the natural surroundings. After the tour, return to Hobart for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Hobart
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a half-day Hobart City Tour beginning at 9:00 AM from Brooke St. Pier. The tour wraps up at 12:45 PM. Explore the city on your own in the afternoon before your private transfer to Hobart Airport for your flight. Recommended flight timing is after 4:00 PM.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Hobart
package_itineraries.description: Upon arriving at Hobart Airport, you’ll be transferred privately to your 5-star hotel. Early check-in isn’t guaranteed, but you may drop your luggage and begin exploring the city. Visit top attractions like the Museum of Old and New Art, Battery Point, and Salamanca Place. Overnight in Hobart.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Grand Port Arthur Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full-day excursion to the historic Port Arthur site. Highlights include the Isle of the Dead tour, a scenic harbour cruise, the Convict Cemetery, Point Puer Boys Prison, and breathtaking views of Tasman National Park. Return to your Hobart hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bruny Island Wilderness Coast Tour with Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Bruny Island on a wilderness tour that includes encounters with seals, dolphins, sea birds, and white wallabies. Walk along pristine beaches and through lush rainforests. Enjoy a gourmet lunch prepared with Tasmanian produce. Return to your Hobart hotel for an overnight stay.Note: This tour requires guests to arrive at the departure point at 7:45 AM on their own.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hobart – Scenic Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a full-day tour to Mt. Field, Russell Falls, and Mt. Wellington. On Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Fridays, or Sundays, the itinerary includes a visit to see Tasmanian Devils. Spend another night in Hobart.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Wineglass Bay Tour – Travel to Launceston
package_itineraries.description: Check out and embark on a scenic full-day tour to Wineglass Bay and Freycinet National Park. The tour includes hikes and wildlife viewing. Moderate fitness is required. Available on Thursdays only. Later, transfer to Launceston via Hobart Transit Centre. Check in and enjoy your evening at leisure. Overnight in Launceston.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Launceston – Choose Your Experience
package_itineraries.description: Today you can choose between two full-day tours:Explore the rugged beauty of Cradle Mountain National Park.Discover the spectacular coastline on the Bays of Fire Tour.After the tour, return to your Launceston hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Launceston
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer privately to Launceston Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to the vibrant City of Sails! Once you arrive in Auckland, our team will greet you and assist with your transfer to the hotel. Settle in and enjoy your first overnight stay in this cosmopolitan city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Auckland Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, gear up for an exciting day exploring Auckland. Visit the fascinating Kelly Tarlton’s Underwater World and Antarctic Encounter. Return in the evening for a restful night at your hotel in Auckland.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Auckland – Waitomo – Rotorua
package_itineraries.description: Today, travel south through the lush countryside of the Waikato region to the magical Waitomo Caves. Take a guided boat ride beneath a canopy of glowworms. After this unique experience, continue your journey to Rotorua and unwind with an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua – Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a visit to Te Puia Thermal Reserve, home to boiling mud pools and powerful geysers. Continue to Rainbow Springs to see native wildlife, followed by a visit to the Agrodome for a live farm show featuring cow milking and sheepdog demonstrations. In the afternoon, fly from Rotorua to Queenstown for your next adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Milford Sound Day Trip
package_itineraries.description: Depart early for a full-day excursion to the spectacular Milford Sound. Travel via Lake Wakatipu and Lake Te Anau, pass through the scenic Eglinton Valley, and marvel at the Homer Tunnel. Once in Milford Sound, enjoy a scenic cruise where you'll witness stunning views of Mitre Peak and Bowen Falls. A buffet lunch is served onboard. Return to Queenstown for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Adventure Day in Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day indulging in your choice of adventure activities. Queenstown offers everything from bungy jumping and jet boating to white water rafting and gondola rides. Make the most of this adrenaline-filled day before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before checking out. Head to Queenstown Airport for your departure, bringing your unforgettable New Zealand journey to a close.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Melbourne
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Melbourne Tullamarine Airport, proceed to your hotel via transfer. After check-in, the rest of the day is yours to relax or explore at your own pace. Enjoy your overnight stay in Melbourne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Melbourne – Half-Day City Discovery
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a guided half-day city tour of Melbourne. Limited hotel pickups are available between 7:00 AM and 7:50 AM. After the tour, choose between two experiences: a one-hour guided tour of the Melbourne Cricket Ground (available 10:00 AM–3:00 PM on non-event days), or take a leisurely walk to Southgate Art & Leisure Precinct for a 1-hour Yarra River cruise (final departure between 3:00–3:30 PM). Return to the hotel independently and stay overnight in Melbourne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Melbourne – Great Ocean Road or Phillip Island
package_itineraries.description: Today, choose from two exciting full-day SIC tours:A full-day Great Ocean Road tour departing at 8:00 AM and returning after 8:00 PM.Or, opt for a full-day SIC tour to Phillip Island, departing at 1:00 PM, with opportunities to view penguins, kangaroos, and koalas, returning after 9:30 PM.Spend the night at your Melbourne hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Melbourne to Brisbane – Onward to Tangalooma
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head to Melbourne Airport for an early flight to Brisbane. Arrive by 7:30 AM (International) or 8:40 AM (Domestic) and continue to Holt Street Wharf. Check-in by 9:30 AM for the 10:00 AM launch to Tangalooma Island Resort on Moreton Island (subject to weather/tide). The remainder of the day is free to explore optional island activities. In the evening, witness the Wild Dolphin Feeding session (weather permitting). Overnight at Tangalooma Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Tangalooma to Gold Coast
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast and enjoy the Desert Safari & Sand Tobogganing tour. Later, catch the 4:00 PM launch back to Holt Street Wharf in Brisbane. From there, travel to Gold Coast by Hotel Conxions SIC transfer and check into your hotel. Overnight stay in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Gold Coast – Dream World Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full day of fun and adventure at Dream World, packed with thrilling rides and entertainment. Return to your hotel in the evening for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Gold Coast – Wildlife & Marine Parks
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a Half-Day Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary tour to explore native Australian animals. In the afternoon, visit SeaWorld for marine life exhibits, exciting rides, and shows. Return to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Gold Coast – Movie World Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Spend your day at Movie World, home to movie-themed rides, live shows, and attractions. Enjoy a day of cinematic excitement before returning to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Gold Coast to Cairns
package_itineraries.description: After checking out from your Gold Coast hotel, transfer to Brisbane or Gold Coast Airport for your flight to Cairns. Upon arrival, proceed to your Cairns hotel for check-in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure and relax overnight. (Breakfast included)

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Cairns – Green Island Reef Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Embark on the Big Cat Cruise to Green Island, which includes a buffet lunch and a choice between a semi-submarine ride or a glass-bottom boat tour. Snorkelling gear is also available for underwater exploration. Optional upgrades are available for cruises to SunLover or Reef Magic Outer Barrier Reefs. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay. (Breakfast and Lunch included)

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Cairns – Kuranda or Daintree Option
package_itineraries.description: Choose a full-day SIC tour to Kuranda, including one-way Sky Rail and one-way Scenic Railway (Diamond Gondola excluded). Explore Kuranda Village at your leisure. Alternatively, opt for a full-day SIC tour to Cape Tribulation and the Daintree Wilderness with lunch at an additional supplement. Spend the night at your hotel in Cairns.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Cairns to Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your Cairns hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight to Sydney. Upon arrival, proceed to your Sydney hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is at leisure. Overnight stay in Sydney.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Sydney – City Tour & Attractions
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a morning Sydney City Tour that includes highlights like the Opera House, Harbour Bridge, and Manly Beach. This complimentary, non-refundable tour concludes by 11:45 AM at Darling Harbour or Circular Quay, without hotel drop-off. Later, make your way to Sea Life Aquarium to use your Combo 2 Pass, which grants access to the Aquarium and the Sydney Tower Eye with its 4D Experience. Transfers are not included. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Sydney – Full Day Tour Options
package_itineraries.description: Choose from the following two full-day SIC tours (hotel pickups limited to select locations between 7:00 AM and 7:50 AM):A full-day Blue Mountains tour with a Wildlife Park visit and Scenic World rides. Pickup is mandatory and non-refundable.Or, a similar Blue Mountains tour that includes lunch, wildlife interaction, and Scenic World rides. Also non-refundable with mandatory pickup.After a full day of exploration, return to your hotel in Sydney.

package_itineraries.title: Day 15: Departure from Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to Sydney Airport for your flight. This service is valid for departures after 7:00 AM (Domestic) or 8:00 AM (International). Early transfers may incur a surcharge. Carry with you the cherished memories of your Australian adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, receive a warm welcome and transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy as you relax by the beach or pool. Overnight at the resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Navua River Experience
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, followed by a scenic boat trip along the Navua River. Visit traditional villages, see cascading waterfalls, and participate in the traditional ‘Kava’ ceremony. Return to the resort for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Temples, Gardens & Culture
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Sri Siva Subramaniya Temple, the Garden of the Sleeping Giant, and the luxurious Denarau Island. End your day with a serene Nadi sunset cruise. Overnight at the resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Free Day in Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Spend this day as you wish—relax, take part in water sports, or explore nearby shops and cafés.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Farewell Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before your transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nadi – Transfer to Savusavu and Namale Resort
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Nadi International Airport, clear immigration and proceed to the information desk. You’ll be welcomed with shell leis, a mint towel, and bottled water. Head to the domestic departures terminal and catch a Fiji Link flight to Savusavu. Upon landing, meet the Namale Resort team for a transfer to your luxury accommodation.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Namale Resort – Inclusive Island Experience
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a luxurious four-night stay with all meals, beverages, roundtrip airport transfers, daily laundry, turndown service, and endless recreational options. From freshwater pools to snorkeling, kayaking, horseback riding, and sports courts—there’s something for every traveler. Indoor entertainment includes billiards, air hockey, and a movie theatre.Honeymoon Specials:Couples receive a personalized welcome, a bottle of champagne, private breakfast in bed, a romantic lunch by waterfalls (weather permitting), private star-lit dinners, and 10% off spa treatments.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Adventure Activities at Namale Resort
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day engaging in your favorite water activities or land-based adventures. Whether it’s reef walks, hiking trails, or team sports, there’s no shortage of fun. Settle in for a peaceful night at the resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Leisure at Namale Resort
package_itineraries.description: Take the day to relax completely. Lounge under the sun, take scenic walks, or simply unwind with the views. Overnight at Namale Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Namale Resort to Sheraton Fiji Resort & Spa
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Savusavu Airport. Fly to Nadi and enjoy a smooth ride to Sheraton Fiji Resort & Spa. Spend the rest of the day relaxing at your new resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Denarau Island
package_itineraries.description: Check out early and head to Nadi International Airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Nadi Arrival and Transfer to Denarau Island
package_itineraries.description: Land at Nadi International Airport and complete immigration and customs formalities. A cheerful “Bula” greeting awaits you from our friendly local representative, along with shell leis, refreshing minted towels, and bottled water. Proceed to a short briefing and voucher collection before meeting your driver for a scenic seat-in-coach transfer to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day unwinding at your leisure. Overnight stay at Denarau Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Denarau Island – Relaxation and Sunset Views
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day enjoying various hotel amenities or opt for an additional excursion. In the evening, set sail on a tranquil Sunset Dinner Cruise and marvel at the tropical horizon. Return for an overnight stay at Denarau Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Denarau Island – Mana Island Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a full-day cruise to Mana Island, inclusive of transfers and lunch. Discover three distinct beaches, swim in warm turquoise waters, and enjoy poolside refreshments. Snorkeling and water activities are available on the lagoon side, while North Beach offers a peaceful retreat. BBQ lunch with side salads is provided. Return and stay overnight at Denarau Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Denarau Island – Adventure and Entertainment
package_itineraries.description: Today, optional experiences include jet boat rides on the Nadi River, parasailing, river safaris, and more. As night falls, explore Denarau’s local nightlife at popular venues like PURPLE HAZE or ICE BAR. Overnight at Denarau Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Denarau Island
package_itineraries.description: Check out early for your transfer to Nadi International Airport to catch your departing flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Nadi International Airport and complete the formalities at Immigration and Customs. Exit the hall to a warm Fijian welcome with shell leis, fresh towels, and bottled water from our local representative.Visit the nearby office for a short briefing and to collect your travel vouchers. Then meet your driver and proceed via a seat-in-coach transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure and rest overnight at Yatule Resort & Spa.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Leisure at Yatule Resort & Spa
package_itineraries.description: Today is yours to explore or unwind as you please. Enjoy the serene beach or explore local culture at your own pace. Overnight stay at Yatule Resort & Spa.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Free Day in Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Another day to explore the island freely. Whether it’s lounging at the beach, engaging in water activities, or exploring nearby attractions, enjoy your stay. Overnight at Yatule Resort & Spa.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Relax and Unwind in Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Spend a relaxing day at the resort. Enjoy the tranquil surroundings or opt for optional excursions. (Breakfast included.) Overnight at Yatule Resort & Spa.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: From Fiji to Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Check out in the morning and proceed to Nadi Airport for your flight to Singapore. Upon arrival at Changi International Airport, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. After checking in, the rest of the day is free.Optional: In the evening, consider visiting the renowned Night Safari – the world’s first nocturnal zoo. Return to your hotel for the night. (Breakfast included.)

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Discover Singapore at Your Pace
package_itineraries.description: Today is reserved for self-exploration. For an unforgettable experience, consider visiting Gardens by the Bay. This lush, award-winning park features breathtaking waterfront views and an expansive collection of plants across 101 hectares. Spend another night at your hotel in Singapore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Your journey concludes as you check out and transfer to Changi International Airport for your flight home or your next destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Perth
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Perth Airport, a private transfer will be arranged for you—available if your flight arrives before 10:00 PM. Note: Surcharges may apply for arrivals after 10:00 PM. You'll be taken to your city hotel, where check-in is available (subject to standard check-in times). Relax and enjoy your first overnight stay in Perth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Perth and Fremantle
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a morning half-day SIC tour of Perth and Fremantle (Tour #PF – Daily). The tour ends at Barrack Street Jetty and does not include a return transfer to the hotel. Afterwards, enjoy a self-guided walk to the Perth Mint on Hay Street and join the 3:30 PM guided tour (no transfers provided). Walk back to your hotel and settle in for another night in Perth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rottnest Island Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a full-day Rottnest Island Discovery Tour, featuring a 90-minute high-speed Adventure Eco Express Boat experience and a satisfying lunch at Thomson Rest. (Tour #EC7 – Daily). Please note this activity is not suitable for children under 4. Optional: Rent a bike and helmet for self-guided island exploration (AUD 50 for adults / AUD 15 for children), also not suitable for children under 4. Enjoy another overnight stay in Perth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Pinnacles Desert and Wildlife Experience
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, join a full-day SIC tour featuring the Pinnacles Desert, Caversham Wildlife Park with koala encounters, and an exciting sandboarding and 4WD adventure. The tour includes a Fish & Chips lunch. Return in the evening to your Perth hotel for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Choose Your Full-Day Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Pick from three enriching SIC tour options:Margaret River Tour (Tour #MR): Visit enchanting caves, enjoy wine tasting, stroll the Busselton Jetty, and see Cape Leeuwin Lighthouse. Includes lunch.Wave Rock Tour (Tour #WR): Explore York, Aboriginal sites, and wildflower country with a picnic lunch. Operates TUE/WED/FRI/SUN.Valley of the Giants (Tour #TT): Marvel at giant trees during the Treetop Walk and enjoy a gourmet picnic. Operates only on TUE.Spend your last night at the hotel in Perth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Perth
package_itineraries.description: Following your final breakfast, check out and transfer to Perth Airport by private vehicle for your flight. Note: A surcharge applies for departures before 6:00 AM.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Adelaide
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Adelaide Airport and proceed with a shuttle transfer to your hotel. Kindly note that early check-in is subject to availability. Once you’ve settled, you can enjoy a 90-minute guided Stadium Tour of Adelaide Oval, which also includes the Bradman Collections. This tour begins at 2:00 PM on non-event days and does not provide transfers. After the tour, return to your hotel for check-in and spend the night in Adelaide.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Adelaide – Select a Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast to start your day. You can choose one Full Day SIC Tour, with limited hotel pickup included. The options are the Full Day Grand Barossa Valley Wine Tasting & Hahndorf Tour with Lunch or the Full Day SIC Victor Harbour, Port of Goolwa, and McLaren Vale Wine Region Tour with Lunch. Overnight stay at your hotel in Adelaide. (Lunch included.)

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Adelaide – Kangaroo Island Highlights Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out early for a Full Day Cruise Kangaroo Island Highlights Tour, which includes a two-course lunch. Upon returning to Adelaide, relax and enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure Day
package_itineraries.description: Savor your morning breakfast. Today is your departure from Adelaide. You may also opt to join a Half Day SIC Morning Adelaide City Tour with limited hotel pickup (please note: no hotel drop-off is available). The tour concludes by 12:00 PM at the Central Bus Station, and you will need to arrange your return to the hotel. Later, proceed via shuttle transfer to Adelaide Airport for your onward journey. Please ensure your flight departure is scheduled after 3:00 PM.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Nadi International Airport, you’ll receive a warm welcome from our local representatives, who will guide you to your hotel. After check-in, the day is yours to enjoy however you wish. Whether it's diving into adventure, walking along soft white sands, or simply unwinding in the island's peaceful charm, you’ll have plenty to explore. End the evening with a relaxing overnight stay at the resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Island Retreat
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with a satisfying breakfast before heading out for underwater exploration through snorkelling in the colourful coral reefs. Dive deeper into the ocean’s secrets or immerse yourself in the cultural essence of Fiji by visiting a traditional village. For complete relaxation, indulge in a rejuvenating spa treatment. You can also participate in non-motorized water and land-based activities such as kayaking, sailing, windsurfing, hiking, tennis, and table tennis. Return to the hotel for a restful overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Island Resort
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a refreshing breakfast before spending the day entirely at your leisure. A wide variety of experiences await, including herbal medicine walks, scenic glass-bottom boat rides, interactive basket-weaving workshops, or a fun round of beach volleyball. You may also choose to book a private boat for island hopping or plan a tranquil picnic on a hidden island. As the sun sets, head back to your resort for another peaceful overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Savusavu (Namale Island Resort)
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a scenic catamaran journey to Port Denarau. Upon arrival, a designated driver will escort you to the airport for a short domestic flight to Savusavu. Once there, transfer to the luxurious Namale Island Resort, a 5-star boutique hideaway nestled between lush tropical rainforests and the azure ocean. Your stay here includes a range of exciting adventures such as rainforest hikes, hill treks, tennis, horseback rides, mountain biking, kayaking, water skiing, and more. Don’t miss the opportunity to join a dolphin-watching cruise in Natewa Bay, where skilled trainers interact with these graceful creatures. Lunch and dinner are included, and your overnight stay promises total comfort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Savusavu (Namale Island Resort)
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a wholesome breakfast amid the soothing environment of Namale Island Resort. You have the entire day to unwind or enjoy the amenities and surroundings at your own pace. As the evening sets in, return to your resort for a calm overnight retreat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Savusavu – Nadi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, it’s time to check out and proceed to the airport for your return domestic flight to Nadi. On arrival, our representatives will assist with a smooth transfer to your hotel. Spend the rest of your day exploring more of Fiji’s thrills or relaxing by the beach. Wind down with an overnight stay at your resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Begin your final day in Fiji with a quick breakfast, followed by your transfer to Nadi Airport. As you await your flight, reflect on the unforgettable moments from your Fiji Island tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Melbourne
package_itineraries.description: Upon arriving at Melbourne Tullamarine Airport, transfer to your hotel and check in. The rest of the day is at your leisure. Spend the night relaxing at your Melbourne hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discovering Melbourne
package_itineraries.description: Begin your morning with a Half-Day SIC Melbourne City Tour. Pickup is available from select hotels between 7:00 am and 7:50 am (Complimentary & NON-Refundable), with the tour ending at Federation Square around 11:45 am. You can then take a short walk to MCG Gate #3 (between light towers 1 & 2) for a 1-hour guided tour of the Melbourne Cricket Ground (on non-event days from 10 am to 3 pm). Alternatively, explore Southgate Art & Leisure Precinct and enjoy a 1-hour Yarra River Cruise, with the last departure between 3:00 pm and 3:30 pm. Return to your hotel in Melbourne for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Melbourne – Your Choice of Full-Day Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Choose one full-day SIC tour from the options below:Great Ocean Road Adventure (Morning): Departs at 8 am and returns around 8 pm. A breathtaking journey showcasing coastal scenery.Phillip Island Wildlife Experience (Afternoon): Starts at 1 pm and returns by 9:30 pm. See penguins, kangaroos, and koalas on Phillip Island.Sovereign Hill Gold Rush Experience (Morning): Available on Mon, Tue, Thu, Sat. Departs at 8 am and ends at 5:30 pm. Step into the 1850s Gold Rush at Sovereign Hill.Puffing Billy & Yarra Valley Wineries (Morning): Operates on Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun. Departs at 8 am. Enjoy a steam train ride and visit premium wineries.Puffing Billy & Healesville Wildlife (Morning): Runs on Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun. Departs at 8 am. Combine a train ride with a visit to Healesville Sanctuary.Return to your Melbourne hotel for an overnight stay after your chosen excursion.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Melbourne to Brisbane/Gold Coast
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your Melbourne hotel and head to Tullamarine Airport for your flight to Brisbane or Gold Coast. Upon arrival, transfer to your Gold Coast hotel and spend the night at your leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Full Day at Movie World
package_itineraries.description: Spend an exciting day at Movie World, enjoying thrilling rides and attractions inspired by blockbuster films. After a fun-filled day, return to your Gold Coast hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Explore Sea World
package_itineraries.description: Devote your day to Sea World – an oceanarium, marine sanctuary, and amusement park. Experience marine life exhibits and thrilling rides. (Combo Ticket - No Refund if 1 Park Used or Lost). Optionally, you can replace either Movie World or Sea World with Dreamworld for an additional AUD 20 per adult and AUD 10 per child (Return SIC). Stay overnight at your Gold Coast hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Gold Coast/Brisbane to Cairns
package_itineraries.description: Check out and head to the airport for your flight to Cairns. Upon arrival, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. Spend the rest of your day exploring at your pace. Overnight stay in Cairns.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Full-Day Big Cat Cruise to Green Island
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full-day cruise to Green Island Reef aboard the Big Cat. Includes buffet lunch and your choice of either a semi-submarine and glass-bottom boat tour or snorkelling gear (Package 4). You can upgrade to the Sunlover Outer Barrier Reef Cruise for AUD 70 (adult) / AUD 50 (child) or to Reef Magic Outer Barrier Reef Cruise for AUD 75 (adult) / AUD 40 (child). Stay overnight at your Cairns hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Choose Your Cairns Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today, choose a full-day SIC Kuranda Tour, including a one-way Skyrail ride (excluding Diamond Gondola), leisure time at Kuranda Village, and a return Scenic Rail journey (Gold Class not included). Optional upgrades include Diamond Gondola (AUD 18/adult, AUD 9/child) and Gold Class Rail (AUD 44/person). Note Skyrail closures: Oct 15, Oct 26, Dec 25. Scenic Rail closed: Oct 15–16, Nov 8–9, Dec 6–7, Dec 25.Optionally, add Tjapukai Cultural Park or Rainforestation with Pamagirri Dance & Army Duck Tour (AUD 50/adult, AUD 35/child). Or, choose the Full-Day SIC Cape Tribulation & Daintree Wilderness Tour with lunch (AUD 35/adult, AUD 20/child). This tour does not run on Dec 25, Jan 1, or February. Return to your Cairns hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Cairns to Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and head to Cairns Airport for your flight to Sydney. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Half-Day Sydney City Tour & More
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, join a complimentary SIC Half-Day City Tour featuring Sydney Opera House, Harbour Bridge, and Manly Beach. Ends at 11:45 near Darling Harbour/Circular Quay (no hotel drop-off).Later, use your Combo 2 Pass to visit Sea Life Aquarium and Sydney Tower Eye with a 4D experience (transfers not included).In the evening, head to King Street Wharf #5 between 6:50 pm – 7:00 pm for the Sydney ShowBoat Indian Dinner Cruise (standard seating). The cruise doesn’t operate on Tuesdays, Sundays,Note: Jain meals are not available. Stay overnight at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Select a Full-Day Sydney Tour
package_itineraries.description: Choose one of the following SIC Full-Day Blue Mountains Tours (limited hotel pickup from 7:00 to 7:50 am depending on location):Option 1: Blue Mountains with Wildlife Park & Scenic World Rides. Operates 8 am to 6 pm.Option 2: Blue Mountains with Wildlife Park, Scenic World Rides & Lunch. From 8 am to 6 pm.Option 3: Blue Mountains with Wildlife Park, 2-Course Lunch & River Cruise. Ends at Darling Harbour or Circular Quay.Hotel pickup is mandatory and non-refundable for all. Return to your Sydney hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Departure from Sydney
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to Sydney Airport for your onward flight. Transfer service is available for domestic flights departing after 7 am and international flights after 8 am. If departing earlier, private transfer charges will apply.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Adelaide
package_itineraries.description: Your adventure begins with your arrival at Adelaide Airport, ideally before 6:30 AM. A shuttle will be ready to transfer you to your selected hotel. While early check-in is subject to availability, every effort will be made to assist. In the afternoon, head out on foot to the renowned Adelaide Oval for a 90-minute guided tour showcasing the famous Bradman Collection. Tours operate at 14:00 hours on non-event days and do not include hotel transfers. Following the tour, return to your accommodation and enjoy a restful evening in Adelaide.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Adelaide – Select One Full-Day Activity
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning with a complimentary breakfast. For today's itinerary, choose one of the following full-day experiences, both offering limited hotel pickup service:Join a full-day SIC excursion through the Grand Barossa Valley Wine Tasting & Hahndorf Tour, complete with a delicious lunch.ORPrefer to take it slow? Enjoy an additional relaxing day at your hotel in Adelaide in preparation for your upcoming exploration.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: From Adelaide to Kangaroo Island – Seal Bay Discovery Adventure
