package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your Adelaide hotel and leave any large luggage at the Bell Desk. Pack only a small overnight bag for the island trip. Early in the morning, embark on the Sealink Shared Coach Cruise and begin your 2-Day Best of Kangaroo Island Overnight Tour. Enjoy a full-day Seal Bay Discovery Tour including visits to Emu Ridge Eucalyptus Distillery, Kangaroo Island Wildlife Park, an impressive Birds of Prey presentation, Seal Bay Conservation Park, and a satisfying 2-Course Lunch at Vivonne Bay. End the day with an overnight stay at a hotel on Kangaroo Island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Return Journey – Kangaroo Island to Adelaide
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast and check-out, continue your discovery with the Full-Day Remarkably Wild Tour. The day’s highlights include stops at Clifford's Honey Farm, Flinders Chase National Park, the awe-inspiring Remarkable Rocks, and Admiral's Arch. Lunch will be served as a 2-Course meal at Hanson Bay. In the late afternoon, travel back to Adelaide and check into your hotel for another comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Farewell Adelaide
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and take advantage of a complimentary Half-Day SIC Morning Adelaide City Tour, which concludes at the Central Bus Station. You can return to your hotel on your own or proceed directly to the airport. Later, a shared shuttle will take you to Adelaide Airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Auckland, fondly known as ‘The City of Sails,’ you’ll be warmly welcomed by our local representative if you’re traveling by coach. They’ll assist with your transfer to the hotel. If you’re self-driving, collect your rental car from the airport and head to your accommodation. Enjoy a restful overnight stay in Auckland.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo
package_itineraries.description: Begin your journey south through the rich farmland of the Waikato region to reach Waitomo. Here, you’ll take part in a guided tour of the mesmerizing Waitomo Glowworm Caves, floating silently beneath thousands of glow worms lighting up the ceilings. Your journey then continues over the Mamaku Ranges to the culturally rich city of Rotorua.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Discovering Rotorua
package_itineraries.description: Today, visit Te Puia to explore its geothermal wonders, attend the entertaining Agrodome Farm Show, and wander through Rainbow Springs to see trout and native wildlife. The rest of the day is yours to unwind or explore more of Rotorua at your own pace.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua to Napier
package_itineraries.description: Spend a relaxed morning before embarking on a scenic drive to Napier. The route takes you through the stunning geothermal landscapes of Wairakei and past Lake Taupo, the largest lake in New Zealand. Pass through tranquil farmland and rolling hills before reaching the beautifully preserved Art Deco town of Napier. Enjoy an overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Leisure Day in Napier
package_itineraries.description: Today is yours to explore Napier's charming streets and coastal ambiance. In the afternoon, set out on a wine-tasting tour, visiting three esteemed local wineries. Experience the region's acclaimed vintages before returning for an overnight stay in Napier.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Napier to Wellington
package_itineraries.description: Travel south via the dramatic Manawatu Gorge and the serene Takapau Plains. Pass through Palmerston North, a hub for agricultural education, and continue toward Wellington. Upon arrival in New Zealand’s capital, settle into your hotel and enjoy the evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Wellington to Christchurch (Self-Arrangement Required)
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a guided morning city tour of Wellington (available to seat-in-coach travelers). Later, you’ll catch a domestic flight to Christchurch (please note that airfare is not included). Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and relax for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Christchurch to Dunedin
package_itineraries.description: Head south across the expansive Canterbury Plains to reach Dunedin, a city shaped by Scottish heritage. Known for its natural beauty and diverse wildlife, Dunedin is also home to the historic Otago University. Stay overnight at your Dunedin hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Dunedin to Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning and optional activities. In the afternoon, depart for Queenstown, passing through historic towns such as Lawrence and Clyde. Continue to Cromwell, then journey through the striking Kawarau Gorge before arriving in Queenstown, your base for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Explore Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Today is at your leisure to enjoy Queenstown’s many adventure and relaxation options. Choose from activities like bungee jumping, white-water rafting, gondola rides, or scenic lake cruises (at your own cost). Spend a relaxing evening at your Queenstown hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Queenstown to the Glacier Region
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a stunning drive along Lake Wanaka and through the scenic Haast Pass into the UNESCO-listed Westland National Park. As you head up the West Coast, admire breathtaking alpine views, thick forests, and shimmering lakes before arriving in the Glacier Region—home to Franz Josef and Fox Glaciers. Overnight in the Glacier Region.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Glacier Region to Christchurch via Greymouth
package_itineraries.description: This morning, travel north to Greymouth. For coach travelers, board the legendary Tranz Alpine train—one of the world’s most scenic rail journeys. Traverse lush beech forests, pass the alpine village of Arthur’s Pass, and cross the wide Canterbury Plains to reach Christchurch. Rest overnight in your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Departure from Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Make your way to Christchurch Airport for your return flight or onward journey. Depart with beautiful memories and unforgettable experiences from your New Zealand luxury tour.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Auckland, known as the 'City of Sails,' you'll be warmly welcomed by a local representative if you've chosen the seat-in-coach option. You’ll be transferred privately to your hotel. Self-drive travelers can collect their rental car from the airport and head to their hotel at their own pace. Settle in and enjoy your overnight stay in Auckland.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discovering Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a guided sightseeing tour of Auckland (exclusive to coach travelers), followed by a visit to the fascinating Kelly Tarlton’s Sea Life Aquarium and Antarctic Encounter—an experience available to both coach and self-drive guests. Spend the rest of your day exploring the city as you please. Enjoy a restful night at your hotel in Auckland.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Auckland – Waitomo – Rotorua
package_itineraries.description: Today’s journey takes you from Auckland to Rotorua with a scenic drive through the green pastures of the Waikato region. Stop at Waitomo for a guided tour of the magical Glowworm Caves, then continue across the Mamaku Ranges to arrive in Rotorua, the renowned ‘Thermal City.’ Check in and unwind with an overnight stay in Rotorua.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out to visit Te Puia Thermal Reserve and witness erupting geysers and bubbling mud pools. Then, enjoy a lively farm experience at the Agrodome and explore Rainbow Springs to spot trout and native birds. In the evening, attend a traditional Maori Hangi dinner and cultural performance. Return to your Rotorua hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Rotorua to Wellington via Taupo
package_itineraries.description: Depart for Wellington, passing through Taupo, a lakeside town offering stunning scenery. Follow the edge of Lake Taupo to Turangi, then travel along the Desert Road beneath the impressive volcanic peaks of Tongariro National Park. Arrive in the vibrant capital city of Wellington and settle in for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Wellington City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a panoramic city tour of Wellington, followed by a guided visit to Te Papa, the Museum of New Zealand. Spend your afternoon exploring the city at your own pace. For an extra special experience, consider joining the Zealandia by Night Tour (optional, additional charge), where you may spot the rare kiwi bird in its natural habitat. Overnight stay in Wellington.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Ferry to Kaikoura via Picton
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a scenic ferry crossing over the Cook Strait to the South Island, passing through the tranquil Marlborough Sounds. Continue south, passing vineyards and rolling hills until you reach the charming seaside town of Kaikoura. Check into your hotel and enjoy a peaceful evening in this coastal retreat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Kaikoura to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Travel through the scenic North Canterbury countryside as you make your way to Christchurch, often referred to as the 'Garden City.' Spend the rest of the day exploring or relaxing. Overnight stay in Christchurch.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Christchurch – Lake Tekapo – Mount Cook – Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Set off through the fertile Canterbury Plains to Lake Tekapo. Pause to admire the iconic Church of the Good Shepherd before continuing to Mount Cook, New Zealand’s tallest mountain. Journey onward along Lake Pukaki, through Central Otago’s historic landscapes, and arrive in Queenstown, the adventure capital. Stay overnight in Queenstown.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Queenstown – Milford Sound – Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a scenic drive alongside Lake Wakatipu, through Lumsden and Te Anau, before entering the majestic Fiordland National Park. Travel through the lush Eglinton Valley and the dramatic Homer Tunnel to reach Milford Sound. Here, embark on a cruise through the stunning fjord, where you’ll marvel at Mitre Peak and Bowen Falls. Return to Queenstown for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Free Day in Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a day at leisure in Queenstown. The town offers thrilling optional activities like bungee jumping, jet boating, gondola rides, and more (activities at an additional cost). Make the most of your time in this vibrant alpine resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Queenstown to Glacier Country
package_itineraries.description: Leave Queenstown behind and travel past Lake Wanaka and through Haast Pass, the gateway to the Westland National Park. Continue along the rugged West Coast, taking in views of dense forests, mountain ranges, and tranquil lakes, before arriving in the glacier region. Rest overnight at your glacier accommodation.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Glacier Region Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day discovering the breathtaking glaciers at your own pace. Opt for a helicopter ride, scenic flight, or a guided glacier walk (optional experiences not included in the tour cost). Enjoy the serene atmosphere and settle in for another night in the glacier region.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Glacier Region – Greymouth – Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Today, head to Greymouth and board the famous TranzAlpine train (for coach travelers), known for its spectacular alpine views. Traverse the Southern Alps via Arthur’s Pass, then descend through the plains to Christchurch. Check in for your final overnight stay in the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 15: Departure from Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, it’s time to transfer to the airport for your flight home or onward journey. Take with you unforgettable memories of your New Zealand adventure. Wishing you a safe and pleasant trip!

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Tokoriki Island
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at the tropical haven of Tokoriki Island and transfer to your luxurious resort. Soak in the peaceful surroundings and spend your first night in paradise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Leisure on Tokoriki Island
package_itineraries.description: Today is dedicated to relaxation. Lounge on the beach, enjoy the amenities of your resort, or simply immerse yourself in the island’s serene beauty. Overnight stay at Tokoriki Island Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Transfer to Sheraton Fiji
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart Tokoriki Island and head to the renowned Sheraton Fiji. Check in and unwind with a relaxing overnight stay at this elegant beachfront resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Relax at Sheraton Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your time at leisure at Sheraton Fiji. Take advantage of the resort’s luxurious facilities or explore the area at your own pace. Spend the night in comfort at Sheraton Fiji.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Sheraton Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Today, check out from the Sheraton Fiji Resort. You will be transferred to the airport, ensuring a smooth and comfortable departure to your next destination or homeward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Upon arriving in Auckland—fondly known as 'The City of Sails'—you’ll begin your adventure with ease.Group travelers (seat-in-coach) will be greeted at the airport by a representative and transferred to their hotel. Independent travelers will collect their rental vehicle and drive themselves to their accommodation.Check-in and relax as you begin your exciting journey in this stunning harbour city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Auckland to Bay of Islands
package_itineraries.description: This morning, journey north over the famous Harbour Bridge and along the picturesque Hibiscus Coast. On the way, marvel at the towering Kauri Trees before passing through Whangarei en route to the beautiful Bay of Islands.In the afternoon, enjoy a guided exploration of the Waitangi Treaty Grounds, where you’ll delve into New Zealand’s founding history.Later, embark on the 'Hole in the Rock and Cape Brett' cruise—an iconic experience. For a romantic detour, opt to disembark in Russell, a charming historic town. Explore at your own pace and return to Paihia via local ferry (ticket included). Overnight stay in the Bay of Islands.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leisure in Bay of Islands
package_itineraries.description: Today is yours to spend as you wish. Consider an optional full-day tour to Cape Reinga and 90 Mile Beach or explore the quaint local towns of Russell and Kerikeri.Optional excursions are not included in the package. Spend another relaxing night in the Bay of Islands.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Return to Auckland (Approx. 228 km)
package_itineraries.description: Use the morning for optional sightseeing or simply relax in the serene surroundings. In the afternoon, make your way back to Auckland at your own pace.Check into your hotel upon arrival and enjoy your final night in the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Farewell Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Your tour concludes today. Head to the airport for your onward flight. As you depart, take with you cherished memories from your New Zealand adventure with our Auckland tour packages.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Alice Springs
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Alice Springs Airport by 11:45 AM to join the Scheduled International Carrier (SIC) transfer service to your city hotel. After check-in, enjoy a Half-Day SIC 'A Town Like Alice' Tour starting at 1:30 PM (AATK A3).This afternoon adventure includes key landmarks of Alice Springs, starting with The School of the Air—offering a fascinating look at the educational system supporting remote communities via radio. If lucky, you might witness a live lesson in action.Next, you’ll explore the historic Telegraph Station, marking the location of the first European settlement in the area. Then, learn about the essential medical work of the Royal Flying Doctor Service, delivering care across remote Australia.Get up close with desert creatures at the Alice Springs Reptile Centre, home to the impressive Perentie and the elusive Thorny Devil. End the day with panoramic views from Anzac Hill, overlooking the town and the MacDonnell Ranges. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Alice Springs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: West MacDonnell Ranges Discovery
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a Full Day SIC Tour of the West MacDonnell Ranges (AATK A8). Moderate walking over uneven ground is expected during this experience.Your first stop is the scenic Standley Chasm (Angkerle), where you’ll enjoy a leisurely walk by a spring-fed creek filled with native wildlife and birds. Pause here for morning tea.Continue to Ellery Creek Big Hole, a striking natural waterway, followed by the colorful Ochre Pits, a site rich in Aboriginal history.Next is Ormiston Gorge, known for its dramatic cliffs and a permanent waterhole attracting wildlife. Enjoy a Ploughman's Lunch at Glen Helen Gorge, surrounded by natural beauty.Conclude your day at Simpson Gap, a picturesque spot where you may spot black-footed rock wallabies hiding in the rocks. Return to your hotel in Alice Springs for another restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Alice Springs to Ayers Rock
package_itineraries.description: Check out early this morning for a Half Day SIC Transfer to Ayers Rock Resort, including a scenic drive through the MacDonnell and James Ranges. Your Driver Guide will share stories and facts along the way.You’ll visit a camel farm, where you can opt for a brief camel ride (own expense), followed by a stop at Mount Ebenezer for lunch. Admire the striking Atila (Mount Conner) before arriving at Ayers Rock Resort for check-in.In the afternoon, experience the magic of the Uluru Sunset Tour (AATK Y11), followed by a SIC Transfer to the Field of Light Self-Guided Tour. Keep your National Park Ticket ready for access. Children over one year are charged a child rate. Overnight at the Ayers Rock Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Ayers Rock
package_itineraries.description: Begin your final day with an early check-out and join the SIC Uluru Sunrise Tour. Note that breakfast is not included today due to the early departure. In the afternoon, a SIC Transfer will take you to Ayers Rock Airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nadi – Transfer to Coral Coast
package_itineraries.description: Your journey begins as you land at Nadi International Airport. After clearing immigration and customs, proceed to the exit at the Customs Hall. Our team can be found at booth number 6 or 21—just look for our helpful representatives dressed in uniform. If you need directions, the Information Desk is readily available.You'll be greeted with a cheerful “Bula,” along with a traditional shell lei, cool mint-scented towels, and bottled water. Our staff will guide you to our desk where you can exchange your vouchers and collect essential travel details. Once completed, our Portage team will manage your luggage, and you'll be introduced to your driver.Travel in comfort aboard our air-conditioned vehicle as you journey along the scenic route to your Coral Coast resort. After check-in, spend the rest of the day relaxing and soaking in the tropical surroundings. Settle into your accommodation and enjoy the peaceful vibes of the Coral Coast—a perfect beginning to your Fijian getaway. Overnight at your resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discovering the Coral Coast
package_itineraries.description: Today offers a flexible schedule for you to enjoy the Coral Coast in your own way. Spend a leisurely day lounging at the resort or basking in the sun on the powdery white beaches.For those craving a unique adventure, consider joining the Sigatoka River Safari Tour, an exciting half-day experience on a custom-built safari jet boat. Cruise approximately 10 miles up the Sigatoka River, stopping at remote villages along the way to connect with the local Kaiviti (Fijian) people.During your journey, you’ll hear captivating tales of the region’s history and culture, making this tour both educational and thrilling. Don’t forget your camera—the landscapes are picture-perfect. A highlight includes participating in a traditional Sevusevu ceremony, including a taste of Kava, Fiji’s ceremonial drink, and savoring local Fijian delicacies.Return to your Coral Coast resort in the evening to relax and recharge after a memorable cultural excursion.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Optional Adventures Around the Coral Coast
package_itineraries.description: This day is open for you to explore as you wish or enhance your stay with an optional guided tour—available at an added cost. One of the top choices is a day trip to Suva, Fiji’s dynamic capital city.This guided excursion introduces you to major landmarks such as the Fiji Museum, historic Catholic Cathedral (built in 1902), Government Buildings, and the iconic Grand Pacific Hotel. Other stops may include colonial cemeteries, city libraries, and public parks. Please note that lunch is not included, but you’ll find a variety of eateries within the MHCC Complex, which also houses a popular food court with local and international cuisine.You’ll also have the opportunity to tour the acclaimed Pure Fiji Factory, open daily except Saturdays, where you can explore Fiji’s premium skincare production process.At the end of the day, you’ll return to your Coral Coast resort for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Relaxation and Cultural Immersion
package_itineraries.description: Treat yourself to a laid-back day of rest, starting with a rejuvenating treatment at your resort’s spa. Choose from a variety of pampering therapies designed to refresh both body and mind.If you’re interested in further exploration, consider visiting the Sigatoka Sand Dunes National Park, a protected heritage site where you can uncover ancient artifacts and enjoy scenic hiking trails. Continue to Kula Eco Park, Fiji’s celebrated wildlife reserve that focuses on conservation and native species education.Later, immerse yourself in Indo-Fijian culture with an invitation to a private home for Indian-style High Tea. Hosted by descendants of Indian settlers, this rare cultural encounter provides insights into their lifestyle, traditions, and agricultural practices.Return to your Coral Coast hotel or resort for a restful evening amid serene coastal beauty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Coral Coast
package_itineraries.description: Your Fijian journey comes to a close today. Please check out early and prepare for your transfer back to Nadi International Airport for your departing flight. Cherish the unforgettable memories made during your Coral Coast Tour Package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Upon arriving in Auckland, lovingly known as "The City of Sails," seat-in-coach guests will be warmly welcomed by our local representative and transferred privately to their hotel. Self-drive travelers can collect their rental car at the airport and make their own way to the hotel. Begin your New Zealand holiday with a relaxing overnight stay in Auckland.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Auckland – Waitomo – Rotorua
package_itineraries.description: Begin your journey south through the scenic Waikato countryside to reach the magical region of Waitomo. Discover the captivating glowworm caves on a guided tour, featuring dazzling limestone formations and an unforgettable boat ride under a starry ceiling of glowworms.Continue onward to Rotorua with a stop at the famous Hobbiton Movie Set. Take a guided tour through the lush green film set and enjoy the fantasy world of Middle Earth. Your day ends with a peaceful overnight stay in Rotorua.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rotorua Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Start your day exploring Rotorua’s geothermal wonders at Te Puia Thermal Reserve, known for its steaming geysers and bubbling mud pools. Continue to the Agrodome for a fun-filled farm show, showcasing New Zealand’s agricultural heritage. Later, visit Rainbow Springs to see native wildlife and the iconic trout-filled streams.The afternoon is yours to enjoy at leisure, with optional activities available. Return to your Rotorua hotel for another restful evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua to Wellington
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart Rotorua for the journey south to Lake Taupo, New Zealand’s largest lake. Travel across the diverse Central Plateau, soaking in the beauty of natural landscapes along the way. Arrive in Wellington, the vibrant capital city, where you'll spend the night at a comfortable hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Explore Wellington
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a guided morning tour of Wellington, including a short visit to Te Papa—New Zealand’s National Museum. Spend the rest of the day discovering the charm of this harborside capital at your own pace. Your overnight accommodation remains in Wellington.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Wellington to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: This morning, embark on a scenic cruise across the Cook Strait, connecting the North and South Islands. Cruise through the serene waterways of Marlborough Sounds before arriving in Picton. Continue your drive through the picturesque towns of Blenheim and Kaikoura before reaching Christchurch, known as the ‘Garden City’. Check in and unwind at your Christchurch hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Christchurch to Dunedin
package_itineraries.description: Set off today through the expansive Canterbury Plains as you head south to Dunedin, a city shaped by its rich Scottish roots. Renowned for its abundant wildlife and prestigious Otago University, Dunedin offers a mix of culture and natural beauty. Spend the night in this historic city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Dunedin to Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning in Dunedin with optional sightseeing. Later, embark on a scenic drive through the heart of Central Otago’s rolling landscapes. Arrive in Queenstown by evening—a resort town famed for its beauty and adventure. Settle in for an overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Queenstown Free Day
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full day at leisure in Queenstown. Choose from thrilling optional activities such as bungee jumping, jet boating, white-water rafting, or scenic gondola rides—all available at your own expense. End your day with a comfortable overnight stay in Queenstown.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Queenstown to the Glacier Region
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel through the stunning landscapes of Lake Wanaka and the rugged Haast Pass, entering the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Westland National Park. Drive along the striking West Coast, passing through verdant rainforests, clear lakes, and mountain vistas, until you reach Franz Josef or Fox Glacier.Self-drive guests will also enjoy complimentary access to the Glacier Hot Pools. Settle in for the night in the serene Glacier Region.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Glacier Region – Greymouth – Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Head north to Greymouth and board the renowned TranzAlpine train (for seat-in-coach travelers). Journey through beech forests and alpine landscapes, including Arthur’s Pass and the majestic Southern Alps. Enjoy stunning panoramic views as the train crosses the Canterbury Plains before arriving in Christchurch.On arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy a free evening exploring the nearby attractions.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Departure from Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Today marks the end of your incredible adventure. Make your way to Christchurch Airport for your flight home or onward journey. Take with you unforgettable memories and the essence of New Zealand’s natural beauty and culture.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Nadi – Journey to Castaway Island Resort
package_itineraries.description: As you arrive at Nadi International Airport, your tropical journey begins. Prepare to experience an island escape where vibrant nature meets heartfelt Fijian hospitality. Your destination is the idyllic Castaway Island Resort.Following a smooth transfer from the airport, you'll be welcomed by the incredible beauty of this iconic island resort. Picture palm-fringed shores, sparkling azure waters, and flourishing greenery—every moment here feels like a dream come true.Yet, it's not just the scenery that makes Castaway special—it’s the warmth of the local staff who make you feel instantly at home. As evening approaches, you’ll settle into your comfortable room at the Castaway Island Resort, where you’ll spend your first night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Leisure at Castaway Island Resort
package_itineraries.description: Today is yours to relax and fully immerse yourself in everything Castaway Island has to offer. Wander the beaches, swim in the ocean, or simply lounge in the sun. Tonight, you’ll once again stay at the Castaway Island Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Full Day at Castaway Island Resort
package_itineraries.description: Wake up to a delightful breakfast and spend another day enjoying the island paradise at your own pace. Whether it’s kayaking, snorkelling, or just unwinding by the pool, you’re free to make the day your own. Overnight stay at Castaway Island Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Castaway Island to Mercure Nadi
package_itineraries.description: Today, you’ll depart the island and head back to the mainland for a stay at Mercure Nadi. After your arrival, the day is yours to relax or explore Nadi at your leisure. Your night will be spent at Mercure Nadi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Auckland, affectionately known as the "City of Sails." Upon landing, our dedicated representatives will greet you and arrange a smooth transfer to your hotel. Settle in and enjoy your overnight stay in this vibrant harbor city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discovering Auckland’s Highlights
package_itineraries.description: After a delicious breakfast, begin your exploration of Auckland’s urban gems. Visit the iconic Harbour Bridge, then take a scenic walk around the bustling Auckland Viaduct. Admire sweeping views from the peaceful Michael Joseph Savage Memorial Park, where the beauty of the Waitemata Harbour and city skyline unfolds before you.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Through Waikato to Rotorua
package_itineraries.description: Today’s journey leads you through the lush Waikato countryside en route to Waitomo. Experience the wonder of the famous Glowworm Caves, where a dazzling display awaits underground. Continue toward the Mamaku Ranges and arrive in the geothermal haven of Rotorua by evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua Adventures
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with a guided visit to the Te Puia Thermal Reserve to witness erupting geysers and bubbling mud pools. Then, explore Rainbow Springs and its fascinating trout and native birdlife. Later, enjoy an authentic Kiwi farming experience at the Agrodome with live animal shows. In the evening, immerse yourself in Maori traditions with a cultural performance and a traditional Hangi feast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Flight to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Today you’ll catch a domestic flight from Rotorua to Christchurch. Upon arrival, our team will escort you to your accommodation where you can relax and unwind.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Scenic Route to Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Depart from Christchurch across the wide Canterbury Plains. Visit the stunning Lake Tekapo and the charming Church of the Good Shepherd. Head toward Mount Cook, New Zealand’s tallest mountain, then continue alongside the serene Lake Pukaki. Journey through Central Otago’s scenic routes and arrive in the alpine gem of Queenstown.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Milford Sound Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Start early and head south along Lake Wakatipu, passing through Lumsden and into the lake-studded Fiordland. Travel through the dramatic Eglinton Valley and the engineering marvel of Homer Tunnel. Arrive at the breathtaking Milford Sound, where you’ll cruise past towering Mitre Peak and cascading Bowen Falls. A tasty buffet lunch is served on board. Return to Queenstown after this spectacular day.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Queenstown Leisure & Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Your day in Queenstown offers endless possibilities. From adrenaline-pumping activities like bungy jumping, white-water rafting, or jet boating to more relaxed options like taking a gondola ride for panoramic views, the choice is yours to make the most of this thrill-seeker’s paradise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Queenstown to Glacier Country
package_itineraries.description: Leave Queenstown behind as you travel through striking mountain scenery. Journey via Lake Wanaka and cross the wild Haast Pass into the dense forests of the West Coast. Continue past mirror-like lakes and rugged cliffs until you reach the glacier region, home to the majestic Franz Josef and Fox Glaciers.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Scenic Rail to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Today, travel north to the town of Greymouth, where seat-in-coach passengers will board the legendary TranzAlpine train. This remarkable rail journey takes you across Arthur’s Pass and the soaring Southern Alps, through native beech forests and open farmland, finally arriving in Christchurch via the Canterbury Plains.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Discovering Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Set out on a guided tour of Christchurch, where you’ll explore the tranquil Monavale Gardens, historic Arts Centre, the University campus, beautiful Botanical Gardens, and the city’s museum. Enjoy a peaceful riverside walk along the Avon River to conclude your exploration.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your final breakfast in New Zealand before heading to the airport for your onward flight. Take home unforgettable memories from your Queenstown Tour Package adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Brisbane – Transfer to the Gold Coast
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Brisbane International Airport, you’ll be warmly welcomed and transferred directly to your hotel on the Gold Coast. The rest of the evening is yours to unwind and settle in, setting the tone for a relaxing start to your journey. Enjoy a peaceful overnight stay at your Gold Coast hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Gold Coast – Movie World Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Spend an exciting day immersed in the wonders of Movie World. This immersive theme park offers an impressive selection of movie-inspired rides, adrenaline-pumping roller coasters, and fun-filled water attractions. As your exciting day concludes, return to your hotel with unforgettable memories. (Your Combo ticket includes a souvenir bag and a themed photo-frame – note: the ticket is non-refundable if only one park is visited or if the ticket is lost.) Rest comfortably once more at your Gold Coast accommodation.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Gold Coast – Discover Sea World
package_itineraries.description: Experience a memorable day at Sea World, a renowned marine theme park combining oceanarium, wildlife presentations, and family-friendly rides. Enjoy up-close interactions with marine life and thrilling shows, all while learning about the importance of conservation. (Combo ticket is non-refundable in case of single park usage or ticket loss.) Alternatively, for an additional fee of AUD 20 per adult and AUD 10 per child, you may opt to substitute this day with entry to Dream World. Conclude your day with another restful night at your Gold Coast hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Gold Coast/Brisbane – Journey to Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Check out and head to Brisbane or Gold Coast airport for your domestic flight to Sydney. Be sure your arrival in Sydney is no later than 21:30 to ensure a smooth transfer. (Note: Infants under 1 year are not eligible for this transfer.) Upon arrival, proceed to your hotel for check-in and enjoy a relaxing overnight stay in Sydney.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Sydney – City Highlights Tour & Showboat Dinner Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a guided morning city tour, including photo stops at the iconic Opera House and Harbour Bridge, and a visit to Manly Beach. (This complimentary city tour is non-refundable.) The tour concludes by 11:45 near Darling Harbour or Circular Quay.Later, make your way to King Street Wharf, Darling Harbour, to redeem your Combo 2 pass, granting admission to Sea Life Aquarium and Sydney Tower Eye with a 4D cinematic experience. (Transfers to these venues are not included.)In the evening, return to King Street Wharf #5 for the Sydney Showboat Cruise. Enjoy a delightful Indian vegetarian dinner and standard seating aboard this spectacular cruise. Note: The cruise does not operate on Tuesdays, Sundays, or specific blackout dates (01 Oct, 25–26, 31 Dec, 01 Jan, 14 Feb). Priority seating is available at an extra AUD 25 per person. Jain meals are not offered. Return to your Sydney hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Sydney – Full-Day Excursion of Your Choice
package_itineraries.description: Choose from several full-day tour options, all beginning between 7 and 7:50 am, depending on your hotel’s location. Pickups are limited to designated points.Scenic Blue Mountains with Wildlife Park: Departs at 8 am, returns by 6 pm. Pickup is compulsory and non-refundable.Scenic Blue Mountains with Wildlife Park, Lunch & Scenic Rides: Same timing and terms apply.Blue Mountains with Wildlife Park, 2-Course Lunch & River Cruise: Tour starts at 8 am, ending at Darling Harbour or Circular Quay. Pickup is mandatory and non-refundable.After your chosen excursion, return to your hotel in Sydney for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Sydney
package_itineraries.description: This morning, check out from your Sydney hotel and proceed to the airport for your return or onward journey. Transfers are available for flights departing after 7 am (domestic) and 8 am (international). Additional charges apply for private early morning transfers. Depart with beautiful memories created during your Australia trip package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: Touch down in the world-renowned city of San Francisco, a place often compared with global icons like Paris and London. With its scenic hills, sweeping views of the Pacific Ocean and San Francisco Bay, eclectic neighborhoods, and vibrant nightlife, the city offers the perfect start to your West Coast adventure. After your arrival, check into your hotel and unwind for an overnight stay in San Francisco.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: San Francisco City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head out on a guided city tour covering San Francisco’s most iconic attractions. Visit the majestic Golden Gate Bridge, ascend to the panoramic Twin Peaks, and stroll through Lombard Street, Pier 39, and Fisherman’s Wharf. Experience the historic Cable Car, marvel at the Palace of Fine Arts, and take in the urban energy of Union Square, Nob Hill, and the Civic Center. Return to your hotel for a restful night in San Francisco.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Fly to Las Vegas
package_itineraries.description: This morning, catch a flight to the dazzling city of Las Vegas. Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to your hotel. In the evening, explore Las Vegas in all its neon-lit glory. Witness the spectacular Bellagio Fountains, check out the Pirate Ships at Treasure Island, rise above the city at the Stratosphere Tower, and visit the electrifying Fremont Street, lit by over 12 million lights. Overnight stay in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Optional Grand Canyon Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day at your leisure or choose to take an optional excursion to the breathtaking Grand Canyon by bus or air. Don’t miss the chance to walk on the incredible Skywalk, offering unmatched canyon views. You may also opt for the Las Vegas Night Flight – a thrilling helicopter ride over the shimmering Vegas skyline. In the evening, catch a live show or explore other free street performances. Overnight in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Las Vegas to Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart by road for Los Angeles, the entertainment capital of the world. On arrival, go on a panoramic city tour featuring landmarks like Hollywood, the Walk of Fame, Grauman’s Chinese Theatre, Sunset Strip, Beverly Hills, Rodeo Drive, and Chinatown. Spend the evening soaking in the city's glamorous vibes before checking in at your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Universal Studios Hollywood
package_itineraries.description: Today’s adventure takes you to Universal Studios Hollywood, where thrilling rides, behind-the-scenes experiences, and real-life movie sets await. From high-octane simulators to themed worlds, this park brings Hollywood magic to life. Keep your eyes open—you might even spot a celebrity. Return to your hotel in Los Angeles for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your final breakfast in California before spending a relaxed morning at your pace. Later, proceed to the airport for your onward flight, taking back wonderful memories from your Whistling West Coast Tour Package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: Kickstart your adventure as you arrive in San Francisco—an iconic American city often compared to Paris and London for its charm and cultural blend. With its dramatic hills, scenic bay views, and vibrant neighborhoods, San Francisco offers a stunning first impression. Explore trendy boutiques, savor global cuisine, and enjoy the city’s exciting nightlife. On arrival, transfer to your hotel and relax with an overnight stay in San Francisco.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: San Francisco City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a guided city tour showcasing the best of San Francisco. Walk across the legendary Golden Gate Bridge, admire panoramic views from Twin Peaks, and visit famous spots like Lombard Street, Nob Hill, Civic Center, Union Square, Pier 39, and Fisherman’s Wharf. Don’t miss a photo stop at the elegant Palace of Fine Arts and a glimpse of the historic Cable Cars. Return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Day Trip to Yosemite National Park
package_itineraries.description: Today, set out on an unforgettable excursion to Yosemite National Park. Behold awe-inspiring landscapes shaped by ancient glaciers, including thundering waterfalls, serene lakes, towering cliffs, and giant sequoia trees. Capture memorable views of Half Dome, El Capitan, and Yosemite Falls. After an adventurous day in nature’s masterpiece, head back to San Francisco for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: San Francisco to Las Vegas
package_itineraries.description: Catch a morning flight to the dazzling city of Las Vegas. Upon arrival, check in and later gear up for an exciting evening city tour. Witness the iconic Bellagio Dancing Fountains, the vibrant Fremont Street light show, Pirate Ships at Treasure Island, and the stunning views from the Stratosphere Tower. Soak in the city’s electric atmosphere before heading back for an overnight stay in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Leisure or Optional Grand Canyon Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your day at leisure or join the optional Grand Canyon Tour by bus or air. Marvel at the vast natural wonder and experience the thrilling Skywalk. In the evening, you can opt for the Las Vegas Night Flight—an exhilarating helicopter ride over the glittering Strip—or attend one of Vegas’s many live shows. Overnight in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Las Vegas to Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Los Angeles, the entertainment capital of the world. Embark on a scenic city tour covering top attractions such as Hollywood, the Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Sunset Strip, Grauman’s Chinese Theater, Rodeo Drive, and China Town. After exploring the star-studded city, unwind with an overnight stay in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Universal Studios Tour
package_itineraries.description: Step into the world of movies with a full-day visit to Universal Studios. Enjoy thrilling rides, live-action shows, and behind-the-scenes movie experiences. This working studio lets you see where magic is made and gives you a taste of Hollywood like never before. Stay overnight in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: San Diego – SeaWorld Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today’s adventure takes you to SeaWorld in San Diego, home to thrilling marine life shows, rides, and interactive exhibits. Brave the water coaster through Atlantis, ride a virtual copter to the Wild Arctic, and get up close with dolphins, sea lions, and orcas. After a fun-filled day, return to your Los Angeles hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Disneyland Magic
package_itineraries.description: Delight in a magical day at Disneyland, where fairy tales come to life. Wander through the enchanting Main Street USA, meet beloved characters, and enjoy classic rides and shows. The park’s immersive atmosphere promises fun for all ages. Overnight at your hotel in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning followed by checkout. Proceed to the airport for your onward journey, bringing an end to your memorable Western Explorer Tour Package experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Vancouver International Airport, collect your rental vehicle, and drive to your hotel. In the evening, enjoy the exhilarating Fly Over Canada 4D experience—soar across Canada's diverse landscapes with immersive visuals and special effects. Relax overnight at your Vancouver hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Vancouver Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today begins with a visit to Vancouver’s top attractions. Cross the iconic Lions Gate Bridge and explore the Capilano Salmon Hatchery before arriving at the Capilano Suspension Bridge Park. Stroll along the thrilling Cliff Walk and immerse yourself in the Treetops Adventure.Continue your day with a scenic ride up Grouse Mountain on the Skyride. Enjoy activities such as the Lumberjack Show, the Peak Chairlift, wildlife encounters, and panoramic views from the Eye of the Wind. In the evening, unwind in downtown Vancouver—shop on Robson Street, visit Stanley Park, or explore the historic Gastown district. Overnight in Vancouver.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Vancouver to Victoria
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal for a 90-minute ferry ride across the Strait of Georgia to Swartz Bay. Visit the world-famous Butchart Gardens, known for its immaculate floral displays. Then, explore Victoria’s Inner Harbour, steeped in British charm. Overnight stay in Victoria.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Victoria to Whistler
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with an included Whale Watching Tour. Spot orcas, seals, and marine birds in their natural habitat. Later, take the ferry from Nanaimo to Horseshoe Bay and enjoy a scenic drive along the Sea-to-Sky Highway to Whistler. Stop at Shannon Falls and soak in views of rugged mountains and glacial fjords. Overnight in Whistler.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Whistler Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Explore Whistler Village and savour a local breakfast. Enjoy shopping, dining, or outdoor cafés before boarding the Peak-2-Peak Gondola—an engineering marvel offering breathtaking views. Optional adventures include ATV tours, bungee jumping, or a paddling trip across Alta Lake and the River of Golden Dreams. Stay overnight in Whistler.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Whistler to Kamloops
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Kamloops, where dramatic desert plateaus meet lush valleys. Enjoy scenic views of Kamloops Lake and the Thompson River. Experience the peaceful rhythm of small-town life and settle in for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Kamloops to Jasper
package_itineraries.description: Travel north along the Thompson River, passing through Yellowhead Pass into Jasper National Park. Admire the alpine lakes, towering peaks, and chance wildlife sightings like elk. End your day in the picturesque mountain town of Jasper. Overnight at a Jasper hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Explore Jasper National Park
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day exploring Jasper's natural beauty. Visit Maligne Canyon and take a boat cruise on Maligne Lake to view Spirit Island. Optional activities include visiting Miette Hot Springs, white water rafting, or the Jasper SkyTram. Overnight stay in Jasper.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Jasper to Lake Louise via Columbia Icefields
package_itineraries.description: Today, journey along the Icefields Parkway—one of the most scenic drives in the world. Stop at the Columbia Icefield Discovery Centre for the Glacier Adventure and Glacier Skywalk. En route to Lake Louise, pass scenic spots like Peyto Lake and Bow Lake. Spend the night at a hotel near the tranquil turquoise waters of Lake Louise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Lake Louise to Banff
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day exploring Lake Louise with optional activities such as hiking to Lake Agnes, kayaking, or visiting the Lake Louise Gondola. Later, head to Banff, a vibrant alpine town. Check into your hotel and enjoy Banff Avenue’s quaint shops and restaurants. Overnight in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Banff Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Explore Banff’s majestic surroundings. Visit Bow Falls, Surprise Corner, Hoodoos, and take a Lake Minnewanka Cruise. Ascend Sulphur Mountain via Banff Gondola for panoramic views. In the afternoon, explore the trails or stroll through town. Overnight in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Banff to Calgary
package_itineraries.description: Drive from Banff to Calgary. Once in the city, check into your hotel and enjoy free time exploring urban attractions or relaxing. Overnight stay in Calgary.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Departure from Calgary
package_itineraries.description: Spend the morning exploring Calgary’s top sites like Heritage Park, Canada Olympic Park, or the Calgary Tower. Return your rental vehicle at Calgary Airport and catch your return flight or continue your journey elsewhere.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Vancouver and get transferred to your hotel. Later in the afternoon, experience the thrill of FlyOver Canada, a state-of-the-art 4D flight simulation. This immersive ride takes you on a breathtaking aerial journey across Canada, complete with motion seats and atmospheric effects like wind, mist, and scents. Before boarding, enjoy a visually engaging pre-show called "Uplift," setting the tone for your airborne adventure. After this unforgettable experience, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Victoria & Butchart Gardens Day Trip
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day guided tour to Victoria and Butchart Gardens. Begin your journey with a scenic 90-minute ferry ride across the Strait of Georgia and through the picturesque Gulf Islands. Once in Victoria, visit the world-renowned Butchart Gardens, an expansive 55-acre botanical paradise. Wander through beautifully landscaped gardens and enjoy the floral artistry. After a day filled with natural beauty and historical charm, return to Vancouver for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Whistler & Shannon Falls Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today’s adventure takes you north on the Sea to Sky Highway to Whistler. After breakfast, set off on a scenic drive along the coast, stopping at Shannon Falls and the Squamish Adventure Centre. As you approach Whistler Village, the towering peaks of Whistler and Blackcomb Mountains provide a majestic backdrop. Enjoy free time in the alpine village, with the option to ride the famous Peak 2 Peak Gondola for panoramic views. After a full day of exploration, return to Vancouver and relax at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Vancouver City Highlights & Capilano Park
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before diving into a full-day city tour. Discover Vancouver’s vibrant neighborhoods including Gastown, Chinatown, and the cultural haven of Granville Island. Take in the beauty of Stanley Park, drive past Robson Street and Canada Place, and enjoy the scenic Lions Gate Bridge. The tour also includes admission to Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, where you’ll walk the thrilling Cliffwalk and sway high above the forest on the Treetops Adventure. After a memorable day, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, it’s time to check out. You’ll be transferred to Vancouver International Airport for your onward journey, marking the end of your delightful Vancouver Tour Package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to Vancouver! Upon your arrival at Vancouver International Airport, a transfer will take you to your centrally located hotel. The rest of the day is free for you to relax or explore the vibrant downtown area at your leisure. Framed by mountain peaks and ocean waters, Vancouver is known for its natural beauty, diverse culture, and laid-back lifestyle. Whether you choose to stroll along the waterfront, explore local boutiques, or sample global cuisine, your adventure begins here. Overnight stay at your hotel in Vancouver.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Vancouver City Highlights & Capilano Suspension Bridge
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a scenic tour showcasing Vancouver's top attractions. Explore historic Gastown and Chinatown, see the sails of Canada Place, shop on Robson Street, and take in the serene beauty of Stanley Park with its totem poles and coastal paths. Later, head across the Lions Gate Bridge to Capilano Suspension Bridge Park. Here, you'll walk the legendary bridge, experience the Treetops Adventure, and feel the thrill of the Cliffwalk. In the evening, unwind with a gourmet dinner at one of Vancouver’s top restaurants. Return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leisure Day in Vancouver (Optional Victoria Day Tour)
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast and a full day to explore Vancouver at your own pace. Visit museums, stroll through art galleries, or relax at English Bay. For those seeking more, opt for an optional day tour to the charming city of Victoria. Highlights include the famous Butchart Gardens, Victoria Harbour, and the Royal BC Museum. After a full day of exploration, return to your hotel in Vancouver for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Travel from Vancouver to Whistler
package_itineraries.description: This morning, depart on a scenic coach journey to Whistler, a world-famous alpine resort town. Upon arrival and check-in at your hotel, enjoy the breathtaking Peak 2 Peak Gondola Experience, offering panoramic views of Whistler Village, glaciers, lakes, and surrounding mountain ranges. Soaring between Whistler and Blackcomb Mountains, this is the world’s longest and highest lift of its kind. After this unforgettable aerial journey, unwind at your hotel and enjoy a peaceful evening in Whistler.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Adventure Day in Whistler
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast, followed by a full day of leisure or adventure in Whistler. You may choose to explore the village on foot or opt for thrilling activities like a guided Snowmobile Tour across the powdery backcountry. For adrenaline seekers, the Winter Ziplining experience offers an exhilarating ride through snowy treetops. After a day of discovery and fun, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Whistler to Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy one last breakfast in Whistler before checking out. You’ll be transferred to Vancouver Airport for your flight to your next destination, bringing your Vancouver Tour Package to a memorable close.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sao Paulo
package_itineraries.description: Once you land at Sao Paulo Airport, you’ll be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at your own pace, relaxing and settling in. Overnight stay in Sao Paulo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sao Paulo - Rio De Janeiro City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a refreshing breakfast. Then, embark on a city tour of Sao Paulo. The journey starts at Centro Cultural and continues through Old Downtown where you’ll see major attractions such as Cathedral Se, Patio do Colegio, Monastery of Sao Bento, Banespa Building, Martinelli Building, Viaduto do Cha, the Municipal Theater, Sala Sao Paulo concert hall, Estaçao da Luz station, and the Municipal Market. Post tour, you’ll be transferred to the airport for your flight to Rio de Janeiro. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the evening at your leisure. Overnight in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rio De Janeiro
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a tour to Sugar Loaf Mountain. Enjoy a panoramic drive through downtown Rio, passing by landmarks like Maracana Stadium, Sambodrome, and the unique Metropolitan Cathedral. Stop at Cinelandia Square with its historical buildings, including the National Library and the Museum of Fine Arts. Then, ascend to Sugar Loaf by cable car for incredible views. Later, visit Corcovado Mountain and enjoy Rio’s iconic beaches. Overnight stay in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rio De Janeiro
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before heading on a scenic cruise along Guanabara Bay. Discover islands like Ilha Fiscal, Ilha das Cobras, and Ilha das Enxadas, and enjoy views of Rio-Niteroi Bridge and surrounding landscapes. On the return, take in the beauty of Niteroi’s coast and see the Museum of Contemporary Art, Santa Cruz Fortress, and beaches like Icarai and Jurujuba. Spend the night at your hotel in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Rio De Janeiro – Iguassu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport and fly to Iguassu. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and later visit the Brazilian side of the Iguassu Falls. Begin at the Visitor Center, then board a panoramic bus to reach the trails. Walk along a scenic path to view the falls from various platforms. Conclude your visit at Floriano fall and explore the upper viewing areas. Return for an overnight stay in Iguazu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Iguassu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a day tour to the Argentinean side of the falls. Begin at the New Visitors Center and explore the Nature Interpretation Center. Ride the train to the Cataratas Station or take the Green Trail.Upper Circuit: 800 meters of raised walkways offering aerial views.Lower Circuit: 1,600 meters with viewpoints surrounding the falls.Devil's Gorge: Take a train to Garganta Station and walk 1,200 meters to a stunning lookout point. Return for your overnight stay in Iguazu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Iguassu to Buenos
package_itineraries.description: AiresTransfer to the airport for your flight to Buenos Aires. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Buenos Aires is a vibrant city filled with European-inspired architecture and culture. In the evening, enjoy a Tango Show and Dinner at Tango Porteño. Overnight in Buenos Aires.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Buenos Aires
package_itineraries.description: Start your city tour of Buenos Aires after breakfast. Visit major landmarks like Av. 9 de Julio, the Colón Theatre, and the Obelisk. Explore Plaza de Mayo, San Telmo, La Boca, Caminito, and Puerto Madero. Continue to Palermo and Recoleta, ending at San Telmo Flea Market if it's Sunday. Overnight in Buenos Aires.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Buenos Aires to Ushuaia
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, fly from El Calafate to Ushuaia, the world’s southernmost city. Enjoy scenic views of the Beagle Channel and check in at your Ushuaia hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Ushuaia
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, explore Tierra del Fuego National Park with a ride on the Train of the End of the World. Enjoy nature and history in Argentina's only coastal national park. In the afternoon, sail the Beagle Channel and visit Seals Island to see sea life in its natural habitat. Overnight in Ushuaia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Ushuaia to El Calafate
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport and fly to El Calafate. Upon arrival, head to your hotel and enjoy a free day. Overnight stay in El Calafate.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: El Calafate
package_itineraries.description: Visit the spectacular Perito Moreno Glacier after breakfast. Tour Los Glaciares National Park and walk the glacier trails. Take a Nautical Safari to witness the glacier from the water. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: El Calafate to Bariloche
package_itineraries.description: Fly from El Calafate to Bariloche. Transfer to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at your own pace. Overnight in Bariloche.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Bariloche Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Explore Bariloche after breakfast with a scenic drive along Ezequiel Bustillo Avenue. Discover lakes, peninsulas, islands, and mountain peaks. Visit the Panoramic Point for breathtaking views. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 15: Bariloche to Puerto Varas
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Bariloche to Puerto Varas via the Cardenal Samore Pass. Stop at Osorno and continue through beautiful landscapes to reach your hotel in Puerto Varas. Overnight in Puerto Varas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 17: Puerto Varas - Santiago
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport and fly to Santiago. Visit La Moneda Palace, Plaza de Armas, San Cristobal Hill, and explore neighborhoods like Bellavista, Las Condes, and Providencia. Overnight stay in Santiago.

package_itineraries.title: Day 18: Santiago
package_itineraries.description: Take a full-day tour of Vina del Mar and Valparaiso. Stop in Pomaire village, explore the Garden City of Vina del Mar, and the historical hills of Valparaiso, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Return for an overnight stay in Santiago.

package_itineraries.title: Day 19: Departing from Santiago
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey or return home, bringing along cherished memories of your South America Travel Packages adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in New York
package_itineraries.description: Step into the vibrant buzz of the “Big Apple.” Upon landing at New York’s airport, our team will escort you to your hotel. Known as America’s largest city, New York dazzles with its mix of business, fashion, arts, and entertainment. Settle into your hotel and enjoy a relaxing evening at your leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Iconic Sights of New York City
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your city tour with a ferry ride to Liberty Island to visit the world-famous Statue of Liberty. Then, head to the One World Observatory for spectacular 360-degree views. Your day continues with key stops at Rockefeller Center, Wall Street, Ground Zero, and the peaceful surroundings of Central Park. Enjoy glimpses of Times Square, Trump Tower, and the United Nations headquarters before heading back to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Travel to Washington D.C.
package_itineraries.description: Today, travel to the capital of the United States, Washington D.C., a city steeped in political and historical significance. Upon arrival and hotel check-in, enjoy a guided tour featuring the White House, Lincoln Memorial, the Capitol Building, Supreme Court, Union Station, the Smithsonian Air and Space Museum, Pentagon, and World War II Memorial. Rest overnight in Washington.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Journey to Niagara via Buffalo
package_itineraries.description: Travel today to Buffalo by air or road for an exciting visit to the iconic Niagara Falls. Check into your hotel in Niagara and soak in the sights and sounds of one of nature’s greatest wonders.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Explore Niagara Falls – USA Side
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast followed by a ride on the legendary “Maid of the Mist” boat tour (seasonal), which takes you right up to the thundering American and Horseshoe Falls. Enjoy the rest of your day relaxing or exploring the illuminated falls by night. Stay overnight in Niagara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Fly to Las Vegas
package_itineraries.description: Take a morning flight to the dazzling city of Las Vegas. After hotel check-in, enjoy a city tour including the Bellagio Fountains, Treasure Island’s Pirate Show, Stratosphere Tower, Fremont Street, and the glittering lights of Downtown Vegas. Spend the night soaking in the city’s energy.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Grand Canyon Optional Tour
package_itineraries.description: You have the option today to explore the majestic Grand Canyon—by bus or air—along with the incredible Skywalk. In the evening, you may also enjoy a Vegas Night Flight (optional helicopter ride) or attend one of the city’s spectacular shows. Overnight stay in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Travel to Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: Proceed to Los Angeles by flight or road. Begin your city tour visiting landmarks like the Hollywood Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Grauman’s Chinese Theatre, Sunset Strip, Rodeo Drive, and Chinatown. Enjoy an overnight stay in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Universal Studios Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore Universal Studios, home to thrilling rides, movie-themed attractions, and real film sets. Get an insider’s look into Hollywood’s magical movie-making world. Return to your hotel in Los Angeles for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Disneyland Experience
package_itineraries.description: Step into a fairy-tale world at Disneyland, where your favorite characters and childhood dreams come to life. From Main Street USA to magical rides and parades, enjoy a full day of wonder and joy. Overnight in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Fly to San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: Fly to the iconic city of San Francisco, a hub of art, culture, and technology. Explore iconic landmarks like the Golden Gate Bridge, Twin Peaks, Lombard Street, Pier 39, Civic Center, Union Square, Fisherman’s Wharf, and the Palace of Fine Arts. Check in and relax at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Departure from San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy some free time to shop or relax. Later, you’ll be transferred to the airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Toronto Arrival & City Discovery
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Toronto Airport, you’ll be warmly welcomed by our local representatives and guided to your hotel. Later, set out to uncover the highlights of this vibrant city. Visit the famed Hockey Hall of Fame and get a glimpse of the prestigious Stanley Cup. Stop by the impressive Rogers Centre, known for its iconic architecture and events. The day culminates with a thrilling elevator ride up the CN Tower to its glass-floored outdoor observation deck at 1,122 feet—offering a mesmerizing panoramic view of Toronto’s skyline.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kingston Cruise & Ottawa Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to the historic city of Kingston. Here, enjoy a relaxing and scenic cruise through the breathtaking 1000 Islands—an unforgettable experience. Continue to Ottawa, Canada’s capital, where you'll explore Parliament Hill, a symbol of national heritage. Discover the beautiful Rideau Canal, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and other notable landmarks in the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Montreal – The Cultural Gem
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, board a comfortable coach to Montreal, a city known for its European flair. Visit the magnificent Notre Dame Basilica, celebrated for its elaborate interior, religious artwork, and detailed carvings. Then, ascend Mont Royal for sweeping views of Montreal’s skyline—an ideal photo opportunity to capture your memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Quebec City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast before diving into the charms of Quebec City. Led by an expert guide, you’ll tour North America's only fortified city. Highlights include the Parliament Buildings, Upper and Lower Towns, the historic Plains of Abraham, Chateau Frontenac, the Citadel, Place d’Armes, and the National Assembly of Quebec—each echoing the city’s storied past.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: From Quebec to Calgary
package_itineraries.description: After a fulfilling breakfast, proceed to the airport for your flight to Calgary. Upon arrival, our team will be ready to assist you. Explore the city’s major highlights, including Heritage Park and the iconic Olympic Park. Afterwards, you'll journey to Banff—a picturesque town nestled in the Canadian Rockies, known for its charming streets and alpine beauty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Icefield Parkway & Glacier Encounter
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast and prepare for an unforgettable drive along the legendary Icefield Parkway. This scenic route treats you to dramatic mountain views, crystal-clear lakes, and towering glaciers. Step onto the ancient ice at the Athabasca Glacier and embark on a Glacier Adventure ride. A stop at the stunning Johnston Canyon caps off a thrilling day of nature and exploration.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Rocky Mountains to Kelowna
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a peaceful breakfast before continuing your journey to Kelowna. En route, feast your eyes on the majestic Canadian Rockies. Upon arrival, you’ll take part in a brief orientation tour to discover the serene beauty and lakeside charm of Kelowna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: From Kelowna to Vancouver via Whistler
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart by luxury coach towards the alpine village of Whistler. Upon reaching, you’ll ride the record-breaking Peak 2 Peak Gondola that connects Whistler and Blackcomb Mountains. As you glide between peaks, soak in the breathtaking mountain and valley views that make this one of Canada’s most iconic experiences.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Immersive Vancouver City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today begins with breakfast and a guided exploration of Vancouver’s top attractions. Visit the lush Stanley Park and cross the thrilling Capilano Suspension Bridge. See Prospect Point, English Bay, and the symbolic West Coast Native Totem Poles. Continue to Gastown, the city’s historic heart, filled with Victorian charm and cobblestone streets, ending with more scenic highlights of Vancouver’s urban and natural beauty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Wrap up your memorable journey with a final breakfast. Then, transfer to the airport for your flight home, taking with you unforgettable moments from your Quebec Tour Package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Trinidad
package_itineraries.description: Your tropical escape begins as you land at Port of Spain, the capital city of Trinidad. A warm welcome awaits you at the airport, followed by a smooth transfer to your hotel. Take the rest of the day to unwind and soak in the island vibe. Overnight stay in Trinidad.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover the City of Port of Spain
package_itineraries.description: Dive into the heart of Trinidad with a guided city tour of Port of Spain. Discover historic architecture, vibrant local markets, and notable attractions such as art galleries, museums, Queen’s Park Savannah, Emperor Valley Zoo, and the Botanical Gardens. Conclude the day with a scenic stop at Lady Young Lookout, offering a sweeping view of the cityscape. Overnight stay in your Trinidad hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Explore Asa Wright Nature Centre
package_itineraries.description: Set off on a nature-filled excursion to the renowned Asa Wright Nature Centre, nestled in the green folds of the Northern Range. After a picturesque drive, join an expert guide for a serene walk through this 200-acre sanctuary. Spot exotic birds like toucans and hummingbirds, admire colorful flora, and take in the tranquil sounds of the forest.Optional: Enjoy a traditional lunch at the Old Plantation House or take a dip at a nearby waterfall before heading back. Return to your hotel for a relaxing night in Trinidad.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Flight to Tobago
package_itineraries.description: This morning, you'll transfer to Piarco Airport for your flight to the island of Tobago. Upon arrival, you’ll be met and escorted to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours—relax by the beach or explore at your own pace. Overnight stay in Tobago.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Full-Day Tobago Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a scenic journey across Tobago, taking in the breathtaking beauty of both the Caribbean and Atlantic coastlines. You'll pass through tropical rainforests, unspoiled beaches, and cascading waterfalls. Highlights include a visit to historical landmarks and a refreshing dip at the Argyle Waterfall.Enjoy lunch at Jemma’s Treehouse—a local favorite offering authentic island cuisine. On days it's closed, a similar local eatery will be provided. Return to your hotel and unwind after a full day of sightseeing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Tobago Rainforest Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Start your day early with a nature-filled adventure along Tobago’s Caribbean coast. Visit local gems like Castara Bay and, when open, a traditional clay oven bakery. Continue on to Englishman’s Bay for postcard-perfect views.Taste seasonal fruits and sample local treats along the way. The highlight of the day is a hike through the Main Ridge Rainforest—the oldest protected reserve in the Western Hemisphere. Keep an eye out for the island’s native wildlife, including the White-tailed Sabrewing hummingbird and the national bird, the Cocrico.After your hike, enjoy lunch in Castara before heading back for an overnight stay at your Tobago hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Farewell from Tobago
package_itineraries.description: On your final day, you’ll be transferred to Scarborough Airport for your return flight, connecting through Trinidad. Depart with unforgettable memories from your Trinidad and Tobago Tour Package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Rio de Janeiro
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Rio’s international airport where a friendly local representative will guide you to your hotel. Known affectionately as "The Marvelous City," Rio de Janeiro was once the capital of both Portugal and Brazil until 1960. Today, it’s a dazzling mix of dramatic mountain landscapes and coastal charm.One of Brazil’s most dynamic cities, Rio is famed for its landmarks like Sugarloaf Mountain (Pão de Açúcar), Christ the Redeemer (Corcovado), and the world-famous Copacabana and Ipanema beaches. The city exudes an irresistible energy, and its locals—Cariocas—are known for their warm, easy-going nature.Whether you're here to enjoy nature, soak in the culture, or join the Carnival celebrations, Rio has something for every kind of traveler. Enjoy your first night at your hotel in Rio.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore the Icons of Rio
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast, then embark on the thrilling Sugarloaf Mountain excursion. This panoramic journey begins with a city tour, passing through downtown Rio and notable spots such as Maracanã Stadium, the Sambadrome, and the architecturally stunning Metropolitan Cathedral—famous for its massive pyramid shape and a height of 80 meters.Next, explore Cinelandia Square, home to Rio's cultural gems like the Municipal Theater, the National Library, and the Museum of Fine Arts. Then, take a scenic cable car ride to Sugarloaf Mountain for breathtaking views over the bay and city skyline.In the afternoon, visit Corcovado Mountain, home to the iconic Christ the Redeemer statue, and enjoy a drive along some of the city’s most beautiful beaches. Return to your hotel in the evening for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cruise Through Guanabara Bay
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head out to explore the stunning Guanabara Bay on a scenic cruise. Surrounded by mountains and lined with golden beaches, the bay reveals Rio from a magical perspective.During the cruise, sail past several islands, including Ilha Fiscal, Ilha das Cobras, and Ilha de Villegaignon.
