Once we arrive at the reserve, get ready for an incredible experience. Here, you'll have the chance to witness the most magnificent scenes in the animal kingdom – from the commanding roar of a lion to the incredible agility of a cheetah during a hunt. Keep your camera ready for moments like an elephant expressing its frustration.Prepare to be captivated by a multitude of fascinating events as you explore the Masai Mara Game Reserve.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: Prepare for another thrilling safari adventure as you embark on a journey to spot wild animals. The early morning and evening are prime times for observing these magnificent creatures in their natural habitat. During the midday, you can enjoy a game viewing drive in pursuit of the famous "big five" – the leopard, lion, rhino, and elephant.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Lake Nakuru National Park
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast and be sure to listen to the instructions provided by your safari driver to help you navigate into Lake Nakuru National Park. Once you're all set, head over to Lake Nakuru Lodge where you can enjoy a leisurely lunch.The real adventure begins in the afternoon as you embark on a thrilling game viewing drive within the boundaries of Lake Nakuru National Park.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Lake Nakuru to Nairobi
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Then, it's time to check out from the hotel and make your way to Nairobi. Our friendly representatives will accompany you to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your departure. Safe travel!

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Cape Town International Airport, a friendly representative will greet you and accompany you to your hotel. You'll have the remainder of the day to leisurely explore the city at your own pace. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Cape Town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cape Town - Exploring the City
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before embarking on a half-day tour of Cape Town. If the weather is on our side, we'll ascend Table Mountain. We'll also take you on a scenic drive past iconic landmarks like The Castle of Good Hope, Company Gardens, Parliament Buildings, City Hall, the Slave Lodge, and the charming Malay Quarter. You'll spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cape Town - Peninsula Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full day exploring the picturesque Cape Peninsula. We'll make a stop at Hout Bay Harbour, take a cruise to Seal Island, and, weather permitting, drive along the breathtaking Chapmans Peak Drive. Our journey continues to Cape Point National Park, where we'll take a funicular tour. Afterward, we'll visit Simons Town, the charming Boulders Beach Penguin Colony, and the lush Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. You'll spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cape Town to Knysna
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel, and then complete the check-out process. You'll embark on a journey to Knysna via the N2 road. Once you arrive, you'll check in at your hotel. The remainder of the day is yours to relax and enjoy at your own pace. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Knysna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Knysna - Oudtshoorn - Knysna
package_itineraries.description: Today, we will journey over the picturesque Outeniqua Mountain Pass to reach Oudtshoorn, renowned as the feather capital of the world. Our day includes a visit to the fascinating Cango Caves and the captivating Cango Wildlife Ranch. You'll also get the chance to explore an Ostrich Farm Tour. After our adventures, we will be returning to our hotel in Knysna for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Knysna to Sun City via Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: We'll arrange a transfer to George Airport for your flight to Johannesburg, though please note that the flight cost is not included (we recommend a departure around 10:00 AM). Upon landing at O.R. Tambo International Airport, a Thompsons Africa representative will be there to greet you and transfer you to Sun City. Check in at the hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Enjoying Sun City
package_itineraries.description: Today is your day to relax and unwind. There are no scheduled tours, and you won't have a vehicle or guide at your disposal. If you're interested in exploring, there's an option to go on a safari in the Pilanesberg National Park, but you'll need to arrange and pay for it directly with the suppliers. After your day of leisure, you'll spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Sun City to Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: You'll be driven to your chosen hotel in Johannesburg, where you can enjoy a leisurely day. Rest for the night at your Johannesburg hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Leaving Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: This morning, it's time to check out and make your way to O.R. Tambo International Airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival on Mahe Island
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Mahe Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and take you to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to relax and enjoy. Have a peaceful overnight stay on Mahe Island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Mahe Island - Full-Day Mahe Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today, you'll enjoy a comprehensive tour of Mahe. Explore court buildings, museums, the post office, and the clock tower. Stroll down Albert Street, where you'll find a vibrant market with stalls brimming with fresh fruits, vegetables, fish, herbs, and spices.Next, take a scenic drive through the Sans Soucis mountain pass and visit the historic Missions Lodge. Afterward, take a break for lunch (not included). Then, continue your journey to the southern tip of the island, where you'll discover the colonial plantation known as "Jardin du Roi."

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Mahe - Reef Safari
package_itineraries.description: On your third day, you'll embark on a reef safari aboard a catamaran. This adventure will take you to the heart of the harbour, where you can feed the fish and observe intriguing underwater creatures while swimming. Afterward, it's time for a well-deserved break! You'll enjoy a delicious buffet lunch served in the traditional Creole style on board. Later, if you're a fan of marine life, you can choose to go for a swim or relax on the beach of Cerf Island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mahe to Praslin to La Digue
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Afterward, visit Vallee-de-Mai, the natural habitat of the giant Coco-de-Mer nut. Then, we'll take you to the renowned Anse Lazio Beach. Following that, enjoy a 30-minute ferry ride to La Digue. Our guide will assist you in transitioning from an ox-cart to L’Union Estate, where you can explore the copra sheds. Your tour of La Digue will continue an open-sided truck with a canopy, known as a 'camion.' Finally, we'll head to one of the world's most stunning beaches, "Anse Source d'Argent."

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Mahe
package_itineraries.description: Today is all yours to enjoy as you wish. Take your time exploring this beautiful island on your own and return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Mahe - Homeward Journey
package_itineraries.description: Have your breakfast and make your way to the airport for your flight back home. Safe Travel!

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nairobi - Samburu
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at the airport, you'll be greeted by our representatives who will help you with customs and immigration procedures. You'll meet your tour guide and begin your journey to Samburu National Park. After arriving, you can check in at the hotel and enjoy your lunch. In the afternoon, we'll take you on a thrilling game drive in the park until sunset. Later, take a break from the tour and savour a delicious dinner at the lodge.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Samburu Safari
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Embark on an exciting adventure in the reserve, spending the entire day on thrilling game drives to witness the incredible wildlife. Return to the hotel in the evening for a sumptuous dinner, and then rest peacefully for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Samburu to Aberdares
package_itineraries.description: After a delicious breakfast in the morning, we will head to Aberdares to explore its wonderful attractions. Upon arriving in the city, we'll check in and enjoy a scrumptious lunch at the Aberdares Country Club. It will be around noon, and you can return to the lodge for a bit of rest. Later in the day, you can relish the joy of observing animals and playing near the floodlit waterhole. Finally, we will proceed to the unique tree lodge known as "The Ark," nestled in the heart of Aberdare National Park. This tree lodge is home to a rich variety of wildlife, including elephants, rhinos, bushbucks, and leopards. Don't forget to capture some incredible moments from the ground-level bunker at the tree lodge.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Aberdares to Lake Nakuru
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. We'll continue our journey towards the breathtaking Great Rift Valley and the mesmerising Lake Nakuru National Park. Upon arrival at the lodge, indulge in a delicious lunch. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy with your loved ones. In the evening, relish a delightful dinner at the lodge before a tranquil night's rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Lake Nakuru to Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast at the hotel. Next, meet your tour representative as you prepare to journey to the renowned Masai Mara National Reserve. Upon reaching the camp, check into the lodge and enjoy a relaxing lunch.In the afternoon, embark on an exciting game drive in this world-famous reserve. Return to the lodge for a delicious dinner and spend the night there.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Today, you have the entire day to explore the reserve and embark on exciting game drives. In the evening, make your way to the lodge for a delicious dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Exploring the Wonders of Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: Today is dedicated to exploring the remarkable beauty of Masai Mara with your knowledgeable tour guide. Masai Mara is a captivating destination teeming with diverse wildlife. Its rolling hills are blessed with a constant water supply throughout the year, making it an ideal habitat for a wide variety of animals.During your visit, you'll have the opportunity to encounter numerous predators, including jackals, leopards, hyenas, lions, and zebras. The animals are typically well-fed during the day, ensuring you witness their natural behaviours and activities.After an exciting day of wildlife sightings, return to your hotel for a delicious dinner and a comfortable night's rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Leaving Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. After breakfast, complete the check-out process, and we'll arrange for your transfer to Nairobi. You'll enjoy a delightful lunch at a city restaurant. Later, our tour representative will assist you in getting to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Mahe - Praslin
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at the Mahe International Airport, our tour managers will welcome you and help you transfer to the ship terminal to board your ship to Praslin. Check into your hotel in Praslin and spend the rest of the day exploring places around your resort.Spend the night in Praslin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Praslin - Vallee-De-Mai
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the Vallee-De-Mai Nature Reserve. This is a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for the coco de mer palm tree, the seeds of which are believed to be the largest in the world. The nature reserve is also home to unique wildlife species, including the Seychelles tree frog, the Seychelles chameleon, the Seychelles black parrot, and the bronze gecko.Return to your resort in the evening to enjoy a candlelight dinner beside the beach.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Praslin - Mahe
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the Praslin Ship Terminal to board your ferry to Mahe. Check into your hotel and spend the evening at leisure.Spend the night in Mahe.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Mahe Island Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After a delicious breakfast, head out for a full-day tour of the island. Some iconic attractions include Anse Royale Beach, Anse Major, Victoria Botanical Gardens, Morne Blanc Trail, Takamaka Rum Distillery, and Beau Vallon Beach.Don’t miss the Jardin du Roi Spice Garden, where you can admire the different medicinal and herbal plants and fruits.Spend the night in Mahe.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Depart Mahe
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, bid adieu to Seychelles and catch your flight to return home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Livingstone - Afternoon Zambezi River Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Livingstone Airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. In the afternoon, enjoy a relaxing sunset cruise on the Zambezi River. Spend the night at your hotel in Livingstone.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Livingstone – Victoria Falls Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore the majestic Victoria Falls on a guided tour. Please note that this tour excludes transfers, as the falls are within walking distance of the hotel. Spend the night at the hotel in Livingstone.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leaving Livingstone
package_itineraries.description: We'll arrange for your transfer from the Avani Victoria Falls Hotel to Livingstone Airport. Enjoy breakfast before you go.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Durban
package_itineraries.description: When you land at King Shaka International Airport, a friendly representative will be there to greet you and take you to your hotel. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Durban.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Durban City Tour
package_itineraries.description: On the second day of our journey, we're off to explore the beautiful city of Durban. Our city tour departs daily between 08:30 and 09:00, returning around 12:30.Our adventure begins as we stroll along the brand-new Golden Mile, a rejuvenated beachfront promenade that stretches along the inviting beaches of Durban. Along the way, we'll admire the newly upgraded Point Waterfront area.Next, we'll meander through the heart of the city, catching a glimpse of the majestic City Hall and enjoying its rich history. Our journey then takes us to the small craft harbour, where we'll witness the 8th largest harbour in the world. As we drive past the busy sugar terminals and bustling harbour warehouses, we'll head towards the University of Natal - Durban Campus. From there, you'll have a fantastic view of the harbour below.Our next stop is the vibrant African/Indian Markets at Warwick Triangle. This area is home to nine distinct markets, all centered around Durban's largest public transport interchange. Approximately 6,000 street vendors ply their trade here to an average of 460,000 daily commuters. It's a truly authentic experience.We'll also pay a visit to the fascinating Phansi Museum, which boasts the largest publicly accessible collection of Southern African artefacts and traditions. Here, you can see beadworks, headrests, Zulu clay pots, and many other treasures (please note that the museum is closed on weekends, and there may be an entrance fee).From delving into culture, we'll switch to nature as we explore the tranquil Durban Botanic Gardens. Established in 1849, the gardens are home to massive trees from Asia, Africa, and America, as well as a magnificent orchid house.Our day concludes with a visit to an icon of KwaZulu-Natal, the Moses Mabhida Stadium. Here, you'll have the option to take a cable car ride (at your own expense) to the top of the stadium, where you can enjoy a phenomenal view of Durban and its surroundings.After our city tour, we'll return to our hotel in Durban for a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Durban - Enjoy a Free Day
package_itineraries.description: Today, you have the day to yourself to explore the city at your own pace. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Durban.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Leaving Durban
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying your morning meal, you'll be taken to King Shaka International Airport for your next flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town
package_itineraries.description: You'll land at Cape Town International Airport, where a friendly representative will greet you. They'll ensure your smooth transfer to your hotel. Afterward, the day is yours to explore at your own pace. Take a leisurely stroll around the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, known for its excellent restaurants and vibrant nightlife. It's one of Cape Town's most popular tourist destinations, nestled in a bustling harbor surrounded by pubs, eateries, craft markets, theaters, and more. With Robben Island and Table Mountain as its neighbors, this picturesque spot in the heart of Cape Town's harbor offers stunning views of the sea and mountains. You'll spend the night at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cape Town City Tour and Table Mountain
package_itineraries.description: After a delightful breakfast, embark on a half-day Cape Town city tour, including tickets for a visit to Table Mountain (weather permitting). Ascend to the summit of the iconic Table Mountain via a cable car, where you'll be treated to panoramic views of the city and the surrounding landscapes of this southernmost tip of Africa.Explore the country's oldest building, The Castle, and nearby, the well-preserved Company Gardens, both of which are steeped in captivating history. As you continue your drive, you'll pass by significant landmarks such as the Parliament Buildings, City Hall, and the Slave Lodge, each reflecting a rich historical tapestry through their unique architectural styles.Wander up the cobbled streets to the Malay Quarter, where the charming Bo-Kaap homes, adorned with vibrant, ice-cream-like colors, will captivate your senses. Witness the craftsmanship of a skilled diamond cutter as he transforms raw stones into every girl's dream gem.The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Relax and soak in the beauty of Cape Town. Spend the night at your hotel in this enchanting city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Full-Day Peninsula Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely cruise along the stunning stretch of coastline known as Millionaire's Paradise, starting from Clifton and continuing to Camps Bay, all the way to the exclusive beach haven of Llandudno. Our journey takes us to the delightful working harbour of Hout Bay, where you'll embark on a close encounter with the resident seals on Seal Island.Next, we'll wind our way along the renowned Chapman's Peak Drive, hugging the cliffs and relishing the breathtaking ocean views. Our lunch stop is at the Cape of Good Hope Section of the Table Mountain National Park, where you can choose your preferred dining spot (on your own account).We'll then meander back along the coast toward the city, visiting the historically significant naval port of Simon's Town and the endearing penguin colony at Boulder's Beach (expenses on your own account). To conclude our day, we'll head inland to our final destination at Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. As the sun sets over the towering peaks of Table Mountain, its last rays illuminate the trees and flowers in a spectacular display of nature's beauty. You'll spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cape Town to Sun City
package_itineraries.description: Following a delightful breakfast, it's time to check out and head to Cape Town International Airport for your flight to Johannesburg (please note that the flight is not included). Upon arrival in Johannesburg, you'll be transferred to the enchanting Sun City resort.Arriving at Sun City, you'll check in and have the entire day at your disposal to explore this expansive resort. Sun City stands as South Africa's premier holiday destination, offering an array of entertainment, relaxation options, and a variety of activities. The resort boasts world-class amenities, including golf courses, thrilling game viewing opportunities, a bustling casino, and four distinct top-notch hotels: The Palace of The Lost City, Cascades Hotel, Sun City Hotel, and The Cabanas.Don't miss the chance to experience 'The Valley of the Waves,' one of Sun City's star attractions. It features a vast wave pool, capable of generating impressive 1.8-meter waves every 90 minutes, along with a sandy beach and a selection of exhilarating rides that promise fun for the entire family.Beyond the excitement, Sun City offers a wide range of dining options in a complete food arcade, from casual to fine dining. Additionally, each of the four hotels at the resort boasts its own swimming pool, and Sun City provides an abundance of thrilling water activities. Water World, situated at the man-made Sun City Lake, offers opportunities for parasailing, water-skiing, wakeboarding, and leisurely lake cruises.Your overnight stay will be at the magnificent Sun City resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Sun City – Pilanesberg Wildlife Safari
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, embark on your exhilarating Pilanesberg Game Drive. Discover the wonders of Pilanesberg National Park, a sanctuary for the magnificent 'Big Five' and an array of other fascinating wildlife species. Despite its relatively small size, this park's unique ecological diversity significantly enhances your chances of encountering the Big 5 in their natural habitat.Our expertly guided tour through this renowned reserve takes place in specially adapted open safari vehicles. This ensures an unobstructed view for game viewing, photography, and birdwatching. There's nothing between you and wildlife! Our knowledgeable guides will enrich your experience with their profound knowledge of the bush, animal behaviour, and bird identification, all of which they'll gladly share with you. Not only will you savour this adventure, but you'll also leave with a treasure trove of newfound knowledge.Enjoy your overnight stay at the Sun City resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Leaving Sun City for Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: Following a hearty breakfast, you'll be chauffeured back to O.R Tambo International Airport for your onward journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Nairobi
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi, you'll disembark from your flight and go through immigration and customs procedures. Your welcoming team will be there to greet you and provide a smooth transfer to your hotel. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Nairobi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Nairobi to Tree Hotel
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, we'll depart from Nairobi in the morning and head towards Nyeri, a charming town nestled in Kenya's coffee-growing and dairy farming region, known as the former White Highlands.Upon reaching the base hotel, you'll be treated to a delicious lunch. Then, our adventure continues as we make our way to a unique tree hotel. Here, you'll experience an enchanting evening watching a procession of animals emerging from the forest. They gather at the floodlit water hole and salt lick, where they playfully jostle for the best spots.As the night falls, you have the option to stay awake and witness a captivating display of strength, with elephants engaging in friendly contests. However, even these gentle giants usually avoid challenging the mighty rhinoceros, keeping a respectful distance.In the case of Mountain Lodge, you'll arrive directly at the lodge for a delightful lunch. You'll enjoy your meals and spend the night at the Tree Hotel, surrounded by the natural beauty of the Kenyan wilderness. (Includes Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner)Remember to pack an overnight bag as you'll be transferring to the Ark for a unique experience in the heart of the forest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tree Hotel to Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a short morning drive to the Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club, located at the base of the awe-inspiring Mount Kenya, standing tall at 17,058 feet. En route, you'll have the exciting opportunity to pause and visit the Equator, adding a unique geographical experience to your journey.With its panoramic vistas of the majestic Mount Kenya, the Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club Resort offers a true blend of comfort, relaxation, and adventure. The resort boasts 120 luxuriously appointed hotel rooms set amidst sprawling 100-acre landscaped gardens. Originally established as the private retreat of renowned movie star and club founder, William Holden, this esteemed establishment has hosted legendary figures like Winston Churchill and Bing Crosby.The Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club offers a wealth of recreational activities to make your stay truly unforgettable. You can enjoy activities such as horseback riding, golf, croquet, a bowling green, table tennis, swimming, and even a relaxing visit to the on-site beauty salon. For nature enthusiasts, the hotel features an animal orphanage, providing a unique opportunity to get up close with local wildlife.After a delightful lunch, the remainder of the day is yours to explore and partake in the various activities offered at the hotel. Whether you're seeking adventure or relaxation, this magnificent resort has something for everyone.Relish your meals at the Fairmont Mount Kenya Safari Club as you enjoy the exquisite blend of British cuisine with the captivating backdrop of Mount Kenya. Enjoy a comfortable and lavish overnight stay at the resort. (Includes Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner)

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mount Kenya to Nakuru/Naivasha
package_itineraries.description: Today's journey takes us over the stunning Aberdare Mountain range. We pause briefly to admire the breathtaking Thompson's Falls, a majestic 73-meter waterfall named after the Scottish explorer Joseph Thompson, who first laid eyes on it in 1884.We continue our adventure to Nakuru, where we'll enjoy a delicious lunch. In the afternoon, get ready for an exciting game drive. Nakuru National Park is teeming with wildlife, and the birdwatching opportunities are truly remarkable. The park is famous for hosting magnificent flocks of both lesser and Greater Flamingos, turning the lakeshores into a striking stretch of pink.Nakuru is a bird lover's paradise, boasting over 400 bird species, including White Pelicans, Plovers, Egrets, and Marabou Storks. It's also one of the few places in Africa where you can spot the White Rhino and the rare Rothschild Giraffe.Tonight, we'll settle in for a comfortable stay at a lodge in Nakuru or Naivasha, where you can relish breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Nakuru/Naivasha to Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: After a satisfying breakfast, embark on a scenic drive through the breathtaking Great Rift Valley to reach the renowned Masai Mara National Reserve. This expansive reserve is a part of the vast Serengeti plains, famous for the incredible annual wildebeest migration and is the habitat of the Big Five: Lions, Elephants, Leopards, Buffaloes, and Rhinos.Enjoy a delicious lunch at your lodge or camp and take some time to relax before setting out on an afternoon game drive. The Masai Mara Game Reserve is one of the world's most extraordinary wilderness areas, where you'll encounter a diverse array of large mammals. Some of the resident wildlife species in the park include Maasai Giraffes, Buffaloes, Elands, and thousands of plains game such as Impalas, Zebras, Topis, as well as both Thomson's and Grant's Gazelles.Conclude your day with a hearty meal and spend the night at a comfortable lodge or camp in the heart of the Mara. This includes Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, we set out for a morning game-viewing drive-in search of the diverse wildlife that calls this reserve home. With a bit of luck, you might witness a thrilling live hunt unfolding right before your amazed eyes!Following a delicious lunch at your lodge, embark on another exhilarating game drive, with a chance to encounter the renowned 'Big 5.' Enjoy your meals and spend the night at a lodge or camp in Mara. Complimentary Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner are provided.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Masai Mara to Nairobi
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your breakfast and then check out of your accommodation. It's time to make the journey back to Nairobi, arriving in time for lunch. You can choose your lunch venue. Afterward, we'll arrange your transfer to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town
package_itineraries.description: When you land at Cape Town International Airport, a friendly representative will be there to greet you and take you to your hotel. After your transfer, the rest of the day is yours to explore at your own pace. You'll spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cape Town - Morning City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today, we set out for a half-day city tour of Cape Town. If the weather allows, we'll visit Table Mountain. We'll drive past the Castle of Good Hope, the Company Gardens, the Parliament Buildings, the City Hall, and the Slave Lodge. We'll also pass by the vibrant Malay Quarter and make a stop to visit the Diamond Cutters. Our tour concludes at the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, where you can enjoy some shopping before returning to your hotel. Spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cape Town – Full-Day Cape Peninsula Tour
package_itineraries.description: On this full-day Cape Peninsula tour, we have an exciting itinerary for you:We'll start with a stop at Hout Bay Harbour, where you can enjoy a Seal Island Cruise.If Chapmans Peak Drive is open, we'll take you on a scenic drive along this stunning route.For lunch, you're free to choose your own meal (at your own expense).Next, we'll visit the beautiful Cape Point National Park and take a Funicular Tour.Then, we're off to see Simons Town and the charming Boulders Beach Penguin Colony.Finally, we'll explore the enchanting Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens.You'll spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cape Town to Sun City (Flight Not Included)
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast and then check out of the hotel. You'll be taken to Cape Town International Airport for your flight to Johannesburg. When you arrive at O.R. Tambo International Airport in Johannesburg, you'll be met and taken to your hotel.In the late afternoon, you'll check in and have the rest of the day to explore the extensive resort. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Sun City - Free Day
package_itineraries.description: Today is a day for you to enjoy yourself, exploring the resort's activities and amenities. You'll spend the night at the Sun City hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Sun City to Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast at your hotel, then check out and head to your hotel in Johannesburg. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy as you please. You'll stay overnight at your Johannesburg hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Johannesburg to Victoria Falls, Zambia (Flight Not Included)
package_itineraries.description: Leave your hotel and head to O.R. Tambo International for your flight to Victoria Falls, Zambia. Upon arriving in Zambia, a Thompsons Africa representative will meet you and take you to your hotel. Check in, and then enjoy the rest of the day at your own pace. You can choose from optional tours for an extra cost. Spend the night at the hotel in Zambia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Victoria Falls, Zambia
package_itineraries.description: Today, you'll join a guided group tour to explore the spectacular Victoria Falls. Afterward, you have the afternoon free to relax or choose from optional activities available at an extra cost:Take a 15-minute helicopter flight for $189.00 per person.Enjoy Elephant Interactions for $80.00 per person.Choose for a full-day Chobe Tour in Botswana, which includes lunch, for $170.00 per person.In the evening, unwind at your hotel and spend a leisurely night in Zambia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Victoria Falls, Zambia to Nairobi (Flight Not Included)
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, we'll take you to Livingstone Airport for your flight to Nairobi. After arriving in Nairobi, we'll arrange your transfer to the hotel. The rest of the day is free for you to enjoy at your leisure. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Nairobi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Nairobi to Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: After having breakfast, the rest of the day is yours to enjoy leisurely activities at the resort. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Masai Mara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Nairobi to Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a whole day exploring the beauty of Masai Mara with morning and afternoon game drives. Rest for the night at the hotel in Masai Mara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Masai Mara to Nairobi
package_itineraries.description: We will head back to Nairobi today and should arrive by the afternoon. After reaching Nairobi, check in at your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to relax and enjoy yourself. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Nairobi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Nairobi - Explore the City
package_itineraries.description: Take a mini van for a tour of the city. Afterward, return to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at your own pace. Spend the night at your Nairobi hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Leaving Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: This morning, you'll be taken to Nairobi Airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Lucknow - Ayodhya
package_itineraries.description: On your arrival at Lucknow Airport, you will be greeted by the tour representative who will assist you with your transfer to the hotel. After check-in and a brief rest, begin your journey towards Ayodhya. The scenic drive of approximately 2.5 hours passes through picturesque villages and lush fields.Your sightseeing begins with the Ram Janmabhoomi Temple, followed by visits to the Nageshwarnath Temple—believed to be founded by Lord Rama’s son Kush—Kanak Bhawan, Treta ke Thakur, and Sita ki Rasoi, an ancient kitchen shrine associated with Goddess Sita. Each site resonates with deep mythological connections and divine charm.Overnight stay will be arranged in Ayodhya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Ayodhya - Allahabad - Varanasi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Prayagraj (Allahabad) to visit the sacred Triveni Sangam, where the holy rivers Ganga, Yamuna, and Saraswati converge. Continue to explore the Alopi Devi Shakti Peeth Temple, Hanuman Temple, Khusro Baugh, and the historic Anand Bhavan Museum, the ancestral home of the Nehru family.Later, proceed to Varanasi and check into your hotel for an overnight stay in the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Varanasi Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Rise early for the serene morning Ganga Aarti at Assi Ghat, followed by a refreshing boat ride and ritual ablutions in the sacred river. Visit the famous Kashi Vishwanath Temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva, and continue to the Maa Annapurna Mandir, Sankat Mochan Hanuman Mandir, Tulsi Manas Mandir, Kaal Bhairav Mandir, and Durga Kund Mandir. In the evening, enjoy another spiritual moment with the grand Maha Aarti on the Assi Ghat. Take a boat tour to witness the beauty of the renowned ghats such as Manikarnika, Munshi, Dashashwamedh, Scindia, and Man Mandir Ghats, each holding its own story and tradition.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart Varanasi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and make a short visit to Kanak Bhavan, also known as the Golden Palace. Then proceed to Varanasi Airport for your flight home, concluding a deeply spiritual and memorable pilgrimage through India’s most sacred cities.

package_itineraries.title: Best Budget Maldives Tour Packages
package_itineraries.description: The Maldives is often thought of as a luxury-only destination, but it also offers plenty of opportunities for travelers who are conscious about their budget. From affordable guesthouses on local islands to budget-friendly resort stays, visitors can enjoy the charm of turquoise waters, white sand beaches, and vibrant coral reefs without overspending. Many (Maldives tour packages) include cost-effective options such as half-board or full-board meals, shared transfers, and local excursions that don’t compromise the experience. For couples, families, or solo travelers, budget Maldives holiday packages are designed to provide the same island beauty and adventures at a fraction of luxury costs. With careful planning, it’s possible to experience water sports, dolphin cruises, and cultural tours while staying within budget.

package_itineraries.title: Ten Reasons To Visit Maldives
package_itineraries.description: Each of these reasons highlights why Maldives is not just another tropical getaway but a once-in-a-lifetime journey for many.Pristine Beaches – Soft powdery sands and clear lagoons create postcard-perfect views.Luxury Resorts – World-class resorts with private villas and overwater bungalows.Marine Life – Encounter manta rays, whale sharks, and colorful coral reefs.Romantic Escapes – Perfect for honeymoons and couples’ getaways.Adventure Activities – Diving, snorkeling, parasailing, and night fishing.Underwater Dining – Unique restaurants offering meals beneath the ocean surface.Wellness Retreats – Rejuvenating spas and yoga with sea views.Local Culture – Visit Malé and nearby islands to explore Maldivian traditions.Privacy & Seclusion – Hundreds of private islands offering exclusivity.Sunsets & Stargazing – Golden sunsets and breathtaking night skies enhance the experience.

package_itineraries.title: Maldives Tour Experience
package_itineraries.description: A Maldives tour experience is a combination of adventure, romance, and pure relaxation. From the moment you step off the plane and transfer by speedboat or seaplane, the panoramic views of turquoise waters set the tone for your trip. Travelers can choose to spend their days lounging on pristine beaches, indulging in world-class spa therapies, or diving into the ocean to explore vibrant reefs. Evening highlights often include romantic candlelight dinners by the sea, beach barbecues, or sunset cruises on a traditional dhoni. Families can enjoy safe, shallow lagoons, while honeymooners can opt for secluded overwater villas with direct access to the ocean. Every moment in the Maldives is carefully crafted to leave lasting memories, whether through adventure, relaxation, or cultural discovery.

package_itineraries.title: Best Places To Visit In Maldives
package_itineraries.description: These destinations provide a mix of culture, adventure, and pure natural beauty, making them must-visits for anyone booking Maldives tour packages.Malé – The bustling capital city known for its markets, mosques, and museums.Maafushi – A popular local island offering budget-friendly stays and activities.Hulhumalé – A reclaimed island with modern infrastructure and beaches.Banana Reef – Famous for diving and rich marine biodiversity.Ari Atoll – Renowned for luxury resorts and whale shark sightings.Biyadhoo Island – A diver’s paradise with easy reef access.Baros Island – Romantic luxury with overwater bungalows and spa retreats.Vaadhoo Island – Known for its magical "Sea of Stars" glowing beach phenomenon.

package_itineraries.title: Relationship Between India and Maldives
package_itineraries.description: India and Maldives share a long-standing relationship built on cultural, historical, and geographical ties. Due to its proximity, India has always been one of the Maldives’ strongest partners in trade, tourism, and defense cooperation. Indian travelers form a large part of the Maldives’ tourist population, making it one of the top source markets. Both countries engage in joint security exercises, medical collaborations, and educational exchanges, strengthening their bilateral ties. For Indian tourists, easy flight connectivity and visa-on-arrival facilities make traveling to the Maldives seamless and convenient. The bond between the two nations continues to grow, enhancing tourism opportunities and mutual development.

travel_services.title: Flight Ticket Booking
travel_services.short_desc: Domestic & international flights with exclusive corporate and group fares.
travel_services.details: Instant ticketing across all major international and domestic airlines with flexible rescheduling, extra baggage allowance assistance, and 24/7 flight delay monitoring.

travel_services.title: Bus Ticket Booking
travel_services.short_desc: Comfortable sleeper & semi-sleeper Volvo buses across India.
travel_services.details: Curated intercity luxury coach bookings with guaranteed seat selection, verified operator safety ratings, and contactless digital boarding passes.

travel_services.title: Car Rental & Chauffeur Services
travel_services.short_desc: Clean, sanitized sedans, luxury SUVs, and tempo travelers with polite drivers.
travel_services.details: From airport drop-offs to multi-day hill station tours, choose from Toyota Crysta, Fortuner, Mercedes E-Class, and spacious luxury vans.

travel_services.title: Luxury Cruise Booking
travel_services.short_desc: Royal Caribbean, Cordelia, and European river cruise reservations.
travel_services.details: Sail through Southeast Asia, the Mediterranean, or the Indian coastline with ocean-view balconies, Broadway shows, and all-inclusive gourmet dining.

travel_services.title: Hotel Reservations
travel_services.short_desc: Verified 3-star, 4-star, and 5-star luxury heritage resorts worldwide.
travel_services.details: Special negotiated travel agency rates, complimentary room upgrades, early check-in requests, and free daily breakfast packages.

travel_services.title: Visa Assistance Services
travel_services.short_desc: Hassle-free Schengen, USA, UK, UAE, and Singapore visa documentation.
travel_services.details: Expert end-to-end guidance on application preparation, cover letter drafting, appointment scheduling, and biometrics interview readiness.

travel_services.title: Travel Insurance Assistance
travel_services.short_desc: Comprehensive medical, flight delay, baggage loss, and trip cancellation cover.
travel_services.details: Zero-deductible overseas medical emergency cover accepted by Schengen consulates, with 24/7 cashless hospitalization assistance.

travel_services.title: Airport Transfers
travel_services.short_desc: Punctual meet & greet transfers at over 350 airports globally.
travel_services.details: Professional English-speaking chauffeurs waiting at arrival gates with name boards, flight tracking for delays, and fixed transparent pricing.

travel_services.title: Web Check-In Assistance
travel_services.short_desc: Automatic seat allocation, baggage tagging, and digital boarding pass delivery.
travel_services.details: Skip airport queues: our operations team automatically completes web check-in as soon as airline windows open and WhatsApps boarding passes to you.

travel_services.title: Customized Travel Itineraries
travel_services.short_desc: Bespoke holiday planning tailored to your exact budget, pace, and interests.
travel_services.details: Personal travel designer creates hour-by-hour itineraries with secret photo spots, offbeat culinary stops, and private guides.
